units.he: א"ה מבואר בדברי רבינו הקדוש אור האורות מוהר"נ זצ"ל בכמה מקומות בספרו הק' לקוטי מוהר"ן ובשיחותיו הק' מענין התיקונים הנפלאים שנעשו ע"י שבאים אצל הצדיק האמת על ראש השנה, ובסימן ס"א במאמר חדי ר"ש מבואר שעי"ז נמתקין כל הדינים וכו', ובסימן רי"א מבואר שזוכין עי"ז לקדושת וטהרת המחשבה ועי"ז נמתקין הדינים כי כולהו במחשבה איתברירו, ובליקות"נ סי' א' במאמר תקעו ממשלה מבואר מענין הצדיקים הגדולים שהם בבחי'מקומו של עולם והם יכולים לעשות ר"ה. ובמאמר תקעו אמונה סי' ה' מבואר הרבה מענין התקונים הנפלאים שנעשים ע"י קיבוץ התלמידים אצל הרבי האמיתי ועיקר זמן הקיבוץ הוא בר"ה, ובסי' מ' מי שיודע מא"י מבוארג"כ שעיקר הקיבוץ הגדול אצל הצדיק הוא בר"ה ומי שזוכה להיות אצל צדיק אמיתי על ר"ה אז יבכל מקום שהאיש הזה מסתכל נעשה אותו האויר בבחי' אוירא דא"י, ועוד מבואר בכמה מאמרים בספריו ז"ל מענין קדושת ר"ה ותקיעות שופר וכלל קדושת חודש תשרי, ועיין בליקות"נ סי' צ"ד מבואר ג"כ מענין שצריכין לנסוע לצדיקים על ר"ה, אך ביותר דיבר הרבה פעמים בעל פה כמבוארקצת מזה בשיחותיו הק', ואמר בפירוש שכל ענינו ועסקו הוא ר"ה ואמר הראש השנה שלי עולה על הכל, והזהיר עלכל המקורבים אליו שיהיו כולם אצלו על ר"ה איש לא יעדר כי כל ענין שלי הוא רק ר"ה וכו', ופעם אחת אמר אצלי העיקר הוא ר"ה וכו' גם אמר הר"ה שלי הוא חידוש גדול וכו' לא מיבעיא אתם כולכם בוודאי תלויים בר"ה שלי אלא אפילו כל העולם כולו תלוי בר"ה שלי. ובערב ר"ה האחרון מימי חייו הקדושים דיבר הרבה מאד מענין זה מגודל החיוב וההכרח להיו תאצלו על ר"ה כל המקורבים אליו וענה ואמר בקול חזק מעומק הלב מה אומר לכם אין דבר גדול מזה (היינו להיות אצלו על ר"ה). ופעם אחת אמר שבר"ה הוא עושה ענינים ותיקונים (היינו גם לנפשות המקורבים אליו ובאים אצלו על ר"ה) מה שבכל השנה גם הוא איננו יכול לעשותם, והנה ממשמעות דבריו ובפרט מה שדיבר הרבה בענין זה בערב ר"ה האחרון כנ"ל הבינו התלמידים הק' ז"ל שרצונו חזק להתקבץ אליו על ר"ה כל המקורבים אליו גם לאחר הסתלקותו היינו להתפלל על קברו בערב ר"ה כמבואר בשו"ע שנוהגין לילך להתפלל על קברי צדיקים בערב ר"ה וגם בר"ה יתפללו כל הקיבוץ הק' שלו ביחד ובהתקשרות אליו ז"ל ולכל הצדיקים שבדור ושהם שוכני עפר וכמבואר במ"א ועי"ז יהיו נעשים תיקונים נפלאים כמו בחיים חיותו ז"ל, וקימו וקיבלו תלמידיו ז"ל והסכימו לעשות כן בכל ר"ה, ובעז"ה שכבר זה יותר מששים שנה*) אחר הסתלקותו ז"ל ואעפי"כ הדבר נוהג בין אנ"ש לדורות עולם כמפורסם וקצת מבואר בזה במ"א בביאור יותר, והנה בר"ה הזה בא על דעתי מאחר שאמר רבינו ז"ל בפה מלא שכל ענינו וכל עסקו הוא ר"ה וכלל הנ"ל א"כ מובן הרבה ממילא שבכל המאמרים שלו הק' הגם שלא נאמרו בר"ה ולא נזכר בהם כלל ענין ר"ה אעפי"כ בודאי נעלם ומלובש בהם ג"כ ענין ר"ה, ע"כ נתתי את לבי לעיין במאמריו ז,ל ולחפש בהם אולי אמצא איזה רמזים מענין ר"ה בכל מאמר ממאמריו ז"ל, ובעז"ה מצאתי קצת רמזים ברוב מאמריו ז"ל מענין ר"ה, והנה ידוע מה שמבואר בספרי קודש מענין קדושת ראש השנה שכלול בו קדושת כל השנה כולה וכפי מה שזוכה האדם לקבל קדושת ר"ה כמו כן זוכה להתנהג בקדושת עבודתו את ה' בכל השנה כולה ובפרט כל קדושת הזמנים של החודש תשרי כגון קדושת יו"כ סוכות וכל קדושת המצוות הנוהגות בהם עד אחר שמיני עצרת בוודאי הכל כלול גם בקדושת ר"ה, וכמובן בזוה"ק ובכוונת האריז"ל כי כל התקונים הנעשים מר"ה עד אחר שמיני עצרת כולם קשורים ומשולבים זה בזה ומחמת כל זה רמזתי בהם עפ"י רוב גם ענין יו"כ סוכות ושמע"צ, ומחמת שידעתי גודל ערך פחיתות מדריגת שכלי הדל הגם כי חזק אני בדעתי שבוודאי יש בכל מאמריו ז,ל מענין ר"ה וכו' כנ"ל אבל ידעתי שאם היתה דעתי רחבה יותר בוודאי יש לבאר בזה נפלאות רבות בדברי רבותינו ז"ל בנסתר ונגלה, כי מאד עמקו ונשגבו מחשבותיו של רבינו הק' זצ"ל ונעלם בהם במאמריו ז"ל פליאות חכמה הרבה מאד, ומחמת גודל קט שכלי רחוק אני מלהשיג זאת ומי יתן ואזכה להבין קצת עכ"פ פשיטות דבריו הק' ז"ל, ע"כ קצרתי בכל ענינים אלו בכל האפשר ולא באתי בזה רק להזכיר ולעורר לב המעיין לחפש בכל מאמריו ז"ל מענין קדושת ר"ה וכו' ובוודאי מי שדעתו רחבה באמת וישים דעתו ולןבו לדברים אלה ימצא בזה פלאות רבות והיה זה שכרי אשר התחלתי לילך בדרך זה, אעפי"כ שאין ביכלתו לגמור הדבר בשלימות כראוי, וכבר אמרו רז"ל כל פטטיא דאורייתא טבין, וכשזוכין לכוין באמת קצת רק בדבר אחד מדברי תורה בוודאי יקר מכל הון ולא יערכנה זהב וכסף וכו'. ומחמת כל הנ"ל במקום שידעתי שכבר מבואר בספר לקוטי הלכות ענין ר"ה וכו' ע"פ מאמר זה רשמתי רק לעיין שם בלקוטי הלכות ולא ראיתי לבאר בזה עוד וקיימתי בזה מקרא שכתוב ובמקום גדולים אל תעמוד, ומכ"ש במאמרים אשר רבינו ז,ל בעצמו ביאר בהם שזה ענין ר"ה וכו' בוודאי יראתי לנגוע בהם כי מה לתבן את הבר ואין מערבין חול בקודש קדשים, וגת זאת ידע המעיין כי כל הדברים האלה נכתבו עפ"י רוב בקיצור גדול ובדרך ראשי פרקים בעלמא ומחמת זה יראה למעיין בהשקפה ראשונה בכמה מקומות שאין הדברים מבוארים ומסודרים כראוי בשלימות וכאשר ישים את לבו לעיין בהם בעין האמת בטחתי בהשי"ת שימצא בהם טעם ויפתחו עיני שכלו למצוא הרבה סגולות יקרות המרומזים בדברי רבותינו ז"ל בענינים אלו וכיוצא בהם.
units.en:
[א"ה]
It is explained in the words of our holy Rebbe, the Light of Lights,
our teacher R' Nachman, of blessed memory — in many places in his holy book
Likutay Moharan and in his holy conversations —
regarding the topic of the wondrous rectifications
that are accomplished by those who come to the true Tzadik
on Rosh HaShanah.

In Likutay Moharan I:61, in the discourse beginning “חדי ר"ש,”
it is explained that through this [being near the Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah]
all judgments are sweetened, etc.
And in Likutay Moharan I:211, it is explained that one thereby merits the holiness and purity of thought,
and through this the judgments are sweetened — for "they are all clarified in thought".

And in Likutay Moharan II:1, in the discourse beginning “תקעו ממשלה,” it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension of being the Place of the World
— and they are able to perform the [spiritual work of] Rosh HaShanah.
And in Likutay Moharan II:5, the discourse beginning “תקעו אמונה,”
much is explained regarding the wondrous rectifications
that are wrought through the gathering of the disciples near the true Rebbe —
and the primary time of gathering is on Rosh HaShanah.

In Likutay Moharan II:40, the discourse beginning “מי שיודע מא"י,” it is explained likewise
that the primary great gathering near the Tzadik is on Rosh HaShanah,
and one who merits to be near a true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah —
in every place that this person gazes,
the air there becomes of the dimension of the air of Eretz Yisroel.

And more is explained in many discourses in his holy books
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, the soundings of the Shofar,
and the general holiness of the month of Tishray.
See also Likutay Moharan II:94,
which likewise explains that one must travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah.

But beyond what is written, he spoke about this many times orally,
as is explained somewhat in his holy conversations.
He said explicitly that
"all his purpose and all his concern is Rosh HaShanah",
and he declared: "My Rosh HaShanah surpasses everything."
He admonished all those close to him that they should all be with him on Rosh HaShanah —
not one absent —
for "all my affair is only Rosh HaShanah," etc.

And once he said:
"With me, the main thing is Rosh HaShanah" — and also:
"My Rosh HaShanah is a great novelty …
not only are you all certainly dependent on my Rosh HaShanah,
but even all the world — the entire world — depends upon my Rosh HaShanah."

On the last Erev Rosh HaShanah of his holy life,
he spoke very much about this —
about the great obligation and necessity for all those close to him
to be with him on Rosh HaShanah.
He answered and said in a strong voice, from the depths of his heart:
"What shall I tell you? There is nothing greater than this"
— meaning, to be with him on Rosh HaShanah.

And once he said that on Rosh HaShanah he performs matters and rectifications
— even for the souls of those close to him who come to him on Rosh HaShanah —
that throughout the entire year, even he himself cannot perform them.

From the import of his words — and especially from what he spoke so much about on the last Erev Rosh HaShanah,
as mentioned — his holy disciples, z"l, understood that
his firm will was that all those close to him should gather to him on Rosh HaShanah
even after his passing —
that is, to pray at his grave on Erev Rosh HaShanah,
as is explained in the Shulchan Aruch that it is the custom to go and pray at the graves of Tzadikim
on Erev Rosh HaShanah.
And also on Rosh HaShanah itself, all his holy gathering would pray together in connection with him, z"l,
and with all the Tzadikim of the generation
and those who dwell in the dust —
and thereby wondrous rectifications would be accomplished,
just as during his physical lifetime.

His disciples, z"l, accepted this upon themselves and agreed to do so every Rosh HaShanah.
And with G-d's help, this has already been [the practice] for more than sixty years*
after his passing, z"l —
and even so, the matter continues among the Anash [Breslov Chassidim]
for generations eternal, as is well known.
Some of this is explained elsewhere in greater detail.

Now, on this Rosh HaShanah,
it occurred to me:
since our Rebbe, z"l, declared explicitly and with full voice
that all his purpose and all his concern is Rosh HaShanah —
and since this is the general principle stated above —
it is understood on its own
that in all of his holy discourses,
even those not delivered on Rosh HaShanah
and in which Rosh HaShanah is not mentioned at all —
nonetheless, the topic of Rosh HaShanah is certainly hidden and clothed within them as well.

Therefore I set my heart to examine his discourses, z"l,
and to search within them —
perhaps I would find some allusions to the topic of Rosh HaShanah in each of his discourses.
And with G-d's help, I found some allusions in most of his discourses, z"l, to the topic of Rosh HaShanah.

It is well known, as is explained in holy books,
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah —
that it encompasses the holiness of the entire year.
To the extent that one merits to receive the holiness of Rosh HaShanah,
to that same extent one merits to conduct oneself in the holiness of one's service to G-d
throughout the entire year.
And in particular, all the holiness of the festive times of the month of Tishray —
such as the holiness of Yom Kippur, Sukkos,
and all the holiness of the mitzvos observed during them
until after the Eighth Day of Assembly —
is certainly all included within the holiness of Rosh HaShanah.

As is understood in the holy Zohar and in the intentions of the Ar"i z"l:
all the rectifications that are accomplished from Rosh HaShanah
until after the Eighth Day of Assembly are all bound and interwoven with one another.
Because of this, I have mostly alluded within them also to the topic of Yom Kippur, Sukkos, and the Eighth Day of Assembly.

Because I knew the great weight of the smallness of my poor understanding —
even though I am firm in my view that certainly in each of his discourses, z"l,
there is the topic of Rosh HaShanah as mentioned above —
still, I knew that if my understanding were broader,
one could certainly explain within this many wonders from the words of our Rabbis, z"l,
in the hidden and revealed Torah.
For the thoughts of our holy Rebbe, z"l, are very deep and exalted,
and very many wonders of wisdom are hidden within his discourses.

Because of the great smallness of my understanding,
I am far from grasping this —
and would that I merit to understand at least the plain meaning of his holy words, z"l.
Therefore I have abbreviated in all these matters as much as possible,
and have come here only to mention and to arouse the heart of the reader
to search through each of his discourses, z"l,
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, etc. —
and certainly one whose understanding is truly broad,
who sets his mind and heart to these matters,
will find therein many wonders.
And this shall be my reward —
that I have begun to walk on this path —
even though he is unable to complete the matter in its proper entirety.

The Sages, z"l, have already said:
"All talk of Torah is good"
— and when one merits to touch upon the truth even a little, in just one matter of Torah,
it is certainly more precious than all wealth,
and gold and silver cannot be compared to it.

Because of all the above:
in places where I knew that the topic of Rosh HaShanah as understood through a given discourse
is already explained in Likutay Halachos,
I noted only to look there — and I did not see fit to explain it further,
fulfilling the verse: "And in the place of the great — do not stand"
[Prov. 25:6].
All the more so in discourses where our Rebbe, z"l, himself explained
that this is the topic of Rosh HaShanah —
I certainly feared to touch them,
for "What has straw to do with grain?"
[Jer. 23:28]
and one does not mix the mundane with the holy of holies.

Also, the reader should know:
all these matters were written mostly in great brevity and in the manner of mere chapter-headings.
Because of this, in many places it will appear to the reader at first glance
that the matters are not explained and ordered as is proper.
But when one sets one's heart to study them with a truthful eye —
I trust in Hashem Yisburach that one will find in them a taste,
and the eyes of one's understanding will open
to find many precious virtues
hinted at in the words of our Rabbis, z"l, in these and similar matters.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Miraculous Rectifications Wrought on Rosh HaShanah by Being near the True Tzadik

Aleph-Hay [abbreviation: א״ה = "with G-d's help"]:
It is explained in the words of our holy Rebbe, the Light of Lights,
Mohara"n, z"l — in many places in his holy book
Likutay Mohara"n and in his holy conversations —
regarding the topic of the wondrous rectifications (tikkunim nifloim)
that are accomplished by those who come to the true Tzadik
on Rosh HaShanah.

In Siman 61 [of Likutay Mohara"n], in the discourse beginning Chadi Reish,
it is explained that through this [being near the Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah]
all judgments (dinim) are sweetened [and nullified], etc.
And in Siman 211, it is explained that one thereby merits the holiness and purity of thought,
and through this the judgments are sweetened — for "all things are clarified within [the faculty of] thought"
[Zohar].

And in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 1, in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola
["Blow the Shofar of Sovereignty"], it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension (bechia) of being the Place of the World
— and they are able to perform the [spiritual work of] Rosh HaShanah.
And in the discourse Tik'u Emuna, Siman 5,
much is explained regarding the wondrous rectifications
that are wrought through the gathering of the disciples near the true Rebbe —
and the primary time of gathering is on Rosh HaShanah.

In Siman 40, Mi SheYodeia M'Eretz Yisroel
["One Who Knows from Eretz Yisroel"], it is explained likewise
that the primary great gathering near the Tzadik is on Rosh HaShanah,
and one who merits to be near a true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah —
in every place that this person gazes,
the air there becomes of the dimension of the air of Eretz Yisroel.

And more is explained in many discourses in his holy books
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, the soundings of the Shofar,
and the general holiness of the month of Tishray.
See also Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 94,
which likewise explains that one must travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah.

But beyond what is written, he spoke about this many times orally,
as is explained somewhat in his holy conversations.
He said explicitly that
"all his purpose and all his concern is Rosh HaShanah",
and he declared: "My Rosh HaShanah surpasses everything."
He admonished all those close to him that they should all be with him on Rosh HaShanah —
not one absent —
for "all my affair is only Rosh HaShanah," etc.

And once he said:
"With me, the main thing is Rosh HaShanah" — and also:
"My Rosh HaShanah is a great novelty (chidush) …
not only are you all certainly bound to my Rosh HaShanah,
but even all the world — the entire world — depends upon my Rosh HaShanah."

An asterisk follows the Hebrew reference to more than sixty years. No associated footnote text is supplied in this Hebrew field.
The supplied Hebrew shifts from a first-person account to the third-person form ביכלתו ("in his ability"). The English retains that shift; the Hebrew has not been changed.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וקראתי שם הכרך הקטן הזה "ירח האיתנים" על שם מאמר הכתוב בירח האיתנים בחג הוא החודש השביעי ודרז"ל ירח שהוא מאותן ותקיף במצוות שזה יסוד כל הכרך הזה על חודש תשרי עם כל החגים והמצוות הק' הנוהגות בו, וה' ישים חלקנו בתורתו וישים בלבינו אהבתו ויראתו לעשות רצנוו ולעבדו בלבב שלם אכי"ר.
units.en: I called this small volume “Yerach Hu'Aisuneem,” after the verse, “In the month of Hu'Aisuneem, at the festival, which is the seventh month.” Our Sages of blessed memory expounded: a month that is strong and mighty in mitzvos. This is the foundation of the entire volume: the month of Tishray, with all the festivals and holy mitzvos observed in it. May Hashem place our portion in His Torah and place His love and fear in our hearts, to do His will and serve Him with a whole heart. Amen, so may it be His will.

From the import of his words — and especially from what he spoke so much about on the last Erev Rosh HaShanah,
as mentioned — his holy disciples, z"l, understood that
his firm will was that all those close to him should gather to him on Rosh HaShanah
even after his passing —
that is, to pray at his grave on Erev Rosh HaShanah,
as is explained in the Shulchan Aruch that it is the custom to go and pray at the graves of Tzadikim
on Erev Rosh HaShanah.
And also on Rosh HaShanah itself, all his holy gathering would pray together in connection with him, z"l,
and with all the Tzadikim of the generation
— those who dwell in the dust —
and thereby wondrous rectifications would be accomplished,
just as during his physical lifetime.

His disciples, z"l, accepted this upon themselves and agreed to do so every Rosh HaShanah.
And with G-d's help, this has already been [the practice] for more than sixty years*
after his passing, z"l —
and even so, the matter continues among the Anash [Breslov Chassidim]
for generations eternal, as is well known.

The asterisk (*) refers to the time of original composition of this work, over sixty years after Rebbe Nachman's passing in 5571 (1810 CE). Rabbi Nachman of Tchehrin composed this work in the later 19th century.

Now, on this Rosh HaShanah,
it occurred to me:
since our Rebbe, z"l, declared explicitly and with full voice
that all his purpose and all his concern is Rosh HaShanah —
and since this is the general principle stated above —
it is understood on its own
that in all of his holy discourses,
even those not delivered on Rosh HaShanah
and in which Rosh HaShanah is not mentioned at all —
nonetheless, the topic of Rosh HaShanah is certainly hidden and clothed within them as well.

Therefore I set my heart to examine his discourses, z"l,
and to search within them —
perhaps I would find some allusions (rmazim) to the topic of Rosh HaShanah in each of his discourses.
And with G-d's help, I found some allusions in most of his discourses, z"l, to the topic of Rosh HaShanah.

It is well known, as is explained in holy books,
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah —
that it encompasses the holiness of the entire year.
Just as one merits to receive the holiness of Rosh HaShanah,
so one merits to conduct oneself in the holiness of one's service to G-d
throughout the entire year.
And in particular, all the holiness of the festive times of the month of Tishray —
such as the holiness of Yom Kippur, Sukkos,
and all the holiness of the mitzvos observed during them
until after Sh'mini Atzeres —
is certainly all included within the holiness of Rosh HaShanah.

As is understood in the holy Zohar and in the intentions (kavanos) of the Ar"i z"l:
all the rectifications that are accomplished from Rosh HaShanah
until after Sh'mini Atzeres are all bound and interwoven with one another.
Because of this, I have mostly alluded within them also to the topic of Yom Kippur, Sukkos, and Sh'mini Atzeres.

units.he: [אמר המעתיק, אפשר שקרא החבר ספר הק' הזה ירח האתנים כמו שכתוב במלכים ח' חסר כי ירח האתנים עם הכולל בגימטריא נחמן בן הרב צבי אריה לרמז שמו בקריאת שם הספר כמו שכתבו הקדמונים ז"ל:]
units.en: [The copyist said: Possibly the colleague called this holy book “Yerach Hu'Aisuneem,” with “האתנים” spelled without the yud as in Kings, chapter 8, because “ירח האתנים,” with one added for the phrase as a whole, has the numerical value of “נחמן בן הרב צבי אריה,” thus alluding to his name in the name of the book, as the early authorities of blessed memory wrote.]

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because I knew the great weight of the smallness of my poor understanding —
even though I am firm in my view that certainly in each of his discourses, z"l,
there is the topic of Rosh HaShanah as mentioned above —
still, I knew that if my understanding were broader,
one could certainly explain within this many wonders from the words of our Rabbis, z"l,
in the hidden and revealed Torah.
For the thoughts of our holy Rebbe, z"l, are very deep and exalted,
and wonders of wisdom are hidden within his discourses.

Because of the great smallness of my understanding,
I am far from grasping this —
and would that I merit to understand at least the plain meaning of his holy words, z"l.
Therefore I have abbreviated in all these matters as much as possible,
and have come here only to mention and to arouse the heart of the reader
to search through each of his discourses, z"l,
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, etc. —
and certainly one whose understanding is truly broad,
who sets his mind and heart to these matters,
will find therein many wonders.
And this shall be my reward —
that I have begun to walk on this path —
even if it is not in my power to complete the matter as is fitting.

The Sages, z"l, have already said:
"All words of Torah are good"
— and when one merits to hit upon the truth even in one matter of Torah,
it is certainly more precious than all wealth,
and gold and silver cannot be compared to it.

Because of all the above:
in places where I knew that the topic of Rosh HaShanah as understood through a given discourse
is already explained in Likutay Halachos,
I noted only to look there — and I did not see fit to explain it further,
fulfilling the verse: "And in the place of the great — do not stand"
[Prov. 25:6].
All the more so in discourses where our Rebbe, z"l, himself explained
that this is the topic of Rosh HaShanah —
I certainly feared to touch them,
for "What has straw to do with grain?"
[Jer. 23:28]
and one does not mix the mundane with the holy of holies.

Also, the reader should know:
all these matters were written mostly in great brevity and in the manner of mere chapter-headings.
Because of this, in many places it will appear to the reader at first glance
that the matters are not explained and ordered as is proper.
But when one sets one's heart to study them with a truthful eye —
I trust in the Almighty that one will find in them a taste,
and the eyes of one's understanding will open
to find many precious virtues (segulahs)
hinted at in the words of our Rabbis, z"l, in these matters.
And this would be my reward.

I called this small volume
Yerech HaAisonim — "The Month of the Mighty Ones" —
after the verse:
"In the month of Eisanim (Mighty Ones), at the Festival — that is the seventh month"
[I Kings 8:2].
And our Sages, z"l, expounded:
"The month that the mighty ones [= the Patriarchs] were born in it" —
and this is the foundation of the entire volume:
the month of Tishray with all its festivals and holy mitzvos that are observed in it.

May G-d place our portion in His Torah,
and may He place in our hearts love for Him and fear of Him,
to do His will and to serve Him with a whole heart. Amen, so may it be His will.

It is possible that the author called this holy book Yerech HaAisonim
[spelled as in the verse in Kings 8 — האיתנים] —
because the verse as written: "Yerech HaAisanim"
[ירח האתנים — without the yud] —
together with the [standard] total (im haKolel) —
equals in gematria [numerology] the name
Nachman ben HaRav Tzvi Aryeh —
to allude to his name in the naming of the book,
as the early authorities, z"l, wrote [it was customary to do].

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Book Yerech HaAisonim — in it are explained many wondrous matters from the topic of
the holiness of Rosh HaShanah and the sounding of the Shofar and the prayers of Rosh HaShanah,
and the great merit of one who is privileged to be near a true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah,

and likewise explained within it are the topics of the holiness of the Ten Days of Repentance,
Yom Kippur, Sukkos, Sh'mini Atzeres, and Simchas Torah, and the holiness of all the mitzvos
of G-d which are observed during them.

units.he: ראש השנה הוא לחמה וראש חודש הוא ללבנה שזה בחי' החי"ת והנו"ן, ומחמת שהנו"ן הוא בחי' מלכות דלית לה מגרמה כלום רק מה' שמקבלת מן החי"ת שהוא בחי' שמש וכו' ע"כ אין מזכיריו של ראש חודש בר"ה, וארז"ל זכרון אחד עולה לכאן ולכאן, וע"כ מתפללין אז הרבה על בניו המלכות דקודשה ומלכות משיח וכן על התגלות הדעת דקדושה וידע כל פעול כי אתה פעלתו וכו', וכן על ביטול מלכות דס"א בחי' כי תעביר ממשלת זדון מן הארץ, וזה בחי' המלך הקדוש שאומרים אז היינ ובחי' התקשרות המלכות בחי' נו"ן עם החי"ת שהוא בחי' חכמה בחי'קודש, וזה בחי' זכרנו לחיים כי החכמה תחי' וכו' וכן המלכות דקדושה הוא בחי' חיים בחי' דוד מלך ישראל חי וקיים וכתיב באור פניך מלך חיים:
units.en:
Rosh HaShanah corresponds to the sun, and Rosh Chodesh [the New Month] corresponds to the moon. These are the aspects of the letters ח and נ.

Since the letter נ is the aspect of Kingship, which has nothing of its own except what it receives from the letter ח, the aspect of the sun, etc., Rosh Chodesh is not mentioned on Rosh HaShanah. The Sages, of blessed memory, said: “One remembrance serves for both.”

Therefore, at that time we pray a great deal for the building of the holy Kingship and the Kingdom of the Messiah, and also for the revelation of holy knowledge: “And all that is formed shall know that You formed it,” etc. We also pray for the nullification of the kingship of the Other Side: “For You will remove the dominion of wickedness from the earth.”

This is the aspect of “the Holy King,” which we say at that time: the connection of Kingship, the aspect of the letter נ, with the letter ח, the aspect of wisdom, the aspect of holiness.

This is the aspect of “Remember us for life,” for “wisdom gives life,” etc. The holy Kingship is also the aspect of life: “David, King of Israel, is alive and enduring.” It is written: “In the light of Your countenance, O King, is life.”

Aleph-Hay [abbreviation: א״ה = "with G-d's help"]:
It is explained in the words of our holy Rebbe, the Light of Lights,
Mohara"n, z"l — in many places in his holy book
Likutay Mohara"n and in his holy conversations —
regarding the topic of the wondrous rectifications (tikkunim nifloim)
that are accomplished by those who come to the true Tzadik

units.he: וע"כ נוסעין על ר"ה לצדיקים כי הצדיק הוא העוסק בזה בשלימות ליתן כח למלכות דקדושה שהוא בחי' היצ"ט להתגבר על מלכות דסט"א בחי' היצה"ר ולהמשיך להמלכות הארה שלימה מן החכמה העליונה ולקשרה אליה:
units.en: Therefore we travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah, for the Tzadik is the one who engages fully in this: giving strength to the holy Kingship, the aspect of the good inclination, to overcome the kingship of the Other Side, the aspect of the evil inclination; drawing down to Kingship a complete illumination from the supernal wisdom; and binding it to that wisdom.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Key Kabbalistic Correspondences in This Section:

Ches [ח] — Chochma (Wisdom); the Sun; the masculine-giving principle.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 1, in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola
["Blow the Shofar of Sovereignty"], it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension (bechia) of being the Place of the World
— and they are able to perform the [spiritual work of] Rosh HaShanah.
And in the discourse Tik'u Emuna, Siman 5,
much is explained regarding the wondrous rectifications
that are wrought through the gathering of the disciples near the true Rebbe —
and the primary time of gathering is on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וע"כ נקרא הצדיק ספר החיים כמובא בתיקונים וגם המלכות נקראת ספר החיים כמובא בכוונות היינו ע"י הצדיק שממיך לה החיים העליונים משרשם, וזה בחי' תמונת אות צדי"ק שהוא יו"ד נו"ן כמובא היינו בחי' חיבור החכמה בחי' יו"ד כידוע להמלכות בחי' נו"ן, וזה בחי' ענין עשו ויעקב הנעשה בר"ה כמובא בזוה"ק כי יעקב מקשר עצמו בכל עת אל החכמה העליונה וע"כ זכה לבכורה כמבואר בפנים ועשו הוא ההיפוך מזה, וזה בחי' כי ציד בפיו שמתלבש עצמו במצוות:
units.en:
Therefore the Tzadik is called “the Book of Life,” as cited in תיקונים. Kingship is also called “the Book of Life,” as cited in כוונות. That is, through the Tzadik, who draws down to Kingship the supernal life from its source.

This is the aspect of the form of the letter צ, which is composed of י and נ, as cited: the joining of wisdom, the aspect of the letter י, as is known, with Kingship, the aspect of the letter נ.

This is the aspect of the matter of Esov and Yaakov that takes place on Rosh HaShanah, as cited in the holy Zohar. Yaakov binds himself at all times to the supernal wisdom, and therefore merited the birthright, as explained in the main text. Esov is the opposite of this. This is the aspect of “because game was in his mouth”: he clothes himself in mitzvos.

Malchus d'Kedusha — the Kingdom of Holiness.

Malchus d'Stra Achra — the Kingdom of the Other Side [the forces of evil].

units.en: Passage beginning: “And therefore we pray.”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And more is explained in many discourses in his holy books
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, the soundings of the Shofar,
and the general holiness of the month of Tishray.
See also Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 94,
which likewise explains that one must travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וע"כ מתפללין אז הרבה על יראה כי יראה הוא מבחי' מוראה של מלכות כידוע והוא עיקר החכמה כ"ש הן יראת ה' חכמה וכתיב ראשית חכמה יראת ה', וזה בחי' מלכיות וזכרונות ושופרות, מלכיות הוא כנגד בחי' המלכות, זכורונות הוא כנגד בחי' ההתקשרות אל השכל שיש בכל דבר שזה בחי' אשרי איש שלא ישכחך וכו' וכן בכל ברכת אתה זוכר מבאו איך שהשי"ת נותן לבו כביכול לכל יצורי עולם ויודע כל עניניהם וכל מעשה דיבור ומחשבה שלהם ודורש מעשה כולם, ומזה מובן ממילא איך שהאדם צריך להיות מקושר ודבוק בו ית' תמיד ולהתסכל רק על השכל שיש בכל דבר בכדי שיתקרב להשי"ת ע"י הדבר הזה, וזה שמובא בכוונות כי זכרונות הם נגד חב"ד סוד המוין שבהם סוד הזכרון וכו', שופרות שהוא ברכת אתה נגלית המדבר מענין מתן תורה, זה כנגד בחי' התורה שעי"ז נותנין כח להמלכות דקדושה להתגבר על מלכות דסט"א, כי אורייתא מחכמה ובינה נפקת ששם סוד שורש השופר העליון הגדול שעל ידו יתקבצו כל נדחי ישראל ותתבטל בחי' המלכות דסט"א, וזה בחי' שופר של ר"ה כיהוא יום ראשון לעשי"ת וצריכין להכניע את היצה"ר בחי' המלכות דסט"א וליתן כח להמלכות דקדושה וזה ע"י השופר:
units.en:
Therefore we pray a great deal at that time for awe, for awe is the aspect of the awe of Kingship, as is known, and it is the essence of wisdom. As it is stated: “Behold, awe of Hashem is wisdom,” and it is written: “The beginning of wisdom is awe of Hashem.”

This is the aspect of Kingship, Remembrances, and Shofar Soundings. Kingship corresponds to the aspect of Kingship. Remembrances corresponds to connecting to the intellect within every thing: “Fortunate is the man who does not forget You,” etc. Likewise, throughout the blessing “You remember,” it is explained how Hashem Yisburach directs His heart, as it were, to all the creatures of the world, knows all their affairs and every deed, word, and thought of theirs, and examines the works of them all. From this it is understood how a person must always be connected and cleave to Him, may He be blessed, and look only at the intellect within every thing, in order to draw near to Hashem Yisburach through that very thing.

This is what is cited in כוונות: Remembrances corresponds to wisdom, understanding, and knowledge—the mystery of the intellectual faculties, in which lies the mystery of memory, etc.

Shofar Soundings is the blessing “You were revealed,” which speaks of the Giving of the Torah. It corresponds to the aspect of the Torah, through which strength is given to the holy Kingship to overcome the kingship of the Other Side. For the Torah comes forth from wisdom and understanding. There lies the mystery of the root of the great supernal Shofar, through which all the dispersed of Israel will be gathered and the kingship of the Other Side will be nullified. This is the aspect of the Shofar of Rosh HaShanah, for it is the first day of the Ten Days of Repentance. We must subdue the evil inclination, the aspect of the kingship of the Other Side, and give strength to the holy Kingship. This is accomplished through the Shofar.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because the Nun is the dimension of Malchus (Sovereignty)
— which has nothing of its own and receives only from the Ches,
which is the dimension of the Sun, etc. —
therefore Rosh Chodesh is not mentioned on Rosh HaShanah.
And the Sages, z"l, said:
"One remembrance [in the Musaf prayer] serves for both"
[Rosh HaShanah 30b].

Therefore one prays greatly at that time
for his children — the holy Malchus and the Kingdom of the Messiah —
and also for the revelation of the holy Daas (Knowledge/Consciousness),
"and all that is formed shall know that You have formed it",
and for the nullification of the kingdom of the Stra Achra
— the dimension of "for You shall remove the dominion of wickedness from the earth".

units.he: ד"ה ואח"כ עוסקין
units.en: Passage beginning: “And afterwards we engage.”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And once he said:
"With me, the main thing is Rosh HaShanah" — and also:
"My Rosh HaShanah is a great novelty (chidush) …
not only are you all certainly bound to my Rosh HaShanah,
but even all the world — the entire world — depends upon my Rosh HaShanah."

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בתשובה כל עשי"ת עד שזוכין ליום כיפורים שאז אימא וברתא סלקיון כחדא שהמלכות מקבלת חיות מן החכמה העליונה ע"י בינה אימא עילאה ואז נכנע היצה"ר לגמרי עד דלית לי' רשות לשטן לאשטוניה ואז נעשה אור הלבנה כאור החמה, וע"כ מקדשין הלבנה במוצאי יו"כ, וזה בחי' התפלות של יו"כ כי עי"ז הנ"ל נתקבלים כל התפלות והבקשות, וזה בחי' הג' ספרים שנפתחין בר"ה צדיקים גמורים שמדבקין עצמן תמיד אל השכל והחכמה ששם עיקר החיים, וע"כ נכתבין לאלתר לחיים, ורשעים גמורים הדבקים ברוח שטות של היצה"ר ורחוקים מהחכמה דקדושה ע"כ נתכבין לאלתר למיתה בבחי' ימותו ולא בחכמה, בינונים תלויים ועומדים עד יו"כ היינו כנ"ל:
units.en:
Afterwards we engage in repentance throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance, until we merit Yom Kippur. At that time, “the Mother and the Daughter ascend together”: Kingship receives vitality from the supernal wisdom through understanding, the supernal Mother. The evil inclination is then completely subdued, to the point that Satan has no permission to accuse. The light of the moon then becomes like the light of the sun. Therefore we sanctify the moon on the night after Yom Kippur.

This is the aspect of the prayers of Yom Kippur, for through the above all prayers and requests are accepted. This is the aspect of the three books opened on Rosh HaShanah. The completely righteous always attach themselves to intellect and wisdom, where the essence of life lies, and therefore are immediately inscribed for life. The completely wicked attach themselves to the spirit of folly of the evil inclination and are distant from holy wisdom; therefore they are immediately inscribed for death, the aspect of “they die, and not in wisdom.” The intermediate people remain suspended until Yom Kippur, as explained above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
This is the dimension of HaMelech HaKadosh — "The Holy King" —
which is declared during [the Rosh HaShanah and Ten Days of Repentance prayers]:
the dimension of the connection of Malchus — the dimension of Nun —
with the Ches, which is the dimension of Wisdom, the dimension of Holiness.

This is the dimension of "Remember us for life, O King Who desires life"
— for "Wisdom gives life"
[Eccl. 7:12].
And the holy Malchus is also the dimension of life,
the dimension of "David, King of Israel, is alive and enduring"
[Rosh HaShanah 25a].
And it is written: "In the light of the King's countenance is life"
[Prov. 16:15].

units.he: ד"ה ואחר יו"כ
units.en: Passage beginning: “And after Yom Kippur.”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And once he said that on Rosh HaShanah he performs matters and rectifications
— even for the souls of those close to him who come to him on Rosh HaShanah —
that throughout the entire year, even he himself cannot perform them.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואחר יו"כ נכנסין לסוכה, אמרה תורה צא מדירת קבע ושב בדירת עראי היינו שלא יעשה לו האדם קבע בדירת העוה"ז רק דירת עראי ועיקר קביעתו יהי' בהשכל והפנימיות שיש בכל דבר כי מקום שהאדם חושב במחשבתו שם כל האדם כולו כמובא וע"כ עיקר קביעותו יהי' בהשכל והפנימיות שיש בכל דבר כי מקום שהאדם חושב במחשבתו שם כל האדם כולו כמובא וע"כ עיקר קביעות מחשבתו ייהה בהשכל של כל דבר שזה בחי' עוה"ב ומלאה הארץ דעה שזה בחי' חלק יעקב שנטל לעצמו העוה"ב, הגם כי ההכרח גם אצלו לעבור דרך העוה"ז אבל רק בדרך דירת עראי:
units.en: After Yom Kippur we enter the sukkah. The Torah said: “Leave your permanent dwelling and dwell in a temporary dwelling.” That is, a person should not establish his permanent dwelling in this world, but only a temporary dwelling. His primary permanence should be in the intellect and inner dimension within every thing. For where a person thinks in his thought, there is his whole being, as cited. Therefore his primary permanence should be in the intellect and inner dimension within every thing. For where a person thinks in his thought, there is his whole being, as cited. Therefore the primary fixed focus of his thought should be the intellect within every thing, the aspect of the World to Come: “And the earth shall be filled with knowledge.” This is the aspect of Yaakov's portion, for he took the World to Come for himself. Although he too must necessarily pass through this world, it is only in the manner of a temporary dwelling.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Therefore We Travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah

Therefore we travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah,
for the Tzadik is the one who is fully engaged in this:
to give strength to the holy Malchus
— which is the dimension of the good inclination (Yetzer Tov) —
to overcome the Malchus d'Stra Achra — the evil inclination (Yetzer Hora);
and to draw down to the Malchus a complete illumination from the Supernal Wisdom,
and to bind her to it.

qualifications.text: The supplied Hebrew repeats the statement about permanence in the intellect and inner dimension, together with the explanation that a person is where his thought is. The English retains that repetition.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ומחמת שאור
units.en: Passage beginning: “And because the light…”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
His disciples, z"l, accepted this upon themselves and agreed to do so every Rosh HaShanah.
And with G-d's help, this has already been [the practice] for more than sixty years*
after his passing, z"l —
and even so, the matter continues among the Anash [Breslov Chassidim]
for generations eternal, as is well known.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ומחמת שאור השכל שהוא בחי' שמש גדול מאד ואי אפשרלזכות אליו כי אם על ידי בחי' נו"ן בחי' מלכות בחי' צמצום ע"כ צריך להיות בסוכה צלתה מרובה מחמתה: וע"כ סוכה שהיא גבוה למעלה מעשרים אמה פסולה משום דלא שלטא בה עינא, כי העיקר להסתכל בעינא פקיחא אל השכל שיש בכל דבר שזה בחי' סוכה שהיא זכר לענני כבוד אשר נאמר שם אשר עין בעין נראה אתה ה' ועננך עומד עליהם, וכן אם היא למטה מעשרה פסולה, כי מעולם לא ירדה שכינה למטה מעשר, ושם עיקרמקום אחיזת עשו מדור הקליפות, וע"כ אם הסכך למטה מעשרה היא בחי' שממשיך החכמה אל מדור הקיפות ח"ו בבחי' חכמים המה להרע וכו' וע"כ נקראת דירה סרוחה בחי' נסרחה חכמתם, כי עיקר החכמה והשכל להסתכל בו למעלה מעשרה היינו למעלה מכל העוה"ז והבליו:" וע"כ צריכין שיהיו כוכבים נראין מתוך הסכך ופירשו הפוסקים דר"ל זוהרורי השמש (עיין בית יוסף) כי השכל הוא בחי' אור השמש:
units.en:
Because the light of the intellect, which is the dimension of the sun, is very great, and it is impossible to merit it except through the dimension of the letter נ, the dimension of Kingship, the dimension of contraction, therefore one must be in a sukkah whose shade exceeds its sunlight. Therefore a sukkah that is higher than twenty cubits is invalid, because the eye does not take it in. For the essential thing is to look with an open eye at the intellect within every thing. This is the dimension of the sukkah, which commemorates the Clouds of Glory, concerning which it is said: “That You, G-d, are seen eye to eye, and Your cloud stands over them.”

Likewise, if it is lower than ten handbreadths, it is invalid, for the Divine Presence never descended below ten handbreadths. There is the principal foothold of Esau, the dwelling place of the husks. Therefore, if the roofing is below ten handbreadths, it is the dimension of drawing wisdom into the dwelling place of the husks, G-d forbid, in the dimension of “They are wise to do evil,” etc. Therefore it is called a foul dwelling, the dimension of “Their wisdom has become foul.” For the essential purpose of wisdom and intellect is to look through it above ten handbreadths—that is, above this entire world and its vanities.

Therefore stars must be visible through the roofing. The legal authorities explained that this means gleams of sunlight (see Bais Yosef), for the intellect is the dimension of the light of the sun.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Tzadik is Called "The Book of Life"

Therefore the Tzadik is called "Sefer HaChaim" — "The Book of Life"
— as brought in the Tikunim;
and also Malchus is called "Sefer HaChaim",
as brought in the Kavanos [Kabbalistic meditations].
That is: through the Tzadik,
the supernal life is drawn down from its root to [the Malchus].

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Therefore I set my heart to examine his discourses, z"l,
and to search within them —
perhaps I would find some allusions (rmazim) to the topic of Rosh HaShanah in each of his discourses.
And with G-d's help, I found some allusions in most of his discourses, z"l, to the topic of Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וזה בחי' מצוות נטילת ארבע מניים שבלולב והם כנגג ארבע אותיות של שם הוי"ה הק' וכנגד האבות וכנגד האמהות וכנגד כלל כתות שבישראל כמו שדרז"ל ומנענעין בהם למעלה ולמטה ולארבע רוחות העולם להורות ולגלות ופרסם בעולם שכל העולם ומלואו וכל אשר בו יש בו פנימיות גדול בבחי'מלאה הארץ קניניך ועיקר הקנין הוא חכמה ודעת דקדושה בבחי' דעת קנית ובחי' זה קנהחכמה כי יש בכל דבר שבעולם שכל וחכמה וצרכין להסתכל רק על השכל שיש בכל דבר בכדי שיתקרב להשי"ת על ידי זה הדבר כמו שרואין בחוש בארבעה מנים אלו שמרומז בפנימיותם דברים גבוהים כאלו ועיין זוהר ויחי דף ר"כ ע"ב שדורש פסוק כל הנקרא בשמי וכו' על ענין הד' מניים ומכוון קצת לענינינו, וזה שדרשו ח"ל במ"ר פ' אמור שאמר שלמה ע"ז וארבעה לא ידעתים אלו ד' מניים שבלולב וכו' וסיים ע"ז והמה חכמים מחוכמים היינו שמלובש בהם חכמה נפלאה, וע"כ הם גדלים על כל מים כי העיקר לזכות לזה הוא ע"י התורה שנקראת מים, וע"כ ארז"ל שמרמזין שאנו נצחנו המלחמה בר"ה היינו בחי' המלחמה שבין יעקב ועשו הנ"ל:
units.en:
This is the aspect of the mitzvah of taking the four species of the lulav. They correspond to the four letters of the holy Name הוי"ה, to the Patriarchs, to the Matriarchs, and to all the groups within Israel, as our Sages, of blessed memory, expounded.

We wave them upwards, downwards, and in the four directions of the world, to show, reveal, and publicize throughout the world that the entire world and its fullness, and everything within it, has a great inner dimension: “The earth is full of Your acquisitions.” The primary acquisition is holy wisdom and knowledge: “You have acquired knowledge,” and “This one acquired wisdom.” For everything in the world contains intellect and wisdom. We must look only at the intellect within every thing, in order to draw near to Hashem Yisburach through that very thing. We can perceive this directly in these four species, whose inner dimension alludes to such lofty matters.

See the Zohar, ויחי, page 220b, which interprets the verse “Everyone called by My Name,” etc., concerning the four species; it partly corresponds to our subject. This is what our Sages expounded in Midrash Rabbah, the portion אמור: Solomon said of these, “And four I did not know”—these are the four species of the lulav, etc. It concludes concerning them: “And they are wise, exceptionally wise”—that is, wondrous wisdom is clothed within them. Therefore they grow upon all water, for the principal way to merit this is through the Torah, which is called water. Therefore our Sages, of blessed memory, said that they allude to our having won the war on Rosh HaShanah: the above-mentioned war between Yaakov and Esov.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
This is the dimension of the shape of the letter Tzadik
[צ] —
which is composed of Yud-Nun, as is brought:
the dimension of the union of Wisdom — the dimension of Yud —
as is known — with Malchus, the dimension of Nun.

This is the dimension of the matter of Esov and Yaakov
that takes place on Rosh HaShanah,
as brought in the holy Zohar —
for Yaakov binds himself at all times to the Supernal Wisdom,
and therefore merited the birthright,
as is explained in the main text;
and Esov is the opposite of this —
the dimension of "for he had [Esov's] game in his mouth"
[Gen. 25:28]
— [meaning,] he clothes himself in mitzvos [outwardly, without inner truth].

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה וע"כ אחז"ל
units.en: Passage beginning: “And therefore our Sages, of blessed memory, said…”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
As is understood in the holy Zohar and in the intentions (kavanos) of the Ar"i z"l:
all the rectifications that are accomplished from Rosh HaShanah
until after Sh'mini Atzeres are all bound and interwoven with one another.
Because of this, I have mostly alluded within them also to the topic of Yom Kippur, Sukkos, and Sh'mini Atzeres.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וע"כ אחז"ל בזכות ולקחתם לכם ביום הראשון הרי אני נגלה לכם ראשון וכו' היינו שזוכין להתגלות אלהותו ית' ולהתקרב אליו יתברך ע"י השכל ישש בכל דברשזה בחי' ראשון בחי'ראשית חכמה ותרגום בראשית בחוכמתא, וזה ופורע לכם מן הראשון זה עשו הרשע וכו' שמכניעין קליפת עשו שהוא ההיפוך מזה כנ"ל, ובונה לכם ראשון זה בית המקדש וכו' ששם עיקר התגלות אלהותו והדעת דקדושה. וע"כ כל מי שיש בו דעה כאילו נבנה ביהמק"ד בימיו, וזה ומביא לכם ראשון זה מלך המשיח היינו בחי' מלכות בחי' נו"ן הנ"ל שנאמר על מלך המשיח לפני שמש ינון שמו כשארז"ל, ויש לרמז כל הד' דברים אלו במצוות הארבע מינים עצמן ואין כאן מקום לזה:
units.en:
Therefore our Sages, of blessed memory, said: By the merit of “You shall take for yourselves on the first day,” “I will be revealed to you as First,” etc. That is, we merit the revelation of His G-dliness, may He be blessed, and drawing near to Him, may He be blessed, through the intellect within every thing. This is the aspect of “first,” the aspect of “the beginning of wisdom”; the Targum renders בראשית as “with wisdom.”

“And I will exact retribution for you from the first”—this is the wicked Esov, etc. We subdue the husk of Esov, who is the opposite of this, as explained above. “And I will build for you the first”—this is the Temple, etc., where the principal revelation of His G-dliness and holy knowledge takes place. Therefore anyone who possesses knowledge is as though the Temple had been built in his days.

“And I will bring for you the first”—this is the King Messiah, the aspect of Kingship, the aspect of the letter נ mentioned above. It is said of the King Messiah: “Before the sun, ינון is his name,” as our Sages, of blessed memory, expounded. All four of these matters can be alluded to in the mitzvah of the four species themselves, but this is not the place for it.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Therefore We Pray Greatly for Awe [on Rosh HaShanah]

Therefore we pray greatly for Yirah (awe/fear [of G-d]) at that time —
for Yirah is from the dimension of the awe that is of Malchus, as is known;
and it is the very essence of Wisdom, as it is stated:
"Behold, the fear of G-d — that is Wisdom"
[Job 28:28],
and it is written: "The beginning of Wisdom is the fear of G-d"
[Ps. 111:10].

This is the dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros
[the three blessings of the Rosh HaShanah Musaf prayer]:
Malchuyos — corresponding to the dimension of Malchus;
Zichronos — corresponding to the dimension of connecting to the intellect (sechel)
present in all things
— the dimension of "fortunate is the man who will not forget You",
and how G-d, as it were, turns His heart to all the creatures of the world,
knowing all their affairs — all their deeds, speech, and thought;
and He examines the works of them all.
From this it is understood how a person must be constantly connected and cleaved to G-d,
and gaze only upon the sechel (intellect/inner wisdom) in every thing,
in order to draw near to G-d through that very thing.

qualifications.text: The English follows the name-reading of ינון in this discussion of the Messiah and the letter נ. The supplied Hebrew is unchanged.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואח"כ זוכין
units.en: Passage beginning: “And afterwards we merit…”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because of the great smallness of my understanding,
I am far from grasping this —
and would that I merit to understand at least the plain meaning of his holy words, z"l.
Therefore I have abbreviated in all these matters as much as possible,
and have come here only to mention and to arouse the heart of the reader
to search through each of his discourses, z"l,
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, etc. —
and certainly one whose understanding is truly broad,
who sets his mind and heart to these matters,
will find therein many wonders.
And this shall be my reward —
that I have begun to walk on this path —
even if it is not in my power to complete the matter as is fitting.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ זוכין לשמיני עצרת ואז זווגא דמטרוניתא שהמלכות מקבלת טפי השכל בשלימות באופן שיהיה נעשה הולדה גמורה ולא יהיה ח"ו בבחי' השחתת זרע לבטלה וגם לא בבחי' הפלת נפלים כמובא בכוונות עיין שם עומק הדברים וסודם, ולענינינו הוא שיזכה לקבל אור השכל והחכמה בשלימות עד שיתקרב עי"ז להשי"ת באמת ע"י כל הדברים שבעולם שזה בחי' שמעלה כל ניצוצי החכמה שישבכל דבר ושיהיו מעשיו מרובין מחכמתו ויראת חטאו קודמת לחכמתו ושיהיההחכמה והשכל כלול ומחובר עם אמונה ותמימות שזה בחי' מה שנאמר אצל יעקב דייקא ויעקב איש תם כי זה עיקר שלימות השכל דקדושה שהוא בחי' יעקב. וע"כ מבואר בזוה"ק כי בשמיני עצרת אז מאיר ביותר מדתו של יעקב אבינו ע"ה והוא אז רישא לחדוותא היינו כנ"ל, וע"כ עולין אז כל ישראל תורה ומסיימין התורה ומתחילין התורה כי העיקר לזכות לזה הוא ע"י התורה כנ"ל:
units.en:
Afterwards we merit the Eighth Day of Assembly. At that time there is “the union of the Matron”: Kingship receives the drops of intellect in completeness, so that a complete birth is brought about, and it will not, Heaven forbid, be the aspect of wasting seed in vain, nor the aspect of miscarriages, as cited in כוונות. See there the depth and secret of these matters.

For our subject, this means meriting to receive the light of intellect and wisdom in completeness, until through this one truly draws near to Hashem Yisburach through all the things in the world. This is the aspect of raising all the sparks of wisdom within every thing, so that one's deeds are more numerous than one's wisdom, one's fear of sin precedes one's wisdom, and wisdom and intellect are included and joined with faith and wholehearted simplicity. This is the aspect of what is said specifically of Yaakov: “And Yaakov was a wholesome man,” for this is the principal completeness of the holy intellect, the aspect of Yaakov.

Therefore the holy Zohar explains that on the Eighth Day of Assembly the quality of Yaakov our Father, peace be upon him, shines especially brightly, and he is then “the head of the rejoicing,” as explained above. Therefore all Israel go up to the Torah at that time, complete the Torah, and begin the Torah; for the principal way to merit this is through the Torah, as explained above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
As is brought in the Kavanos: Zichronos correspond to Chochma-Bina-Daas
[Wisdom, Understanding, and Knowledge] — the secret of the intellects
wherein lies the secret of remembrance.

Shofaros — the blessing of Ata Niglaysa ["You were revealed"],
which speaks of the topic of the Giving of the Torah —
corresponds to the dimension of the Torah,
through which strength is given to the holy Malchus
to overpower the Malchus d'Stra Achra.
For the Torah emerges from Wisdom and Understanding,
and there is the secret of the source of the Great Supernal Shofar —
through which all the scattered of Israel will be gathered
and the dimension of the Malchus d'Stra Achra will be nullified.
And this is the dimension of the Shofar of Rosh HaShanah —
for it is the first day of the Ten Days of Repentance (Aseres Y'may Tshuva),
and one must humble the evil inclination (Yetzer HaRa)
— the dimension of the Malchus d'Stra Achra —
and give strength to the holy Malchus.
And this is accomplished through the Shofar.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה וזה שדרז"ל
units.en: Passage beginning: “And this is what our Sages, of blessed memory, expounded…”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because of all the above:
in places where I knew that the topic of Rosh HaShanah as understood through a given discourse
is already explained in Likutay Halachos,
I noted only to look there — and I did not see fit to explain it further,
fulfilling the verse: "And in the place of the great — do not stand"
[Prov. 25:6].
All the more so in discourses where our Rebbe, z"l, himself explained
that this is the topic of Rosh HaShanah —
I certainly feared to touch them,
for "What has straw to do with grain?"
[Jer. 23:28]
and one does not mix the mundane with the holy of holies.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וזה שדרז"ל בזוה"ק ובתיקונים ותנח התיבה בחודש השיביע וכו' על ענין תשרי וראש השנה כי אז ממשיכיןבחי' התי"ו והנו"ן והחי"ת המבואר בפנים שזה בחי' ות'נ'ח' הנ"ל:
units.en: This is what our Sages, of blessed memory, expounded in the holy Zohar and in תיקונים: “And the ark rested in the seventh month,” etc., concerning Tishray and Rosh HaShanah. For then we draw down the aspects of the letters ת, נ, and ח, explained in the main text. This is the aspect of ות'נ'ח', mentioned above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Afterwards One Engages in Repentance Through the Ten Days

Afterwards one engages in repentance throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance,
until one merits on Yom Kippur
— when "the Mother and the Daughter ascend together"
[Zohar] —
meaning, Malchus receives vitality from the Supernal Wisdom through Bina (Understanding), the Supernal Mother.
Then the evil inclination is completely subdued,
until "the Accuser has no authority to prosecute"
[Yoma 20a],
and then the light of the moon becomes like the light of the sun.
Therefore one sanctifies the new moon on the night after Yom Kippur.

And this is the dimension of the prayers of Yom Kippur —
for through the above, all prayers and requests are accepted.
This is the dimension of the Three Books that are opened on Rosh HaShanah:
complete Tzadikim — who cleave themselves always to the sechel and Wisdom
wherein lies the essence of life —
are therefore immediately inscribed for life;
complete wicked people — who cleave to the spirit of folly of the evil inclination
and are distant from the holy Wisdom —
are therefore immediately inscribed for death,
the dimension of "they die, and not in wisdom"
[Job 4:21];
and the intermediate ones are suspended until Yom Kippur, as mentioned above.

After Yom Kippur — Sukkos

After Yom Kippur one enters the Sukka.
The Torah said: "Leave your permanent dwelling and dwell in a temporary dwelling"
— meaning, a person should not make the world of this life a permanent dwelling,
but only a temporary dwelling;
and his primary permanence shall be in the intellect (sechel) and the inner dimension
present in every thing.
For "wherever a person directs his thought — there is the person's whole being"
[as brought in Chassidic writings].
Therefore the primary permanence of one's thought shall be in the sechel of every thing,
which is the dimension of the World to Come,
"and the earth shall be filled with knowledge [of G-d]"
[Is. 11:9]
— this is the portion of Yaakov,
who took the World to Come for himself.
Even though he too must necessarily pass through this world,
it is only in the manner of a temporary dwelling.

The Light of the Intellect and the Sukka's Shade

Because the light of the sechel — which is the dimension of the sun — is exceedingly great,
and it is impossible to merit it except through the dimension of Nun,
the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of contraction (tzimtzum),
therefore one must be in a Sukka
whose shade exceeds its light
(tzilosoh m'ruba m'chamsah).

And therefore a Sukka that is more than twenty cubits high is invalid —
because "the eye cannot govern it"
[the eye cannot see into it properly] —
for the essential [purpose] is to gaze with an open eye
at the sechel present in every thing.
This is the dimension of the Sukka which is
"a reminder of the Clouds of Glory"
— about which it is said:
"which eye has not seen — You, G-d, and Your cloud stands over them"
[Is. 64:3].

And likewise if it is less than ten handbreadths [from the ground], it is invalid —
for "the Divine Presence never descended below ten [handbreadths]"
[Sukkah 5a].
And there is where the primary foothold of Esov — the domain of the husks (klippos) — lies.
Therefore if the s'chach [roofing] is lower than ten handbreadths,
it is the dimension of drawing Wisdom down into the domain of the husks, heaven forbid —
the dimension of "they are wise — to do evil"
[Jer. 4:22] —
and it is therefore called a "putrid dwelling",
the dimension of "their Wisdom became putrid."
For the essence of Wisdom and intellect is to gaze upward — above ten [handbreadths] —
above all the vanities of this world.

And therefore it is required that stars be visible through the s'chach,
and the legal authorities have explained that this means
the radiance of the sun is meant [i.e., gaps through which sunlight can pass]
[see Beis Yosef],
for the sechel is the dimension of the light of the sun.

The Four Species of the Lulav

This is the dimension of the mitzvah of taking the
four species of the lulav —
they correspond to the four letters of the holy Name Havaya
[the Tetragrammaton],
and they correspond to the Patriarchs, and the Matriarchs,
and to all the general groupings within Israel,
as the Sages, z"l, expounded.

One waves them upward and downward and in all four directions of the world —
to declare and reveal and publicize in the world
that all the world and its fullness, and all that is in it,
contains a great inner dimension (p'nimius),
the dimension of "the earth is full of Your acquisitions"
[Ps. 104:24]
— and the primary acquisition is Wisdom and Knowledge (Daas) of holiness,
the dimension of "with knowledge you have acquired"
and the dimension of "this one acquired Wisdom"
— for in every thing in the world there is intellect and wisdom,
and one must gaze only upon the sechel in every thing
in order to draw near to G-d through it,
as one perceives concretely in these four species —
that wondrous sublime matters are hinted within their inner dimension.

See the Zohar, Vayechi, p. 220b,
where it expounds the verse "All who are called by My Name"
[Is. 43:7] regarding the four species —
and it is somewhat aligned with our topic.
And the Midrash Rabba, Parshas Emor, states that Shlomo [King Solomon] said
of this: "And four which I did not know"
[Prov. 30:18] — these are the four species of the lulav —
and concludes regarding them: "And they are wise, they are made wise"
— meaning, a wonderful Wisdom is clothed within them.
Therefore they grow over [all kinds of] water —
for the essential means to merit this is through the Torah, which is called water.
And therefore the Sages, z"l, said:
"They hint that we have been victorious in the war [begun] on Rosh HaShanah"
— meaning, the war between Yaakov and Esov described above.

On Account of This the Sages Said…

And therefore the Sages, z"l, said:
"Say before Me Malchuyos on Rosh HaShanah
— so that you will crown Me over you;
Zichronos — so that your remembrance will rise before Me for good;
and through what? Through the Shofar."
[Rosh HaShanah 16a]

In merit of taking the four species on the first day [of Sukkos],
"I will reveal Myself to you as the First"
[i.e., the Blessed One will be first to benefit you]
— meaning, one merits the revelation of His G-dliness and drawing near to Him
through the intellect found in every thing.
This is "the First" — the dimension of "the beginning is Wisdom"
[Reishis Chochma],
and the Targum renders Bereishis [In the Beginning] as B'Chochma [With Wisdom].
"And He pays back to you from the First — this is the wicked Esov"
— meaning one subdues the husk (klippa) of Esov which is the opposite of this, as above.
"And He builds for you the First — this is the Temple"
— wherein is the primary revelation of His G-dliness and holy Knowledge.
And therefore: "Whoever possesses knowledge, it is as though the Temple was built in his days"
[Berachos 33a].
"And He brings for you the First — this is King Messiah"
— meaning the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of Nun, mentioned above,
of which it is said concerning King Messiah:
"Before the sun, Yinon is His name"
[Ps. 72:17],
as the Sages, z"l, expounded.

One can allude all four of these matters in the mitzvah of the four species themselves —
but this is not the place [to elaborate upon it].

Afterwards One Merits Sh'mini Atzeres

Afterwards one merits Sh'mini Atzeres —
and then comes the "union of the Matron" (zivuga d'Matronissa):
Malchus receives the drops of intellect in completeness,
such that complete birth (holoda) is accomplished —
and [the seed of holiness] will not be, heaven forbid,
in the dimension of wasted emission (hashchasas zera l'vatala),
nor in the dimension of miscarriage (nafolim),
as is brought in the Kavanos — see there the depth of these matters and their secrets.

As it applies to us:
one merits to receive the light of the intellect and Wisdom in completeness,
to draw near through this to G-d in truth through all the things in the world —
this being the dimension of elevating all the sparks of Wisdom (nitzotzay chochma)
present in every thing;
and that one's deeds exceed one's wisdom;
and that one's fear of sin precedes one's wisdom;
and that the Wisdom and intellect be included and joined with
faith (emuna) and wholehearted simplicity (smimius).
This is the dimension of what is said of Yaakov specifically:
"And Yaakov was a wholesome man"
[Gen. 25:27]
— for this is the essential completeness of holy intellect,
which is the dimension of Yaakov.

And therefore it is explained in the holy Zohar
that on Sh'mini Atzeres, the quality of Yaakov our Father, a"h, shines most intensely,
and he is then "the head of the joy" — as mentioned above.
Therefore all Israel at that time ascend to the Torah,
complete the Torah, and begin the Torah again —
for the essential means to merit this is through the Torah, as above.

And This Is the Dimension of What the Sages Said…

And this is the dimension of what the Sages, z"l, said in the Zohar
and in the Tikunim:
"And the Ark rested in the seventh month"
[Gen. 8:4]
— regarding the topic of Tishray and Rosh HaShanah —
for then one draws down the dimension of the Tav-Nun-Ches
explained in the main text of the discourse,
which is the dimension of T'N'CH
[= Teshuva-Nun-Ches, or: the Ark rested — Vanach HaTaiva] as mentioned.

Translator's Summary — Siman 1

Siman 1 is based upon the discourse Ashray Smimay Dorech (Ps. 119:1) from Likutay Mohara"n.
The author reveals how Rosh HaShanah is fundamentally about the unification of
Chochma (Wisdom / Sun / Ches) with Malchus (Sovereignty / Moon / Nun) —
achieved through the Tzadik's work.
This theme then ripples forward through the entire month of Tishray:
the Ten Days of Repentance build the Malchus;
Yom Kippur perfects its union;
Sukkos teaches living in the "intellect" rather than material permanence (shade over sunlight);
the Four Species wave in all directions, proclaiming the inner divine intellect in all of Creation;
and Sh'mini Atzeres completes the sacred union — the Malchus receiving its fullness.
The centerpiece of all: being near the true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah,
who alone can accomplish these rectifications in their completeness.

units.he: ד"ה מבואר בתיקוני מבואר בתיקוני תני סרי דף ל"ו שבר"ה עוסקין בתקיעות שופר תקיעה שברים תרועה להעביר הקליפות שמכסין ומחשיכין אור הקשת ועי"ז ממשיכין אורו של משיח וסימניך לא תצפה לרגלי דמשיחא עד דתחזי קשתא בגווני נהירין וכו', ומחמת שעיקרחיותו של משיח הוא התפילה וכל מלחמתו שיעשה וכל הכבושות שיכבוש הכל משם ועיקר החרב והקשת שלו הוא תפלה ובקשה ע"כ מרבין אז ישראל ביותר בתפלות ובקשות ומתפללין הרבה על בנין המלכות דקדושה וצמיחת קרן לדוד עבדך ועריכת נר לבן ישי משיחך וכו', ומחמת שצריכין לזה בחי' יוסף שהוא בחי' שמירת הברית וגם בחי' יעקב שהוא בחי' משפט ולמשפט זוכין ע"י צדקה ע"כ מרבין אז בצדקה ומתפללין הרבה לתקן פגם הברית שזה בחי' מה שהולכין על קברי צדיקים בערב ראש השנה, כי הצדיקים האמיתיים הם תיקון גדול לפגם הברית כמובן בליקות"נ סי' ק"ט, וזה בחי' המלך הקדוש ומלך המשפט שואמרים אז כי אז עוסקין בבנין המלכות ותיקוני התפלה שתלוי בשמירת הברית שזה עיקר בחי' הקדושה כמו שארז"ל כ"מ שאתה מוצא וכו' שם תמצא קדושה. וצרכין גם בחי' משפט לזה כנ"ל. וזה בחי' תקעו בחודש שופר וכו' היינו תקיעת שופר הנ"ל שעוסקין בר"ה ומסיים ע"ז כי חק לישראל הוא משפט לאלהי יעקב שמרומז על שמירת הברית ובחי' משפט כמבוארבפנים במאמר זה הנ"ל. וזה עדות ביהוסף וכו' ודרז"ל שבר"ה יצא יוסף במבית האסורים וכו' וע"כ מאיר אז ביותר זכות של יוסף בחי' שמירת הברית הנ"ל:
units.en:
Passage beginning “It is explained in תיקוני”

It is explained in תיקוני תני סרי, page 36, that on Rosh HaShanah one engages in the shofar-soundings—תקיעה, שברים, תרועה—to remove the husks that cover and darken the light of the rainbow. Through this, the light of the Messiah is drawn down. And the sign of it is: “Do not expect the footsteps of the Messiah until you see the rainbow in bright colors,” etc.

Because the very vitality of the Messiah is prayer, and all his battles that he will wage and all the conquests he will conquer all come from there, and his primary sword and bow are prayer and supplication, therefore Israel at that time greatly multiply their prayers and supplications. They pray extensively for the building of the holy Kingship, “the sprouting of the horn of David Your servant” and “the preparation of a lamp for the son of Jesse, Your anointed one,” etc.

Because for this one needs the dimension of Yosef, who is the dimension of guarding the covenant, and also the dimension of Yaakov, who is the dimension of justice—and justice is merited through charity—therefore one greatly increases charity at that time and prays extensively to rectify the blemish of the covenant. This is the dimension of going to the graves of Tzadikim on the eve of Rosh HaShanah, for the true Tzadikim are a great rectification for the blemish of the covenant, as is understood in Likutay Moharan, Part II, section 109.

This is the dimension of “the Holy King” and “King of Justice” which one says at that time, for then one is engaged in building the Kingship and the rectification of prayer, which depends upon guarding the covenant. For this is the very essence of holiness, as our Sages of blessed memory said: “Wherever you find..., there you find holiness.” One also needs the dimension of justice for this, as above.

This is the dimension of “Blow the shofar in the month,” etc.—that is, the above-mentioned shofar-sounding in which one engages on Rosh HaShanah. The verse concludes with this: “For it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the G-d of Yaakov,” which alludes to guarding the covenant and the dimension of justice, as explained in the main text of the above-mentioned discourse. This is “A testimony in Yosef,” etc. Our Sages of blessed memory expounded that on Rosh HaShanah Yosef went out of prison, etc. Therefore the merit of Yosef, the above-mentioned dimension of guarding the covenant, shines most intensely at that time.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
On Rosh HaShanah We Engage in the Shofar-Soundings to Drive Away the Husks

It is explained in Tikkunay Zohar, Tikkun 13, p. 36, that on Rosh HaShanah
one engages in the Shofar-soundings —
Tekia, Sh'vorim, Teruah —
to remove the husks (klippos) that cover and darken the light of the Keshes (Rainbow),
and through this, the light of the Messiah is drawn down.
And the sign of it is:
"Do not hope for the footsteps of the Messiah
until you see the rainbow in dazzling colors".

Because the very vitality of the Messiah is prayer —
and all his battles that he will wage,
and all the conquests he will conquer,
all come from there;
and his primary sword and bow is prayer and supplication —
therefore Israel at that time greatly multiply their prayers and supplications,
and pray extensively for the building of the holy Malchus
and the sprouting of the glory of David Your servant,
and the preparation of a lamp for the son of Yishai, Your anointed one, etc.

Because for this one needs the dimension of Yosef —
who is the dimension of guarding the Bris (covenant/holy bond) —
and also the dimension of Yaakov —
who is the dimension of Mishpot (justice/judgment) —
and justice is merited through Tzedaka (charity);
therefore one greatly increases [giving] charity at that time,
and prays extensively to rectify the blemish of the Bris.

And this is the dimension of going to the graves of Tzadikim on Erev Rosh HaShanah —
for the true Tzadikim are a great rectification for the blemish of the Bris,
as is understood in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 109.

This is the dimension of HaMelech HaKadosh and Melech HaMishpot
["The Holy King" and "King of Justice"] which one says at that time —
for then one is engaged in building the Malchus
and the rectification of prayer,
which depends upon guarding the Bris —
for this is the very essence of holiness,
as the Sages, z"l, said: "Wherever you find [holiness]… there you find [the guarding of the]
Bris".
And one needs also the dimension of justice for this, as above.

units.he: וזה בחי' מלכיות זכרונות שופרות, מלכיות כנגד בחי' מלכות משיח שעיקר חיותו מהתפלה שהיא בחי' מלכות כידוע. ומובא במ"א, זכרונות כנגד בחי'יוסף בחי' ברית כמובא בזוה"ק ע"פ יראה כל זכורך וכו' וזהבחי' זכר לעולם בריתו, שופרות כנגד בחי' יעקב בחי' משפט בחי' שופריה דיעקב וכמובא בזוה"ק, כי ע"י קול השופר מעוררין העיקר בחינתו ומדתו של יעקב בחי' משפט ועי"ז עיקר התיקון, וזה שארז"ל קרני רוב החיות פסולין לשופר מפני שאין להם זכרות מבפנים כי השופר שהוא בחי' יעקב צריך שיהיו כלול גם מבחי' יוסף שהוא בחי' זכרות בחי' ברית כי יעקב ויוסף אזלי כחדא כי גוף וברית חשבינן חד בבחי' אלה תולדות יעקביוסף והוא עיקר תולדותיו ועל ידו עיקר נצחון המלחמה בבחי' והיה בית יעקב אש ובית יוסף להבה וכמו שארז"ל, וע"כ אם הוציא זכרות שלשופר וניקבו ותקע בו פסול כי צריכין גם בחי' משפט בחי' יעקב שהוא השופר עצמו. וזה בחי' תרועה שהיא בחי' יעקב כמבואר בזוה"ק, וזכרון תרועה הוא כשהוא כלול עם בחי' יוסף וזה נאמר על ר"ה שחל בשבת שמזכירין אבל לא תוקעין כמו שדרשו רז" ועיקר הטעם דילמא אתי לאתויי השופר ברה"ר ויהי בזה חילול שבת שהוא כנגד מדתו של יוסף כמבואר בזוה"ק ע"כ אין תוקעין רק ע"י קדושת שבת בעצמו מאירין שני הבחינות הנ"ל כי שבת הוא בבחינת נחלת יעקב ג"כ כמו שארז"ל רק במקום שיש בית דין קבוע כמו ביבנה ושם מאיר ביותר בחי'משפט שהוא בחי' יעקב ע"כ תוקעין שם גם בשתב כי בוודאי לא יבוארשם לחילול שב תעי"ז ח"ו, ומחמת שצריכין לקשר כל התפלות אל הצדיק האמת בחי'משה כי רק הוא יכול להאיר ולתקן תפלות ישראל בשלימות ולבנות מהם קומת השכינה והמשכן והוא בעצמו בחי' משיח כמפב"נ ע"כ צריכין לנסוע על ר"ה ביותר אל הצדיק האמת, ומחמת שאותיות התורה שהם ניצוצי נשמות הק' באין ונכללין ג"כ בתוך התפלה להתחדש שם וכו' ע"כ מזכירין בתפלות ר"ה פסוקים הרבה שלתנ"ך ופסוקים של קבלת התורה וכו':
units.en:
This is the dimension of Kingship, Remembrances and Shofaros. Kingship corresponds to the dimension of the Kingship of the Messiah, whose very vitality comes from prayer, which is the dimension of Kingship, as is known and as is brought elsewhere. Remembrances correspond to the dimension of Yosef, the dimension of the covenant, as is brought in the holy Zohar on the verse “All your males shall appear,” etc. This is the dimension of “He remembered His covenant forever.” Shofaros correspond to the dimension of Yaakov, the dimension of justice, the dimension of “the beauty of Yaakov,” as is brought in the holy Zohar. For through the sound of the shofar one arouses the essential quality and measure of Yaakov, the dimension of justice, and through this the essential rectification is accomplished.

This is what our Sages of blessed memory said: the horns of most wild animals are invalid for the shofar because they do not have an inner core. For the shofar, which is the dimension of Yaakov, must also include the dimension of Yosef, who is the dimension of masculinity, the dimension of the covenant. For Yaakov and Yosef go together as one, for the body and the covenant are considered one, in the dimension of “These are the generations of Yaakov: Yosef.” He is the chief of his offspring, and through him comes the principal victory in battle, in the dimension of “The house of Yaakov shall be fire and the house of Yosef a flame,” and as our Sages of blessed memory said.

Therefore, if one removed the core of the shofar, pierced the core and blew through it, it is invalid, for one also needs the dimension of justice, the dimension of Yaakov, which is the shofar itself. This is the dimension of the תרועה, which is the dimension of Yaakov, as is explained in the holy Zohar. “Remembrance of the תרועה” is when it is included with the dimension of Yosef. This is said of Rosh HaShanah that falls on Shabbos, when one mentions but does not blow, as our Sages of blessed memory expounded. The main reason is lest one come to carry the shofar into the public domain, thereby desecrating Shabbos; Shabbos corresponds to the quality of Yosef, as is explained in the holy Zohar. Therefore one does not blow; rather, through the holiness of Shabbos itself both of the above-mentioned dimensions shine, for Shabbos is also in the dimension of the inheritance of Yaakov, as our Sages of blessed memory said. Only in a place where there is a fixed court, as in Yavneh, where the dimension of justice, which is the dimension of Yaakov, shines most intensely, does one blow even on Shabbos. For certainly there this will not lead to desecration of Shabbos, G-d forbid.

Because one must connect all prayers to the true Tzadik, the dimension of Moshe, for only he can illuminate and rectify the prayers of Israel in their completeness and build from them the stature of the Divine Presence and the Tabernacle—and he himself is the dimension of the Messiah (כמפב"נ)—therefore one must travel especially on Rosh HaShanah to the true Tzadik. Because the letters of the Torah, which are the sparks of the holy souls, also come and are included within prayer to be renewed there, etc., therefore one mentions in the Rosh HaShanah prayers many verses from the Torah, Prophets and Writings, and verses concerning the receiving of the Torah, etc.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
This is the dimension of "Blow the Shofar in the month [of Tishray]"
— i.e., the Shofar-soundings of Rosh HaShanah —
and the verse concludes:
"for it is a statute for Israel — the judgment of the G-d of Yaakov"
[Ps. 81:5]
— hinting at guarding the Bris [chok] and the dimension of judgment of Yaakov,
as explained in the main text of this discourse above.
And this is the dimension of:
"A testimony in Yosef He placed it"
— and the Sages, z"l, expounded that on Rosh HaShanah, Yosef went out of prison —
and therefore the merit of Yosef, the dimension of guarding the Bris,
shines most intensely at that time.

The Three Blessings — Malchuyos, Zichronos, Shofaros

Malchuyos — corresponding to the dimension of the Kingdom of the Messiah,
whose very vitality comes from prayer, which is the dimension of Malchus, as is known,
and as is brought elsewhere.
Zichronos — corresponding to the dimension of Yosef,
the dimension of the Bris,
as is brought in the Zohar on the verse
"all your males shall appear before Me"
[Ex. 23:17]
— and this is the dimension of "He remembered His covenant forever"
[Ps. 111:5].
Shofaros — corresponding to the dimension of Yaakov,
the dimension of judgment, the dimension of
"the beauty of Yaakov"
[Lam. 2:1],
as is brought in the Zohar —
for through the sound of the Shofar, the essential quality and measure of Yaakov is aroused —
the dimension of justice —
and through this the essential rectification is accomplished.

qualifications.text: The word זכרות denotes the horn’s inner core in the shofar ruling and also carries the sense of maleness. The passage uses both senses in its interpretation concerning Yosef and the covenant.
The expression שופריה דיעקב, “the beauty of Yaakov,” also provides a verbal link with שופר, shofar.
The sentence about the fixed court is read in context as an assurance that blowing there will not lead to desecrating Shabbos. The supplied form יבוארשם is left unchanged in the Hebrew.
The supplied abbreviation כמפב"נ is retained without expansion.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 1, in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola
["Blow the Shofar of Sovereignty"], it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension (bechia) of being the Place of the World
— and they are able to perform the [spiritual work of] Rosh HaShanah.
And in the discourse Tik'u Emuna, Siman 5,
much is explained regarding the wondrous rectifications
that are wrought through the gathering of the disciples near the true Rebbe —
and the primary time of gathering is on Rosh HaShanah.
