units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בזה כל השי"ת כי ע"י התשובה ממשיין אורו של משיח כמבואר בספר המדות ועיקר התשובה הוא ע"י תפלה ותחנונים בבחי' דרשו ה' בהמצאו קראוהו בהיותו קרוב יעזוב רשע דרכו וכו' כמו שדחז"ל, עד שזוכין ליום כפורים ואז המלכות שהוא עיקר אורו של משיח ניזונית רק מחמשה קולות שהם סוד החמשה עינויים וחמשה תפלות של יו"כ ואז נמשך ביותר סוד המאמר שאנו עוסקין בו שעיקר חיותו של משיח הוא מהתפלה שזה סוד מנוקבא דפרדשקא משך רוחא דחיי למשיחא, ומחמת שבהפרדשקא הנ"ל משם שורש הענין של סליחת עון ועבור על פשע ומשם שורש המתקת הדינים כמובן כ"ז בזוה"ק תרומה דף קע"ז בסד"צ ובאד"ר נשא דפף קל"ו ובאד"זדף רפ"ט ע"ש ע"כ ביו"כ אז עיקר המתקת הדינים וסליחת עונות, ואז כל העבודה בכ"ג שקדוש ביותר בקדושת הברית כי מוזהר גם על האלמנה וארז"ל בזאת יבא אהרן וכו' בזכות המילה וכה"ג לובש ח' בגדים כנגד ימי המילה והוא בחי' אהרן שהוא בחי' משפט כמבואר במאמר הנ"ל, ואז נמשך בחי' הקמת המשכן שנבנה מתפלות ישראל וע"כ תיכף ממחרת יו"כ נצטוו על ענין המשכן וגם חנוכת הביהמק"ד של שלמה היה ביו"כ, ואז נתחדשין גם אותיות התורה בתוך התפלה שזה בחי'מה שגם גמר קגלת התורה של לוחות שניות היה ביו"כ כמו שדרשו רז"ל על יו"כ ביום חתונתו זה מתן תורה וביום שמחת לבו זה בנין ביהמק"ד וכמ ושפירשו המפרשים, וע"כ רוב המניים שנצרכו לנדבת המשכן מרמזין על ענין ר"ה ויו"כ וסוכות ועשי"ת כמבואר בזוה"ק תרומה דף קל"ה:
units.en:
And afterward one engages in this throughout the Ten Days of Repentance, for through repentance the light of the Messiah is drawn down, as is explained in Sefer HaMidos. The essence of repentance is through prayer and supplication, in the dimension of “Seek G-d when He may be found; call upon Him when He is near; let the wicked forsake his way,” etc., as our Sages of blessed memory expounded, until one merits Yom Kippur.

Then Kingship, which is the very light of the Messiah, is nourished only from five voices, which are the secret of the five afflictions and five prayers of Yom Kippur. Then the secret of the teaching we are discussing is drawn down most intensely: the very vitality of the Messiah comes from prayer. This is the secret of “From the opening of פרדשקא, he drew a spirit of life to the Messiah.”

In the above-mentioned פרדשקא is rooted the matter of forgiveness of iniquity and passing over transgression, and from there is rooted the sweetening of judgments, as all this is understood in the holy Zohar, תרומה, page 177, in סד"צ; in אד"ר, נשא, page 136; and in אד"ז, page 289; see there. Therefore on Yom Kippur comes the essential sweetening of judgments and forgiveness of iniquities.

Then all the service is performed by the High Priest, who is especially holy in the holiness of the covenant, for he is forbidden even a widow. Our Sages of blessed memory said: “With this shall Aharon enter,” etc.—in the merit of circumcision. The High Priest wears eight garments corresponding to the days of circumcision, and he is the dimension of Aharon, who is the dimension of justice, as explained in the above-mentioned teaching.

Then the dimension of erecting the Tabernacle, which is built from the prayers of Israel, is drawn down. Therefore immediately on the day after Yom Kippur they were commanded concerning the Tabernacle. The dedication of Solomon’s Temple was also on Yom Kippur. Then the letters of the Torah are also renewed within prayer. This is the dimension of the completion of receiving the Torah of the second tablets also being on Yom Kippur, as our Sages of blessed memory expounded concerning Yom Kippur: “On the day of his wedding”—this is the giving of the Torah; “and on the day of the gladness of his heart”—this is the building of the Temple, as the commentators explained. Therefore most of the kinds needed for the Tabernacle offering allude to Rosh HaShanah, Yom Kippur, Sukkos and the Ten Days of Repentance, as explained in the holy Zohar, תרומה, page 135.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is why the Sages, z"l, said:
"The horns of most animals are invalid for the Shofar
because they do not have an inner masculinity"
[Rosh HaShanah 26b]
— for the Shofar, which is the dimension of Yaakov,
must be included also from the dimension of Yosef —
the dimension of masculinity, the dimension of the Bris —
for Yaakov and Yosef go together as one,
as it is said:
"And the body and the covenant are considered one"
— and this is the essential substance of his progeny:
"These are the generations of Yaakov — Yosef"
[Gen. 37:2].

And therefore if one removed the masculinity (zichrus) of the Shofar and perforated it,
and blew through it — it is invalid —
for one also needs the dimension of justice, the dimension of Yaakov,
which is the Shofar itself.
And this is the dimension of the Teruah which is the dimension of Yaakov,
as is explained in the Zohar.
And Zichron Teruah [Remembrance of the Teruah — Lev. 23:24]
is when it is included also with the dimension of Yosef.

And this is said regarding Rosh HaShanah that falls on Shabbos —
when one mentions [the soundings] but does not actually blow the Shofar:
because the risk is that one might bring the Shofar into a public domain
[thereby desecrating the Shabbos],
and Shabbos desecration would be in the dimension of the quality of Yosef,
as is explained in the Zohar.
Therefore one does not blow —
rather, through the holiness of Shabbos itself
both dimensions shine —
for Shabbos is also in the dimension of the inheritance of Yaakov, as the Sages said.
Only in a place where there is a fixed Rabbinical court — such as in Yavneh —
where the dimension of justice which is the dimension of Yaakov shines more intensely,
does one blow even on Shabbos.

qualifications.text: The opening abbreviation השי"ת is read here as the Ten Days of Repentance, following the passage’s sequence up to Yom Kippur and its closing עשי"ת. The supplied Hebrew is unchanged.

The opening נוקבא in the Aramaic quotation is read as an opening, not a female attendant. פרדשקא is retained as the term in the supplied quotation; the masculine verb “he drew” is preserved without assigning it an additional named subject.

units.he: ואח"כ אחר יו"כ מתחילין ליכנס החסידים וכו' כמבואר בוכוונות זה בחי' מה שמסיים רבינו זל בסוף המאמר שאעפ"י שנראה שע"י תפלותינו ותורתינו יהיה הגאולה אעפי"כ צריכין אנחנו לחסדו ואי לא חסדו היה טבעינן ח"ו בגלות, ע"כ אחר כל התיקונים שנמשכין ע"י תפלתינו ותשובותינושעד יו"כ אעפי"כ גמר הישועה והתיקון הוא ע"י חסדי ה' בחי' החסדים שנכנסין אז כנ"ל, וע"כ נכנסין לסוכה שמרמזת לסוכה עילאה בחי' בינה ולסוכה תתאה בחי'מלכות שזה בחי' לאה ורחל שהן בחי' הז' שמות ע"ב ס"ג מ"ה ב"ן קס"א קנ"א קמ"ג שהם גימטריא תרפ"ו פרדשקא כמובא בכתבי האריז"ל, וזה בחי' משיח בן דוד שיצא דייקא מלאה ועיקר חיותו מהתפלה שכלולה ג"כ משני בחי' הנ"ל שה בחי' דיבורי התפלה וכוונת הלב בתפלה בבחי' תכין לבם וכו' כמו שארז"ל, ועיין בסי' מ"ח מבואר ג"כ שסוכה הוא בחי' תפלה בכוונה ובכח, וזה בחי' סוכת דוד הונפלת בחי' אור של משיח שנקרא בר נפל. ומצוות סוכה הוא זכר להיקף ענני כבוד בחי' ביטול עננים דסט"א שהם בחי' המחשבות זרות המבטלין כוונת התפלה שהוא בחי' כבוד כמבואר בפנים, וע"כ צריכין שתהיה פחותה מעשרים דשלטא בה עינא שזה בחי' תיקון המשפט וביטול המחשבות זרות שהן עננין דמכסיין על עיינין בבחי' כי עין בעין יראו כוו' כמבאור בפנים. וזה בחי'אשר עין בעין נראה אתה ה' ועננך עומד עליהם, וכן אם הואלמטה מעשרה פסולה כי נקראת דירה סרוחה בחי' פגם הברית שהוא עיקר הסרחון כ"ש וסרוחים על ערשותם כמו שדרשו חז"ל שהיו מסריחין מטותיהם בשכבת זרע וכו', וע"כ אין מסככין אלא בדבר שאין מקבל טומאה בחי' תיקון הברית היפוך פגם הברית שהוא עיקר הטומאה, ובדבר הצומח מן הארץ ששם צריכין העיקר להמשיך בחי' תיקון המשפט בחי' השופט כל הארץ לא יעשה מפשט וכתיב מלך במשפט יעמיד ארץ, וגם צריכין שיהיו בתלושדווקא שהוא דבר המטלט ולא במחובר שהוא קבוע במקומו כי זהעיקר שלימות התפלה לחדש בה דבר ובבחי' אל תעש תפלתך קבע וכו', וזה בעצמו מה שארז"ל על ענין סוכה צא מדירת קבע ושב בדירת עראי כמבואר במ"א, וע"י התפלה נבנה המשכן שהוא ג"כ בחי' סוכה כ"ש ויהי בשלם סוכו, ועיקר שלימות התפלה ע"י התקשרות לצדיקים והצדיקים שהוא בחי' מאור הגדול מזהיר ומאיר את התפלה שהוא בחי' מאור הקטן וזה בחי' סוכה כ"ו ה"ס יחוד הוי"ה אדנ"י וזה בעצמו בחי'מאור הגדול ומאור הקטן כידוע, גם נשמות ישראל הנכנסין לתוך הסוכה הם בחי' האותיות התורה שהם ניצוצי נשמות הבאים ונכללים בתוך התפלה להתחדש שם וע"כ תיכף כשיוצאין מהסוכה מסיימין התורה ומתחילין התורה עולין אז לתורה:
units.en:
And afterward, after Yom Kippur, the pious ones begin to enter, etc., as explained in כוונות. This is the dimension of what Rabbainu of blessed memory concludes at the end of the teaching: although it appears that redemption will come through our prayers and Torah, nevertheless we need His kindness; were it not for His kindness, we would have drowned, G-d forbid, in exile. Therefore, after all the rectifications drawn through our prayers and repentance up to Yom Kippur, nevertheless the completion of salvation and rectification comes through the kindnesses of G-d, the dimension of the loving-kindnesses that enter at that time, as above.

Therefore one enters the sukkah, which alludes to the supernal sukkah, the dimension of understanding, and to the lower sukkah, the dimension of Kingship. These are the dimensions of Leah and Rachel, the dimension of the seven Names: 72, 63, 45, 52, 161, 151 and 143, whose numerical value is given here as 686, פרדשקא, as brought in the writings of the Ar"i of blessed memory. This is the dimension of Messiah son of David, who came specifically from Leah. His essential vitality comes from prayer, which also includes both of the above-mentioned dimensions: the spoken words of prayer and the intention of the heart in prayer, in the dimension of “You prepare their heart,” etc., as our Sages of blessed memory said. See section 48, where it is also explained that the sukkah is the dimension of prayer with intention and strength. This is the dimension of the fallen sukkah of David, the dimension of the light of the Messiah, who is called בר נפל.

The mitzvah of sukkah commemorates the encompassing Clouds of Glory, the dimension of nullifying the clouds of the Other Side, which are the alien thoughts that nullify the intention of prayer. Prayer is the dimension of glory, as explained in the main text. Therefore the sukkah must be lower than twenty cubits, so that the eye takes it in. This is the dimension of rectifying justice and nullifying the alien thoughts, which are clouds that cover the eyes, in the dimension of “For they shall see eye to eye,” etc., as explained in the main text. This is the dimension of “That You, G-d, are seen eye to eye, and Your cloud stands over them.”

Likewise, if it is below ten handbreadths, it is invalid, for it is called a foul dwelling, the dimension of the blemish of the covenant, which is the essence of foulness. As it is written: “And those who sprawl upon their beds,” as our Sages expounded: they used to foul their beds with semen, etc. Therefore one may roof the sukkah only with something that is not susceptible to ritual impurity, the dimension of rectifying the covenant—the opposite of blemishing the covenant, which is the essence of impurity—and with something that grows from the earth. For there one must principally draw down the dimension of rectifying justice, the dimension of “Shall the Judge of all the earth not do justice?” And it is written: “A king establishes the earth through justice.”

It must also be specifically detached, something movable, and not attached, fixed in its place. For this is the essential completeness of prayer: to introduce something new within it, in the dimension of “Do not make your prayer fixed,” etc. This itself is what our Sages of blessed memory said concerning the sukkah: “Leave a permanent dwelling and sit in a temporary dwelling,” as explained elsewhere.

Through prayer the Tabernacle is built, which is also the dimension of the sukkah, as it is written: “His sukkah was in Shalem.” The essential completeness of prayer comes through attachment to Tzadikim. The Tzadikim, who are the dimension of the great luminary, illuminate and give light to prayer, which is the dimension of the small luminary. This is the dimension of סוכה: 26 and 65, the unification of הוי"ה and אדנ"י. This itself is the dimension of the great luminary and the small luminary, as is known. Also, the souls of Israel that enter the sukkah are the dimension of the letters of the Torah, the sparks of souls that enter into prayer and are included within it, to be renewed there. Therefore, immediately upon leaving the sukkah, one finishes the Torah and begins the Torah, and at that time one ascends to the Torah.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because one must connect all prayers to the true Tzadik —
the dimension of Moshe —
for only he can illuminate and rectify the prayers of Israel in their completeness
and build from them the structure (koma) of the Divine Presence and the Sanctuary;
and he himself is in the dimension of the Messiah, as is explained —
therefore one must travel especially to the true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah.

And because the letters of the Torah, which are the holy sparks of souls,
come and are included within prayer to be renewed there, etc. —
therefore one recites in the Rosh HaShanah prayers many verses
from the entire Tanach [Torah, Prophets, and Writings]
and verses regarding the Giving of the Torah, etc.

Afterwards One Engages in Repentance — Yom Kippur

qualifications.text: The opening reads החסידים, “the pious ones,” while the later explanation reads החסדים, “the loving-kindnesses.” Both supplied forms are preserved rather than replacing one with the other.

The supplied Hebrew gives the total תרפ"ו, 686. The seven listed numerical Names add to 687, while פרדשקא has the standard letter value 685. These differing values are retained without a speculative reconciliation.
In the sukkah-height discussion, twenty is measured in cubits and ten in handbreadths; the supplied paragraph gives the numbers without spelling out both units here.

units.he: וזה ג"כ בחי' הארבע מינים שמריכןי ליטלם ולברך עלהים בתוךם הסוכה כמבואר בכוונות והן מרמזין על כל הד' כתות שיש בישראת שזה בחי' כלל נשמות ישראל, ואח"כ אומרין עמהם את ההלל שהוא בחי' כלל תפלות ישראל שיש בו לשעבר ולעתיד וכו' כמו שארז"ל וגם אומרין עמהם הושענות, וע"כ מנענעין בהודו לה' ובאנא ה' הושיעה נא שזה בחי' כלל התפלות שהוא שבחו של מקום ושאלת צרכיו כמב"פ, ועיקר הברכה על נטילת לולב שהוא גבוה מכולם ומרמז על בחי' הצדיק שכל הכתות שבישראל צריכין להתקשר אליו בתפלתו והוא בחי' מאור הגדול ומאיר לאתרוג שהוא בחי' מאור הקטן, וזה בחי' ולקחתם לכם ביםו הראשון פרי עץ הדר וכו' ודרז"ל שזה בחי' כל עצמותי תאמרנה וכו' שזה בחי' שלימות התפלה כי לולב דומה לשדרה וזה בחי' יוסף הצדיק בחי' צדיק ח"י עלמין בחי' ח"י חוליות שבשדרה, אתרוג דומה ללב זה בחי' משיח בן דוד שהוא בחי' הלב של העולם כמובן בהמעשה של הז' בעטלירס וע"כ נקרא הדר בחי' הוד והדר תשוה עליו הנאמר על משי חבן דוד, הדס דומה לעינים זה בחי' המשפט בבחי' עין משפט ואין לו לדיין אלא מה שעיניו רואות ע"כ דרז"ל שהדס מרמז על יעקב שהוא בחי' משפט, ערבה דומה לשפתים זה בחי' התפלה בחי' אדנ"י שפתי תפתח, גם מרמז על אותיות התורה בחי' נשמות ישראל שנאמר עליהם וצמחו בבנין חציר כערבים על יבלי מים (ישעי' מד), וזה שאמרו חז"ל בזהכות ולקחתם לכם ביום הראשון אני נגלה לכם ראשון וכו' ופורע לכם מן הראשון זה עשו היינ וכי מבטלין כל המחשבות זרות שבתפלה שהן בחי' עענין דמכסיין על עיינין הבאים מבחי' קליפות עשו עמלק כידוע וזוכין לחבי' כי עין בעין יראו וכו' ובונה לכם ראשון זה בית המקדש בחי' משכן שנבנה מתפילות ישראל ומביא לכם ראשון זה מלך המשיח כי הוא מקבל כח חיותו מהתפילה, וזה שמביא בזהו"ק שהד' מנים הן בבחי' מאני קרבא כלי זיין כי התפלה היא עיקר כלי זיינו של משיח כנ"ל ועיין זוהר בראשית דף רנ"ו מבואר שסוכות מרמז על ימות המשיח:
units.en:
This is also the dimension of the Four Species, which one must take and bless within the sukkah, as explained in כוונות. They allude to all four groups within Israel, which is the dimension of the totality of the souls of Israel. Afterward one recites with them Hallel, which is the dimension of the totality of the prayers of Israel, containing past and future, etc., as our Sages of blessed memory said. One also recites with them Hoshanos. Therefore one waves them at “Give thanks to G-d” and at “Please, G-d, save now.” This is the dimension of the totality of prayers, which is praise of the Omnipresent and asking for one’s needs, as explained in the main text.

The principal blessing is on taking the lulav, which is taller than all of them and alludes to the Tzadik, to whom all the groups within Israel must attach themselves in his prayer. He is the dimension of the great luminary and illuminates the esrog, which is the dimension of the small luminary. This is the dimension of “And you shall take for yourselves on the first day a fruit of a beautiful tree,” etc. Our Sages of blessed memory expounded that this is the dimension of “All my bones shall say,” etc., which is the dimension of the completeness of prayer. For the lulav resembles the spine, and this is the dimension of Yosef the Tzadik, the dimension of the Tzadik, the life of the worlds, the dimension of the eighteen vertebrae in the spine.

The esrog resembles the heart. This is the dimension of Messiah son of David, who is the heart of the world, as is understood in the story of the Seven Beggars. Therefore it is called הדר, the dimension of “Splendor and glory You place upon him,” which is said of Messiah son of David. The myrtle resembles the eyes: this is the dimension of justice, in the dimension of “the eye of justice,” and “A judge has only what his eyes see.” Therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded that the myrtle alludes to Yaakov, who is the dimension of justice. The willow resembles the lips: this is the dimension of prayer, the dimension of “G-d, open my lips.” It also alludes to the letters of the Torah, the dimension of the souls of Israel, of whom it is said: “They shall sprout among the grass, like willows by streams of water” (ישעי', chapter 44).

This is what our Sages of blessed memory said: in the merit of “And you shall take for yourselves on the first day,” “I shall be revealed to you as First,” etc., “and exact retribution for you from the first”—this is Esau. That is, one nullifies all the alien thoughts within prayer, which are the dimension of clouds that cover the eyes, coming from the husks of Esau and Amalek, as is known; and one merits the dimension of “For they shall see eye to eye,” etc. “And I build for you the first”—this is the Temple, the dimension of the Tabernacle built from the prayers of Israel. “And I bring you the first”—this is the King Messiah, for he receives the strength of his vitality from prayer. This is what the holy Zohar brings: the Four Species are in the dimension of implements of battle—weapons—for prayer is the principal weaponry of the Messiah, as above. See Zohar, בראשית, page 256, where it is explained that Sukkos alludes to the days of the Messiah.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Afterwards one engages in this throughout the Ten Days of Repentance —
for through repentance, the light of the Messiah is drawn down,
as is explained in Sefer HaMidos.
And the essence of repentance is through prayer and supplication —
the dimension of "Seek G-d when He may be found; call upon Him when He is near;
let the wicked forsake his way" etc.,
[Is. 55:6–7]
as the Sages, z"l, expounded —
until one merits on Yom Kippur.

Then Malchus, which is the very light of the Messiah,
is nourished only from the five voices —
the secret of the Five Afflictions and Five Prayers of Yom Kippur.
Then there is drawn most intensely the secret of the discourse we are engaged in:
that the very vitality of the Messiah is from prayer.
This is the secret of "from the Maid of the Palace she drew out a breath of life for the Messiah"
[Zohar, Teruma 177].

Because within the Pardashka mentioned above
is rooted the matter of the forgiveness of sin
and the overlooking of transgression,
and from there is rooted the sweetening of judgments —
as all of this is understood in the Zohar, Teruma p. 177, in the Sifra d'Tzniusa,
and in the Idra Rabba, Nasso, p. 136,
and in the Idra Zuta, p. 289 —
therefore on Yom Kippur is the essential sweetening of judgments and forgiveness of sins.

And then all the service [is performed] by the High Priest (Kohain Godol),
who is most holy in the holiness of the Bris —
for he is admonished even regarding a widow.
The Sages, z"l, expounded:
"With this shall Aharon enter"
[Lev. 16:3]
— in the merit of circumcision.
And the High Priest wears eight garments corresponding to the eight days of circumcision,
and he is the dimension of Aharon, who is the dimension of judgment (mishpot),
as is explained in the above discourse.

qualifications.text: The supplied בתפלתו is singular, “in his prayer.” That form is retained rather than replacing it with “their prayer.”
The title ח"י עלמין, “the life of the worlds,” is linked here with ח"י, eighteen, and the eighteen vertebrae.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואח"כ הוא
units.en: Passage beginning “And afterward it is”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And once he said that on Rosh HaShanah he performs matters and rectifications
— even for the souls of those close to him who come to him on Rosh HaShanah —
that throughout the entire year, even he himself cannot perform them.

qualifications.text: These are opening words used as a discourse heading, not a separate teaching paragraph.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ הוא שמיני עצרת זווגא דמטרוניתא פנים בפנים שזה בחי' כד חם גביה איתהפיך כמבואר בפנים והנוקבא עוצרת הטיפה שלא תפיל, כי עכשיו אעפ"י שע"יהתפלה נבנה קומת השכינה הוא רק בבחי' ההכנה לזייוג בבחי' וסלקינן ואפינן ובשלינן, אבל אעפי"כ מחמת שאין הישועה עדיין בשלימות ע"כ יכולין לטעות ולומר שהתפילות אין עושין פירות בבחי' סברינן יבשתא הוא, אבל שמיני עצרת מרמז על הישועה השלימה שלעתיד שאז יהיה בבחי' זווגא דמטרוניתא ממש פנים בפנים בבחי' כד חם גביה איתהפיך והנוקבא עוצרת הטיפה שלא תפיל רק כל זיווג ויחוד שנעשה ע"י תפלות ישראל יראו אז שעשה פירות. והולדה גמורה ממש כביכול, ואז השמחה גדולה מאד מאחר שנגמר הבנין הקדוש הזה ונעשה היחוד והזיווג הקדוש והנורא הזה שעוסקים בו בכל הימים הנוראים האובשלימות ואז גם האותיות התורה הבאין בתוך התפלה נתחדשין ונשלמיןמאד שזה בי' מה שכל ישראל עולין אז לתורה ושמחים מאד כי זה בחי' בתולות אחריה רעותיה מובאות לך תובלנה בשמחות וגילן ועיין פנים:
units.en:
And afterward comes the Eighth Day of Assembly, the union of the Matron face to face. This is the dimension of “When its back grew hot, it turned over,” as explained in the main text, and the female principle retains the drop so as not to miscarry. For now, although the stature of the Divine Presence is built through prayer, it is only in the dimension of preparation for union, in the dimension of “And we ascended, and we baked, and we cooked.” Nevertheless, because salvation is not yet complete, one can err and say that prayers bear no fruit, in the dimension of “We thought it was dry land.”

But the Eighth Day of Assembly alludes to the complete salvation of the future, when there will be the actual union of the Matron face to face, in the dimension of “When its back grew hot, it turned over.” The female principle retains the drop so as not to miscarry; rather, every union and unification accomplished through the prayers of Israel will then be seen to have produced fruit and actual, complete birth, as it were. Then the joy is very great, since this holy building has been completed and this holy and awe-inspiring unification and union, in which one engages throughout all the Days of Awe, has come to completion. Then also the letters of the Torah that enter into prayer are greatly renewed and completed. This is the dimension of all Israel ascending to the Torah at that time and rejoicing greatly, for this is the dimension of “The maidens after her, her companions, are brought to You; they shall be led with joy and gladness.” See the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Then the dimension of the erection of the Sanctuary is drawn —
which is built from the prayers of Israel.
And therefore immediately on the day after Yom Kippur
they were commanded regarding the matter of the Sanctuary.
And also the dedication of the Temple of Solomon was on Yom Kippur.
Then the letters of the Torah are also renewed within prayer —
which is the dimension of what [the Sages taught]:
the completion of the reception of the Torah on the Second Tablets
was also on Yom Kippur,
as the Sages, z"l, expounded on the verse:
"On the day of his wedding"
[Song of Songs 3:11] — "this is the Giving of the Torah"
[Taanis 26b],
as the commentators have explained.

After Yom Kippur — The Loving-Kindnesses Enter

After Yom Kippur, the [supernal] loving-kindnesses (chassodim) begin to enter —
as is explained in the Kavanos —
the dimension of what the discourse concludes:
that even though it appears that through our prayers and Torah
the redemption will come,
nonetheless we need His loving-kindness —
for were it not for His kindness, we would have drowned, heaven forbid, in exile.
Therefore, after all the holy rectifications drawn through prayer and repentance
until Yom Kippur,
nonetheless the completion of salvation and rectification
is through the kindness of G-d — the dimension of the loving-kindnesses
that enter at that time.

And therefore one enters the Sukka,
which alludes to the Supernal Sukka — the dimension of Bina —
and to the Lower Sukka — the dimension of Malchus —
which is the dimension of Leah and Rachel.
These are the dimension of the seven Names:
72, 63, 45, 52, 161, 151, 143 —
their numerical value (gematria) is 689,
which is the gematria of Pardashka,
as brought in the writings of the Ar"i z"l.

And this is the dimension of Messiah Son of David,
who came specifically from Leah.
His essential vitality is from prayer,
which is itself included from both dimensions mentioned above —
the spoken words of prayer, and the intention (kavona) of the heart in prayer —
the dimension of "prepare their heart"
[Ps. 10:17], as the Sages said.

And see Siman 48 [of Likutay Mohara"n],
where it is also explained that the Sukka is the dimension of prayer with intention and strength.
This is the dimension of "the Sukka of David that has fallen"
[Amos 9:11]
— the dimension of the light of the Messiah who is called bar nofal [the fallen one].

The mitzvah of Sukka is a remembrance of the encompassing Clouds of Glory —
the dimension of the nullification of the clouds of the Stra Achra,
which are the dimension of alien thoughts
that nullify the intention of prayer, which is the dimension of [G-d's] honor (kovod),
as is explained in the main text.

The Four Species — Recalled and Praised within the Sukka

This is also the dimension of the Four Species —
which one takes and blesses within the Sukka as explained in the Kavanos —
and they allude to all the four groupings within Israel,
which is the dimension of the totality of the souls of Israel.

Afterwards one recites with them the Hallel prayer —
which is the dimension of the totality of the prayers of Israel,
containing past and future, etc., as the Sages, z"l, said.
And one also recites with them Hoshanos.
Therefore one waves [the four species] during "Give thanks to G-d"
and during "Please, G-d, save now"
— the dimension of the totality of prayers,
which is [G-d's] praise and the request for one's needs,
as is explained in the main text.

The primary blessing is on the taking of the lulav,
which is the tallest of all —
and alludes to the dimension of the Tzadik,
to whom all the groupings of Israel must attach themselves in their prayer.
The Tzadik is the dimension of Maor HaGodol — the Great Luminary —
and illuminates the esrog, which is the dimension of Maor HaKoton — the Small Luminary.

This is the dimension of "And you shall take for yourselves on the first day —
a fruit of a beautiful tree" etc. [Lev. 23:40],
and the Sages, z"l, expounded
that this is the dimension of
"all my bones shall say [G-d, who is like You]"
[Ps. 35:10]
— the dimension of the completeness of prayer —
for the lulav resembles the spine,
and this is the dimension of Yosef the Tzadik,
the dimension of Tzadik Chai Olamim — the Tzadik who is the life of the worlds —
the dimension of the eighteen vertebrae of the spine.
The esrog resembles the heart — the dimension of Messiah Son of David,
who is the heart of the world, as is understood in the story of the Seven Beggars.
Therefore it is called Hadar [beauty/adornment] —
the dimension of "splendor and glory You place upon him"
said of Messiah Son of David.

The hadas [myrtle] resembles the eyes — the dimension of judgment,
the dimension of "the eye of judgment"
— and the Sages, z"l, taught that the myrtle alludes to Yaakov,
who is the dimension of justice.
The arova [willow] resembles the lips — the dimension of prayer,
the dimension of "G-d, open my lips"
[Ps. 51:17];
and it also alludes to the letters of the Torah — the souls of Israel —
as it is said of them:
"And they shall sprout among the grass, like willows by streams of water"
[Is. 44:4].

Sh'mini Atzeres — The Sacred Union is Completed

Afterwards, on Sh'mini Atzeres,
comes the "union of the Matron" face to face —
the dimension of [the Zohar's] "when he warms with her, she turns",
as is explained in the main text.
The feminine [Malchus] retains the drop so that it does not miscarry —
for now, even though through prayer the structure (koma) of the Divine Presence is built,
it is only in the dimension of preparation for union —
the dimension of "we prepared and baked and cooked" [before Shabbos].
But even so, because the salvation is not yet complete,
one might err and say that the prayers produce no fruit —
the dimension of "we thought it was dry land".

But Sh'mini Atzeres alludes to the complete salvation that will come in the future —
when there will be the true union of the Matron face to face,
and every union and unification accomplished through the prayers of Israel
will be seen to have produced fruit and complete birth, as it were.
And then the joy is very great,
for the holy building is completed and the sacred, awe-inspiring union is accomplished —
which was engaged in during all the Days of Awe in their completeness.
And then also the letters of the Torah
that come within prayer are renewed and completed greatly —
this being the dimension of all Israel ascending to the Torah
and rejoicing greatly —
the dimension of:
"the maidens behind her, her companions, are brought to You;
they are led with joy and gladness"
[Ps. 45:15].
See the main text.

Translator's Summary — Siman 2

Siman 2 is based on the discourse Emor el HaKohanim (Likutay Mohara"n).
The central theme: the Messiah's entire life-force is prayer.
On Rosh HaShanah — through the Shofar soundings —
the husks covering the rainbow of the Messiah are removed.
The rectification requires the joining of two dimensions:
Yosef (the guarded Bris) and Yaakov (justice/judgment) —
hence visiting Tzadik's graves and increasing charity on Erev Rosh HaShanah.
The Three Blessings map precisely: Malchuyos = Messiah/Prayer; Zichronos = Yosef/Bris; Shofaros = Yaakov/Justice.
Yom Kippur is the apex of prayer-building (Five Prayers = Five Voices).
Sukkos and the Four Species encode the same structure — prayer, Bris, Tzadik-connection —
culminating in Sh'mini Atzeres when the union is perfected.

qualifications.text: The Aramaic phrases are from the fish narrative explained in the cited discourse, Likutay Moharan 2. “Its back grew hot; it turned over” retains that narrative image, which is applied here to the union of the Matron. “We ascended” is retained rather than replacing it with “we prepared.”
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ידוע כי
units.en: Passage beginning “It is known that”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Book Yerech HaAisonim — in it are explained many wondrous matters from the topic of
the holiness of Rosh HaShanah and the sounding of the Shofar and the prayers of Rosh HaShanah,
and the great merit of one who is privileged to be near a true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah,
and the topic of the custom that was practiced to go on Erev Rosh HaShanah to pray at the graves of the Tzadikim;
and likewise explained within it are the topics of the holiness of the Ten Days of Repentance,
Yom Kippur, Sukkos, Sh'mini Atzeres, and Simchas Torah, and the holiness of all the mitzvos
of G-d which are observed during them.

qualifications.text: These are opening words used as a discourse heading, not a separate teaching paragraph.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ידוע כי בר"ה עוסקין כל ישראל בבנין המלכות דקודשה וביטול המלכו תדסט"א כמו שמתפללין ע"ז הרבה בתפלת ר"ה. ומחמת שהצפרים דסט"א שהן מוחין שבמלכות דקליפה הם בקליפה כנגד בחי' לאה ורחל כמבואר בכתבים ע"כ סובב והולך כוונת תפלת ר"ה על ענין לאה ורחל כמבואר שם. ומחמת שקול הנגינה נמשך מבחי' הציפרים דקדושה או ליהפך ח"ו ע"כ מדקדקין בניגונים של תפלות ר"ה ביותר שיהיה ש"ץ הגון וראוי וכן על התוקע כמבואר בשו"ע כי גם התקיעות הם בחי' קול הנגינה כ"שהטיבו נגן בתרועה, וזה בחי' יום תרועה יהיהלכם הנאמר בר"ה. וזה שאחז"ל על תקיעת שופר שהוא חכמה ואינה מלאכה כי הנגינה היא מבחי' המלכות, וזה כי מלך כל הארץ אלהים זמרו משכיל, וזה אשי העם יודעי תרועה שהתרועה בבחי' דעת ומוחין, ומחמת שתיקון הנגינה הוא ע"י תורה שבע"פ ע"כ דרז"ל בתיקונים שתרטועה מרמז תור"ה עיין בחי' עיין פנים לתורה וכו' שזה בחי' כל תורה שבע"פ, וע"כ מרמזין בהתקיעות גם על דוד המלך כמובא כי הוא בבחי' תורה שבע"פ כמ"ש בלקו"א סי' י"ב. וזה ג"כ בחי' מלכיות זכרונות ושופרות, מלכיות הוא בחי' מלכות, זכרונות הוא בחי' מוחין ודעת כנ"ל בסי' א', שופרות הוא בחי' הנגינה כנ"ל, וזה שמובא בזוהר שקול שופר ותרועה הוא כנגד יעקב כי יעקב זכה לתקן הקול הנ"ל בשלימות שזה בחי' הקול קול יעקב וזכהלתקן בחי' הציפרים הנ"ל בשרשן העליון שזה סוד שנשא בנות לבן כמובןבזוהר הק' ובכת' האריז"ל וע"כ נחשב חשבון שנות הנבואה מיעקב כמובא במגלה עמוקות אופן רכ"ח:
units.en:
It is known that on Rosh HaShanah all Israel engage in building the holy Kingship and nullifying the kingship of the Other Side, as one prays extensively for this in the Rosh HaShanah prayers. Because the birds of the Other Side, which are the mental faculties within the kingship of the husk, correspond within the husk to the dimensions of Leah and Rachel, as explained in the writings, therefore the intention of the Rosh HaShanah prayers revolves around Leah and Rachel, as explained there.

Because the voice of melody is drawn from the dimension of the holy birds, or the opposite, G-d forbid, therefore one is especially careful about the melodies of the Rosh HaShanah prayers, that the prayer-leader be fitting and worthy, and likewise concerning the one who blows the shofar, as explained in Shulchan Aruch. For the shofar-soundings are also the dimension of the voice of melody, as it is written: “Play well with the תרועה.” This is the dimension of “A day of תרועה shall it be for you,” which is said concerning Rosh HaShanah. This is what our Sages of blessed memory said of blowing the shofar: it is wisdom and not labor. For melody is from the dimension of Kingship. This is “For G-d is King of all the earth; sing with understanding.” This is “Fortunate is the people who know the תרועה,” for the תרועה is in the dimension of knowledge and the mental faculties.

Because the rectification of melody is through the Oral Torah, therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded in תיקונים that תרועה alludes to תורה and ע, the dimension of the seventy faces of the Torah, etc., which is the dimension of the entire Oral Torah. Therefore the shofar-soundings also allude to King David, as cited, for he is the dimension of the Oral Torah, as written in Likutay Moharan, section 12.

This is also the dimension of Kingship, Remembrances and Shofaros. Kingship is the dimension of Kingship; Remembrances are the dimension of the mental faculties and knowledge, as above in section 1; Shofaros are the dimension of melody, as above. This is what is brought in the Zohar: the voice of the shofar and the תרועה correspond to Yaakov, for Yaakov merited to rectify this voice completely, which is the dimension of “The voice is the voice of Yaakov.” He merited to rectify the above-mentioned birds at their supernal root. This is the secret of his marrying the daughters of Lavan, as is understood in the holy Zohar and the writings of the Ar"i of blessed memory. Therefore the years of prophecy are counted from Yaakov, as brought in מגלה עמוקות, approach 228.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
On Rosh HaShanah All Israel Engage in Building the Holy Kingdom

It is known that on Rosh HaShanah all Israel are engaged
in building the holy Malchus and nullifying the Malchus d'Stra Achra,
as one prays extensively for this in the Rosh HaShanah prayer service.

qualifications.text: The supplied forms תרטועה and עיין are read contextually as תרועה and the letter ע. Here “seventy faces of the Torah” is a contextual reading of the supplied עיין פנים לתורה, following that wordplay; it is not a claim that the irregular spelling has been uniquely resolved. The Hebrew is retained unchanged.
The supplied reference לקו"א, section 12, is identified here with Likutay Moharan 12, which explicitly associates David with the Oral Torah.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואח"כ עוסקין
units.en: Passage beginning “And afterward they engage”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Aleph-Hay [abbreviation: א״ה = "with G-d's help"]:
It is explained in the words of our holy Rebbe, the Light of Lights,
Mohara"n, z"l — in many places in his holy book
Likutay Mohara"n and in his holy conversations —
regarding the topic of the wondrous rectifications (tikkunim nifloim)
that are accomplished by those who come to the true Tzadik
on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: These are opening words used as a discourse heading, not a separate teaching paragraph.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בזה כל עשי"ת להרבות בתפלות ותחנונים ולצעור הרבה קולות דקדושה בחי' ממעמקים קראתיך ה' ה' שמעה בקולי וכו' עד שעי"ז נתתקין כל הפגמים שנפגמו במלכות דקדושה עד שחוזרת ונבנית בשלימות עד שביו"כ אז ניזון המלכות רק מחמשה קולות וכו' ששם שורש תיקון הקול דקדושה הנ"ל ואז נכנס הכהן הגדול לפני ולפנים ששם הכרובים והציפרים הק' וכשזכו ישראל אז היו הכרובים פנים אל פנים ושמעו מהם קולות קדושים ומזה ידעו שנתרצה הקב"ה לישראל בשלימות כמובא בזוה"ק היינו כנ"ל:
units.en:
And afterward one engages in this throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance: multiplying prayers and supplications and crying out many holy voices, in the dimension of “Out of the depths I called to You, G-d; G-d, hear my voice,” etc. Through this, all the blemishes inflicted upon the holy Kingship are rectified, until it returns and is rebuilt completely. On Yom Kippur, Kingship is then nourished only from five voices, etc.; there is the root of rectifying the above-mentioned holy voice.

Then the High Priest enters the innermost sanctuary, where the cherubim and the holy birds are. When Israel merited, the cherubim faced one another, and Israel heard holy voices from them. From this they knew that the Holy One, blessed be He, had been completely reconciled to Israel, as brought in the holy Zohar—that is, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because the birds (tzipporim) of the Stra Achra —
which are the mental faculties (mochin) of the Malchus d'Klipa [the husk-kingdom] —
are in the husk corresponding to the dimensions of Leah and Rachel,
as is explained in the holy writings —
therefore the intention of the Rosh HaShanah prayers
revolves around the matter of Leah and Rachel, as is explained there.

Because the flow of song and melody draws from the dimension
of the holy birds (tzipporim d'kedusha),
or [its opposite] from the side of evil, heaven forbid —
therefore one is exceedingly careful about the melodies of the Rosh HaShanah prayers —
that the prayer-leader (Shliach Tzibbur) be fitting and worthy —
and likewise regarding the one who blows the Shofar,
as is explained in the Shulchan Aruch.
For the Shofar soundings are also in the dimension of the voice of melody —
as it is written: "play well with the Teruah"
[Ps. 33:3].
And this is the dimension of: "A day of the Teruah shall it be for you"
— said of Rosh HaShanah.

And this is what the Sages, z"l, said:
"The Shofar-sounding is wisdom (chochma) and not a craft [melocha]"
[Rosh HaShanah 33b]
— for melody is from the dimension of Malchus.
This is the dimension of:
"for G-d is King of all the earth — sing a maskil"
[Ps. 47:8].
And this is "fortunate is the people who know the Teruah"
[Ps. 89:16]
— the Teruah is in the dimension of Daas (Knowledge) and the mental faculties.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 1, in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola
["Blow the Shofar of Sovereignty"], it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension (bechia) of being the Place of the World

And in the discourse Tik'u Emuna, Siman 5,

units.he: ואחר יו"כ נמשכין החסדים שה בחי' כמה נפיש חילא דאיילנא המרבא בפנים כי ע"י כל התיקונים הקדושים שהמשיכו ישראל בעשרת ימי תשובה שהם ימי דין שהוא בחי' לילה עי"זזוכין אח"כ לקבל חסדים גדולים בבחי' הלומד תורה בלילה מושכין עליו חוט של חסד ביום וזוכין לכנוס לסוכה שזה זכו ישראל בשכר שאמר אברהם אבינו להמלאכים והשענו תחת העץ שזה בחי' האשל שנטע אברהם שמרמז על החסד הנ"ל כמבואר בפנים, והחסד הזה מגין על האדם שלא יזיק לו המחשבה של שלא לשמה רק אדרבה מתוך שלא לשמה יבוא לבחי' לימוד לשמה ממש כשרז"ל, כי עד עכשיו מחמת תוקף הדין והיראה אפשר שישתלשל מזה איזהאחיזה לבחי' שלא לשמה כמו יראת העונש וכדומה ואפילו אם שב מיראה ממש ארז"ל שהעוונות נחשבין לשגגות יש מזה איזה יניקה עדיין לסט"א מיראה ממש שזה בחי' כי גדול מעל שמים חסדך המובא בפנים, וזה שארז"לשצריך שיהיה הכוכבים נראין מתוכה שזה סחי' מה שנאמר באברהם הבט נא השמימה וספור הכוכבים ודרז"ל שהגביהו למעלה מן השמים והכוכבים כי אין הבטה אלא מלמעלה למטה, ומחמת שעיקר המשכת התיקון הוא ע"י הלימוד בלילה דייקא ולילה היא בחי' צל נגד אור יום ע"כ צריכין שתהא צילתה של סוכה מרובה מחמתה, וע"כ למדו חז" שיעור הסוכה שהוא למעלה מעשרה מהכרובים שהן בחי' ציפרים הנ"ל, וזה בחי' השמחה של סוכות ועיקר השמחה היה בשמחת ביטת השואבה ודרז"ל ששאבו משם רוח הקודש היינו בחי' נבואה שמשם יניקת הציפרים הנ"ל מאתר דנ ביאים ינקין ומשם בנין המלכות דקדושה שהוא בחי' סוכת דוד, וזה שארז"ל שם לענין נבואה ממש אין הנבואה שורה על הנביא אלא מתוך שמחה של מצוה שנאמר והיה כמנגן המנגן וכו' כנגן המנגן דייקא כי הנבואה ונגינה ממקור אחד רק שצריכין מנגן כשר וצדיק דיקא כנ"ל:
units.en:
And after Yom Kippur the loving-kindnesses are drawn down, the dimension of “How great is the power of the tree,” cited in the main text. For through all the holy rectifications Israel drew down during the Ten Days of Repentance, which are days of judgment, the dimension of night, one afterward merits to receive great loving-kindnesses, in the dimension of “One who studies Torah at night has a thread of kindness drawn over him by day.” One merits to enter the sukkah, which Israel merited as a reward for Avraham our father’s saying to the angels, “Rest under the tree.” This is the dimension of the אשל that Avraham planted, alluding to the above-mentioned kindness, as explained in the main text.

This kindness protects a person so that the thought of studying not for its own sake does not harm him. Rather, on the contrary, from studying not for its own sake he will come to actual study for its own sake, as our Sages of blessed memory said. For until now, owing to the intensity of judgment and awe, some foothold for the dimension of not-for-its-own-sake could develop from this, such as fear of punishment and the like. Even if he repents out of genuine awe, our Sages of blessed memory said that the sins are counted as unintentional transgressions; there is still some nourishment from this for the Other Side—from genuine awe. This is the dimension of “For Your kindness is great above the heavens,” cited in the main text.

This is what our Sages of blessed memory said: stars must be visible through it. This is the dimension of what was said to Avraham: “Look now toward the heavens and count the stars.” Our Sages expounded that He raised him above the heavens and stars, for looking is only from above downward. Because the principal drawing of the rectification comes specifically through study at night, and night is the dimension of shade in contrast to daylight, therefore the sukkah’s shade must exceed its sunlight. Therefore our Sages derived the sukkah’s height, which is above ten handbreadths, from the cherubim, which are the dimension of the above-mentioned birds.

This is the dimension of the joy of Sukkos. The principal joy was at the Water-Drawing Celebration. Our Sages of blessed memory expounded that from there they drew the holy spirit—that is, the dimension of prophecy, from which the above-mentioned birds draw nourishment, “from the place where the prophets draw nourishment.” From there comes the building of the holy Kingship, the dimension of the sukkah of David. This is what our Sages of blessed memory said there concerning actual prophecy: prophecy rests upon a prophet only through the joy of a mitzvah, as it is said: “And it was, as the musician played,” etc.—specifically, “as the musician played.” For prophecy and melody come from one source; only one needs specifically a fit and righteous musician, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because the rectification of song and melody is through the Oral Torah (Torah SheBeal Peh),
therefore the Sages, z"l, taught in the Tikunim
that Teruah alludes to [the acronym]
T-O-R-A-H [Tav-Vav-Reish-Hay] — see the inner text [of the discourse] —
which is the dimension of the entire Oral Torah.
And therefore the Shofar soundings allude also to King David,
as is brought [in the Kabbalistic works] —
for he is in the dimension of the Oral Torah,
as is explained in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 12.

This is also the dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros:
Malchuyos — the dimension of Malchus;
Zichronos — the dimension of the mental faculties and Daas,
as above in Siman 1;
Shofaros — the dimension of melody, as above.

units.he: וזה ולקחתם לכם ביום הראשון פרי עץ הדר ודרז"ל זה אברהם וכו' בחי' חסד דאברהם הנ"ל, וכפות תמריו זה יצחק וכו' שהוא בחי' דין מדת לילה כ"ש ותכהנין עיניו וכו' וכמבואר במ"א וזה בחי' לימוד התורה בלילה דווקא, וענף עץ עבות זה יעקב וכו' שזכה לקול דקדושה בחי' הקול קול יעקב הנ"ל, וערבי נחל זה יוסף שזכה למלכות ולרוח נבואה כ"ש אישד אשר רוח אלהים בו וע"כ מרומז בערבי נחל שמרמזין על אתר דנביאים ינקין כידוע, ועוד דרשו פרי עץ הדר זו שרה וכו' היינו בחי' מלכות כידוע בחי' שרה על כל העולם בחי' כי מלך כל הארץ אלהים כוו', וכפות תמרים זו רבקה מה תמר יש בו אוכל ויש בו קוצים כך רבקה ילדה יעקב ועשו, רבקה היא בחי' תבונה ולכך נאמר ויהי יצחק בן ארבעים שנה ב קחתו את רבקה כמבואר בליקוטי תורה להאריז"ל ושם שורש התורה שבע"פ ועיין במגלה עמקוות אופן רמ"ו ובלימוד הזה יש לפעמים אחיזה גם לעשו בחי' מלכות דסט"א היינו כשלומד שלא לשמה ח"ו, וענפ אץ עבוד תוערבי נחל מרמזין על לאה ורחל ששם שורש הציפרים הנ"ל שנתתקנו בשלימות ע"י יעקב כנ"ל, ועוד דרשו שמרמזין הארבע מינים על הסנהדרין ות"ח שלפניהם שאצלם עיקר התורה שבע"פ, ועוד דרשו שמרמזין על כל הכתות שבישראל כי כולם זוכין להתתקן ע"י החסד הנ"ל שנמשך ביום הראשון של סוכות שהוא כנגד אברהם וזוה שאמרו בזכות ולקחתם לכם ביום הראשון אני נגלה לכם ראשון וכו' זה בחי' נבואה שלימה שהיא בחי' התגלות אלהות בחי' פנים בפנים דיבר ה' עמכם דיבר ה' זו נבואה כמובא במ"א, ופורע לכם מן הראשון זה עשו וכו' בחי' ביטול המלכות דסט"א, ובונה לכם ראשון זה ביהמ"ק בחי' הדעת והמוחין של מלכות דקדושה ושם היו הכרובים הקדושים כנ"ל, ומביא לכם ראשון זה מלך שיזכה למלכות דקדושה בשלימות גמור:
units.en:
This is “And you shall take for yourselves on the first day a fruit of a beautiful tree.” Our Sages of blessed memory expounded: this is Avraham, etc., the dimension of the above-mentioned kindness of Avraham. “And the fronds of his date palms”—this is Yitzchok, etc., who is the dimension of judgment, the quality of night, as it is written: “His eyes grew dim,” etc., and as explained elsewhere. This is the dimension of studying Torah specifically at night. “And a branch of a leafy tree”—this is Yaakov, etc., who merited the holy voice, the dimension of “The voice is the voice of Yaakov,” as above. “And willows of the brook”—this is Yosef, who merited Kingship and the spirit of prophecy, as it is written: “A man in whom is the spirit of G-d.” Therefore he is alluded to by willows of the brook, which allude to the place where the prophets draw nourishment, as is known.

They further expounded: “A fruit of a beautiful tree”—this is Sarah, etc., the dimension of Kingship, as is known: Sarah, ruler over the entire world, the dimension of “For G-d is King of all the earth,” etc. “And palm branches”—this is Rivka. Just as a date palm has food and thorns, so Rivka bore Yaakov and Esau. Rivka is the dimension of understanding (תבונה). Therefore it is said: “Yitzchok was forty years old when he took Rivka,” as explained in Likutay Torah of the Ar"i of blessed memory. There is the root of the Oral Torah; see מגלה עמקוות, approach 246. In this study Esau, the dimension of the kingship of the Other Side, also sometimes has a foothold—that is, when one studies not for its own sake, G-d forbid. The myrtle branch and willows of the brook allude to Leah and Rachel, where the above-mentioned birds are rooted, fully rectified through Yaakov, as above.

They further expounded that the Four Species allude to the Sanhedrin and the Torah scholars before them, with whom the Oral Torah is principally found. They further expounded that they allude to all the groups within Israel, for all merit rectification through the above-mentioned kindness, drawn down on the first day of Sukkos, which corresponds to Avraham. This is what they said: in the merit of “And you shall take for yourselves on the first day,” “I shall be revealed to you as First,” etc. This is the dimension of complete prophecy, which is the dimension of divine revelation: “Face to face G-d spoke with you.” “G-d spoke”—this is prophecy, as brought elsewhere. “And I exact retribution for you from the first”—this is Esau, etc., the dimension of nullifying the kingship of the Other Side. “And I build for you the first”—this is the Temple, the dimension of the knowledge and mental faculties of the holy Kingship; there were the holy cherubim, as above. “And I bring you the first”—this is a king who will merit the holy Kingship in complete fullness.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is what is brought in the Zohar:
that the voice of the Shofar and the Teruah
corresponds to Yaakov —
for Yaakov merited to perfect this [holy] voice in its completeness,
the dimension of "the voice is the voice of Yaakov"
[Gen. 27:22].
He merited to rectify the dimension of the holy birds in their supernal root —
and this is the secret of [Yaakov] marrying the daughters of Lavan,
as is understood in the holy Zohar and in the writings of the Ar"i z"l.
And therefore the count of years of prophecy begins from Yaakov,
as brought in Megila Amukkos, Ofen 228.

Afterwards One Engages in Repentance — Yom Kippur

Afterwards one engages in this throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance —
greatly multiplying prayers and supplications,
and raising many holy voices —
the dimension of "from the depths I call to You, G-d; G-d, hear my voice"
[Ps. 130:1–2]
— until through this all the blemishes that were inflicted upon the holy Malchus are rectified,
until it returns and is rebuilt in completeness.
Until on Yom Kippur, Malchus is nourished only from five voices, etc. —
wherein is rooted the rectification of the holy voice above.
Then the High Priest enters "before and within"
[= the Holy of Holies],
where the Keruvim (Cherubs) and the holy birds are.
When Israel merited, the Keruvim faced one another —
and from them holy voices were heard —
and from this it was known that G-d had been fully appeased by Israel,
as brought in the holy Zohar.

units.he: ואח"כ זוכין לשמיני עצרת ואז נמגר בנין המלכות דקדושה בשלימות וע"כ נקרא עצרת מלשון זה יעצור בעצמי כמבואר בזוה"ק ואז נשלם גם הנגינה דקדושה בבחי' זמרו משכיל המבואר בפנים ואז זיווגא דמטרוניתא וכו' כי עיקר ההתחברות והזווג דקדושה הוא ע"י נגינה שלימה דקדושה כמובן בפנים בסימן רל"ז וע"כ מרבין אז בניגונים וזמירות ושמחה גדולה:
units.en: And afterward one merits the Eighth Day of Assembly. Then the building of the holy Kingship is finished completely. Therefore it is called עצרת, from the expression “This one will rule within myself,” as explained in the holy Zohar. Then the holy melody is also completed, in the dimension of “Sing with understanding,” explained in the main text. Then comes the union of the Matron, etc., for the principal holy joining and union come through complete holy melody, as is understood in the main text, in section 237. Therefore one greatly increases melodies, songs and great joy at that time.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
After Yom Kippur — The Loving-Kindnesses Flow

After Yom Kippur the loving-kindnesses flow —
the dimension of [the Zohar's expression]
"how great is the force of the tree that is abundant",
as explained in the main text.
For through all the holy rectifications Israel drew in during the Ten Days of Repentance —
which are days of judgment, the dimension of night —
one thereafter merits to receive great loving-kindnesses
in the dimension of:
"one who studies Torah at night is drawn over with a thread of kindness by day"
[Avoda Zara 3b].

One merits to enter the Sukka —
which Israel merited in reward for Avraham our Father's saying to the angels:
"rest under the tree"
— the dimension of the eshel which Avraham planted,
which alludes to the loving-kindness (chesed) above, as explained in the main text.
This loving-kindness protects a person
so that the thought of doing a mitzvah not for its own sake (shelo lishmah)
does not harm him —
rather, on the contrary:
from within the shelo lishmah one will come to do it truly for its own sake (lishmah),
as the Sages, z"l, said.

And therefore it is required that stars be visible through the s'chach —
the dimension of what was said of Avraham:
"Look now toward the heavens and count the stars"
[Gen. 15:5],
and the Sages taught that He elevated him above the stars —
for [true] looking is always from above downward.

And because the essential drawing of this rectification is through Torah study at night specifically —
and night is the dimension of shade against the light of day —
therefore the shade of the Sukka must exceed its light.
And therefore the Sages derived the minimum height of the Sukka
from the Keruvim — the dimension of the holy birds mentioned above.

And this is the dimension of the joy of Sukkos,
and the primary joy was in Simchas Beis HaShoaiva [the Water-Drawing Celebration].
The Sages, z"l, taught that from there they drew forth the holy spirit —
meaning prophecy —
for from there is the source of the holy birds,
from the place where the prophets drew —
and from there is the building of the holy Malchus, the dimension of the Sukka of David.

And the Sages, z"l, said explicitly regarding prophecy:
"Prophecy does not rest upon a prophet except from within the joy of a mitzvah"
— as it is written: "and it was when the musician played"
[II Kings 3:15]
— specifically, "as the musician played" —
for prophecy and melody come from one source,
but they require a kosher and righteous musician specifically, as above.

The Four Species and the Patriarchs / Matriarchs

Peri Eitz Hadar [fruit of the beautiful tree] — this is Avraham —
the dimension of the loving-kindness of Avraham above.
Kapos Smorim [branches of date palms] — this is Yitzchok —
the dimension of judgment, the quality of night,
as it is written "and his eyes were dim"
[Gen. 27:1],
and as is explained elsewhere —
this is the dimension of Torah study at night specifically.
Anaf Eitz Avos [branches of a leafy tree] — this is Yaakov —
who merited the holy voice, the dimension of "the voice is the voice of Yaakov," as above.
Arvay Nachal [willows of the brook] — this is Yosef —
who merited sovereignty and the spirit of prophecy,
as it is written: "a man in whom there is the spirit of G-d"
[Gen. 41:38].
Therefore he is alluded to in arvay nachal
which alludes to the place from which the prophets draw, as is known.

[The Midrash] also expounded:
Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Sarah — the dimension of Malchus;
Kapos Smorim — this is Rivka,
as the date-palm has food and thorns,
so Rivka bore Yaakov and Esov.
Rivka is the dimension of Tvuna (Understanding/Applied Wisdom),
and therefore it is said:
"And Yitzchok was forty years old when he took Rivka"
[Gen. 25:20],
as is explained in Likutay Torah of the Ar"i z"l —
and there is the root of the Oral Torah.
Anaf Eitz Avos and Arvay Nachal allude to Leah and Rachel —
wherein is the root of the holy birds rectified completely by Yaakov, as above.

Sh'mini Atzeres — The Song is Completed

Afterwards one merits Sh'mini Atzeres —
and then the building of the holy Malchus is completed,
and therefore it is called Atzeres ["holding back"] —
the dimension of "this one holds back within himself",
as is explained in the Zohar.
And then the holy song is completed —
the dimension of "sing a maskil"
mentioned in the main text.
Then comes the union of the Matron, etc. —
for the essential connection and union of holiness is through the complete holy melody.
And therefore one greatly multiplies melodies, songs, and great joy [on Sh'mini Atzeres].

Translator's Summary — Siman 3

Siman 3 is drawn from the Akroksa discourse of Likutay Mohara"n.
The central insight: holy song and melody are the medium through which
the Malchus is built and the Stra Achra subdued on Rosh HaShanah.
The Shofar itself is a form of sacred melody — hence the requirement for a fitting, righteous Shofar-blower.
Yaakov perfectly rectified the dimension of holy song
(alluded to in his marriage to Lavan's daughters / the birds of Leah and Rachel).
Prophecy and song share one root.
The Four Species map to the Patriarchs and Matriarchs —
and all together point to the completion of holy song at Sh'mini Atzeres.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Book Yerech HaAisonim — in it are explained many wondrous matters from the topic of
the holiness of Rosh HaShanah and the sounding of the Shofar and the prayers of Rosh HaShanah,
and the great merit of one who is privileged to be near a true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah,
and the topic of the custom that was practiced to go on Erev Rosh HaShanah to pray at the graves of the Tzadikim;
and likewise explained within it are the topics of the holiness of the Ten Days of Repentance,
Yom Kippur, Sukkos, Sh'mini Atzeres, and Simchas Torah, and the holiness of all the mitzvos
of G-d which are observed during them.

units.he: בר"ה אנו עוסקין בבנין המלכות דקדושה וחורבן ממשלת העכו"ם כאשר אנו מתפללין ע"ז הרבה בר"ה, ומחמת שאי אפשר אלא ע"י ווידוי דברים לפני ת"ח אמיתי שהוא בחי' משה, על כן צריכין ליזהר ביותר לנסוע לצדיקים אמיתיים על ר"ה או עכ"פ להתפלל על קברי צדיקים בערב ר"ה כמבואר בשו"ע כי גדולים צדקים במיתתם וכו' כי אז הם נכללים כביכול באין סוף ית' ממש וע"י הווידוים שמתוודים על קבריהם וע"י התפלות והתחנונים שמרבים שם עי"ז מחזירין המלכות לשרשה היינו אל רצון א"ס כמבואר בפנים:
units.en: On Rosh HaShanah we engage in building the holy Kingship and destroying the rule of the idolworshippers, as we pray extensively about this on Rosh HaShanah. Since this is impossible except through verbal confession before a true Torah scholar, who corresponds to Moshe, one must therefore take particular care to travel to true tzadikim for Rosh HaShanah, or at least to pray at the graves of tzadikim on the eve of Rosh HaShanah, as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. For the righteous are great in their death, etc.; then they are included, as it were, in the Infinite One Himself, Yisburach. Through the confessions made at their graves and the prayers and supplications multiplied there, Kingship is returned to its root—that is, to the will of the Infinite One, as explained in the main text.

units.he: וע"כ אפילו בר"ה עצמו שאז א"א להתוודות בפה מלא כדי שלא יתעורר הקטרוג מחמת תוקף הדינים שיש אז כמבואר בכוונות היינו כי מחמת שע"י כל החטאים פוגמין במלכות ומכניסין אותה כביכול בתוך העכו"ם ונותנין כח למלכות דסט"א ע"כ בר"ה עצמו שאז הדינין מתגברין ביותר ומשם שורש אחיזתם כידוע ע"כ יש לחש אם יזכירו העוונות בפךה מלא שלא יתעורר לקטרג ביותר, בפרט כי לפעמים גם הויידוי אינה בשלימות, ו כמובן במאמר קרא את יהושע סימן וא"ו, אך אעפי"כ גם בר"ה צריכין להתוודות בלחש עכ"פ ובשעת התקיעות בין סדר לסדר כמובא, כי מאחר שעיקר החזקת המלכות לשרשה הוא ע"י ווידוי דברים ע"כ לא סגי בלאו הכי גם בר"ה וע"כ מתוודין בשעת תקיעת שופר כי אז עיקר העסק בזה להחזיר המלכות לשרשה ולבנותה בנין שלם מחדש ולהמתיק הדינים שבשם אלהי"ם ע"י השופר כמבואר בכוונות, וע"כ עי"ז נתייחד השם אלהי"ם עם השם הוי"ה ית', והשי"ת עומד מכסא דין ויושב על כסא רחמים שזה בחי' עלה אלהים בתורעה ה' בקול שופר, כי בקול שופר מעוררין מדתו של יעקב ששרשו התורה שבע"פ, ועוד דרשו שמרמזין על כל הכתות שבישראל כי כולם זוכין בהדעת הק' ששם בחי' אחדות של חסדים וגבורות שזה בחי' ה' הוא האלהים, וזה בחי' אשרי העם יודע תרועה יודעי דייקא בחי' הדעת הק' והדעת הזה הוא מעין עוה"ב וזה בעצמו בחיח' שופר שמרמז על בינה בחי' עלמא דאתי, וזה אמרו לפני מלכיות כדי שתמליכוני עליכם הוא בחי' בנין המלכות דקדושה, זכרונות כדי שיעלה זכרוניכם לפני לטובה בחי' המתקת הדינים בשרשן בחי' זכרנו לחיים מלך חפץ בחיים היפוך בחי' חמת מלך מלאכי מות, וע"כ אין מזכירין זכרונות של פורעניות כמו שארז"ל, וזה ובמה בשופר, וזה שארז"ל תקיעות שופר חכמה וכו'. וע"כ ע"י תקיעת שופר והתשובה שעושין ישראל אז עי"ז מחזירין המלכות לשרשה שהיא החכמה האדוקה באין סוף כמבואר בשל"ה בכוונת שופר, כי שורש המלכות בחכמה בחי' ה' בחכמה יסד ארץ אבא יסד ברתא כידוע והחכמה אדוקא באין סוף בחי' והחכמה מאין תמצא, וע"כ ממשיכין ע"י תקיעת שופר בחי' המתקת הדינין בחי' ואיש חכם יכפרנה בפנים:
units.en:
Therefore, even on Rosh HaShanah itself, when one cannot confess in full voice so as not to arouse accusation because of the intensity of the judgments then, as explained in the teachings on mystical intentions: through all sins one blemishes Kingship, brings it, as it were, among the idolworshippers, and gives strength to the kingship of the Other Side. On Rosh HaShanah itself the judgments become especially strong, and there is the root of their foothold, as is known. There is therefore reason to fear that mentioning the sins in full voice might arouse still greater accusation—particularly because sometimes even the confession is incomplete, as is understood in the discourse קרא את יהושע, section 6. Nevertheless, even on Rosh HaShanah one must at least confess quietly, and during the shofar blasts, between one set and the next, as brought there. For since maintaining Kingship at its root is principally through verbal confession, confession cannot be dispensed with even on Rosh HaShanah.

One therefore confesses at the time of the shofar sounding, for then the principal work is to return Kingship to its root, build it anew as a complete structure, and sweeten the judgments in the Name אלהי"ם through the shofar, as explained in the teachings on mystical intentions. Through this the Name אלהי"ם is united with the Name הוי"ה, Yisburach. G-d, Yisburach, arises from the throne of judgment and sits upon the throne of mercy. This is the dimension of “G-d has ascended with teruah; the L-rd, with the sound of the shofar.” Through the shofar’s voice one arouses the quality of Yaakov, whose root is the Oral Torah. They further expounded that these allude to all the groups within Israel, for all attain the holy knowledge in which loving-kindnesses and severities are united. This is the dimension of “The L-rd is G-d.”

This is “Fortunate is the people that knows the teruah”—specifically, “knowers”: the dimension of holy knowledge. This knowledge is a foretaste of the World to Come. This itself is the dimension of the shofar, which alludes to Understanding, the dimension of the World to Come. “Say Kingship verses before Me so that you crown Me over you” is the building of holy Kingship. “Remembrance verses, so that your remembrance rises before Me for good” is the sweetening of judgments at their root: “Remember us for life, King Who desires life,” the opposite of “A king’s wrath is messengers of death.” Therefore one does not mention remembrances of calamity, as our Sages of blessed memory said. This is “And through what? Through the shofar.” This is what our Sages of blessed memory said: “Shofar blasts are wisdom,” etc.

Through the shofar sounding and the repentance Israel performs then, Kingship is returned to its root, which is Wisdom bound up with the Infinite One, as explained in the של"ה concerning the intention of the shofar. The root of Kingship is in Wisdom: “The L-rd founded the earth with wisdom”—“The Father founded the daughter,” as is known. Wisdom is bound up with the Infinite One: “And wisdom—from where is it found?” Through the shofar sounding one therefore draws the sweetening of judgments, the dimension of “And a wise man will appease it,” explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because this is impossible except through verbal confession (vidui d'vorim)
before a true Torah scholar (Talmid Chochom Amisi) —
who is the dimension of Moshe —
therefore one must be very careful to travel to the true Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah;
or at the very least to pray at the graves of Tzadikim on Erev Rosh HaShanah,
as is explained in the Shulchan Aruch.
For "the Tzadikim are great in their death"
[Berachos 18b], etc. —
for then they are [absorbed], as it were, into the Infinite One [Ein Sof] completely.
And through the confessions one confesses at their graves,
and through the prayers and supplications one multiplies there —
through this, the Malchus is restored to its root,
meaning to the Will of the Infinite [Ein Sof],
as is explained in the main text.

Even on Rosh HaShanah Itself — One Confesses Softly

Therefore even on Rosh HaShanah itself —
when it is impossible to confess in a full, clear voice,
so as not to arouse the prosecutorial angels,
because of the great intensity of the judgments at that time —
nonetheless, even on Rosh HaShanah one must confess in a whisper at the very least.
And at the time of the Shofar-soundings, between one set and the next,
as is brought [in the Kavanos] —
for since the essential restoration of the Malchus to its root
is through verbal confession,
it is insufficient without it even on Rosh HaShanah.

units.he: וע"כ צריכין אז להתוודות בלחש כי הווידוי שמתוודין אז הוא בבחי' הווידוי שמתוודין לפני החכם שעי"ז מחזירין המלכות לשרשה, וע"כ באמת צריכין שיהיה התוקע עצמו אדם גדול וחכם שזה בחי' יודעי תרועה כמבואר בזוה"ק:
units.en: One must therefore confess quietly then. The confession made at that time corresponds to confession before the sage, through which Kingship is returned to its root. Therefore, in truth, the shofar blower himself must be a great person and a sage. This is the dimension of “those who know the teruah,” as explained in the holy Zohar.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Therefore one confesses at the time of the Shofar-sounding —
for then the essential engagement is in this:
to restore the Malchus to its root
and to build it as a complete new structure,
and to sweeten the judgments within the Name Elokim
through the Shofar, as is explained in the Kavanos.

And therefore through this, the Name Elokim is unified with the Name Havaya;
and G-d arises from the throne of judgment and sits upon the throne of mercy —

For through the Shofar-sound, the quality of Yaakov is aroused —
whose root is the Oral Torah.
And the Divine unity that is:
"G-d is the [same] G-d"
[I Kings 18:39]
— this is the dimension of the unity of loving-kindnesses and severe judgments —
the dimension of
"fortunate is the people that knows the Teruah"
[Ps. 89:16]
— "knows" specifically — the dimension of holy Daas.
And this Daas is a foretaste of the World to Come —
and this itself is the dimension of the Shofar,
which alludes to Bina (Understanding), the dimension of the World to Come.

units.he: ד"ה ועיקר השלימות ועיקר השלימות כשזוכין להיות אצל צדיק אמיתי על ר"ה שהוא החכם הדור האמת ומתוודין לפניו באמת קודם ר"ה ומספרין לפניו את אשר עם לבבו עי"ז ממשכיין אח"כ בר"ה כל התיקונים הנ"ל בשלימות ע"י התפלות והתקיעות של ר"ה, וכל התיקונים שממשיכין ישראל בר"ה בכל מקומות מושבותיהם הכל רק בכחם של צדיקים יחידי הדורות הנ"ל, וע"כ נוהגין לילך בכל מקום עכ"פ על קברי צדיקים בערב ר"ה כנ"ל, וזה בחי' המלך הקדוש שואמרין אז היינו שמרמז שמחזירין המלכות לשרשה שבחכמה שהיא בחי' קודש כידוע, וע"כ כולל מלכיות עם קדושת היום דייקא, והו שמתפללין וידע כל פעול כי אתה פעלתו וכו' כי כשמחזירין המלכות (שכוללת כל התמונות והישות והברואים) לשרשה שהוא בחי' אין סוף עי"ז נשאר רשומו בהדעת של כל אחד מאור האין סוף ית' עד שידע כל פעול כי אתה פעלתו וכו' עד שעי"ז נבנית המלכות בשלימות ומחזירין המלכוה להקב"ה לבדו בבחי' ויאמר כל אשר נשמה באפו ה' אלהי ישראל מלך ומלכותו בכל משלה:
units.en:
Passage beginning “And the principal completeness”

The principal completeness is attained when one merits to be with a true tzadik for Rosh HaShanah, who is the true sage of the generation. One confesses truly before him prior to Rosh HaShanah and tells him what is in one’s heart. Through this, afterward, on Rosh HaShanah, one draws down all the above rectifications completely through the prayers and shofar blasts of Rosh HaShanah. All the rectifications Israel draws down on Rosh HaShanah in all their places of residence are only through the power of those tzadikim, the unique ones of the generations. Therefore it is customary everywhere at least to go to the graves of tzadikim on the eve of Rosh HaShanah, as above.

This is the dimension of “the holy King,” said then: it alludes to returning Kingship to its root in Wisdom, which is the dimension of holiness, as is known. Therefore one includes the Kingship verses specifically together with the sanctification of the day. This is the prayer “May every made thing know that You made it,” etc. When Kingship—which includes all forms, selfhood and created beings—is returned to its root, the dimension of the Infinite One, a trace of the Infinite Light, Yisburach, remains in each person’s knowledge, until every made thing knows that You made it, etc. Through this Kingship is built completely, and sovereignty is returned to the Holy One, blessed be He, alone: “And all that has breath in its nostrils shall say: The L-rd, G-d of Israel, is King, and His Kingship rules over all.”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is what [the Sages] said:
"Say Malchuyos before Me — so that you crown Me over you"
— the dimension of building the holy Malchus;
"Zichronos — so that your remembrance ascends before Me for good"
— the dimension of the sweetening of judgments at their root,
the dimension of "remember us for life, O King Who desires life"
— the opposite of the dimension of "the wrath of the King is the messenger of death"
[Prov. 16:14];
and therefore one does not recite Zichronos of [divine] punishment,
as the Sages, z"l, [taught].
And this is "And through what? Through the Shofar."

Therefore, through the Shofar-blowing and the repentance Israel performs then,
the Malchus is restored to its root in Wisdom,
which is absorbed into the Infinite —
as is explained in the Shla"h on the Kavona of the Shofar —
for the root of Malchus is in Wisdom:
"G-d established the earth with Wisdom"
[Prov. 3:19] —
"the Father founded the daughter", as is known.
And Wisdom is absorbed into the Infinite:
"and Wisdom — from whence is it found?"
[Job 28:12].
Therefore through the Shofar-blowing
one draws the sweetening of judgments —
the dimension of "and a wise man can appease it"
[Prov. 16:14], as is explained in the main text.

The Tekia-Terua-Tekia Pattern of the Baal Teshuva's Journey

This is the dimension of Tekia-Teruah-Tekia [which is from Torah law] —
for this is the way of the Baal Teshuva [one who returns to G-d]:
first G-d sends from above some illumination and flash of Infinite Light into his heart —
and through this he greatly regrets his deeds
and begins to engage in the rectifications of repentance,
until he merits afterward to cleave to G-d and to be absorbed in His Infinite Light
through arousal from below (isarusa d'lisata).

The first flash is in the dimension of the Tekia voice —
a simple sound —
for this illumination reaches him from G-d, Who is absolutely simple,
with no change whatsoever —
"I am G-d — I have not changed"
[Mal. 3:6].

units.he: וזה בחי' תקיעה תרועה תקיעה שזה מדין תורה (רק שאח"כ נפל ספק בהתרועה אם הוא שברים או תרועה) כי כן דרך הבעל תשובה שבתחלה שולח לו הקב"ה מלמעלה איזה הארה והתנוצצות אלהות בלבו ועי"ז הוא מתחרט מאד על מעשיו ומתחיל לעסוק בתיקוני התשובה עד שזוכה אח"כ לדבק עצמו בהשי"ת ולכלול באורו הא"ס ית' ע"י אתערותא דלתתא, והנה הזריחה הראשונה היא בבחי' קול תקיעה שהיא קול פשוט כי מגיע לו הארה הזאת ממנו ית' שהוא ית' פשוט בתכלית הפשיטות ואין בו שום שינוי כלל בבחי' אני ה' לא שניתי, ואח"כ מה שהאדם עוסק בתיקוני התשובה שהעיקר הוא ע"י שמרבה בקולות וצעקות ווידוים ותחנונים שזה בחי' תרועה בחי' וכי תבואו למלחמה וכו' (בחי' מלחמת היצר שהיא עיקר המלחמה הגדולה שיש להאדם בזה העולם) והרעותם וכו' ונזכרתם לפני ה' אלהיכם שזה ג"כ בחי' תקיעת שופר של ר"ה כמובא בזוה"ק, ואח"כ תוקע עוד תקיה פשוטה היינו שע"י תשובתו מחזיר המלכות לשרשה בבחי' זרקא דאיזדריקת לאתר דאיתנטילת מתמן ואז זוכה לחזור ולהכלל בא"ס ע"H אתערותא דלתתא כנ"ל, ובענין זה עצמו יש בו ג"כ בחי' תקיעה תרועה תקיעה, תקיעה הוא בחי' מה שנכלל באין סוף בבחי' ביטל גמור ובהתפשטות הגשמיות עד שהוא בבחי' ולא ידע שאפילו הוא בעצמו אינו יודע מעצמו כי הוא עכשיו במדריגה והארה עליונה כרזאת שהוא בבחי' למעלה מכלי הדעת והמוחין, ואח"כ כשהוא בבחי' ושוב שבב לדעתו ולישותו זה בחי' תרועה שהיא בחי' יעקב ששרשו בדעת כנ"ל ובבחי' הישות יש בו שינויי רצינות ושינויי התמונות שזה בחי' תרועה שכלולה מכמה קולות בפרט שברים ותרועה שהיא גנוחי גנח ילולי מילל שכ"ז שייך רק בבחי' הישות, ואח"כ חוזר לתקיעה פשוטה כי ע"י הרשימו שנשאר בו מהדעת של הא"ס עי"ז מראה גם לדעתו שידע בידיעה שלימה אחדות הא"ס וטובו עד שאפילו כשהוא בבח'י ושוב ששב מהביטול אל בחי' הישות אעפ"כ ידע בידיעה שלימה שכולו טוב כולו אחד בבחי' אתה הראית לדעת כי ה' הוא האלהים, וזה עיקר שלימות הדעת שהוא בחי' אחדות של חסדים וגבורות, וע"כ אמרו כל תרועה פשוטה לפניה ופשוטה לאחריה כי זה עיקר שלימות הדעת שהוא בחי' יעקב בחי' תרועה שימשיך אחדות הרצון הפשוט של אור איןסוף גם לדעתו כנ"ל, גם תקיעה הראשונה מרמז על ההתקרבות וןההתקשרות להצדיק (כי תקיעה היא מלשון התקשרות כמו תקעו כף וכיוצא) שע"י זוכה לתקן כל המדות של הד' יסודות. וזה בחי' מה שכתוב בפרשת החצוצרות ותקעו בהן ונועדו אליך כל העדה אל פתח אהל מועד מזה מבואר שתקיעה מרמזת על נסיעה דקדושה כ"ש ותקעתם תרועה ונסעו וכו' זה בחי' מה שע"י ווידוי דברים לפני הצדיק הצדיק מברר לו דרך ישר לפי שורש נשמתו שזה בחי' הגיע לפרשת דרכים שאז יודע באיזה דרך מהלך, גם תרועה מרמזת על חורבן ממשלת העכו"ם שזה בחי' שברים. בחי' שבור זרוע רשע וכן שבר ה' מטה רשעים שבט מושלים וכן תרועה הוא מלשון שבר כ"ש תרועם בשבט ברזל, ומרמז ג"כ על בנין המלכות דקדושה שזה בחי' ה' אלהיו עמו ותרעות מלך בו וכ"ש בחצוצרות וקול שופר הריעו לפני המלך ה' ויש בזה לבאר עוד מענין גנוחי גנח ילולי יליל ע"ד שארז"ל אנחה שוברת גופו של אדם וזה תיקון למה שנשברו עצמותיו ע"י עוונותיו החקוקים על עצמותיו עיין פנים, תקיעה שניה מרמזת על מה שנכלל עי"ז באור הא"ס ששם כל השינויים נכללים באחדות הרצון הפשוט כנ"ל שזה בחי' ובהקהיל את הקהל תתקעו ולא תריעו:
units.en:
This is the dimension of tekiah–teruah–tekiah, which is Torah law. Only afterward did uncertainty arise about the teruah—whether it is shevarim or teruah. For this is the way of the penitent: first the Holy One, blessed be He, sends him from above some illumination and a flash of divinity in his heart. Through this he deeply regrets his deeds and begins to engage in the rectifications of repentance, until afterward he merits to attach himself to G-d, Yisburach, and be included in His Infinite Light, Yisburach, through arousal from below.

The first shining is the dimension of the tekiah sound, a simple sound. This illumination reaches him from Him, Yisburach, Who is utterly simple, with no change at all: “I am the L-rd; I have not changed.” Afterward the person engages in the rectifications of repentance, principally by multiplying voices, cries, confessions and supplications. This is teruah: “When you come to war,” etc.—the war against the evil inclination, the principal great war a person has in this world—“you shall sound teruah,” etc., “and you shall be remembered before the L-rd your G-d.” This too is the dimension of the Rosh HaShanah shofar sounding, as brought in the holy Zohar. Afterward one sounds another simple tekiah: through repentance one returns Kingship to its root, in the dimension of “זרקא, which was cast back to the place from which it was taken.” Then one merits to return and be included in the Infinite One through arousal from below, as above.

Within this very matter there is also tekiah–teruah–tekiah. Tekiah is being included in the Infinite One in complete self-nullification and divestment of physicality, to the point of “and he did not know”: even he himself does not know of himself, for he is now at so lofty a level and illumination that it is above the vessels of knowledge and the mental faculties. Afterward, in the dimension of “return,” he returns to his knowledge and selfhood. This is teruah, the dimension of Yaakov, whose root is in knowledge, as above. Within selfhood there are variations of will and variations of forms. This is teruah, composed of several sounds—especially shevarim and teruah, groaning and wailing—all of which pertain only to selfhood.

Afterward one returns to the simple tekiah. Through the trace remaining within him from the knowledge of the Infinite One, he makes it apparent even to his knowledge, so that he knows with complete knowledge the unity of the Infinite One and His goodness. Even in “return,” when he has returned from self-nullification to selfhood, he nevertheless knows completely that all is good, all is one: “You were shown to know that the L-rd is G-d.” This is the principal completeness of knowledge, the unity of loving-kindnesses and severities. Therefore they said: every teruah has a simple sound before it and a simple sound after it. For this is the principal completeness of knowledge, the dimension of Yaakov, the dimension of teruah: to draw the unity of the simple Will of the Infinite Light into his knowledge too, as above.

The first tekiah also alludes to drawing near and attaching oneself to the tzadik. Tekiah is an expression of attachment, as in “they clasped hands” and similar expressions. Through this one merits to rectify all the traits of the four elements. This is what is written in the passage of the trumpets: “They shall sound them, and the whole congregation shall assemble to you at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.” This shows that tekiah alludes to a holy journey, as it is written: “You shall sound teruah, and they shall journey,” etc. Through verbal confession before the tzadik, the tzadik clarifies a straight path for him according to the root of his soul. This is reaching a crossroads, when one knows on which path one is traveling.

Teruah also alludes to the destruction of the rule of the idolworshippers. This is shevarim: “Break the arm of the wicked,” and likewise, “The L-rd broke the staff of the wicked, the rod of rulers.” Teruah too is an expression of breaking: “You shall break them with a rod of iron.” It also alludes to building holy Kingship: “The L-rd his G-d is with him, and the teruah of a king is within him,” and, “With trumpets and the sound of a shofar, sound teruah before the King, the L-rd.” There is more to explain concerning groaning and wailing according to our Sages’ statement, “A sigh breaks a person’s body.” This rectifies the breaking of his bones through his sins, which are engraved upon his bones; see the main text. The second tekiah alludes to being included through this in the Infinite Light, where all changes are included in the unity of the simple Will, as above. This is “When assembling the congregation, you shall sound tekiah and not sound teruah.”
