units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בזה בכל עשי"ת כי זה עיקר התשובה על מה שלא קיימנו התרי"ג עטין שעל ידם נשלמה האמונה הק' שהיא כלליות כולם כ"ש כל מצותיך אמונה רק אדרבה נלכדנו בעצת רשעים שהם מבחי' זוהמת הנחש ופגמנו באמונה הק' ועי"ז גלינו מארצינו ובאנו למה שבאנו, ובעש"י עוסקין לתקן זאת ואז התפלה מקובלת ביותר כ"ש דרשו את ה' בהמצאו וכמו שדרז"ל, וע"כ הם עשי"ת כנגד עשר קדושות שקדשה ארץ ישראל ועשרה מאמרות של חידוש העולם שזה עיקר האמונה הק' שיש מחדש ועשרת הדברות שהם כלל התורה הק' שעל ידם נשלם האמונה ועשרה לשונות שנקראת התפלה כשארז"ל וכנגד עשרה נסים שנעשו לאבותינו במצרים ועל הים וכו' ועשרה נסים שנעשו לאבותינו בבית המקדש ששם מקור קדושת א"י שהוא מקום הנסים עד שזוכין אח"כ לקדושת יום כפור ואז נשלם האמונה בבחי' רראש אמנה וע"כ אז סליחת עוונות כמבואר בספר המדות אות אמונה ע"י אמונה יסלח לך הקב"ה על עוונותיך והוא מקרא מלא (ירמיה ה') שוטטו בחוצות ירושלים וכו' אם יש עושה משפט (בחי' משפטי אמת הנ"ל) מבקש אמונה ואסלח לזה, ואז נשלמת התפלה שזה בחי' החמשה תפלות שמתפללין אז, ואז נמשך בחי' נסים שהוא בחי' המתקת הדינים בשרשם שזה עיקר הנסים, וגם בפשיטות היה אז כמה נסים בהגורל שעלה במין ובלשון של זהורית שהיה מלבין ולא אירע קרי לכה"ג ביו"כ וכן עוד כמה דברים שחשבו רז"ל. ואז נתגלה פנימיות קדושת א"י שזה בחי' מה שנכנס הכהן גדול לפני ולפנים שמשם מקור כל קדושת א"י, ואז ירד משה עם הלוחות שניות שהם כלל התורה הק' תרי"ג עטין דקדושה בחי' אמת שעל ידם נשלם האמונה הק' ואז נכנע הנחש ונתבטל זוהמתו לגמרי מישראל שזה בחי' מה שביו"כ לית רשות לשטן לאשטוני, ומחמת שע"י מצוות ציצית ניצול האדם מעצת הנחש וזוכה לכלכ הנ"ל ע"כ ביו"כ אז מתעטפין בציצית בערב יו"כ מבעוד יום וכל היום של יו"כ עומדין ישראל מעוטפין בציצית, וזה בחי' הווידוים שמרבין אז להתוודות על מה שנכשלין כ"כ בעצת רשעים ומבקשין ע"ז סליחה ומחילה וכפרה ושלא נחטא עוד, וזה שדחז"ל על יו"כ ביום חתונתו זה מתן תורה ר"ל הלוחות שניות שניתנו בו כנ"ל כי אז נמשך בחי' מתן תורה שהיא בחי' נישואין דק' כמב"פ, ואז נמשך בחי' התנוצצות הגואלה האחרונה וביאת משיח שזה בחי' מה שארז"ל אמריתו אמאי לא אתי משיחא וכו' כי באמת אם היו זוכין כל ישראל קבל קדושת יו"כ כראוי בוודאי היה בא משיח תיכף כי אז נמשכין כל התיקונים הנ,ל שעי"ז בא הגאולה כנ"ל:
units.en:
Afterward one engages in this throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance, for this is the principal repentance for our failure to fulfill the 613 counsels through which holy faith, which encompasses them all, is brought to completeness, as it is written, “All Your commandments are faith.” Instead, we have become ensnared in the counsel of the wicked, which derives from the serpent's defilement, and have blemished holy faith. Through this we were exiled from our land and came to the state in which we find ourselves.

During the Ten Days of Repentance one engages in rectifying this, and prayer is then accepted especially readily, as it is written, “Seek the L-rd when He may be found,” and as our Sages of blessed memory expounded. Therefore these are the Ten Days of Repentance, corresponding to the ten degrees of holiness with which the Land of Israel was sanctified; the ten utterances of the creation of the world, which are the essence of holy faith that there is One Who renews creation; the Ten Commandments, which encompass the holy Torah and through which faith is completed; the ten expressions by which prayer is called, as our Sages of blessed memory said; the ten miracles performed for our forefathers in Egypt and at the sea, etc.; and the ten miracles performed for our forefathers in the Temple, which is the source of the holiness of the Land of Israel, the place of miracles.

Afterward one merits the holiness of Yom Kippur, and then faith is completed in the dimension of רראש אמנה. Therefore there is forgiveness of sins then, as explained in Sefer HaMidos, under Faith: “Through faith the Holy One, blessed be He, will forgive you your sins.” This is an explicit verse (Yirmeya, chapter 5): “Go about the streets of Jerusalem,” etc., “If there is one who executes justice”—the dimension of the above-mentioned judgments of truth—“who seeks faith, then I will forgive this one.”

Then prayer is brought to completeness, the dimension of the five prayers recited on that day. Then the dimension of miracles is drawn down, which is the sweetening of judgments at their root, the principal essence of miracles. Even in the plain sense, several miracles took place then: in the lot, which came up on the right; in the crimson thread, which turned white; and in the fact that the High Priest did not experience a seminal emission on Yom Kippur, together with several other matters enumerated by our Sages of blessed memory.

Then the inner holiness of the Land of Israel is revealed. This is the dimension of the High Priest entering the innermost sanctuary, from which all the holiness of the Land of Israel originates. Then Moshe descended with the second Tablets, which encompass the holy Torah, the 613 holy counsels, the dimension of truth through which holy faith is completed. Then the serpent is subdued and its defilement is entirely nullified from Israel. This is the dimension of the fact that on Yom Kippur Satan has no permission to accuse.

Because through the mitzvah of tzitzis a person is saved from the counsel of the serpent and merits all the above, on Yom Kippur people wrap themselves in tzitzis already on the eve of Yom Kippur, while it is still daytime, and throughout the day of Yom Kippur Israel stands wrapped in tzitzis.

This is the dimension of the many confessions recited then concerning how greatly we have stumbled through the counsel of the wicked. We ask forgiveness, pardon and atonement for this, and that we should not sin again. This is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded concerning Yom Kippur: “On the day of his wedding”—this is the giving of the Torah, meaning the second Tablets given on that day, as above. For then there is drawn down the dimension of the giving of the Torah, which is the dimension of holy union, as explained in the main text.

Then the dimension of the first glimmering of the final redemption and the coming of Mashiach is drawn down. This is the dimension of what our Sages of blessed memory said: “You say: Why has Mashiach not come?” etc. For in truth, if all Israel had merited to receive the holiness of Yom Kippur properly, Mashiach would certainly have come immediately. For then all the above-mentioned rectifications, through which redemption comes, would be drawn down, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And Israel engages in the rectification of this matter every year
from Rosh HaShanah to Sh'mini Atzeres, as is explained in the Kavanos.
And this is the dimension of engaging in building the holy Malchus at that time —
to establish and build the holy faith (Emuna),
which is itself the dimension of Malchus, as is known —
and it is the dimension of prayer, miracles, and the Land of Israel.
All of these rectifications are drawn on Rosh HaShanah.

And therefore one multiplies prayer at that time for this very matter —
that the holy faith spread throughout the world,
and the redemption draws near through the King Messiah —
for upon this the redemption depends.
And that the holiness of Eretz Yisroel, Tzion, and Yerushalayim be revealed.

Also on Rosh HaShanah the dimension of miracles and the nullification of nature is drawn —
for the root of the governance of nature derives from the dimension of the concealment of the Divine Countenance (hester ponim),
the dimension of judgment —
for Elokim has the same numerical value as ha-Teva [nature].
And on Rosh HaShanah one is primarily engaged in sweetening the judgments —
which is the dimension of miracles above nature.

And therefore the Sages, z"l, in the Yerushalmi of Rosh HaShanah, Chapter 1,
expressed astonishment:
"Since Israel knows that Rosh HaShanah is the Day of Judgment,
nonetheless they don white clothing, etc., and eat and drink and rejoice —
knowing that G-d performs miracles for them" — as mentioned above.

qualifications.text: The supplied phrase רראש אמנה is rendered contextually as the dimension of the beginning or summit of faith. Its unusual spelling is retained in the Hebrew, and the term remains literal in the English rather than asserting a unique original-print reading.

The supplied wording describes a miracle in the lot as שעלה במין. The English reads this contextually as the lot coming up on the right, but the supplied form does not uniquely establish that wording.

The source's concluding rabbinic question is אמריתו אמאי לא אתי משיחא. It is presented as a quoted question about why Mashiach has not come, without expanding the source's etc. or claiming a verified full external quotation.

The supplied quotation ends מבקש אמונה ואסלח לזה. The word לזה refers to “this one,” the person described as executing justice and seeking faith; it is not rendered as “it” referring to Jerusalem. The supplied Hebrew remains unchanged.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואחר יו"כ

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 1, in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola
["Blow the Shofar of Sovereignty"], it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension (bechia) of being the Place of the World
— and they are able to perform the [spiritual work of] Rosh HaShanah.
And in the discourse Tik'u Emuna, Siman 5,
much is explained regarding the wondrous rectifications
that are wrought through the gathering of the disciples near the true Rebbe —
and the primary time of gathering is on Rosh HaShanah.

units.he: ואחר יו"כ מתחילין החסדים לכנוס ועי"ז נתתקן האמונה שהיא בחי' מלכות ביותר כמובא בכתבים שעיקר תיקון המלכות הוא ע"י החסדים בבחי' והוכן בחסד כסא, וע"כ אברהם אבינו שהיה איש החסד היה ראש למאמינים וכמובן גם במאמר בני לן ביתא בסי' כ"ח. וכן עיקר הנסים נמשכין ע"י החסדים כ"ש לעושה נפלאות גדולות לבדו כי לעולם חסדו, וכן עיקר התפלה ע"י החסדים כ"ש ברוך ה' אשר לא הסיר תפלתי וחסדו מאתי, וכן ירושת ארץ ישראל הוא ע"י החסדים כ"ש נחלה לישראל עבדו כי לעולם חסדו, וכן לאמת זוכין ע"י החסדים כ"ש תתן אמת ליעקב חסד לאברהם וכתיב כי חסדך לנגד עיני והתהלכתי באמתך ובפסוקים רבים נסמך חסד לאמת, וכן ההתקרבות להצדיק ולקבל עצתו בבחי' שמע עצה וקבל מוסר (משלי יט) הוא בבחי' חסדים כ"ש יהלמיני צדיק חסד ויוכיחני וכו', וכן כלל התורה הק' נקראת תורת חסד, וכן עיקר הגאולה ע"י החסדים כ"ש ויפרקנו מצרינו כי לעולם חסדו (וכמובן במאמר אמרו אל הכהנים סי' ב'):
units.en:
After Yom Kippur the loving-kindnesses begin to enter, and through this faith, which is the dimension of Kingship, is rectified all the more. As brought in the writings, the principal rectification of Kingship is through loving-kindnesses, in the dimension of “A throne is established through kindness.” Therefore Avraham our father, who was a man of kindness, was the first of the believers, as is also understood in the discourse בני לן ביתא, section 28.

Likewise, the principal miracles are drawn down through loving-kindnesses, as it is written, “To Him Who alone performs great wonders, for His kindness endures forever.” The principal prayer is likewise through loving-kindnesses, as it is written, “Blessed is the L-rd, Who has not removed my prayer or His kindness from me.” The inheritance of the Land of Israel is likewise through loving-kindnesses, as it is written, “An inheritance to Israel His servant, for His kindness endures forever.”

Likewise, one merits truth through loving-kindnesses, as it is written, “You shall give truth to Yaakov, kindness to Avraham.” And it is written, “For Your kindness is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.” In many verses kindness is placed alongside truth.

Likewise, drawing near to the Tzadik and receiving his counsel, in the dimension of “Hear counsel and receive instruction” (Mishlay, chapter 19), is in the dimension of loving-kindnesses, as it is written, “Let the righteous strike me—it is kindness—and reprove me,” etc. Likewise, the whole holy Torah is called “a Torah of kindness.” The principal redemption is likewise through loving-kindnesses, as it is written, “And He redeemed us from our adversaries, for His kindness endures forever,” as is also understood in the discourse אמרו אל הכהנים, section 2.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Also, the holiness of Eretz Yisroel — where the primary miracles [occur] —
is drawn primarily from the holiness of Rosh HaShanah,
as it is written:
"the eyes of G-d your L-rd are upon it, from the beginning of the year"
[Deut. 11:12].

And this is the dimension of what was established by the early authorities
to recite V'Chol Maaminim ["And All Believe"] on Rosh HaShanah —
for this is the primary engagement at that time: to complete the holy faith.

And because the completeness of faith is through truth —
and this too must be drawn on Rosh HaShanah,
which is the dimension of the beginning of creation, which was through truth —
as it is written:
"In the beginning, G-d created"
— the final letters [of the first three words in Hebrew]: Aleph-Mem-Tav = Emes [truth].
And the Sages, z"l, expounded on this:
"The beginning of Your word is truth"
[Ps. 119:160].

And this itself is the matter of Rosh HaShanah on which Rosh Chodesh also falls —
the dimension of the joining of Emes [truth — the dimension of the year]
with Emuna [faith — the dimension of the month].
And where the male and female are [united in truth], the male is not mentioned separately —
therefore Rosh Chodesh is not mentioned on Rosh HaShanah.

and the general holiness of the month of Tishray.
See also Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 94,
which likewise explains that one must travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah.

units.he: ואח"כ נכנסין לסוכה ואז מאירין החסדים באור נפלא ונשלם היחוד של אמת ואמונה שהם בחי' איש ואשה שזה בחי' סוכה אותיות כ"ו ה"ס שם הוי"ה ושם אדנ"י כמבואר בזוה"ק, וע"כ ארז"ל תשבו כעין תדורו איש ואשתו כמבואר בשו"ע, ואז נמשך הארה גדולה מבחי' בינה לבא שהיא בחי' סוכה העליונה לסוכה התחתונה בחי' סוכת דוד בחי' מלכות היינו כי שורש העצה הוא בבחי' בינה לבא כמ"ש מים עמוקים עצה בלב איש ושם שורש האמת כ"ש ודובר אמת בלבבו וע"כ כלל התורההק' יוצאת משם וכמובן לקמן בסי' רס"ו במאמר ויעקב נסע סכותה וע"י כל זה נשלמה האמונה הק' וזוכין לגאולה שלימה בבחי' אקים את סוכת דוד הנופלת, וזה בחי' הארבע מינים שבלולב ודרז"ל פרי עץ הדר זה אברהם שזה בחי' אמונה כ"ש והאמין בה' והוא היה ראש למאמינים, וכפות תמרים זה יצחק זה כנגד בחי' תפלה כי ארז"ל על יצחק שתפס אומנות התפלה (עיין ילקוט חדש) וגם כי ארז"ל לעולם יהא אדם זהיר בתפלת המנחה ויצחק תיקן תפלת המנחה, ענף עץ עבות זה יעקב שהוא בחי' אמת כנ"ל, וערבי נחל זה יוסף בחי'שמירת הברית שמירה מעצת רשעים שהיא בחי' ניאוף ר"ל.ף ועוד אמרו פרי עץ הדר זו שרה בחי' מלכות בחי' אמונה וארז"ל כשם שאברהם גייר גרים ופירסם אמונה בעולם כך שרה ג"כ, כפות תמרים זו רבקה וכו' שהיא ג"כ בחי' תפלה כ"ש ויעתר יצחק לה' לנוכח אשתו וארז"ל היא עומדת בזויות זו ומתפללת וכו' וע"כ יצחק רבה גימט' תפלה כמובא, וענף עץ עבות זו לאה זה כנגד בחי' נסים כי ארז"ל לאה פתחה בהודאה תחלה שזה בחי' על הנסים שאומרין בברכת הודאה, גם עפ"י הטבע היתה לאה עתידה ליפול בחלקו של עשו רק ע"י רוב הבכיות שלה עשה הקב"ה עמה נסים ונפלה בחלקו של יעקב וגם במה שילדה את דינה ע"י שדנה דין בעצמה וכו' היה בדרך נס נפלא ונורא כמו שארז"ל, וערבי נחל זו רחל שהיא סוד קדושת ארץ ישראל כמבואר בזוה"ק ובכתבי האריז"ל, וע"כ יהושע שיצא מבני בניה הוא הנחיל לנו את ארץ ישראל כמ ושאמר לו משה כי אתה תביא את העם הזה אל הארץ וכו' ואתה תנחילנה אותם, ועוד דרשו שכל הד' מניים מרמזין על הסנהדרין והת"ח היושבים לפניהם כי הם עוסקים להמשיך בחי' משפטי ה' אמת שעי"ז נשלמת האמונה וזוכין לכל הנ"ל, ועוד דרשו אתרוג דומה ללב ששם עיקר שלימות האמונה בחי' בתוך לבי אמונתך וכתיב ומצאת את לבבו נאמן לפניך, לולב דומה לשדרה שעל ידה נמשך טפי המח והשכל אל כלי ההולדה שזה בחי' עצת צדיקים שהיא כולה זרע אמת, והדס דומה לעינים ה בחי' ציצית כמבואר בפנים שעל ידם ניצולין מעצת הנחש עצת רשעים, ערבה דומה לשפתים זה בחי' תפלה בחי' ה' שפתי תפתח, וע"כ ארבעה מינים אלו מרצין על הגשמים שבאין מן התהומות בחי' נסים, ועיקר הגשמים בארץ ישראל כמבואר בפנים, וזה בחי' השמחה שעם הד' מינים כ"ש ושמחתם לפני ה' אלהיכם כי כל הבחינות האלו הנ"ל הם בחי' שמחה, האמונה שהיא בחי' מלכות היא בחי' שמחה בחי' ה' מלך תגל הארץ וכתיב ישמח ישראל בעושיו בני ציון יגילו במלכם וכמוהו רבים, תפלה היא בחי' שמחה כ"ש עבדו את ה' בשמחה ואין עבודה אלא תפלה, נסים הם בחי' שמחה כי כשנעשה נס לאדם בוודאי הוא שמח מאד בבחי' זה היום עשה ה' נגילה ונשמחה בו, ארץ ישראל היא בחי' שמחה בחי' יפה נוף משוש כל הארץ וכמו שמתפללין שתעלינו בשמחה לארצינו, הגואלה שזוכין עי"ז היא בחי' שמחה כ"ש בשוב ה' את שיבת ציון וכו' היינו שמחים, וכתיב מי יתן מציון וכו' יגל יעקב ישמח ישראל. ההתקרבות להצדיק היא בחי' שמחה בחי' ברבות צדיקים ישמח העם וכתיב אור צדיקים ישמח, עצת צדיק היא בחי' שמחה כ"ש וליועצי שלום שמחה, וכלל תרי"ג עטין שבתורה נאמר עליהם פקודי ה' ישרים משמחי לב, משפטי ה' אמת הם בחי' שמחה כ"ש שמחה לצדיק עשות משפט:
units.en:
Afterward one enters the sukkah, and then the loving-kindnesses shine with a wondrous light, and the union of truth and faith, which are the dimensions of man and woman, is completed. This is the dimension of סוכה, whose letters allude to 26 and 65, the Names הוי"ה and אדנ"י, as explained in the holy Zohar. Therefore our Sages of blessed memory said, “You shall dwell as you ordinarily reside”—a man and his wife—as explained in the Shulchan Aruch.

Then a great illumination is drawn down from the dimension of Understanding, the heart, which is the dimension of the upper sukkah, to the lower sukkah, the dimension of the sukkah of David, the dimension of Kingship. For the root of counsel is in the dimension of Understanding, the heart, as it is written, “Counsel in the heart of man is deep water.” There also is the root of truth, as it is written, “And speaks truth in his heart.” Therefore the whole holy Torah emerges from there, as is also understood later in section 266, in the discourse ויעקב נסע סכותה. Through all this holy faith is completed and one merits complete redemption, in the dimension of “I shall raise up the fallen sukkah of David.”

This is the dimension of the Four Species of the lulav. Our Sages of blessed memory expounded: “A fruit of a beautiful tree”—this is Avraham, the dimension of faith, as it is written, “And he believed in the L-rd”; he was the first of the believers. “And palm branches”—this is Yitzchok, corresponding to the dimension of prayer, for our Sages of blessed memory said of Yitzchok that he took up the occupation of prayer (see ילקוט חדש). They also said that a person should always be careful concerning the Mincha prayer, and Yitzchok instituted the Mincha prayer. “A branch of a leafy tree”—this is Yaakov, the dimension of truth, as above. “And willows of the brook”—this is Yosef, the dimension of guarding the covenant, protection against the counsel of the wicked, which is the dimension of adultery, Heaven forbid.

They further said: “A fruit of a beautiful tree”—this is Sarah, the dimension of Kingship and faith. Our Sages of blessed memory said that just as Avraham brought converts and publicized faith throughout the world, so did Sarah. “And palm branches”—this is Rivka, etc., who is likewise the dimension of prayer, as it is written, “Yitzchok entreated the L-rd opposite his wife.” Our Sages of blessed memory said that she stood in one corner and prayed, etc. Therefore the names Yitzchok and Rivka together have the numerical value of תפלה, as brought elsewhere.

“A branch of a leafy tree”—this is Leah, corresponding to the dimension of miracles, for our Sages of blessed memory said that Leah was the first to give thanks. This is the dimension of “For the miracles,” which is recited in the blessing of thanksgiving. Moreover, according to the natural course of events, Leah was destined to fall to Esau's portion. But through her abundant weeping the Holy One, blessed be He, performed miracles for her, and she fell to Yaakov's portion. Likewise, her giving birth to Dinah, through her making a judgment concerning herself, etc., occurred by way of a wondrous and awesome miracle, as our Sages of blessed memory said.

“And willows of the brook”—this is Rachel, who is the secret of the holiness of the Land of Israel, as explained in the holy Zohar and the writings of the Ar"i of blessed memory. Therefore Yehoshua, who descended from her descendants, was the one who apportioned the Land of Israel to us, as Moshe said to him: “For you shall bring this people into the land,” etc., “and you shall cause them to inherit it.”

They further expounded that all four Species allude to the Sanhedrin and the Torah scholars who sit before them, for they engage in drawing down the dimension of “The judgments of the L-rd are truth.” Through this faith is completed and one merits all the above.

They further expounded that the esrog resembles the heart, where the principal completeness of faith resides, in the dimension of “Your faith is within my heart,” and as it is written, “And You found his heart faithful before You.” The lulav resembles the spine, through which the drops of the brain and intellect are drawn down to the organs of procreation. This is the dimension of the counsel of the Tzadikim, which is entirely the seed of truth. The myrtle resembles the eyes; this is the dimension of tzitzis, as explained in the main text, through which one is saved from the counsel of the serpent, the counsel of the wicked. The willow resembles the lips; this is the dimension of prayer, in the dimension of “L-rd, open my lips.”

Therefore these Four Species bring favor concerning rain, which comes from the depths, the dimension of miracles. The principal rains are in the Land of Israel, as explained in the main text.

This is the dimension of the rejoicing with the Four Species, as it is written, “And you shall rejoice before the L-rd your G-d,” for all the above-mentioned dimensions are dimensions of joy. Faith, which is the dimension of Kingship, is a dimension of joy, in the dimension of “The L-rd reigns; let the earth be glad,” and as it is written, “Israel shall rejoice in its Maker; the children of Zion shall exult in their King,” and many similar verses.

Prayer is a dimension of joy, as it is written, “Serve the L-rd with joy,” and there is no service except prayer. Miracles are a dimension of joy, for when a miracle is performed for a person, he certainly rejoices greatly, in the dimension of “This is the day that the L-rd has made; we shall exult and rejoice in it.” The Land of Israel is a dimension of joy, in the dimension of “Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth,” and as we pray, “That You bring us up in joy to our land.”

The redemption that one merits through this is a dimension of joy, as it is written, “When the L-rd restored the captivity of Zion,” etc., “we were joyful.” And it is written, “Who will grant from Zion,” etc., “Yaakov shall exult; Israel shall rejoice.” Drawing near to the Tzadik is a dimension of joy, in the dimension of “When the righteous increase, the people rejoice,” and as it is written, “The light of the righteous rejoices.” The counsel of the Tzadik is a dimension of joy, as it is written, “And to counselors of peace there is joy.” Concerning all the 613 counsels of the Torah it is said, “The precepts of the L-rd are upright, rejoicing the heart.” The true judgments of the L-rd are dimensions of joy, as it is written, “It is joy to the righteous to execute justice.”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And because it is impossible to come to truth except through drawing near to Tzadikim
and walking in the way of their guidance —
therefore one must travel to the Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah,
or at the very least to pray at the graves of Tzadikim on Erev Rosh HaShanah —
in order to draw upon oneself their strength and holiness.

They merited the dimension of guarding the Bris —
after which they are called Tzadikim, as is known.
And guarding the Bris is the dimension of the holy union (nissuim d'kedusha),
the dimension of holy counsels —
through which one merits to truth,
until through this the holy faith is completed,
and one merits to the eternal redemption —
which is the essential engagement of Rosh HaShanah, as above.

And because faith and prayer are in the dimension of miracles —
and are propitious for remembrance — as is explained in the main text —
therefore Rosh HaShanah is called Yom HaZikaron — "The Day of Remembrance."

This is the dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros.
As the Sages, z"l, said:
"Say Malchuyos on Rosh HaShanah so that you crown Me over you"
— the dimension of building Malchus and rectifying faith and prayer.
"Zichronos — so that your remembrance ascends before Me for good"
— the dimension of the nullification of judgments and of nature,
from which derives the dimension of forgetfulness, as it were —
as it is written:
"How long will You forget me forever?"
[Ps. 13:2].
And the more one merits to nullify the forgetfulness
and attain the holy remembrance,
one can certainly be confident that one's remembrance ascends before G-d for good.
For truly there is no forgetfulness before the Throne of His Glory,
as one recites in the blessing of Zichronos.

qualifications.text: The supplied sukkah-name expression links סוכה with כ"ו and ה"ס, corresponding to the numerical values 26 and 65 of הוי"ה and אדנ"י. The English preserves the stated letter-and-number association without changing the Hebrew.

The supplied wording יצחק רבה גימט' תפלה is understood contextually as the names Yitzchok and Rivka together corresponding numerically to תפלה. The Hebrew remains unchanged; this contextual reading is not a claim of verified original-print spelling.

The source identifies Yehoshua as descending from Rachel's descendants and connects him with Israel's inheritance of the land. The supplied relative phrase בני בניה is retained without adding an unsupported intermediate genealogy.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

"With me, the main thing is Rosh HaShanah" — and also:
"My Rosh HaShanah is a great novelty (chidush) …
not only are you all certainly bound to my Rosh HaShanah,
but even all the world — the entire world — depends upon my Rosh HaShanah."

units.he: ואח"כ זוכין לשמיני עצרת ואז זיווא דמטרוניתא שזה בחי' השוו אשה לאיש המבואר בפנים שנתייחד בחי' אמת ואמונה בתכלית היחוד השלם והנוקבא עוצרת הטיפה שלא תפיל היינו שזוכין לקבל טיפי השכל והמוח של הצדיקי אמת ושל כלל תורתינו הק' בתכלית השלימות ובקשר של קיימא באופן שנזכה עי"ז לעושת פירות והולדות טובות וקדושות בתכלית השלימות וזה בחי'מה שמבואר בכוונות שההולדה מבחי' החוד הק' הזה של שמיני עצרת נעשה משביעי של פסח שאז היה גמר הגאולה של גלות מצרים שכולל כל הגלויות, ומה שנעשה הוא שיעשה כי בכל דור ודור ובכל שנה ושנה נמשך בחי' זאת עד שנזכה עי"ז לגאולה שלימה ב"ב, וע"כ השמחה של שמיני עצרת גדולה מאד ויעקב אבינו הוא רישא לחדוותא כמבואר בזוה"ק כי כל התיקונים הנ"ל נשלמין ע"י תתן אמת ליעקב כנ"ל:
units.en:
Afterwards one merits Sh'mini Atzeres
— then the radiance of the Matron —
the dimension of [the Zohar's expression that]
man and woman are equalized,
as is explained in the main text —
meaning: the dimensions of truth and faith are unified in ultimate perfect union.
And the feminine [Malchus] retains the drop so that it does not miscarry —
meaning one merits to receive the drops of intellect and mind of the true Tzadikim
and of the entirety of our holy Torah in ultimate completeness,
in an enduring bond —
so that one thereby merits to produce good and holy fruits and offspring in ultimate completeness.

And this is the dimension of what is explained in the Kavanos:
that the birth from the sacred union of Sh'mini Atzeres
is realized from the Seventh Day of Pesach —
when the completion of the Exodus from Egypt, which includes all exiles, took place.
And what is accomplished is what will be accomplished —
for in every generation and every year this dimension is drawn,
until one thereby merits the complete redemption, speedily in our days.

And therefore the joy of Sh'mini Atzeres is exceedingly great —
and Yaakov our Father is the "head of joy" at that time,
as is explained in the Zohar —
for all the rectifications mentioned above are completed through "grant truth to Yaakov," as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is the dimension of
"fortunate is the man who does not forget You"
— said at that time.
And "through what? Through the Shofar" —
for the Shofar-sound alludes to the quality of Yaakov,
whose quality is truth;
and through this, faith is completed
and one merits complete knowledge and holy remembrance, as is understood in the main text.

And this is the dimension of Zichron Teruah ["A Remembrance of the Teruah"] —
for Teruah is the dimension of Yaakov, as is explained in the Zohar —
for Yaakov merited to rectify the blemish of Adam the first man
and to nullify the impurity of the serpent,
as is brought in the Zohar.
And therefore he merited guarding the Bris in ultimate completeness —
as it is written:
"the first-fruits of my strength"
[Gen. 49:3],
and from him was born Yosef the Tzadik,
who merited guarding the Bris completely, as is explained in the main text.

And therefore all Israel — who are in the dimension of "wholly a seed of truth" —
are called by the name of Yosef:
"He leads Yosef like sheep"
[Ps. 80:2].
And therefore in the Exodus from Egypt it was said:
"You shall bring up my bones from here with you"
[Gen. 50:25].
And likewise:
"And Moshe took the bones of Yosef with him"
[Ex. 13:19]
— for through the dimension of Yosef, the faith was completed,
upon which the redemption depends.
And the Sages, z"l, taught
that even the bones of the other tribes were elevated with them —
for the tribes are the dimension of the twelve texts of prayer, as is explained in the main text —
they are the dimension of faith;
they are the dimension of the twelve oxen upon which the "Sea of Solomon" rested —
the dimension of the sovereignty of Heaven, which is the dimension of faith —
all were completed and elevated through the bones of Yosef,
the dimension of the grave of the true Tzadik.
Therefore the custom is to go on Erev Rosh HaShanah to the graves of Tzadikim —
for on Rosh HaShanah the dimension of the redemption of Pesach begins to shine.
Therefore on Rosh HaShanah Yosef went out of prison —
and on Rosh HaShanah the enslaved labor of our ancestors in Egypt ceased, as the Sages, z"l, said.

Afterwards — The Ten Days of Repentance

Afterwards one engages in this throughout the Ten Days of Repentance —
for this is the essential repentance: for not having fulfilled the 613 counsels
through which the holy faith is completed —
the general principle of all of them,
as it is written:
"all Your commandments are faith"
[Ps. 119:86].
Rather, on the contrary —
we were ensnared by the counsel of the wicked, the dimension of the impurity of the serpent,
and we blemished the holy faith —
and through this we were exiled from our land and came to where we have come.

And on the Ten Days of Repentance one engages in rectifying this —
and then prayer is received most intensely,
as it is written: "Seek G-d when He may be found"
[Is. 55:6],
as the Sages, z"l, expounded.
And therefore they are Ten Days of Repentance
corresponding to the ten holiness levels with which Eretz Yisroel was sanctified,
and to the Ten Utterances of the world's creation — the essence of holy faith —
and to the Ten Commandments — the entirety of the holy Torah through which faith is completed —
and to the ten expressions by which prayer is called, as the Sages, z"l, said —
and corresponding to the ten miracles wrought for our ancestors in Egypt and at the Sea,
and to the ten miracles wrought for our ancestors in the Temple —
for there is the source of the holiness of Eretz Yisroel, the place of miracles —
until one merits afterward to the holiness of Yom Kippur,
when faith is completed in the dimension of the "pinnacle of faith" (rosh emuna).

And therefore on Yom Kippur there is forgiveness of sins,
as is explained in Sefer HaMidos, under Emuna:
through faith, G-d will forgive your sins.
And this is a full scriptural verse:
"wander through the streets of Jerusalem…
if there be one who acts with justice, who seeks truth — I will forgive this one"
[Jer. 5:1].
And then prayer is completed — this being the dimension of the Five Prayers of Yom Kippur.
And then the dimension of miracles is drawn — the sweetening of judgments at their root —
which is the essence of miracles.
And indeed in a simple sense there were many miracles — in the lot that was cast,
in the scarlet thread that would turn white,
and that no improper emission befell the High Priest on Yom Kippur —
and likewise other things the Sages, z"l, enumerated.

And then the inner holiness of Eretz Yisroel is revealed —
this being the dimension of the High Priest entering the innermost [sanctuary] —
for from there is the source of all the holiness of Eretz Yisroel.
And then Moshe descended with the Second Tablets —
the sum of the holy Torah — 613 holy counsels — the dimension of truth —
through which the holy faith is completed.
And then the serpent was subdued and its impurity
completely nullified in Israel —
this being the dimension of what [the Sages taught]:
on Yom Kippur the Accuser has no authority to prosecute.

And because through the mitzvah of tzitzis a person is saved from the counsel of the serpent
and merits all the above —
therefore on Yom Kippur one wraps oneself in tzitzis [from before sunset] —
and all of Yom Kippur Israel stands wrapped in tzitzis.

After Yom Kippur — Sukkos: The Loving-Kindnesses Enter

After Yom Kippur the loving-kindnesses begin to enter,
and through them faith — the dimension of Malchus — is rectified most fully,
as is brought in the holy writings:
that the essential rectification of Malchus is through loving-kindnesses —
the dimension of "and through kindness a throne is established"
[Is. 16:5].
And therefore Avraham our Father — the man of loving-kindness —
was the first among believers,
as is also understood in the discourse Bini Lon Baisa, Siman 28.

And likewise the essential miracles flow through loving-kindnesses —
"to the One Who performs great wonders alone — for His kindness is eternal"
[Ps. 136:4].
And likewise the essential prayer is through loving-kindnesses —
"blessed is G-d Who has not removed my prayer and His kindness from me"
[Ps. 66:20].
And likewise the inheritance of Eretz Yisroel is through loving-kindnesses —
"an inheritance to Israel His servant — for His kindness is eternal"
[Ps. 136:21–22].
And likewise truth is merited through loving-kindnesses —
"grant truth to Yaakov, kindness to Avraham"
[Mic. 7:20].
And likewise drawing near to the Tzadik and receiving his guidance is in the dimension of loving-kindnesses.
And likewise the entire holy Torah is called Toras Chesed — the Torah of Kindness.
And likewise the essential redemption is through loving-kindnesses.

Then One Enters the Sukka — The Union of Truth and Faith

Then one enters the Sukka,
and the loving-kindnesses shine in a wondrous light —
and the union of Emes [truth] and Emuna [faith] is completed —
they being the dimension of man and woman —
this being the dimension of the Sukka,
whose letters spell out Kuf-Vav = 26 and Hay-Samech = 65
[= the numerical values of the Names Havaya and Adnay],
as is explained in the holy Zohar.
And therefore the Sages, z"l, taught:
"You shall dwell as you normally dwell — a man and his wife"
[Sukkah 28b],
as is explained in the Shulchan Aruch.

Then a great illumination flows from the dimension of the Supernal Bina to the heart —
which is the dimension of the Supernal Sukka
to the Lower Sukka, the dimension of the Sukka of David, the dimension of Malchus.
For the root of counsel (aitza) is in the dimension of Bina to the heart —
as it is written:
"deep waters are counsel in a person's heart"
[Prov. 20:5].
And there is the root of truth —
"and one who speaks truth in his heart"
[Ps. 15:2].
And therefore the entire holy Torah emerges from there,
as is understood in Siman 266, the discourse Vayaakov Nosa Sukkosa.
And through all of this the holy faith is completed —
and one merits the complete redemption —
the dimension of:
"I will raise up the Sukka of David that has fallen"
[Amos 9:11].

And this is the dimension of the four species:
Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Avraham —
the dimension of faith —
as it is written: "and he believed in G-d"
[Gen. 15:6]
— and he was first among believers.
Kapos Smorim — this is Yitzchok —
the dimension of prayer —
for the Sages, z"l, taught that Yitzchok mastered the craft of prayer;
and the Sages, z"l, said: "A person should always be diligent in the afternoon prayer (Mincha)"
— and Yitzchok established the Mincha prayer.
Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Yaakov —
the dimension of truth, as above.
Arvay Nachal — this is Yosef —
the dimension of guarding the Bris, guarding against the counsel of the wicked —
the dimension of licentiousness (niuf), heaven forbid.

And also [the Midrash] expounded:
Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Sarah, the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of faith —
the Sages, z"l, taught: just as Avraham converted [brought people to faith] and publicized faith in the world, so too did Sarah.
Kapos Smorim — this is Rivka — also the dimension of prayer —
as it is written:
"and Yitzchok prayed to G-d opposite his wife"
[Gen. 25:21]
— and the Sages, z"l, taught: she stood in the corner and prayed.
Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Leah —
the dimension of miracles:
the Sages, z"l, taught that Leah was the first to give thanks —
the dimension of Al HaNissim ["For the Miracles"]
that one says in the blessing of thanksgiving (Hoda'a).
Also, by natural law Leah was destined to fall to the portion of Esov —
but through her many tears
G-d performed miracles for her and she fell to the portion of Yaakov.
Arvay Nachal — this is Rachel —
the secret of the holiness of Eretz Yisroel, as is explained in the Zohar and the writings of the Ar"i z"l.
And therefore Yehoshua, who descended from her children's children,
was the one who gave us our inheritance in Eretz Yisroel.

The Four Species — Joy

And therefore these four species atone for the rains that come from the depths — the dimension of miracles —
for the primary rains in Eretz Yisroel are explained in the main text.
And this is the dimension of the joy with the four species —
"and you shall rejoice before G-d your G-d"
[Lev. 23:40]
— for all these dimensions are themselves the dimension of joy:
Faith which is the dimension of Malchus is joy —
"G-d reigns, the earth shall rejoice"
[Ps. 97:1].
Prayer is joy — "serve G-d with joy"
— and there is no service but prayer.
Miracles are joy — "this is the day G-d has made; we shall rejoice and be glad in it"
[Ps. 118:24].
Eretz Yisroel is joy —
"beautiful of height, the joy of the entire earth"
[Ps. 48:3].
The redemption is joy —
"when G-d returned the captivity of Tzion… we were as dreamers"
— joyful.
Drawing near to the Tzadik is joy —
"when the Tzadikim increase, the people rejoice"
[Prov. 29:2].
The counsel of the Tzadik is joy —
"and for those who counsel peace — joy"
[Prov. 12:20].
And the 613 counsels of the Torah —
"the statutes of G-d are upright, gladdening the heart"
[Ps. 19:9].
The judgments of G-d — truth — are joy —
"it is joy for the Tzadik to do justice"
[Prov. 21:15].

Sh'mini Atzeres — The Union of Truth and Faith is Complete

Afterwards one merits Sh'mini Atzeres
— then the union of the Matron —
the dimension of [the Zohar's expression that]
man and woman are equalized,
as is explained in the main text —
meaning: the dimensions of truth and faith are unified in ultimate perfect union.
And the feminine [Malchus] retains the drop so that it does not miscarry —
meaning one merits to receive the drops of intellect and mind of the true Tzadikim
and of the entirety of our holy Torah in ultimate completeness,
in an enduring bond —
so that one thereby merits to produce good and holy fruits and offspring in ultimate completeness.

And this is the dimension of what is explained in the Kavanos:
that the birth from the sacred union of Sh'mini Atzeres
is realized from the Seventh Day of Pesach —
when the completion of the Exodus from Egypt, which includes all exiles, took place.
And what is accomplished is what will be accomplished —
for in every generation and every year this dimension is drawn,
until one thereby merits the complete redemption, speedily in our days.

And therefore the joy of Sh'mini Atzeres is exceedingly great —
and Yaakov our Father is the "head of joy" at that time,
as is explained in the Zohar —
for all the rectifications mentioned above are completed through "grant truth to Yaakov," as above.

Translator's Summary — Siman 7

Siman 7 uncovers the hidden theme of Rosh HaShanah as the renewal of creation —
grounded in the virtue of Emes (Truth) joined with Emuna (Faith).
Adam's sin was following the counsel of the serpent (against Truth);
the Tzadik and the Bris are the antidote.
The month of Tishray is a complete arc:
Rosh HaShanah (drawing Faith and Truth / beginning of creation);
Ten Days (rectifying through prayer and mitzvos / the 613 counsels);
Yom Kippur (the Second Tablets / completion of Faith);
Sukkos (union of Truth and Faith / Avraham and the Kindnesses);
Sh'mini Atzeres (perfect birth / the Messianic future realized each year anew).

qualifications.text: The supplied expression is זיווא דמטרוניתא, not זיווגא דמטרוניתא. The English renders זיווא as “radiance,” reflecting its attested splendor or radiance sense. The passage subsequently describes the complete union of truth and faith explicitly. The supplied wording is preserved without assuming a missing ג or claiming verification against an original printed edition.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה בר"ה נמשך
units.en: Passage beginning “On Rosh HaShanah is drawn down”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Book Yerech HaAisonim — in it are explained many wondrous matters from the topic of
the holiness of Rosh HaShanah and the sounding of the Shofar and the prayers of Rosh HaShanah,
and the great merit of one who is privileged to be near a true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah,
and the topic of the custom that was practiced to go on Erev Rosh HaShanah to pray at the graves of the Tzadikim;
and likewise explained within it are the topics of the holiness of the Ten Days of Repentance,
Yom Kippur, Sukkos, Sh'mini Atzeres, and Simchas Torah, and the holiness of all the mitzvos
of G-d which are observed during them.

units.he: בר"ה נמשך בחי' התחדשות הבריאה שהיתה ע"י בחי' הרוח חיים כמבואר בפנים, ואז ספקי חיים וספרי מתיפ פתוחים לפניו ית' וצדיקים גמורי םנכתבים לאלתר לחיים כי הם דבקים בהתורה הק' אשר שם עיקר הרוח חיים, ורשעים גמורים נכתבים לאלתר למיתה כי הם רחוקים לגמרי מקדושת התורה הק' ע"כ נכתבים לאלתר למיתה מאחר שרחוקים מהרוח חיםי דקדושה ע"כ גם בחייהם קרוים מתים, בינונים שמעורבין טוב ורע ע"כ תלויים ועומדין עד יוה"כ כי אז זוכין כל ישראל בכלל להפריש ולהבדיל הרע מהטוב בבחי' גורל אחד לה' וגורל אחד לעזאזל כי אז נמשך בשלימות קדושת תורה ותפלה שעי"ז מבדילין הרע מהטוב כי אז קיבל משה הלוחות שניות שהם כלל התורה הקדושה שכלולה בעשרת הדברות שמשם מקבלין העשרה מינינ דפקין את הרוח חיים, וכן אז נשלמת התפלה ביותר שזה בחי' החמשה תפלות שמתפללין אז, ומשה רבינו זכה לקבל אז הלוחות שניות ג"כ רק ע"י ריבוי תפלותיו והשלשל עשרה מדות שגילה לו השי"ת שכל זה בחי' המשכת רוח חיים ע"י הצדיקםי הק' להשלים החסרונות ולכפר עוונות בבחי' איש חכם יכפרנה. וע"כ אז המשיך משה בחי' סליחת עוונות ביו"כ לדורות עולם ואז נכנע בחי' ממשלת עשו איש שעיר בחי' הקיטרוג של בחי' הרוח סערהלגמרי בבחי' ונשא השעיר עליו את כל עוונותם אל ארץ גזירה שדרז"ל על עשו איש שעיר, מתגברין אז מאד וע"כ אין להזכיר אז שום חטא ועון כדי שלא ליתן לו בזה תוקף ועוז ביותר כי עיקר חיותו והתגברות הרוח סערה שלו הוא רק מעוונות ישראל ר"ל שעי"ז פוגמין בהרוח חיים דק' ונותנין כח לעשו ולאלופיו ר"ל כמובן בפנים, ועל כן החיוב אז ביותר לילך ולנבוע להצדיק האמת על ר"ה בכדי להמשיך על ידו בחי' אריכת הרוח להשלים כל החסרונות ולהתגבר ולהכניע בחי' קליפת עשו ואלופיו ר"ל בכח הצדיק הזה שהוא בבחי' רב חסד ואמת. וזה בחי' המלחמה הגדולה שיש אז בין יעקב ועשו כמובא בזוה"ק. וזה בחי' יום תרועה יהיה לכם ומבואר בזוה"ק שזה בחי' וכי' תבואו למחלמה בארצכם וכו' והרעותם וכו', כי כל בחי' המלחמות מהצר הצורר הכל הוא מבחי' הרוח הסערה של עשו וצריכין להכניעו ע"י קול התרועה שהוא בבחי' אנחה דקדושה שהוא בחי' אריכת הרוח להשלים החסרונות ולהתגבר על רוח סערה של עשו ואלופיו, וזה שנסתפקו רז"ל על התרועה אם היא שברים שהוא גנוחי גנח היינו אנחה. הנ"ל שהיא בחי' אריכת הרוח דקדושה וממילא נכנע עי"ז הרוח סערה, או אם היא תרועה שהיא יילולי יילילי היינו קולות קצרות ותכופות כי זה לעומת זה בכדי להתגבר עי"ז על הרוח סערה של עשו שמתגבר בבהלה גדולה ובמהירות גדול והצרות הבאים ממנו קרובות ותכופות זו לזו כמו שארז"ל עד שהראשונה פקידה וכו' שניה אצה וממהרת לבוא, ע"כ הסכימו לעשות שניהן, וע"כ צריכין לעשות השברים וכן התרועה בנשימה אחת ויש אומרים שגם השברים והתרועה ביחד צריכין לעשותן בנשימה אחת שכל זה בחי' אריכת הרוח והנשימה דקדושה, ועכ"פ אין להפסיק בתשר"ת בין השברים והתרועה כדי נשימה מאחר שבסדר זה עושין שניהם להורות כי צריכין שניהם וזה תלוי בזה, והשברים קודמין לתרועה כי ע"י אנחה ואריכת הרוח דקדושה שהיא בחי' שברים עי"ז מתגברין נגד הרוח סערה של עשו ואלופיו שזה מרומז בתרועה כנ"ל, וזה שארז"ל שתרועה מרמז על התורה בחי' תור"ה עיי"ן וכו' כי עיקר אריכות הרוח חיים מקבלין מהתורה הק', וכן עיקר הכנעת עשו איש שעיר הוא ע"י התורה הק' כמו שדרז"ל על הקול קול יעקב וכו' ומחמת שהמון עם אי אפשר להם לקבל אריכת הרוח ושלימות החסרונות מהרוח חיים שבהתורה הק' כי אם ע"י הצדיק והרב שבדור ע"כ כל תרועה פשוטה לפניה ופשוטה לאחריה, כי תקיעה פשוטה מרמזת על ההתוועדות וההתחברות להצדיק כמבואר בפרשת חצוצרות ותקעו בהן ונועדו אליך כל העדה וכו' וכמובא לעיל, גם תקיעה פשוטה מורה על השלימות שיש לו להרוח חיים קודם שיחטא האדם, ותרועה מורה על האנחה שצריך להתנאח על החסרון שנעשה ע"י החטא בבחי' אין יסורין בלא עון, אך אעפי"כ ע"י אנחה זוכה להשלים החסרון שזה בחי' התקיעה פשוטה שלאחריה והכל בכח הצדיק כנ"ל. וכל ענין זה כלול בהי"ג מדות של רחמים כמבואר בפנים, וזהו שדרז"ל ה' ה'. ה'קודם שיחטא וה' לאחר שיחטא היינו כנ"ל, וזהו בחי' מלכיות זכרונות שופרות, כי עיקר הרוח חיים דקדושה מקבלין מבחי' המלכות הק' בבחי' ותלבש אסתר מלכות ודרז"ל שלבשתה רוח הקודש וכתיב באור פני מלך חיים וכמובן במאמר ויתן עוז למלכו סי' ע"ח, וזה בחי' ורוח אלהים מרחפת על פני המים שדרז"ל על מלכות משיח, זכרונות הוא בחי' שלימות החסרונות ואריכת הרוח שממשיכין ע"י אחנה דק' בבחי' וישמע אלהים את נאקתם ויזכור אלהים את בריתו וכו' שאומרים בפסוקי זכרונות, וכן ויזכור אלהים את נח וכו' ויעבר אלהים רוח על הארץ וכו' רוח דייקא כנ"ל, וזה בחי' זכור כי רוח חיי (איוב ז), וזה בחי' כי אין במות זכרך כי המות ההיפוך מבחי' רוח חיים הנ"ל שהוא בחי' זכרון, וזה ובמה בשופר היינו שופרות שמזכירין שם הרבה ממתן תורה שמשם עיקר הרוח חיים ומסיימין בפסוקי נביאים איך שהגאולה וקיבוץ גליות שזה בחי' הכנעת הרוח סערה עשו איש שעיר יהיה ע"י שופר, ועי"ז לבסוף הרוח סערה יסער גופ ונשמתם כמבואר בפנים. וזה בחי' וה' אלהים בשופר יתקע והלך בסערות תימן היינו שיתעורר עליהם הרוח סערה ועלינו יגן ה' צבאות וכו':
units.en:
On Rosh HaShanah the dimension of the renewal of creation is drawn —
which came through the dimension of the spirit of life (ruach chaim),
as is explained in the main text.
And then the Books of Life and the Books of Death
are opened before Him —
and the completely righteous — who cleave to the holy Torah,
wherein is the primary spirit of life —
are immediately inscribed for life.
The completely wicked — who are entirely distant from the holiness of the holy Torah —
are therefore immediately inscribed for death —
for they are distant from the holy spirit of life.
Even in their physical lifetimes they are called dead.
The intermediate ones — who have good and evil intermingled —
are therefore suspended until Yom Kippur.

For then all Israel in general merit to separate and distinguish evil from good, in the dimension of “One lot for the L-rd and one lot for Azazel.” For then the holiness of Torah and prayer is drawn down in completeness, through which evil is separated from good. For then Moshe received the second Tablets, which encompass the holy Torah, included within the Ten Commandments, from which the ten kinds of pulsations receive the spirit of life.

Likewise, prayer is then brought to greater completeness, in the dimension of the five prayers recited on that day. Moshe Rabbainu also merited to receive the second Tablets then only through his many prayers and the thirteen Attributes that G-d, Yisburach, revealed to him. All this is the dimension of drawing down the spirit of life through the holy Tzadikim, to complete deficiencies and atone for sins, in the dimension of “A wise man will appease it.” Therefore Moshe then drew down the dimension of forgiveness of sins on Yom Kippur for all generations.

Then the dimension of the rule of Esau, the hairy man, the dimension of accusation arising from the stormy spirit, is completely subdued, in the dimension of “The he-goat shall bear upon itself all their iniquities to a cut-off land,” which our Sages of blessed memory expounded concerning Esau, the hairy man. They become greatly intensified at that time. Therefore one must not mention any sin or iniquity then, so as not to give him even greater force and strength through this. For his principal vitality, and the intensification of his stormy spirit, come only from the sins of Israel, Heaven forbid. Through these sins they blemish the holy spirit of life and give strength to Esau and his chiefs, Heaven forbid, as is understood in the main text.

Therefore there is an especially great obligation at that time to go and travel to the true Tzadik for Rosh HaShanah, in order to draw down through him the dimension of lengthening the spirit, to complete all deficiencies and overcome and subdue the husk of Esau and his chiefs, Heaven forbid, through the power of this Tzadik, who is in the dimension of abundant kindness and truth. This is the dimension of the great battle that takes place then between Yaakov and Esau, as brought in the holy Zohar.

This is the dimension of “It shall be a day of teruah for you.” It is explained in the holy Zohar that this corresponds to “When you come to war in your land,” etc., “you shall sound the teruah,” etc. For all the dimensions of war arising from the oppressive enemy come from the stormy spirit of Esau. One must subdue it through the sound of the teruah, which is in the dimension of holy sighing, the dimension of lengthening the spirit to complete deficiencies and overcome the stormy spirit of Esau and his chiefs.

This is why our Sages of blessed memory were uncertain whether the teruah is shevarim, which is groaning—that is, the above-mentioned sighing, the dimension of the holy lengthening of the spirit, through which the stormy spirit is consequently subdued—or whether it is teruah, which is wailing, consisting of short and closely repeated sounds. For one stands against the other: through this one overcomes the stormy spirit of Esau, which intensifies with great alarm and great speed, while the troubles that come from it are close together and follow one another rapidly. As our Sages of blessed memory said, before the first trouble has passed, etc., the second hastens and hurries to come. Therefore they agreed to perform both.

Therefore the shevarim, and likewise the teruah, must be performed in one breath. Some say that the shevarim and teruah together must also be performed in one breath. All this is the dimension of the holy lengthening of the spirit and breath. In any case, in the sequence tashrat, one must not pause between the shevarim and teruah for the duration of a breath, since in this sequence both are performed to indicate that both are necessary and that one depends upon the other.

The shevarim precede the teruah, because through sighing and the holy lengthening of the spirit, which is the dimension of shevarim, one overcomes the stormy spirit of Esau and his chiefs, which is alluded to by the teruah, as above.

This is what our Sages of blessed memory said: teruah alludes to the Torah, in the dimension of תור"ה עיי"ן, etc. For the principal lengthening of the spirit of life is received from the holy Torah. Likewise, the principal subduing of Esau, the hairy man, is through the holy Torah, as our Sages of blessed memory expounded concerning “The voice is the voice of Yaakov,” etc.

Because ordinary people cannot receive the lengthening of the spirit and the completion of deficiencies from the spirit of life within the holy Torah except through the Tzadik and the rabbi of the generation, every teruah therefore has a simple sound before it and a simple sound after it. The simple tekiah alludes to gathering and joining with the Tzadik, as explained in the passage concerning the trumpets: “They shall sound them, and the whole congregation shall assemble to you,” etc., as brought above.

The simple tekiah also indicates the completeness possessed by the spirit of life before a person sins. The teruah indicates the sigh that one must sigh over the deficiency produced through sin, in the dimension of “There are no sufferings without iniquity.” Nevertheless, through sighing one merits to complete the deficiency, which is the dimension of the simple tekiah that follows it. All this is through the power of the Tzadik, as above.

This entire matter is included in the thirteen Attributes of Mercy, as explained in the main text. This is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded concerning “The L-rd, the L-rd”: the first “L-rd” is before a person sins, and the second “L-rd” is after a person sins. This is as explained above.

This is the dimension of Kingship, Remembrances and Shofaros. For the principal holy spirit of life is received from the dimension of holy Kingship, in the dimension of “Esther clothed herself in Kingship,” concerning which our Sages of blessed memory expounded that the Holy Spirit clothed her. It is also written, “In the light of the King's countenance is life,” as is understood in the discourse ויתן עוז למלכו, section 78.

This is the dimension of “And the spirit of G-d hovered over the surface of the waters,” which our Sages of blessed memory expounded concerning the Kingship of Mashiach.

Remembrances are the dimension of completing deficiencies and lengthening the spirit, drawn down through holy sighing, in the dimension of “G-d heard their groaning, and G-d remembered His covenant,” etc., which is said among the verses of Remembrances. Likewise, “G-d remembered Noach,” etc., “and G-d caused a wind to pass over the earth,” etc.—specifically a wind or spirit, as above.

This is the dimension of “Remember that my life is a spirit” (Iyov, chapter 7). It is also the dimension of “For in death there is no remembrance of You,” for death is the opposite of the above-mentioned spirit of life, which is the dimension of remembrance.

This is “And through what? Through the shofar.” That is, in Shofaros one mentions many passages concerning the giving of the Torah, from which the principal spirit of life is received. One concludes with verses from the Prophets describing how redemption and the ingathering of the exiles—which are the dimension of subduing the stormy spirit of Esau, the hairy man—will come through the shofar.

Through this, ultimately, the stormy spirit will storm against their bodies and souls, as explained in the main text. This is the dimension of “And the L-rd G-d will sound the shofar and go forth in the storms of the south”: the stormy spirit will be stirred against them, while over us “the L-rd of Hosts will protect,” etc.

qualifications.text: The supplied opening has ספרי חיים וספרי מתיפ, understood contextually as the Books of Life and Books of Death. The irregular spelling מתיפ is retained in the Hebrew.

The supplied clause שמשם מקבלין העשרה מינינ דפקין את הרוח חיים is read with the ten kinds of pulsations as the recipients of the spirit of life, which they receive from the Ten Commandments. The Hebrew retains its supplied wording and the ordinary meaning of דפקין as pulsations.

The supplied compound והשלשל עשרה מדות is read contextually as referring to the thirteen Attributes revealed to Moshe. The phrase's irregular form is retained unchanged. The same paragraph subsequently refers explicitly to הי"ג מדות של רחמים, and the corresponding cited discourse discusses שלש־עשרה מדות. This supports the contextual thirteen-attribute reading without establishing an original-print correction.

After the he-goat quotation the source reads מתגברין אז מאד, “They become greatly intensified at that time,” without an explicit new plural subject. The English retains that plural construction rather than assigning an additional named subject.
The source associates teruah with תור"ה עיי"ן. The letter forms remain literal; the translation does not expand the wordplay into a different source wording.

The wording רוח סערה יסער גופ ונשמתם is rendered as the stormy spirit storming against their bodies and souls. The unusual form יסער גופ is preserved in the Hebrew, and no different agent is introduced.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Aleph-Hay [abbreviation: א״ה = "with G-d's help"]:
It is explained in the words of our holy Rebbe, the Light of Lights,
Mohara"n, z"l — in many places in his holy book
Likutay Mohara"n and in his holy conversations —
regarding the topic of the wondrous rectifications (tikkunim nifloim)
that are accomplished by those who come to the true Tzadik
on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: These are opening words used as a discourse heading, not a separate teaching paragraph.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בתשובה בכל עשי"ת והכל לתקן פגם החטאים שמשם יונק הרוח סערה ולברר ולהפריש הרע מהטוב שבד' יסודות ולהגביר הרוח חיים של הצדיקים על הרוח סערה של הרשעים ומרבים אז בצעקות ואנחות דק' עד שביו"כ זוכין לסליחת עונות ושלימות החסרונות על ידי הרוח חיים דק' כנ"ל וע"כ עומדים אז כל היום מעוטפין בטלית וציצית ואומרים כמה פעמים הי"ג מדות של רחמםי שכל זה הוא בחי' המשכת הרוח חים דק' כמבפ"נ:
units.en: Afterward one engages in repentance throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance. All this is to rectify the blemish of sins, from which the stormy spirit draws nourishment; to clarify and separate evil from good within the four elements; and to strengthen the spirit of life of the Tzadikim over the stormy spirit of the wicked. One then greatly increases holy cries and sighs, until on Yom Kippur one merits forgiveness of sins and the completion of deficiencies through the holy spirit of life, as above. Therefore on that day they stand throughout the entire day wrapped in a tallis and tzitzis, and recite the thirteen Attributes of Mercy several times. All this is the dimension of drawing down the holy spirit of life, as explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
For on Yom Kippur all Israel in general merit to separate and distinguish the evil from the good —
the dimension of:
"one lot for G-d and one lot for Azazel"
[Lev. 16:8]
— for then the holiness of Torah and prayer is drawn in completeness,
through which the evil is separated from the good.
For then Moshe received the Second Tablets —
the essential holy Torah, comprising the Ten Commandments —
from which the ten types of spiritual arousal (minei d'fokin)
that awaken the spirit of life are received.

And likewise prayer is completed most fully at that time —
the dimension of the Five Prayers of Yom Kippur.
And Moshe our Teacher merited to receive the Second Tablets at that time also
only through his many prayers —
and the disclosure of the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy
which G-d revealed to him —
all of which is the dimension of drawing the spirit of life through the holy Tzadikim
to complete the lacks and to atone for sins —
the dimension of "a wise man can appease it."

And therefore on Yom Kippur Moshe accomplished the drawing of forgiveness of sins
for eternal generations —
and then the dimension of the rule of Esov —
the man of Seir — the dimension of the spirit of the storm (ruach seara) — was completely subdued.
The dimension of:
"and the he-goat shall carry upon itself all their sins to a desolate land"
[Lev. 16:22]
— the Sages, z"l, expounded this of Esov.

qualifications.text: The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 1, in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola
["Blow the Shofar of Sovereignty"], it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension (bechia) of being the Place of the World
— and they are able to perform the [spiritual work of] Rosh HaShanah.
And in the discourse Tik'u Emuna, Siman 5,
much is explained regarding the wondrous rectifications
that are wrought through the gathering of the disciples near the true Rebbe —
and the primary time of gathering is on Rosh HaShanah.

units.he: ואחר יו"כ אז מתחילין ליכנס ולהאיר אור החסדים שעל ידם עיקר המתקת הדינים והתגברות על אלופי עשו שזה בחי נוצר חסד לאלפים המבואר בפנים, עד שביום ראשון של סוכות אז נכנס החסד הגדול הפנימי וגם אור החסד העליון של המקיפים והוא בחי' הטלית לבן שסידר בו הקב"ה י"ג מדות של רחמים, כי הטלית הוא בחי' מקיף כמובן במאמר לשמש סי' מ"ט שהוא בחי' הרוח חיים בחי' סובב הולך הרוח כמבפ"נ וע"כ נכנסין אז לסוכה שהיא בחי' אורות המקיפין כמבואר במאמר עתיקא סי' כ"א, גם סוכה מרמזת על בינה לבא אשר שם עיקר הרוח חיים כמבפ"נ ומשם ממשיכין חיי המלך אל בחי' מלכות בחי' סוכת דוד הנופלת להקים אותה ולסעדה, ועיקר תיקון המלכות ע"י החסדים בבחי' והוכן בחסד כסא כמובא לעיל, וזה בחי' חיםי וחסד עשית עמדי וכו'. (וע"כ סוכה היא זכר לענני כבדו שהגינו עאל ישראל ממלחמת עמלק שהוא מאלופי עשו כי החסד העליון הנכנס ביום ראשון של סוכות הוא בחי' נוצר חסד לאלפים כנ"ל), וזה בח'י הד' מינים שנוטלים אז וארז"ל שכולם מרמזין על הקב"ה. ובכתבים מבואר שהם נגד ד' אותיות של שם הוי"ה ב"ה, היינו שמרמזין שאנו נצחנו המלחמה ע"י שאנו אחוזים ודבוקים בהרוח חיים דק' שהיא בחי' ארבע אותיות הוי"ה שהם בחי' הרוח חיים והטוב שבכל הד' יסודות כמובן בפנים:
units.en:
After Yom Kippur, the light of the loving-kindnesses begins to enter and shine. Through them comes the principal sweetening of judgments and the overcoming of the chiefs of Esau. This is the dimension of “Preserving kindness for thousands,” as explained in the main text.

This continues until the first day of Sukkos, when the great inner kindness enters, together with the light of the supernal encompassing kindness. This is the dimension of the white tallis in which the Holy One, blessed be He, arranged the thirteen Attributes of Mercy. For the tallis is the dimension of an encompassing light, as is understood in the discourse לשמש, section 49. This is the dimension of the spirit of life, in the dimension of “The wind goes round and round,” as explained in the main text.

Therefore one enters the sukkah at that time, for the sukkah is the dimension of encompassing lights, as explained in the discourse עתיקא, section 21. The sukkah also alludes to Understanding, the heart, where the principal spirit of life is found, as explained in the main text. From there one draws the life of the King to the dimension of Kingship, the dimension of the fallen sukkah of David, to raise it up and support it. The principal rectification of Kingship is through loving-kindnesses, in the dimension of “A throne is established through kindness,” as brought above. This is the dimension of “You have dealt with me in life and kindness,” etc.

(Therefore the sukkah commemorates the Clouds of Glory, which protected Israel from the war of Amalek, who is among the chiefs of Esau. For the supernal kindness that enters on the first day of Sukkos is the dimension of “Preserving kindness for thousands,” as above.)

This is the dimension of the Four Species taken at that time. Our Sages of blessed memory said that all of them allude to the Holy One, blessed be He. In the writings it is explained that they correspond to the four letters of the Name הוי"ה, blessed be He. That is, they allude to the fact that we have won the battle by holding fast and cleaving to the holy spirit of life, which is the dimension of the four letters of הוי"ה. These are the dimension of the spirit of life and the good within all four elements, as is understood in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
[The forces of accusation] intensify greatly [on Rosh HaShanah]
— and therefore one must not mention any sin or transgression [on Rosh HaShanah itself],
so as not to give them increased strength —
for their primary vitality and the intensification of the storm-wind of [Esov]
derives only from the sins of Israel, heaven forbid.

And therefore the obligation is most intense at that time
to go and journey to the true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah —
in order to draw through him the dimension of extended breath (arichas ruach)
to complete all the lacks
and to overpower and humble the dimension of the husk of Esov and his princes, heaven forbid,
through the strength of this Tzadik
who is in the dimension of Rav Chesed V'Emes — great in loving-kindness and truth.

qualifications.text: The expression נוצר חסד לאלפים is retained as “Preserving kindness for thousands.” In this passage it is also associated with overcoming the chiefs of Esau. The English preserves the quoted expression without replacing its literal “thousands” with “chiefs.”
The supplied references are the discourse לשמש, section 49, and the discourse עתיקא, section 21. Their Hebrew titles and numerical locators are retained without an unverified alternative title.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, the soundings of the Shofar,
and the general holiness of the month of Tishray.
See also Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 94,
which likewise explains that one must travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah.

units.he: וזה שדרז"ל פרי עץ הדר זה אברהם וכו' היינו בחי' חסד הנ"ל, כפות תמרים זה יצחק וכו' בחי' מדת הדין שמשם שורש השתלשלות יניקת בחי' הרוח סערה של אלופי עשו רק שע"י החסד דאברהם הנ"ל נמתק גם הוא בסוד עקידת יצחק כידוע שזה בחי' נוצר חסד לאלפים, וע"כ מבואר בכוונות ברכת זכרונות כמו שכבש אברהם אבינו את רחמיו וכו' כן יכבשו רחמיך את כעסך מעלינו וכו' שזה בחי' נוצר חסד לאלפים וכו', ענף עץ עבות זה יעקב שהוא כנגד בחי' רוח כידוע, גם הוא בבחי' התורה שמשם תוצאות הרוח חיים כנ"ל, ערבי נחל זה יוסף היינ ובחי' הצדיק שעל ידו מקבלין הרוח חיים שזה בחי' איש אשר רוח אלהים בו שנאמר אצל יוסף וממנו מקבלין הכל הרוח חיים דק' בבחי' כי למחיה שלחני אלהים וכו' ולהחיות עם רב, ועוד דרשו פרי עץ הדר זו שרה שהיא בחי' מלכות דק' שממנה מקבלין הרוח חיים כנ"ל, וע"כ זכתה לחיים טובים בשלימות בלי חסרון כמו שפירש"י שני חיי שרה כולם שוים לטובה וזה כי היתה בת קו"ף כבת כ"ף לחטא נמצא שלא פגמה בהרוח חיים דקדושה שום פגם, כפות תמרים זו רבקה מה תמר וכו' כך רבקה יצאו ממנה יעקב ועשו זה בחי' המתקת הרוח סערה של עשו איש שעיר ע"י יעקב שהוא בחי' הרוח חיים דק' כנ"ל וע"כ יעקב אבינו לא מת כמו שארז"ל ועשו אמר הנה אנכי הולךם למות בחי' רשעים בחייהם קרוים מתים מאחר שאין להם הרוח חיים דק' כי יעקב היה בחי' הרב דקדושה שהוא בחי' רב חסד ואמת שזה בחי' תתן אמת ליעקב חסד לאברהם, וע"כ כשהיה מתיירא מפני עשו אמר קטנתי מכל החסדים ומכל האמת וכו' כי עיקר הכנעת עשו הוא ע"י בחי' רב חסד ואמת, וזה שארז"ל שאמר יעקב הן עשו אחי איש שעיר ואנכי איש חלק היינ וכי חלק ה' עמו וכו' כי יעקב דבוק ברוח חיים דקדושהשהוא בחי' הארבע אותיות של שם הוי"ה ב"ה כנ"ל, ענף עץ עבות זו לאה,וערבני נחל זו רחל, לאה היא בחי' עלמא דאיתכסיא זה בחי' תפלה שהיא בחי' עדן עין לא ראתה כמבפ"נ רחל היא בחי' עלמא דאיתגליא בחי' תורה כי ע"י תפלה ותורה זוכין לברר הרע מהטוב ולדבק עצמו בהרוח חיים ולהכניע הרוח סערה הנ"ל, ועוד דרשו שהד' מינים מרמזין על הסנהדרין וכו' שעוסקין לברר הלכות שבתורה שעי"ז מפרישין הרע מהטוב שבד' יסודות, ועוד דרשו שמרמזין על בחי' כל עצמותי תאמרנה וכו' שזה בחי' שלימות התפלה. כי בקדושה כל בחינה בפני עצמה כלולה מכמה בחינות, וזהו שאמר ואתרוג דומה ללב ששם עיקר הרוח חיים. לולב דומה לשדרה שהוא בחי' הצדיק ח"י עלמין שעל ידו ממשיכין הרוח חיים להשלים כל החסרונות, הדס דומה לעינים זה בחי' בירור ההלכות שבתורה בחי' והאר עינינו בתורתך. ערבה דומה לשפתים זה בחי' תפלה בחי' ה' שפתי תפתח וכו', ועוד דרשו שהד' מינים מרמזין על כל הכתות שבישראל והעיקר שיהיו כולם באגודה אחת כי זה מחסדי השי"ת שצמצם עצמו כביכול להיות הרוח חיים אצל הצדיקים באופן שעי"ז יכולים הצדיקים להמשיך הרוח חים שליות החסרונות לכל הדבוקים ומקושרים אליהם אעפ"י שפגמו בהתורה הק' ולהחזירם בתשובה ולכפר עוונם בבחי' ואיש חכם יכפרנה כמבפ"נ, וזה בחי' השמחה שעם הד' מינים כמו שכתוב ושמחתם לפני ה' אלהיכם כי מאחר שזוכין לשלימות החסרוונת בוודאי מלאים שמחה ועיקר השמחה היא ג"כ מבחי' הרוח חיים בבחי' השיבה לי ששון ישעך ורוח נדיבה תסמכני, וכן ורוח קדשך אל תקח ממני שכתוב לפני זה, וע"כ דרשו חז"ל על שמחת בית השואבה שהיו שואבין משם רוח הקודש כי הרוח חיים דק' הוא בחי' רוח הקודש ממש והוא עיקר בחי' השמחה דק' כנ"ל, וזה בחי' השבעים פרים שמקריבים בסוכות נגד השבעים אומות, ובאמת עי"ז דייקא הם מתמעטין והולכין כמו שארז"ל וכמבואר בזוה"ק שזה בחי' כי גחלים אתה חותה על ראשו זה בחי' מה שמבואר בפנים שהצדיק שרוצה להכניע ולהשפיל את הרשעים שקמבלין הרוח סערה מהרב דקליפה בחי' אופי עשו הוא מוכרח להוריד עצמו לתוך המדות רעות של הרשעים לפי שעה בכדי לקלקל הצינורות שלהם שדרך שם מקבלין אריכת הרוח שלהם, והם בשעה שיורד הצדיק להמדות שלהם הם טועין לומר כאילו הצדיק חפץ ג"כ במדותיהם ח"ו וסוברין שעי"ז יתפסו אותו ויתגברו עליו ביותר, ובאמת הוא בבחי' עת אשר שלט האדם באדם לרע לו, שזה בחי' ירידת אברם למצרים ותפסו את שרה וינגע ה' את פרעה וכו' ויעל אברם ממצרים וכו' וכמובפ"נ:
units.en:
This is what our Sages of blessed memory expounded: “A fruit of a beautiful tree”—this is Avraham, etc., the dimension of the above-mentioned kindness. “And palm branches”—this is Yitzchok, etc., the dimension of the quality of judgment, from which originates the progression of the nourishment of the stormy spirit of the chiefs of Esau. However, through the above-mentioned kindness of Avraham, even this quality is sweetened, in the secret of the binding of Yitzchok, as is known. This is the dimension of “Preserving kindness for thousands.” Therefore it is explained in the mystical intentions of the blessing of Remembrances: “Just as Avraham our father subdued his mercy,” etc., “so may Your mercy subdue Your anger toward us,” etc. This is the dimension of “Preserving kindness for thousands,” etc.

“A branch of a leafy tree”—this is Yaakov, who corresponds to the dimension of spirit, as is known. He is also in the dimension of the Torah, from which the spirit of life emerges, as above. “And willows of the brook”—this is Yosef, the dimension of the Tzadik through whom the spirit of life is received. This is the dimension of “A man in whom is the spirit of G-d,” which was said concerning Yosef. From him all receive the holy spirit of life, in the dimension of “For G-d sent me before you to preserve life,” etc., and “to keep many people alive.”

They further expounded: “A fruit of a beautiful tree”—this is Sarah, who is the dimension of holy Kingship, from which the spirit of life is received, as above. Therefore she merited good life in completeness, without deficiency, as Rashi explained concerning “The years of Sarah's life”: all of them were equally good. This is because at one hundred years of age she was like one twenty years old regarding sin. Thus she did not cause any blemish whatsoever in the holy spirit of life.

“And palm branches”—this is Rivka. Just as the date palm, etc., so Yaakov and Esau came forth from Rivka. This is the dimension of the sweetening of the stormy spirit of Esau, the hairy man, through Yaakov, who is the dimension of the holy spirit of life, as above. Therefore Yaakov our father did not die, as our Sages of blessed memory said. But Esau said, “Behold, I am going to die,” in the dimension of the wicked, who are called dead even during their lifetimes because they do not possess the holy spirit of life.

For Yaakov was the dimension of the holy rabbi, who is the dimension of abundant kindness and truth, as in “You shall give truth to Yaakov, kindness to Avraham.” Therefore, when he was afraid of Esau, he said, “I am diminished by all the kindnesses and all the truth,” etc. For the principal subduing of Esau is through abundant kindness and truth.

This is what our Sages of blessed memory said concerning Yaakov's words: “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.” That is, “For the L-rd's portion is His people,” etc. For Yaakov cleaves to the holy spirit of life, which is the dimension of the four letters of the Name הוי"ה, blessed be He, as above.

“A branch of a leafy tree”—this is Leah; “and willows of the brook”—this is Rachel. Leah is the dimension of the concealed world, which is the dimension of prayer, the dimension of Eden, “No eye has seen,” as explained in the main text. Rachel is the dimension of the revealed world, the dimension of Torah. For through prayer and Torah one merits to separate evil from good, cleave to the spirit of life, and subdue the above-mentioned stormy spirit.

They further expounded that the Four Species allude to the Sanhedrin, etc., who engage in clarifying the laws of the Torah, through which evil is separated from good within the four elements.

They also expounded that the Four Species allude to the dimension of “All my bones shall say,” etc., which is the dimension of the completeness of prayer. For in holiness each dimension in itself includes several dimensions.

This is what was said: the esrog resembles the heart, where the principal spirit of life is found. The lulav resembles the spine, which is the dimension of the Tzadik, the life of the worlds, through whom one draws down the spirit of life to complete all deficiencies. The myrtle resembles the eyes; this is the dimension of clarifying the laws of the Torah, in the dimension of “Illuminate our eyes through Your Torah.” The willow resembles the lips; this is the dimension of prayer, in the dimension of “L-rd, open my lips,” etc.

They further expounded that the Four Species allude to all the groups within Israel, and the essential thing is that they should all be bound together in one bundle. For it is among the kindnesses of G-d, Yisburach, that He contracted Himself, as it were, so that the spirit of life would be with the Tzadikim. Through this, the Tzadikim are able to draw down the spirit of life to complete the deficiencies of all who cleave and are bound to them, even though these people have blemished the holy Torah, and to bring them back in repentance and atone for their sins, in the dimension of “And a wise man will appease it,” as explained in the main text.

This is the dimension of rejoicing with the Four Species, as it is written, “And you shall rejoice before the L-rd your G-d.” For since one merits the completion of deficiencies, one is certainly filled with joy. The principal joy also comes from the dimension of the spirit of life, in the dimension of “Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and support me with a generous spirit,” and likewise “Do not take Your Holy Spirit from me,” which is written before it.

Therefore our Sages of blessed memory expounded concerning the Water-Drawing Celebration that they drew the Holy Spirit from there. For the holy spirit of life is truly the dimension of the Holy Spirit, and it is the principal dimension of holy joy, as above.

This is the dimension of the seventy bulls offered on Sukkos corresponding to the seventy nations. In truth, precisely through this they progressively diminish, as our Sages of blessed memory said, and as explained in the holy Zohar. This is the dimension of “For you are heaping burning coals upon his head.”

This is the dimension of what is explained in the main text: when the Tzadik wishes to subdue and humble the wicked, who receive their stormy spirit from the rabbi of the husk, the dimension of the chiefs of Esau, he is compelled to descend temporarily into the evil traits of the wicked in order to damage their channels, through which they receive their lengthening of spirit.

When the Tzadik descends into their traits, they mistakenly say that the Tzadik also desires their traits, Heaven forbid. They suppose that through this they will capture him and overcome him all the more. But in truth this is the dimension of “A time when one man rules over another to his own harm.” This is the dimension of Avram's descent into Egypt, when they seized Sarah, and “The L-rd afflicted Pharaoh,” etc., followed by “Avram went up out of Egypt,” etc., as explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
This is the dimension of the great war that takes place at that time
between Yaakov and Esov, as brought in the Zohar.
This is the dimension of:
"a day of Teruah shall it be for you"
[Num. 29:1]
— and it is explained in the Zohar that this is the dimension of:
"and when you go to war in your land against the enemy who oppresses you —
and you shall sound the Teruah"
[Num. 10:9].
For all the wars from the distressing oppressor
all come from the dimension of the storm-wind of Esov.
And one must humble it through the voice of the Teruah —
which is the dimension of the holy sigh (anochah),
the dimension of extended breath (arichas ruach) —
to complete the lacks and to overpower the storm-wind of Esov and his princes.

And this is why the Sages, z"l, were uncertain about the Teruah:
whether it is Sh'vorim — which is "groaning-groaning" [gonochi gonach] —
that is, the holy sigh above —
which is the dimension of the extended holy breath,
and through it the storm-wind is subdued;
or whether it is Teruah — which is "wailing-wailing" [yelulai yeilil] —
i.e., short and rapid sounds —
for this corresponds to the storm-wind of Esov
which intensifies with great panic and great speed,
and the troubles that come from it are close and rapid, one after another,
as the Sages, z"l, taught:
"Until the first one takes notice, the second hurries and hastens to come."

qualifications.text: The statement concerning Sarah gives בת קו"ף כבת כ"ף, literally one hundred like twenty regarding sin. The ages are rendered numerically without replacing the supplied Hebrew letter forms.

The supplied expression הרוח חים שליות החסרונות is read contextually as drawing down the spirit of life to complete deficiencies, consistent with the passage's repeated explanation of the Tzadikim's function. The Hebrew remains unchanged.

The supplied reference to the opposing rabbi ends בחי' אופי עשו. The English reads this contextually as the chiefs of Esau in light of the repeated אלופי עשו earlier in the same discussion. The irregular supplied form is retained without an asserted original-print correction.
