units.he: ואח"כ זוכין לשמיני עצרת ואז זיווגא דמטרוניתא בשלימות וכמו כן למטה ג"כ הצדיק מתחבר עם כלל כנסת ישראל בחיבור שלם וממשיך להם הרוח חיים מהתורה הק', וע"כ כל ישראל עולין אז לתורה ומסיימין התורה בענין שבירת הלוחות וכו' עשה בכדי שלא ליתן מקום להרוח סערה להתגבר אז לינק כביכול מהתורה בעצמה שזה בחי' ודורש רעה תבואנו המובפ"נ, ע"כ ירד משה לעומקה של הלכה ודרש ק"ו מדעתו ושיבר את הלוחות והקב"ה הסכים על ידו, אח"כ הרבה בתפלה עד שגילה לו השי"ת הי"ג מדות של רחמים שמרומז בהם סוד זה מה שהצדיק יכול להמשיך הרוח חיים להשלים החסרונות ולפכר עוונות עד שזכה לקבל אח"כ הלוחות שניות שהם כלל התורה ששם עיקר הרוח חיים, וזה שמתחילין תיכף אח"כ בראשית ברא וכו' והארץ היתה תהו ובוהו וכו' שמרמז על התגברות ממשלת הד' מלכיות ע"י הרוח סערה שיונק מהרע שבד' יסודות שמרומז ג"כ בזה, והתיקון הוא ע"י ורוח אלהים מרחפת על פני המים היינו הרוח חיים ששורה בהתורה הק', ויאמר א' יהי אור וכו' ויבדל א' בין האור ובין החשך שהבדיל והפריש הרע מהטוב, ויהי ערב זה ערבו של עשו, ויהי בוקר ה בוקרו של יעקב וכו' היינ ושסוף כל סוף יתגבר הרוח חיים של יעקב ויכניע ויבטל את הרוח סערה של עשו ואז תושלם כוונת הבריאה ותצא כל הבריאה כולה מכח אל הפועל בשלימות עד שנזכה ליום שכולו שבת שבזה מסיימין הפרשה אז, ואז הנוקבא עוצרת הטיפה (שמלובש בה בחי' הרוח חיים בסוד האי רוחא דשדי בגווה כידוע) שלא תפיל שזה מרמז על סוד הגאולה האחרונה שאין אחריהגלות כי כבר נכנע הרוח סערה רוח הטומאה לגמרי בבחי' ואת רוח הטומאה אעביר מן הארץ, ואז השמחה גדולה מאוד ויעקב הוא אז רישא לחדוותא כי הוא המנצח ומכניע הרוח סערה של עשו וממשיך הרוח חיים דקדושה לכל ישרא לומשלים חסרונותם ועי"ז זוכין כולם לשמחה גדולה כנ"ל:
units.en:
Afterward one merits the Eighth Day of Assembly, and then comes the complete union of the Matron. Likewise, below as well, the Tzadik joins with the entire Congregation of Israel in a complete union and draws down to them the spirit of life from the holy Torah. Therefore all Israel ascend to the Torah then and complete the Torah with the matter of the breaking of the Tablets, etc. This was done so as not to allow the stormy spirit to become powerful at that time and draw nourishment, as it were, from the Torah itself, which is the dimension of “And one who seeks evil, it shall come upon him,” as explained in the main text.

Therefore Moshe descended into the depths of the law, derived an argument a fortiori through his own understanding, and broke the Tablets; and the Holy One, blessed be He, agreed with him. Afterward Moshe greatly increased his prayers until G-d, Yisburach, revealed to him the thirteen Attributes of Mercy. Within them is alluded the secret of how the Tzadik can draw down the spirit of life to complete deficiencies and atone for sins. Ultimately Moshe merited to receive the second Tablets, which encompass the Torah, where the principal spirit of life is found.

This is why immediately afterward one begins “In the beginning [G-d] created,” etc., and “The earth was formless and void,” etc., which alludes to the strengthening of the rule of the four kingdoms through the stormy spirit that draws nourishment from the evil within the four elements, also alluded to here. The rectification is through “And the spirit of G-d hovered over the surface of the waters”—that is, the spirit of life dwelling within the holy Torah. “And G-d said: Let there be light,” etc., and “G-d separated between the light and the darkness”: He distinguished and separated evil from good.

“And there was evening”—this is the evening of Esau. “And there was morning”—this is the morning of Yaakov, etc. That is, ultimately the spirit of life of Yaakov will prevail and subdue and nullify the stormy spirit of Esau. Then the purpose of creation will be fulfilled, and all creation in its entirety will emerge from potential into actuality in complete perfection, until we merit the day that is entirely Shabbos, with which the reading is concluded at that time.

Then the feminine principle retains the drop, in which the dimension of the spirit of life is enclothed, in the secret of “this spirit which he cast within her,” as is known, so that she does not miscarry. This alludes to the secret of the final redemption, after which there will be no exile, for the stormy spirit, the spirit of impurity, will already have been completely subdued, in the dimension of “And I shall remove the spirit of impurity from the earth.”

Then the joy is exceedingly great, and Yaakov is the head of joy at that time, for he is the one who defeats and subdues the stormy spirit of Esau, draws down the holy spirit of life to all Israel, and completes their deficiencies. Through this they all merit great joy, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Therefore they agreed to do both.
And therefore the Sh'vorim and the Teruah must be done in one breath (neshima),
and some say that also both the Sh'vorim and the Teruah together
must be done in one breath —
for all of this is the dimension of the extended holy breath and respiration.
And in any case, in the Tashra"T sequence
[Tekia-Sh'vorim-Teruah-Tekia]
one must not pause between Sh'vorim and Teruah
[even] for the length of a breath —
for in this sequence, both are performed to demonstrate that both are needed and each depends upon the other.
And Sh'vorim precedes Teruah —
for through the sigh and extended holy breath — which is the dimension of Sh'vorim —
one overpowers the storm-wind of Esov and his princes —
which is alluded to in Teruah, as above.

And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught:
"Teruah alludes to the Torah — the letters Tav-Vav-Reish-Hay"
— for the essential extension of the spirit of life is received from the holy Torah.
And likewise the essential humbling of Esov the man of Seir
is through the holy Torah —
as the Sages, z"l, expounded:
"the voice is the voice of Yaakov"
[Gen. 27:22].

qualifications.text: The opening account of completing the Torah and breaking the Tablets continues with the source's implicit reference to Moshe's action. The English “This was done” preserves that connection without introducing an additional event.

The supplied Aramaic האי רוחא דשדי בגווה means “this spirit which he cast within her.” The verb retains its unnamed masculine subject and the feminine recipient; the wording does not independently identify the one who cast the spirit. The surrounding passage connects this spirit with the drop retained by the feminine principle.

The source links the creation reading's conclusion with the day that is entirely Shabbos. The English retains this stated relationship without supplying an additional scriptural quotation or altering the reading's stated endpoint.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

— even for the souls of those close to him who come to him on Rosh HaShanah —
that throughout the entire year, even he himself cannot perform them.

units.he: (שייך לעיל) וזהו שארז"ל בשכר ולקחתם לכם ביום הראשון אני נגלה לכם ראשון וכו' כי בשכר לקיחת הד' מינים המורים שאנו כרוכים ודבוקים בהרוח חים דקדושה ששהוא בחי' הנשמה ועכשיו הנשמה עצמה ג"כ אינה נראית ונגלית ומכש"כ הקב"ה שהוא מקור הרוח חיים בחי' כי עמך מקור חים בוודאי רואה ואינו נראה וכמו שארז"ל (ברכות יו"ד), אבל לעתיד אז יתבררו הד' יסודות כל כך עד שיהיו בבחי' ארבעה אותיות הוי"ה ב"ה אז ונגלה כבוד ה', ופורע לכם מן הראשון זה עשו הוא ביטול הרוח סערה של עשו איש שעיר, ובונה לכם ראשון זה בית המקדש ששם עיקר מקום התפלה בחי' כי ביתי בית תפלה והמעיין היוצא מבית ה' ובירור הלכות התורה כי שם יושבין הסנהדרין בלשכת הגזית ומבררין הלכה, וזה ומביא לכם את הראשון מלך המשיח שהוא עיקר הרוח חיים של כלל ישראל בחי' רוח אפינו משיח ה', ועיקר הרוח חיים שבהתורה הק' שהוא בחי' רוח אלהים מרחפת על פני המים הוא אצל המלך המשיח כמו שדרשו חז"ל ורוח אלהים מרחפת על פני המים דא רוחא של משיח וכו':
units.en:
(Belongs above.) And this is what our Sages, z"l, taught: "As a reward for 'And you shall take for yourselves on the first day,' I will reveal Myself to you as the First," etc. For as a reward for taking the Four Species, which indicate that we are bound and cleave to the holy spirit of life, which is the dimension of the soul. And at present, even the soul itself cannot be seen or revealed; all the more so the Holy One, blessed be He, Who is the source of the spirit of life, in the dimension of "For with You is the source of life," certainly sees but is not seen, as our Sages, z"l, taught (Berachos 10).

But in the future the four elements will be so thoroughly purified that they will be in the dimension of the four letters of the Name הוי"ה, blessed be He. Then "the glory of G-d shall be revealed."

"And He will exact recompense for you from the first"—this is Esau: the nullification of the stormy spirit of Esau, the hairy man.

"And He will build for you the first"—this is the Bais HaMikdash, where the principal place of prayer is, in the dimension of "For My house shall be a house of prayer"; and the spring that goes forth from the House of G-d; and the clarification of the laws of the Torah, for there the Sanhedrin sit in the Chamber of Hewn Stone and clarify the Halacha.

And this is "And He will bring you the first"—King Mashiach, who is the principal spirit of life of all Israel, in the dimension of "The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of G-d." And the principal spirit of life within the holy Torah, which is the dimension of "And the spirit of G-d hovered over the surface of the waters," is with King Mashiach, as our Sages, z"l, expounded: "And the spirit of G-d hovered over the surface of the waters"—this is the spirit of Mashiach, etc.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And because the masses of the people cannot receive
the extension of the spirit of life and the completion of their lacks from the holy Torah —
except through the Tzadik and the Torah teacher of the generation —
therefore every Teruah has a simple [Tekia] before it and after it.
For the simple Tekia alludes to the gathering and connecting to the Tzadik —
as is explained in the passage of the trumpets:
"and you shall blow them and all the congregation shall assemble to you"
[Num. 10:3],
as was brought above.

Also, the simple Tekia indicates the completeness that the spirit of life possesses
before a person sins;
and the Teruah indicates the sigh one must sigh over the lack created by the sin —
the dimension of: "there are no sufferings without sin."
But even so, through the sigh one merits to complete the lack —
and this is the dimension of the simple Tekia that follows.
And all of this is through the power of the Tzadik, as above.

And all this entire matter is included in the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy,
as is explained in the main text.
And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught:
"G-d, G-d"
[Ex. 34:6]
— "'G-d' before one sins and 'G-d' after one sins"
— as mentioned above.

And this is the dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros:
for the essential holy spirit of life is received from the dimension of holy Malchus
— the dimension of:
"and Esther clothed herself in royalty"
[Esther 5:1]
— and the Sages, z"l, taught that she clothed herself in the holy spirit —
and it is written:
"in the light of the King's countenance is life"
[Prov. 16:15].
And as is understood in the discourse Vayitain Oz L'Malko, Siman 78.
And this is the dimension of:
"and the spirit of G-d hovered over the waters"
— the Sages, z"l, taught: this is the spirit of the King Messiah.

Zichronos — the dimension of completing the lacks and extending the spirit [of life]
that is drawn through the holy sigh —
the dimension of:
"and G-d heard their groaning, and G-d remembered His covenant"
[Ex. 2:24],
and: "and G-d remembered Noach... and G-d caused a wind (ruach) to pass over the earth"
[Gen. 8:1]
— ruach specifically, as above.
And this is the dimension of:
"remember, that my life is wind (ruach)"
[Job 7:7].
And this is the dimension of:
"for there is no mention of You in death"
[Ps. 6:6]
— for death is the opposite of the holy spirit of life,
which is the dimension of remembrance.

And "through what? Through the Shofar" —
i.e., Shofaros,
in which one recalls at length the Giving of the Torah
— from which the primary spirit of life comes —
and one concludes with verses of the Prophets
about how the redemption and the ingathering of the exiles
— the humbling of the storm-wind of Esov the man of Seir —
will be through the Shofar.
And through this, ultimately, the storm-wind will swirl upon them,
as is explained in the main text.
And this is the dimension of:
"And G-d the L-rd shall blow the Shofar and shall go in the storms of the south wind"
[Zech. 9:14]
— meaning: the storm-wind shall be stirred up against them —
and upon us G-d of Hosts shall protect, etc.

Afterwards One Engages in Repentance — Yom Kippur

Afterwards one engages in repentance throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance —
to rectify the blemish of sins
from which the storm-wind draws sustenance —
to clarify and separate the evil from the good within the four elements —
and to strengthen the spirit of life of the Tzadikim
over the storm-wind of the wicked.
And one multiplies holy cries and sighs
until on Yom Kippur one merits forgiveness of sins
and the completion of lacks through the holy spirit of life, as above.
And therefore one stands the entire day wrapped in a tallis and tzitzis,
and recites many times the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy —
all of which is the dimension of drawing the holy spirit of life, as explained in the main text.

After Yom Kippur — Sukkos: The Loving-Kindnesses Illuminate

After Yom Kippur, the light of the loving-kindnesses
begins to enter and to shine —
through which the essential sweetening of judgments
and overpowering of the princes of Esov takes place.
This is the dimension of:
"preserving loving-kindness to thousands"
[Ex. 34:7],
as is explained in the main text.
Until on the first day of Sukkos,
the great inner loving-kindness enters —
and also the supernal encompassing loving-kindness —
which is the dimension of the white tallis
in which G-d arranged the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy.

For the tallis is in the dimension of an encompassing [light] (makif),
as is understood in the discourse LaShemesh, Siman 49 —
which is the dimension of the spirit of life —
the dimension of:
"the spirit goes about and returns"
[Eccl. 1:6],
as is explained in the main text.
And therefore one enters the Sukka —
which is the dimension of encompassing lights (oiros hamakifin),
as is explained in the discourse Atika, Siman 21.

Also, the Sukka alludes to Bina —
for there is the primary spirit of life, as explained in the main text.
And from there the life of the King is drawn to the dimension of Malchus
— the dimension of the Sukka of David that has fallen — to raise and support it.
And the essential rectification of Malchus is through loving-kindnesses —
the dimension of "and through kindness a throne is established", as brought above.
And this is the dimension of:
"and life and kindness You have done with me"
[Job 10:12].

(And therefore the Sukka is a remembrance of the Clouds of Glory
that protected Israel from the war of Amaleik —
who is from the princes of Esov —
for the supernal loving-kindness that enters on the first day of Sukkos
is the dimension of "preserving loving-kindness to thousands," as above.)

And this is the dimension of the four species that are taken at that time —
and the Sages, z"l, taught that they all allude to the Holy One, blessed be He.
And in the holy writings it is explained that they correspond to
the four letters of the Name Havaya, blessed be He —
meaning they hint that we have been victorious in the war
through being grasped and cleaved to the holy spirit of life —
which is the dimension of the four letters of Havaya,
the dimension of the spirit of life and the good
within all four elements, as is understood in the main text.

Translator's Summary — Siman 8

Siman 8 frames the entire High Holiday season through the lens of
Ruach Chaim (the Spirit of Life) versus the Ruach Seara (the Storm-Wind of Esov).
The Shofar debate (Sh'vorim vs. Teruah) reflects both strategies for overcoming the storm-wind:
the extended, deep sigh of holy breath (Sh'vorim)
and the rapid, urgent cries that counter Esov's quick-striking attacks (Teruah).
The Tzadik — the embodiment of Ruach Chaim — is the conduit for all rectification.
The Three Blessings map precisely: Malchuyos = holy sovereignty / Esther's spirit; Zichronos = G-d's remembering / holy wind; Shofaros = Torah / the Shofar of final redemption.
After Yom Kippur, the loving-kindnesses of the first day of Sukkos
correspond to the white tallis and the Thirteen Attributes —
the encompassing spirit-of-life that protects and nourishes the Four Species' victory.

qualifications.text: The initial (שייך לעיל) is an editorial indication that this passage belongs above. It is retained within this prose owner, separately from the preceding structural owner.

The source cites ברכות יו"ד for the teaching that G-d sees but is not seen. The English retains Berachos 10 without assigning an unsupplied amud or reproducing additional words of the rabbinic passage.

The final supplied Aramaic דא רוחא של משיח means “this is the spirit of Mashiach.” The English preserves that identification without expanding the source's concluding etc.

units.he: עיין לקוטי הלכות הלכו תראש השנה הלכה א' מבואר כל ענין ר"ה ע"פ מאמר זה, ולבאר עוד קצת, כי בר"ה אנו עוסקין בבנין המלכות דקדושה העומדת על שנים עשר בקר כמבואר במ"א, וזה בחי' התפלה שהיא בחי' מלכות ויש בה שנים עשר נוסחאות ועולה דרך י"ב שערים, ומחמת שעיקר החיות מקבלין מהתפלה וכן עיקר הפרנסה נמשכת משם ע"כ מתפללין אז הרבה זכרנו לחיים וכתבינו בספר החיים וארז"ל מזונותיו של אדם קצובין לו מר"ה, וזה בחי' מה שאנו עוסקין מר"ה עד שמיני עצרת להשלים בחי' זיווגא דמטרוניתא שהעיקר תלוי בתפלה כמבואר בפנים, וזה בחי' יום הדין של ר"ה כי עיקר דינו של אדם הוא על שלא היה זהיר בענין התפלה כי ע"י תפלה יכולין לבוא לכל טוב לתורה ולמעש"ט ולתשובה ולהנצל מן החטא וכמו שתיקנו רז"ל תפלות הרבה ע"ז, וזה מובן בדברי רז"ל (עירובין ס"ה) שאמר ראב"ע יכול אני לפטור כל העולםמן הדין וכו' ומסקו מאי אני יכול לפטור דקאמר מדין תפלה כי דין תפלה הוא כלל הדין והחשבון של האדם כי אלמלי היה זהיר ורגיל בתפלה כראוי היה זוכה לתקן הכל וכמבואר גם במפרשים כעין זה וכמבואר אצלינו במ"א שזה נלמד מענין נערה המאורסה שעיקר החיוב שלה למיתה ר"ל הוא על דבר אשר לא צעקה וכו', אך כשאדם עומד להתפלל אז יהחושך והקליפות מסבבין אותו מכל צד ומבלבלין תפלתו וזה בחי' המחשבות זרות שבתפלה, ע"כ עיקר תיקון התפלה הוא ע"י אמת כי ע"י אמת הקב"ה שוכן עמו כוו' וכשהקב"ה עמו אז יהוא מאירלו איך לצאת מן החושך וכו' כ"ש ה' אורי וכו' ועיי"ש, וזה בחי' גודל הקיטרוגים שמתעוררין בר"ה והקב"ה מרחם עלינו ומאיר לנו בבחי' ה'אורי כמו שדרשו רז"ל, וע"כ ציוה עלינו לשמוע קול שופר ועי"ז ממתיקין הדין והחושך ע"י שמעוררין מדתו של יעקב כמבואר בזוה"ק שזה בחי' יום תרועה יהיה לכם ומדתו של יעקב הוא אמת כ"ש תתן אמת ליעקב וכמבואר ג"כ בליקוטי הלכות הנ"ל:
units.en:
See Likutay Halachos, Laws of Rosh HaShanah, Law 1, where the entire topic of Rosh HaShanah through this discourse is explained. And to elaborate somewhat further:

On Rosh HaShanah we are engaged in building the holy Malchus, which stands upon twelve oxen, as is explained elsewhere. This is the dimension of prayer — which is the dimension of Malchus, and has twelve texts (nuscha'os), and ascends through twelve gates. And because the primary vitality is received through prayer, and likewise the primary sustenance flows from there — therefore one prays extensively at that time: "Remember us for life" and "inscribe us in the Book of Life." And the Sages, z"l, taught: "a person's sustenance is apportioned to him from Rosh HaShanah."

And this is the dimension of what we engage in from Rosh HaShanah to Sh'mini Atzeres: to complete the dimension of the union of the Matron (zivuga d'Matronissa) — which depends primarily upon prayer, as is explained in the main text.

And this is the dimension of the Day of Judgment on Rosh HaShanah — for the essential judgment upon a person is for not having been careful in the matter of prayer. For through prayer one can come to all goodness: to Torah, to good deeds, to repentance, and to escape from sin — as the Sages, z"l, established many prayers for this. And this is understood from the words of the Sages, z"l (Eruvin 65a), where Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah said: "I can exempt the entire world from judgment," etc. And the conclusion is: from what judgment? — from the judgment of prayer. For the judgment of prayer is the total accounting of a person — for had he been careful and diligent in prayer as is fitting, he would have merited to rectify everything. And this is also explained in the commentators in a similar vein, and as is explained by us elsewhere — for this is learned from the matter of the betrothed maiden, whose primary liability to death, heaven forbid, is for the fact that "she did not cry out" [Deut. 22:24], etc.

But when a person stands to pray, the darkness and the husks surround him from all sides and confuse his prayer — this is the dimension of the alien thoughts (machshavos zaros) in prayer. Therefore the essential rectification of prayer is through truth (emes) — for through truth G-d dwells with him — and when G-d is with him, He illuminates for him how to emerge from the darkness, as it is written: "G-d is my light" [Ps. 27:1] — see there. And this is the dimension of the great accusations that intensify on Rosh HaShanah — and G-d in His mercy illuminates us with the dimension of "G-d is my light," as the Sages, z"l, expounded. And therefore He commanded us to hear the voice of the Shofar — and through this the judgment and the darkness are sweetened, by arousing the quality of Yaakov, as is explained in the holy Zohar — the dimension of "a day of Teruah shall it be for you." And the quality of Yaakov is truth — as it is written: "grant truth to Yaakov" [Mic. 7:20] — as is also explained in the abovementioned Likutay Halachos.

units.he: ומחמת שיש שני בחי' אמת] יש אמת שהוא מאיר בעצמו כמו אבן טוב ויש אמת שהוא רק בבחי' חלון שאין לו אור בעצמו רק עכ"פ יכולין להמשיך על ידו האור שמאיר מבחוץ, וזה בחי' מה שנסתפקו רז"ל על התרועה אם היא גנוחי גנח שזהבחי' מה שחולה גונח ומתאנח על חליו כל זמן שלא הכביד עליו חליו כ"כ שזה בחי' אמת שהוא רק בבחי' חלון שאין לו אור מעצמו כי הוא רחוק עדיין מעצם האמת וע"כ אינו מרגיש עדיין כובד חליו רק אעפי"כ הוא מושך עצמו בכל לבו אל האמת וע"כ הוא גונח ומתאנח על כאבו הגדול ועי"ז יוכל אחר להאיר בו עכ"פ הארת האמת עד שיצא מן החשך, וזה בחי' שברים. או תרועה הוא יילולי ייליל שמרגיש גודל כאבו הכבד עליו באמת וע"כ הוא צועק באמת מעומק לבו קולו ויללות תכופות זה אחר זה שזה בחי' האמת שהוא מאיר מעצמו כמו אבן טוב, וע"כ תיקנו רז"ל לתקוע שתיהן גם לתקוע שתיהן ביחד, ומתחילה שברים ואח"כ תרועה כי כן דרך החולים ג"כ, כי כן הדרך שבתחילה צריכין למשוך עצמו עכ"פ אל האמת ולהטות אזנו ולשמוע היטב בלבו הקול הקדוש של האמת של דיבורי התפלה ולומר הדברים באמת ובתמימות כפי מדריגתו עכ"פ שכ"ז כלול בבחי' לשמוע קול שופר שהוא בחי' קול יעקב בחי' אמת, ועי"ז בעצמו זוכין אח"כ לבוא לאור האמת בעצם, וזה בחי' פשוטה לפניה ופשוטה לאחריה, כי התרועה ושברים הוא בחי' המשכת אור האמת גם כשהחושך והקליפות מסבבין אותו מכל צד שעי"ז רואה הפתחים איך לצאת מתוך החושך שזה בחי' וכי תבואו מלחמה וכו' והרעותם וכו', ותקיעה פשוטה מורה על אור הקדושה והאמת בעצמו כשאין החשך מסבב אותו וע"כ פשוטה לפניה ואח"כ תוקעין תרועה וזוכין עי"ז לצאת מן החושך ואז תוקעין פשוטה לאחריה שזוכה ליכנס אל קדושת התפלה בשלימות, גם תרועה מרמזת על התורה כשארז"ל כי לתיקוני התפלה צריכין גם לימוד התורה כמבפ"נ, גם תקיעה פשוטה מרמזת על התקרבות להצדיק שהוא בחי' משה משיח כמבואר בפ' החצוצרות וכמבואר לעיל ואליו צריכיןלקשר כל התפלות כמבפ"נ ומחמת שבר"ה עוסקין ביותר בתיקון התפילה, ע"כ אז החיוב ביותר לבוא אל הצדיק האמת הגדול במעלה שהוא כלול מכל התפלות כמבפ"נ:
units.en:
Because there are two dimensions of truth: there is truth that illuminates of itself — like a precious stone; and there is truth that is only in the dimension of a window — having no light of its own, but through which one can at least draw in the light that shines from outside.

And this is the dimension of what the Sages, z"l, were uncertain about: whether the Teruah is gonochi gonach — the dimension of an ill person who groans and sighs over his illness as long as it has not yet severely burdened him — this being the dimension of truth that is only in the dimension of a window, having no self-illuminating light, for he is still far from the essence of truth, and therefore does not yet feel the full weight of his illness — but even so, he draws himself with his whole heart toward truth, and therefore groans and moans over his great pain. And through this, someone else can at least illuminate within him the illumination of truth, until he can emerge from the darkness. And this is the dimension of Sh'vorim.

Or: the Teruah is yelulai yelil — meaning he truly feels the full weight of his illness pressing upon him, and therefore cries out in truth from the depths of his heart — rapid wailing calls one after the other — the dimension of truth that illuminates of itself like a precious stone.

And therefore the Sages, z"l, established to sound both — and also to sound both together. And first Sh'vorim, then Teruah — for this is the natural sequence with the ill as well. For this is the path: in the beginning one must draw oneself at least toward truth, and incline one's ear, and listen well in one's heart to the holy voice of truth in the words of prayer, and say the words in truth and wholesome simplicity (tmimus) according to one's level, at the very least — for all of this is included in the dimension of "to hear the voice of the Shofar" — the voice of Yaakov, the dimension of truth. And through this itself one merits afterward to come to the light of truth in its essence.

And this is the dimension of the simple Tekia before and after — for Teruah and Sh'vorim are the dimension of drawing the light of truth even when the darkness and husks surround one from all sides — through which one sees the openings for emerging from the darkness, the dimension of "and when you go to war in your land against the enemy who oppresses you — you shall sound the Teruah" [Num. 10:9]. And the simple Tekia indicates the light of holiness and truth itself when the darkness does not surround one. Therefore first one sounds a Tekia, then one sounds the Teruah and merits thereby to emerge from the darkness — and then one sounds the simple Tekia after, so that one merits to enter the holiness of prayer in its completeness.

Also: Teruah alludes to the Torah, as the Sages, z"l, taught — for the rectification of prayer also requires Torah study, as is explained in the main text. And the simple Tekia alludes to the drawing-near to the Tzadik — who is the dimension of Moshe-Messiah, as is explained in the passage of the trumpets, and as is explained above — and to him one must connect all prayers, as is explained in the main text. And because on Rosh HaShanah one is engaged most intensively in the rectification of prayer — therefore then the obligation is greatest to come to the true Tzadik of the highest stature, who is himself comprised of all the prayers, as is explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
On Rosh HaShanah we are engaged in building the holy Malchus, which stands upon twelve oxen, as is explained elsewhere. This is the dimension of prayer — which is the dimension of Malchus, and has twelve texts (nuscha'os), and ascends through twelve gates. And because the primary vitality is received through prayer, and likewise the primary sustenance flows from there — therefore one prays extensively at that time: "Remember us for life" and "inscribe us in the Book of Life." And the Sages, z"l, taught: "a person's sustenance is apportioned to him from Rosh HaShanah."

And this is the dimension of what we engage in from Rosh HaShanah to Sh'mini Atzeres: to complete the dimension of the union of the Matron (zivuga d'Matronissa) — which depends primarily upon prayer, as is explained in the main text.

And this is the dimension of the Day of Judgment on Rosh HaShanah — for the essential judgment upon a person is for not having been careful in the matter of prayer. For through prayer one can come to all goodness: to Torah, to good deeds, to repentance, and to escape from sin — as the Sages, z"l, established many prayers for this. And this is understood from the words of the Sages, z"l (Eruvin 65a), where Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah said: "I can exempt the entire world from judgment," etc. And the conclusion is: from what judgment? — from the judgment of prayer. For the judgment of prayer is the total accounting of a person — for had he been careful and diligent in prayer as is fitting, he would have merited to rectify everything. And this is also explained in the commentators in a similar vein, and as is explained by us elsewhere — for this is learned from the matter of the betrothed maiden, whose primary liability to death, heaven forbid, is for the fact that "she did not cry out" [Deut. 22:24], etc.

שלימות התפלה שהיא בחי' ניסים בחי'. אמונה וא"י עי"ז יוצאין מהגליות ע"כ מסיימין הברכה בתפלה על קיבוץ גליות לארצינו:
units.en:
The Dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros

Malchuyos — the dimension of building prayer, which is the dimension of faith (emuna), the dimension of Malchus. Zichronos — the dimension of the completeness of the rectifications of prayer through the light of truth — for through truth [the person] calls G-d to mind within himself in truth, and [G-d] knows all his thoughts and schemes — and therefore his thought is compelled to direct his heart toward Him in truth, according to his level at the very least. Through this, his remembrance ascends before Him for good, and he draws near to Him, and He illuminates for him how to emerge from the darkness and draw near to Him in truth.

And this is the dimension of what Yona said from within the belly of the fish: "You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas" [Jonah 2:4], and "all Your breakers and waves passed over me," etc. (For all of this, and more, a person must say to himself at the time when the darkness and husks and alien thoughts — called "the depths of the sea" — disturb and confuse his thought greatly, and he cannot direct his heart in his prayer.) And he concluded: "when my soul fainted within me, I remembered G-d — and my prayer came before You, into Your holy Temple" [Jonah 2:8], etc.

And this is also the entire matter of the blessing Ata Zocher ["You Remember"] — where it is explained clearly how G-d remembers everything, knows everything, supervises and sets His eyes and heart upon all creatures, and there is no forgetfulness before the Throne of His Glory. And it mentions there the verses of Noach — how G-d remembered him when he sheltered in the Ark. (For there is hinted the matter of how when the floodwaters — which are the dimension of alien thoughts — intensify, one must enter the Ark — meaning: draw all one's strength and focus into the teivos [words/letters] of the words of prayer, the dimension of "come, you and all your household, into the Ark" [Gen. 7:1] as is brought — and to say the word in truth — which is the dimension of "make a window for the Ark," as is explained in the main text.) "And G-d caused a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subsided" [Gen. 8:1].

And there are also mentioned other verses of Zichronos — showing how when Israel draw themselves toward truth and cry out to Him, even though they are not yet at the level of the finest self-luminous truth — even so, G-d has mercy upon them and remembers for them the true truth that the Patriarchs merited, and in their merit He illuminates for them and answers them in their time of distress. And one concludes with prayer to recall for us the Akaidah of Yitzchok — through which the judgment and darkness are sweetened at their supernal root. Even though Esov came from Yitzchok and wishes to intensify with his many accusations, etc., as is explained in the holy Zohar — and this itself is also the dimension of the alien thoughts and confusions, for he descends and entices, etc. — even so, he is not counted as part of the seed of Yitzchok at all — for "in Yitzchok shall your seed be called" — and not all [who come from] Yitzchok. And all of this G-d will remember for us now as well, and will illuminate for us His light, and will remove from us all types of darkness and disturbing thoughts, and will sweeten from upon us all the judgments, etc.

Shofaros — there it explains the matter of the Giving of the Torah with the Shofar-sound, and the matter of the Shofar of the Messiah and the ingathering of the exiles — for the rectification of prayer requires also Torah study, as above. And one must also connect prayer to the Tzadik of the generation who is the dimension of the Messiah. And through the completeness of prayer — which is the dimension of miracles, faith, and the Land of Israel — through this one exits the exiles. Therefore one concludes the blessing with prayer for the ingathering of exiles to our Land.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
But when a person stands to pray, the darkness and the husks surround him from all sides and confuse his prayer — this is the dimension of the alien thoughts (machshavos zaros) in prayer. Therefore the essential rectification of prayer is through truth (emes) — for through truth G-d dwells with him — and when G-d is with him, He illuminates for him how to emerge from the darkness, as it is written: "G-d is my light" [Ps. 27:1] — see there. And this is the dimension of the great accusations that intensify on Rosh HaShanah — and G-d in His mercy illuminates us with the dimension of "G-d is my light," as the Sages, z"l, expounded. And therefore He commanded us to hear the voice of the Shofar — and through this the judgment and the darkness are sweetened, by arousing the quality of Yaakov, as is explained in the holy Zohar — the dimension of "a day of Teruah shall it be for you." And the quality of Yaakov is truth — as it is written: "grant truth to Yaakov" [Mic. 7:20] — as is also explained in the abovementioned Likutay Halachos.

Because There Are Two Dimensions of Truth

units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בזה בכל עשרת ימי תשובה כי זה עיקר התשובה להרבות בתפלה ותחנונים לפני השי"ת ולקיים מקרא שכתוב קומי רוני בלילה וכו' שפכי כמים לבך וכו' שזה בחי' מה שעומדין אז באשמורת ומרבין בתחנונים לפני השי"ת, עד אשר זוכין לקדושת יו"כ ואז התפלה בשלימות ומתפללין חמשה תפלות והמלכות ניזונית מחמשה קולות הפנימיים שהם בחי' עצם האמת בחי' ודובר אמת בלבבו, ואז העננים שהם המחשבות זרות הבאין מעונות ומעכבין כוונת התפלה שבשביל זה איטן להזכיר בר"ה שום חטא ועון (אם לא בשעת תקיעת שופר) בכדי שלא יתגברו העננים והקטרוגים ביותר, אבל ביו"כ לית רשות לשטן לאשטוני וזוכין לסליחת ענות וביטול העננים בבחי' מחיתי כעב פשעיך וכענן חטאתיך וכו', ואז היה גמר קבלת התורה של הלוחות שניות שעי"ז נשלמו תיקוני התפלה ואז היה העבודה בכהן גדול שהוא בחי' הצדיק הדור שאליו צריכין לקשר כל התפלות, והכהן גדול נכנס אז לפני ולפנים ששם מקור קדושת ארץ ישראל ששם מקור התפלה והנסים וע"כ נעשה אז כמה נסים וכמובא לעיל על מאמר משפטים סי' ז':
units.en:
Afterwards one engages in this throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance — for this is the essential repentance: to greatly multiply prayers and supplications before G-d, and to fulfill the scriptural verse: "Arise, cry out in the night… pour out your heart like water" [Lam. 2:19] — which is the dimension of rising at the dawn watch and multiplying supplications before G-d — until one merits the holiness of Yom Kippur. Then prayer is complete, and one prays Five Prayers, and Malchus is nourished from the five innermost voices — the dimension of the very essence of truth — the dimension of "and one who speaks truth in his heart" [Ps. 15:2].

And then the clouds — which are the alien thoughts that come from sins and impede the intention of prayer — [are annulled]. Because of this [on Rosh HaShanah itself] no sin or transgression is mentioned (except during the Shofar-soundings), so as not to intensify the clouds and accusations. But on Yom Kippur "the Accuser has no authority to prosecute" [Yoma 20a], and one merits forgiveness of sins and the nullification of the clouds — the dimension of "I have blotted out as a thick cloud your transgressions, and as a cloud your sins" [Is. 44:22]. Then came the completion of the reception of the Second Tablets — through which the rectifications of prayer were completed. And the service was performed by the High Priest — who is the dimension of the Tzadik of the generation to whom all prayers must be connected. And the High Priest entered at that time into the innermost sanctuary (lifnai v'lifnim) — where is the source of the holiness of the Land of Israel, the source of prayer and miracles. And therefore many miracles were performed then, as brought above in the discourse of Mishpatim, Siman 7.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Because there are two dimensions of truth: there is truth that illuminates of itself — like a precious stone; and there is truth that is only in the dimension of a window — having no light of its own, but through which one can at least draw in the light that shines from outside.

And this is the dimension of what the Sages, z"l, were uncertain about: whether the Teruah is gonochi gonach — the dimension of an ill person who groans and sighs over his illness as long as it has not yet severely burdened him — this being the dimension of truth that is only in the dimension of a window, having no self-illuminating light, for he is still far from the essence of truth, and therefore does not yet feel the full weight of his illness — but even so, he draws himself with his whole heart toward truth, and therefore groans and moans over his great pain. And through this, someone else can at least illuminate within him the illumination of truth, until he can emerge from the darkness. And this is the dimension of Sh'vorim.

"My Rosh HaShanah is a great novelty (chidush) …
not only are you all certainly bound to my Rosh HaShanah,
but even all the world — the entire world — depends upon my Rosh HaShanah."

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ואחר יו"כ is a partial discourse heading, not a complete teaching or an editorial back-reference.

units.he: ואחר יו"כ מתחילין לכנוס אורות החסדים שעי"ז עיקר תיקון המלכות כ"ש והוכן בחסד כסא ולענינינו כי עיקר תיקון התפלה שהוא בחי' אמונה הוא ע"י החסדים בבחי' ברוך ה' אשר לא הסיר תפלתי וחסדו מאתי וזה בחי' זכר חסדו ואמונתו לבית ישראל וכן להגיד בבקר חסדך ואמונת בלילות, וכן לאור האמת זוכין רק ע"י חסדו ית' בחי' תתן אמת ליעקב חסד לאברהם וכמובא גם לעיל, עד אשר ביום ראשון של סוכות אז נכנס גם החסד העליון של אורות המקיפים ואז נשלם האמונה שהיא ג"כ בחי' מקיפין בחי' ואמונתך סביבותיך בשלימות, ונכסין לסוכה שהיא ג"כ בחי' מקיפין בחי' סביבותי סוכות וכמובא במאמר עתיקא סי' כ"א, ואז מקימין את סוכת דוד שהיא בחי' התפלה בשלימות ע"י שממשיכין אור האמת משרשו שהיא בחי' סוכה העליונה בחי' בינה אימא עילאה ואז נתייחד קוב"ה ושכיתיה שזה אותיות סוכה כ"ו ה"ס כי עיקר יחודם ע"י שלימות התפלה כמבפ"נ, גם כשמאיר אור האמת שהוא בחי' אור השי"ת שהוא עצם האמת אל התפלה שהיא בחי' אמונה מלכות זה בעצמו ג"כ יחוד קוב"ה ושכינתיה בחי' סוכה כנ"ל, וע"כ צריכין שיהיה הכוכבים נראין מתוך הסוכה גם סוכ"ה גמטריא מלא"ך כמובא גם בליקוטי תנינא סי' ה' כי ע"י התפלה השלימה משפיעין כח וחיות גם לעולם הכוכבים ועולם המלאכים:
units.en:
After Yom Kippur the lights of the loving-kindnesses begin to enter — for through them is the essential rectification of Malchus, as it is written: "and through kindness a throne is established." And as it applies to us: the essential rectification of prayer — which is the dimension of faith — is through the loving-kindnesses, the dimension of "blessed is G-d Who has not removed my prayer and His loving-kindness from me" [Ps. 66:20]. And this is the dimension of "He remembered His loving-kindness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel" [Ps. 98:3]. And likewise: "to declare Your loving-kindness in the morning and Your faithfulness in the nights" [Ps. 92:3]. And also: to the light of truth one merits only through G-d's loving-kindness — the dimension of "grant truth to Yaakov, loving-kindness to Avraham," as is also brought above.

Until on the first day of Sukkos the supernal loving-kindness of the encompassing lights enters too — and then faith — which is also in the dimension of the encompassing lights — is completed in its fullness: the dimension of "Your faithfulness surrounds You" [Ps. 89:9]. And one enters the Sukka — which is also in the dimension of encompassing lights — the dimension of "Sukkos surrounds me" [Ps. 27:5], as is brought in the discourse Atika, Siman 21. And then the Sukka of David is raised up — which is the dimension of complete prayer — by drawing the light of truth from its root: the dimension of the Supernal Sukka, the dimension of Supernal Bina, the Supernal Mother. And then the Blessed Holy One and the Divine Presence are united — for the letters of סוכה spell out Kaf-Vav = 26 and Hay-Samech = 65 [the numerical values of the Names Havaya and Adnay] — for their essential unity is through the completeness of prayer, as is explained in the main text. Also: when the light of truth — which is G-d's light, the very essence of truth — shines upon prayer, which is the dimension of faith and Malchus — this itself is also the unity of the Blessed Holy One and the Divine Presence — the dimension of Sukka, as above. And therefore it is required that stars be visible through the s'chach. Also: סוכה has the same numerical value as מלאך (malach — angel), as is brought also in Likutay Mohara"n Tinyona, Siman 5 — for through complete prayer one conveys strength and vitality even to the world of the stars and the world of the angels.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Or: the Teruah is yelulai yelil — meaning he truly feels the full weight of his illness pressing upon him, and therefore cries out in truth from the depths of his heart — rapid wailing calls one after the other — the dimension of truth that illuminates of itself like a precious stone.

And therefore the Sages, z"l, established to sound both — and also to sound both together. And first Sh'vorim, then Teruah — for this is the natural sequence with the ill as well. For this is the path: in the beginning one must draw oneself at least toward truth, and incline one's ear, and listen well in one's heart to the holy voice of truth in the words of prayer, and say the words in truth and wholesome simplicity (tmimus) according to one's level, at the very least — for all of this is included in the dimension of "to hear the voice of the Shofar" — the voice of Yaakov, the dimension of truth. And through this itself one merits afterward to come to the light of truth in its essence.

qualifications.text: The supplied בינה אימא עילאה identifies Bina as the Supernal Mother. Both elements are retained in the English.

The supplied סוכה כ"ו ה"ס gives כו (Kaf-Vav), valued at 26, and הס (Hay-Samech), valued at 65. The historical English's “Kuf-Vav” is corrected only to “Kaf-Vav”; קו (Kuf-Vav) would total 106. The Hebrew operands remain unchanged.

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה וזה בחי' contains the actual partial opening words of a discourse heading; it does not provide the following teaching.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וזה בחי' לקיחת הד' מניים ודרז"ל פרי עץ הדר זה אברהם זה בחי' תפלה כי הוא הראשון שהתקין תפלה שחרית ונאמר אצלו ויתפלל אברהם אל האלהים וכו' כפות תמרים זה יצחק בחי' תורה כמו שארז"ל תורה מפי הגבורה ניתנה וכמובא, ענף עץ עבות זה יעקב וכו' בחי' אמת הנ"ל כ"ש תתן אמת ליעקב, וערבי נחל זה יוסף וכו' בחי' הצדיק כי כל בחי' אלו הם תיקוני תפלה כנ"ל, פרי עץ הדר זו שרה בחי' התפלה בחי' מלכות, כפות תמרים זו רבקה שיצאו ממנה יעקב ועשו שזה בחי' התגברות המחשבות זרות בשעת התפלה והם מסטרא דעשו בחי' כי ציד בפיו המובפ"נ והתיקון לזה הוא ע"י יעקב שהוא בחי' אמת כנ"ל, ענף עץ עבות זו לאה וכו' שיצא ממנה משיח שכלול מכל התפלות וע"כ ההדס יש לו ריח כי משיח הוא מורח ודאין כמבפ"נ, וערבי נחל זו רחל וכו' שהיא בחי' התורה שהיא כרחל לפי גוזזיה שהכל גוזזין ממנה הלכות וכו' וכמבואר במאמר תהלה לדוד סי' י"ב, ועוד דרשו הד' מניים כנגד הסנהדרין וכו' שעיקר עסקם בתורה, ועוד דרשו שהם כנגד בחי' כל עצמותי תאמרנה שזה בחי' שלימות התפלה עם כל הכחות המבואר בפנים, וזה אתרוג דומה ללב זה בחי' שצריך לכוין לבו בתפלתו כ"ש הכין לבם תקשיב אזניך וכמו שדרשו רז"ל וזה בחי' שפכי כמים לבך המבואר בפנים, לולב דומה לשדרה שבה עיקר קשר הבנין שלכל קומת הגוף היינו כי צריך להתפלל עם כל כחות הגוף ובתנועות כל האברים בבחי' כל עצמותי תאמרנה וכו' עד שיתפקקו כל החוליות שבשדרה כמו שדרז"ל על ר' עקיבא כשהיה מתפלל ביחיד היה מתפלל בכריעת הגוף הרבה וכו', הדס דומה לעינים כי צריך לומר תיבות התפלה באמת ועי"ז משגיח עליו השי"ת בעניא פקיחא בבחי' עיני בנאמני ארץ וכו' וכמבוארגם במאמר אמר ר' עקיבא סי' נ"א ואז הוא קרוב אליו ומאיר עיניו איך לצאת מן החשך המסבב אותו, ערבה דומה לשפתים זה בחי' דיבורי התפלה בעצמה בחי' אדני שפתי תפתח וע"כ מנענעין בהם בהודו לה' ובאנא ה' הושיעה נא כי זה כלל התפלה בחי' מודה על העבר וצועק לעתיד לבוא כמו שארז"ל, וזה בחי' השמחה של סוכות כי ע"י שלימות התפלה זוכין לשמחה בחי' ושמחתים בבית תפלתי וכמבואר גם במאמר חותם בתוך חותם סי' כ"ב, וע"כ כל הד' מינים הנ"ל גדילים על כל מים כי הם בבחי' שלימות התפלה שהיא בחי' שפכי כמים לבך הנ"ל, וע"כ הד' מינים אלו מסוגלים לירידת גשמים כמו שארז"ל כי שלימות התפלה שהיא בחי' אמונה היא בחי' נסים בחי' גשמים כמבפ"נ:
units.en:
And this is the dimension of the taking of the four species. The Sages, z"l, expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Avraham — the dimension of prayer, for he was the first to establish the Morning Prayer (Shacharis), and it is said of him: "and Avraham prayed to G-d" [Gen. 20:17], etc. Kapos Smorim — this is Yitzchok — the dimension of Torah, as the Sages, z"l, taught: "Torah was given from the power of Gevura," as is brought. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Yaakov — etc. — the dimension of truth above, as it is written: "grant truth to Yaakov." Arvay Nachal — this is Yosef — etc. — the dimension of the Tzadik — for all these dimensions are rectifications of prayer, as above.

Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Sarah — the dimension of prayer, the dimension of Malchus. Kapos Smorim — this is Rivka — from whom came Yaakov and Esov — the dimension of the intensification of alien thoughts during prayer, which come from the side of Esov — the dimension of "for he had [Esov's] game in his mouth" [Gen. 25:28], as is explained in the main text. And the rectification is through Yaakov, who is the dimension of truth, as above. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Leah — etc. — from whom the Messiah descended, who is comprised of all the prayers. And therefore the hadas (myrtle) has fragrance — for the Messiah "smells and judges", as is explained in the main text. Arvay Nachal — this is Rachel — etc. — who is the dimension of Torah — "like a ewe before her shearers": all shear laws (halachos) from her, etc. — as is explained in the discourse Tehila l'Dovid, Siman 12.

And more was expounded: the four species correspond to the Sanhedrin — whose essential work is Torah. And more was expounded: they correspond to the dimension of "all my bones shall say" — the dimension of the completeness of prayer with all the [bodily] forces, as is explained in the main text.

And this is: the esrog resembles the heart — the dimension of having to direct one's heart in prayer, as it is written: "prepare their heart — incline Your ear" [Ps. 10:17], as the Sages, z"l, expounded — and this is the dimension of "pour out your heart like water," as is explained in the main text. The lulav resembles the spine — for it is the essential connecting structure of the entire frame of the body — meaning: one must pray with all the forces of the body and the movements of all the limbs, the dimension of "all my bones shall say," etc. — to the extent that all the vertebrae of the spine articulate, as the Sages, z"l, taught of Rabbi Akiva: when he prayed privately he would bow deeply many times, etc. The hadas resembles the eyes — for one must say the words of prayer in truth — and through this G-d supervises one with an open eye (eina p'kicha), the dimension of "my eyes are upon the faithful of the land" [Ps. 101:6], etc. — as is also explained in the discourse Amar Rabbi Akiva, Siman 51 — and then He is near to one and illuminates one's eyes on how to emerge from the darkness surrounding one. The arova resembles the lips — the dimension of the words of prayer themselves, the dimension of "G-d, open my lips" [Ps. 51:17]. And therefore one waves them during "Give thanks to G-d" and during "Please, G-d, save now" — for this is the entirety of prayer: thanking for the past and crying out for the future, as the Sages, z"l, said.

And this is the dimension of the joy of Sukkos — for through the completeness of prayer one merits joy, the dimension of "and I will gladden them in My house of prayer" [Is. 56:7], as is also explained in the discourse Chosom B'Soch Chosom, Siman 22. And therefore all four species grow over all types of water (al kol mayim) — for they are in the dimension of complete prayer, the dimension of "pour out your heart like water," as above. And therefore these four species are propitious (s'gula) for the descent of rains, as the Sages, z"l, taught — for complete prayer, which is the dimension of faith, is the dimension of miracles — the dimension of rain, as is explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is the dimension of the simple Tekia before and after — for Teruah and Sh'vorim are the dimension of drawing the light of truth even when the darkness and husks surround one from all sides — through which one sees the openings for emerging from the darkness, the dimension of "and when you go to war in your land against the enemy who oppresses you — you shall sound the Teruah" [Num. 10:9]. And the simple Tekia indicates the light of holiness and truth itself when the darkness does not surround one. Therefore first one sounds a Tekia, then one sounds the Teruah and merits thereby to emerge from the darkness — and then one sounds the simple Tekia after, so that one merits to enter the holiness of prayer in its completeness.

Also: Teruah alludes to the Torah, as the Sages, z"l, taught — for the rectification of prayer also requires Torah study, as is explained in the main text. And the simple Tekia alludes to the drawing-near to the Tzadik — who is the dimension of Moshe-Messiah, as is explained in the passage of the trumpets, and as is explained above — and to him one must connect all prayers, as is explained in the main text. And because on Rosh HaShanah one is engaged most intensively in the rectification of prayer — therefore then the obligation is greatest to come to the true Tzadik of the highest stature, who is himself comprised of all the prayers, as is explained in the main text.

The Dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ואח,כ זוכין contains the actual partial opening words of a discourse. The comma in ואח,כ is retained in the Hebrew; the English renders the contextual temporal expression without supplying an additional opening or completing the discourse.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח,כ זוכין לקדושת שמיני עצרת ואז זיווגא דמטרוניתא בשלימות והנוקבא עוצרת הטיפה שלא תפיל כי אז מתחבר הקב"ה עם ישראל בהתקרבות גדול כמבואר בזוה"ק ומאיר להם אז אורו ית' שהוא בחי' אור האמת (בחי' שלח אורך ואמתך שנאמר על אורו של משיח שמתנוצך בשמיני עצרת שהיא כנגד בחי' מלכות בחי' זה יעצור בעממי כמובא), כי הקב"ה הוא עצם האמתונזרע ונקלט בלבם של ישראל אז התנוצצות אור האמת עד שמתקשרין בו ית' בקשר של קיימא באופן שלא תפיל ולא תתבטל רשימו של ההארה הזאת לעולם בבחי' ואמת ה' לעולם, וע"כ כל ישראל עולין אז לתורה שנקראת אמת בחי' אמת קנה וכו' וכמו שארז"ל להורות שבכל אחד מישראל יש נקודת אמת כי הם בבחי' כולו זרע אמת ועי"ז יכולין הכל להתקרב אליו ית', וע"כ מסיימין אז התורה בשבירת הלוחות ששיבר משה לעיני כל ישראל כי מזה רואין גודל מעלת התפלה כי אעפ"י שלשלימות תיקוני התפלה צריכין גם לימוד התורה כי מסיר אזנו משמוע תורה גם תפלתו תועבה כנ"ל אעפי"כ זמן תורה לחוד וזמן תפלה לחוד, וחסידים הראשונים שהיו שוהין בתפלתן גם תורתם מתברכת ומתקיימת בידם כמו שארז"ל וע"כ כשראה משה שעשו ישראל את העגל ופגמו באמונה שהיא בחי' תפלה אז תיכף שיבר את הלוחות לעיניהם להורות להם שכבר נתרחקו מהתורה ג"כ כי כל קיום התורה תלויה באמונה שהיא בחי' תפלה, ואח"כ הרבה בתפלה כ"כ עד שזכה שנמחל עוונם ואז קבלו הלוחות שניות, ואח"כ תיכף מתחילין התורה בראשי"ת בר"א אלהי"ם וכו' סופי תיבות אמ"ת בחי' ראש דברך אמת כשדרז"ל, את השמים ואת הארץ שהם בחי' תורה ותפלה כידוע, והארץ היתה תהו ובהו כי בשעת התפלה דייקא מתגברים המחשבות זרות מאד שהם בחי' תהו ובהו וחשך וכו' ורוח אלהים מרחפת על פני המים זה רוחו של מלך המשיח שהוא בחי' אור האמת כנ"ל וזה על פני המים בחי' שפכי כמים לבך כמו שדרז"ל כי משיח כלול מכל התפלות והתפלות הם בחי' חרב אצל משיח כשישראל זוכין לבחי' שפכי כמים לבן כמבפ"נ, וזה ויאמר אלהים יהי אור וכו' ויבדל א' בין האור זה יעקב ובין החשך זה עשו וכו' כשדרז"ל כי ע"י אור האמת שהוא מבחי' יעקב נדחה ונתבטל החשך שמבחי' עשו כנ"ל, יום אחד בחי' והיה יום אחד הוא יודע לה' אשר הוא לא יום ולא לילה כמו שארז"ל כי ע"י אור האמת זוכין לצאת מן החשך וליכנס אל הקדושה בשלימות וליכלל באחדותו ית' בפרט בשעת התפלה ושם אין שום שייכות לשום חשך כלל כי מי הוא זה ערב את לבו לגשת אליו וגם חשך לא יחשיך ממך ולילה כיום יאיר, ושם הוא בחי' אשר לא יום ולא לילה, וכנגד יום אחד הנ"ל הוא שמיני עצרת שהוא רק יום אחד כמובא, וע"כ אז השמחה גדולה מאד בבחי' השמחה שלעתיד ויעקב הוא אז רישא לחדוותא כי הכל ע"י אור האמת שהוא מדתו של יעקב כנ"ל:
units.en:
Afterwards one merits the holiness of Sh'mini Atzeres — and then the union of the Matron in completeness — and [the feminine principle] retains the drop so that it does not miscarry — for then the Blessed Holy One unites with Israel with great closeness, as is explained in the holy Zohar, and His light illuminates for them — which is the dimension of the light of truth (the dimension of "send out Your light and Your truth" [Ps. 43:3] — said of the light of the Messiah that glimmers at Sh'mini Atzeres, which corresponds to the dimension of Malchus — the dimension of "this one will hold back within my people," as is brought). For the Blessed Holy One is the very essence of truth — and the flash of the light of truth is seeded and absorbed into the hearts of Israel at that time, connecting them to Him in an enduring bond — such that it will not miscarry and the trace of this illumination will never be nullified forever — the dimension of "and G-d's truth is forever" [Ps. 117:2]. And therefore all Israel ascend to the Torah at that time — for Torah is called truth, the dimension of "acquire truth" [Prov. 23:23], etc. — as the Sages, z"l, taught: to show that within every one of Israel there is a point of truth, for they are in the dimension of "entirely a seed of truth" [Jer. 2:21] — and through this all can draw near to Him.

And therefore one concludes the Torah with the breaking of the Tablets, which Moshe broke before the eyes of all Israel — for from this one sees the great importance of prayer: even though the completeness of the rectifications of prayer also requires Torah study — for "one who turns his ear from hearing Torah — even his prayer is an abomination" [Prov. 28:9], as above — even so, the time of Torah is separate, and the time of prayer is separate. And the early pious ones (Chassidim Rishonim) who would linger in their prayer — their Torah study too was blessed and endured in their hands, as the Sages, z"l, said. And therefore when Moshe saw that Israel made the Golden Calf and blemished the faith (emuna) — which is the dimension of prayer — he immediately shattered the Tablets before their eyes, to show them that they had thereby distanced themselves from Torah as well — for the entire endurance of Torah depends upon faith, which is the dimension of prayer. And afterward he prayed so greatly that he merited forgiveness of their sin — and then they received the Second Tablets. And immediately one begins the Torah with Bereishis bara Elokim — the source associates the final letters of the first three words with Emes (Truth) — the dimension of "the beginning of Your word is truth" [Ps. 119:160], as the Sages, z"l, expounded. "The heavens and the earth" — the dimension of Torah and prayer, as is known. "And the earth was void and formless" — for specifically during prayer the alien thoughts intensify greatly — these being the dimension of void, formless, and darkness, etc. "And the spirit of G-d hovered over the face of the waters" — this is the spirit of King Messiah, who is the dimension of the light of truth, as above — and "over the face of the waters" is the dimension of "pour out your heart like water," as the Sages, z"l, expounded — for the Messiah is comprised of all prayers, and the prayers are the dimension of the sword of the Messiah when Israel merit the dimension of pouring out the heart like water, as is explained in the main text. And this is "G-d said: Let there be light", etc., and "G-d separated between the light" — this is Yaakov — "and between the darkness" — this is Esov — etc., as the Sages, z"l, expounded — for through the light of truth, which is from the dimension of Yaakov, the darkness from the dimension of Esov is repelled and nullified, as above. "One day" — the dimension of "and it shall be one day — it is known to G-d — neither day nor night" [Zech. 14:7], as the Sages, z"l, expounded — for through the light of truth one merits to emerge from the darkness and enter into holiness in its completeness and be absorbed in His unity — especially during prayer, where there is no connection to any darkness whatsoever — for "who is he that would pledge his heart to draw near to Him?" [Jer. 30:21], and "darkness does not darken before You, and night illuminates like day" [Ps. 139:12]. And there it is the dimension of "neither day nor night." And corresponding to this "one day" is Sh'mini Atzeres — which is only one day, as is brought. And therefore the joy at that time is exceedingly great in the dimension of the future joy — and Yaakov is the head of joy (reisha l'chedvasa) — for all is through the light of truth, which is his quality, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Malchuyos — the dimension of building prayer, which is the dimension of faith (emuna), the dimension of Malchus. Zichronos — the dimension of the completeness of the rectifications of prayer through the light of truth — for through truth [the person] calls G-d to mind within himself in truth, and [G-d] knows all his thoughts and schemes — and therefore his thought is compelled to direct his heart toward Him in truth, according to his level at the very least. Through this, his remembrance ascends before Him for good, and he draws near to Him, and He illuminates for him how to emerge from the darkness and draw near to Him in truth.

And this is the dimension of what Yona said from within the belly of the fish: "You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas" [Jonah 2:4], and "all Your breakers and waves passed over me," etc. (For all of this, and more, a person must say to himself at the time when the darkness and husks and alien thoughts — called "the depths of the sea" — disturb and confuse his thought greatly, and he cannot direct his heart in his prayer.) And he concluded: "when my soul fainted within me, I remembered G-d — and my prayer came before You, into Your holy Temple" [Jonah 2:8], etc.

qualifications.text: The supplied opening says עוצרת הטיפה שלא תפיל and later repeats באופן שלא תפיל ולא תתבטל רשימו של ההארה הזאת לעולם. Both the prevention of miscarriage and the enduring preservation of the illumination are retained at their respective positions.

The supplied בראשי"ת בר"א אלהי"ם וכו' סופי תיבות אמ"ת associates the final letters of the first three words with אמת. and to search within them —

units.he: (שייך לעיל) וזהו שארז"ל בזכות ולקחתם וכו' אני נגלה לכם ראשון זה בחי' התגלות אורו ית' שמאיר להאדם בתפלתו בבחי' ה' אורי כנ"ל, ופורע לכם מן הראשון זה עשו וכו' היינו שנתבטל החשך הבא מסטרא דעשו כנ"ל ובונה לכם ראשון זה בימה,ק ששם עיקר מקום התורה והתפלה וכמובא גם לעיל וזה ומביא לכם ראשון זה מלך המשיח שהוא כלול מכל התפלות ומעלה אותם למקום ולשרשם כנ"ל וכמבואר בפנים, ע"פ הנ"ל תבין דבר נפלא הובא בספר בני יששכר חדש תשרי מאמר יו"ד בשם הקדמונים ז"ל שעל ד' מניים הנ" אינו שולט עליהם שום שר שיאמר לו גדל רק כולם גדילים רק בהשגחתו ית' היינו כנ"ל כי הם מורים על שלימות התפלה שכל הכוכבים והשרים העליונים מקבלים חיות ממנה כמבפ"נ במאמר ה ועיין גם בליקו"ת במאמר תקעו ממשלה סי' א', וע"כ הם מרצין על הגשמים שכל גידולי הארץ גדילים על ידם כנ"ל:
units.en: [Appended — belonging to the above:] And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught: in merit of "take for yourselves on the first day," etc. — "I will reveal Myself to you as the First" — the dimension of the revelation of His light that illuminates for a person during his prayer — the dimension of "G-d is my light," as above. "And He pays back to you from the First — this is Esov" — meaning the darkness coming from the side of Esov is nullified, as above. "And He builds for you the First — this is the Temple" — which is the primary place of Torah and prayer, as is also brought above. "And He brings for you the First — this is King Messiah" — who is comprised of all the prayers and elevates them to their place and root, as above and as is explained in the main text. According to the above, one will understand a wondrous matter brought in Bnei Yissaschar, the month of Tishray, Discourse 10, in the name of the early authorities, z"l: that over the four species no heavenly minister can say to them "grow!" — rather, they all grow solely under His direct supervision — as above, for they indicate the completeness of prayer, through which all the stars and supernal ministers receive vitality, as is explained in the main text in discourse 5. See also in Likutay Moharan Tinyona in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola, Siman 1. And therefore they atone for the rains — for all the growths of the earth grow through them, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is also the entire matter of the blessing Ata Zocher ["You Remember"] — where it is explained clearly how G-d remembers everything, knows everything, supervises and sets His eyes and heart upon all creatures, and there is no forgetfulness before the Throne of His Glory. And it mentions there the verses of Noach — how G-d remembered him when he sheltered in the Ark. (For there is hinted the matter of how when the floodwaters — which are the dimension of alien thoughts — intensify, one must enter the Ark — meaning: draw all one's strength and focus into the teivos [words/letters] of the words of prayer, the dimension of "come, you and all your household, into the Ark" [Gen. 7:1] as is brought — and to say the word in truth — which is the dimension of "make a window for the Ark," as is explained in the main text.) "And G-d caused a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subsided" [Gen. 8:1].

And there are also mentioned other verses of Zichronos — showing how when Israel draw themselves toward truth and cry out to Him, even though they are not yet at the level of the finest self-luminous truth — even so, G-d has mercy upon them and remembers for them the true truth that the Patriarchs merited, and in their merit He illuminates for them and answers them in their time of distress. And one concludes with prayer to recall for us the Akaidah of Yitzchok — through which the judgment and darkness are sweetened at their supernal root. Even though Esov came from Yitzchok and wishes to intensify with his many accusations, etc., as is explained in the holy Zohar — and this itself is also the dimension of the alien thoughts and confusions, for he descends and entices, etc. — even so, he is not counted as part of the seed of Yitzchok at all — for "in Yitzchok shall your seed be called" — and not all [who come from] Yitzchok. And all of this G-d will remember for us now as well, and will illuminate for us His light, and will remove from us all types of darkness and disturbing thoughts, and will sweeten from upon us all the judgments, etc.

Shofaros — there it explains the matter of the Giving of the Torah with the Shofar-sound, and the matter of the Shofar of the Messiah and the ingathering of the exiles — for the rectification of prayer requires also Torah study, as above. And one must also connect prayer to the Tzadik of the generation who is the dimension of the Messiah. And through the completeness of prayer — which is the dimension of miracles, faith, and the Land of Israel — through this one exits the exiles. Therefore one concludes the blessing with prayer for the ingathering of exiles to our Land.

Afterwards — the Ten Days of Repentance

Afterwards one engages in this throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance — for this is the essential repentance: to greatly multiply prayers and supplications before G-d, and to fulfill the scriptural verse: "Arise, cry out in the night… pour out your heart like water" [Lam. 2:19] — which is the dimension of rising at the dawn watch and multiplying supplications before G-d — until one merits the holiness of Yom Kippur. Then prayer is complete, and one prays Five Prayers, and Malchus is nourished from the five innermost voices — the dimension of the very essence of truth — the dimension of "and one who speaks truth in his heart" [Ps. 15:2].

And then the clouds — which are the alien thoughts that come from sins and impede the intention of prayer — [are annulled]. Because of this [on Rosh HaShanah itself] no sin or transgression is mentioned (except during the Shofar-soundings), so as not to intensify the clouds and accusations. But on Yom Kippur "the Accuser has no authority to prosecute" [Yoma 20a], and one merits forgiveness of sins and the nullification of the clouds — the dimension of "I have blotted out as a thick cloud your transgressions, and as a cloud your sins" [Is. 44:22]. Then came the completion of the reception of the Second Tablets — through which the rectifications of prayer were completed. And the service was performed by the High Priest — who is the dimension of the Tzadik of the generation to whom all prayers must be connected. And the High Priest entered at that time into the innermost sanctuary (lifnai v'lifnim) — where is the source of the holiness of the Land of Israel, the source of prayer and miracles. And therefore many miracles were performed then, as brought above in the discourse of Mishpatim, Siman 7.

After Yom Kippur — The Loving-Kindnesses Enter

After Yom Kippur the lights of the loving-kindnesses begin to enter — for through them is the essential rectification of Malchus, as it is written: "and through kindness a throne is established." And as it applies to us: the essential rectification of prayer — which is the dimension of faith — is through the loving-kindnesses, the dimension of "blessed is G-d Who has not removed my prayer and His loving-kindness from me" [Ps. 66:20]. And this is the dimension of "He remembered His loving-kindness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel" [Ps. 98:3]. And likewise: "to declare Your loving-kindness in the morning and Your faithfulness in the nights" [Ps. 92:3]. And also: to the light of truth one merits only through G-d's loving-kindness — the dimension of "grant truth to Yaakov, loving-kindness to Avraham," as is also brought above.

Until on the first day of Sukkos the supernal loving-kindness of the encompassing lights enters too — and then faith — which is also in the dimension of the encompassing lights — is completed in its fullness: the dimension of "Your faithfulness surrounds You" [Ps. 89:9]. And one enters the Sukka — which is also in the dimension of encompassing lights — the dimension of "Sukkos surrounds me" [Ps. 27:5], as is brought in the discourse Atika, Siman 21. And then the Sukka of David is raised up — which is the dimension of complete prayer — by drawing the light of truth from its root: the dimension of the Supernal Sukka, the dimension of Supernal Bina. And then the Blessed Holy One and the Divine Presence are united — for the letters of סוכה spell out Kuf-Vav = 26 and Hay-Samech = 65 [the numerical values of the Names Havaya and Adnay] — for their essential unity is through the completeness of prayer, as is explained in the main text. Also: when the light of truth — which is G-d's light, the very essence of truth — shines upon prayer, which is the dimension of faith and Malchus — this itself is also the unity of the Blessed Holy One and the Divine Presence — the dimension of Sukka, as above. And therefore it is required that stars be visible through the s'chach. Also: סוכה has the same numerical value as מלאך (malach — angel), as is brought also in Likutay Mohara"n Tinyona, Siman 5 — for through complete prayer one conveys strength and vitality even to the world of the stars and the world of the angels.

The Four Species

And this is the dimension of the taking of the four species. The Sages, z"l, expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Avraham — the dimension of prayer, for he was the first to establish the Morning Prayer (Shacharis), and it is said of him: "and Avraham prayed to G-d" [Gen. 20:17], etc. Kapos Smorim — this is Yitzchok — the dimension of Torah, as the Sages, z"l, taught: "Torah was given from the power of Gevura," as is brought. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Yaakov — etc. — the dimension of truth above, as it is written: "grant truth to Yaakov." Arvay Nachal — this is Yosef — etc. — the dimension of the Tzadik — for all these dimensions are rectifications of prayer, as above.

Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Sarah — the dimension of prayer, the dimension of Malchus. Kapos Smorim — this is Rivka — from whom came Yaakov and Esov — the dimension of the intensification of alien thoughts during prayer, which come from the side of Esov — the dimension of "for he had [Esov's] game in his mouth" [Gen. 25:28], as is explained in the main text. And the rectification is through Yaakov, who is the dimension of truth, as above. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Leah — etc. — from whom the Messiah descended, who is comprised of all the prayers. And therefore the hadas (myrtle) has fragrance — for the Messiah "smells and judges", as is explained in the main text. Arvay Nachal — this is Rachel — etc. — who is the dimension of Torah — "like a ewe before her shearers": all shear laws (halachos) from her, etc. — as is explained in the discourse Tehila l'Dovid, Siman 12.

And more was expounded: the four species correspond to the Sanhedrin — whose essential work is Torah. And more was expounded: they correspond to the dimension of "all my bones shall say" — the dimension of the completeness of prayer with all the [bodily] forces, as is explained in the main text.

And this is: the esrog resembles the heart — the dimension of having to direct one's heart in prayer, as it is written: "prepare their heart — incline Your ear" [Ps. 10:17], as the Sages, z"l, expounded — and this is the dimension of "pour out your heart like water," as is explained in the main text. The lulav resembles the spine — for it is the essential connecting structure of the entire frame of the body — meaning: one must pray with all the forces of the body and the movements of all the limbs, the dimension of "all my bones shall say," etc. — to the extent that all the vertebrae of the spine articulate, as the Sages, z"l, taught of Rabbi Akiva: when he prayed privately he would bow deeply many times, etc. The hadas resembles the eyes — for one must say the words of prayer in truth — and through this G-d supervises one with an open eye (eina p'kicha), the dimension of "my eyes are upon the faithful of the land" [Ps. 101:6], etc. — as is also explained in the discourse Amar Rabbi Akiva, Siman 51 — and then He is near to one and illuminates one's eyes on how to emerge from the darkness surrounding one. The arova resembles the lips — the dimension of the words of prayer themselves, the dimension of "G-d, open my lips" [Ps. 51:17]. And therefore one waves them during "Give thanks to G-d" and during "Please, G-d, save now" — for this is the entirety of prayer: thanking for the past and crying out for the future, as the Sages, z"l, said.

And this is the dimension of the joy of Sukkos — for through the completeness of prayer one merits joy, the dimension of "and I will gladden them in My house of prayer" [Is. 56:7], as is also explained in the discourse Chosom B'Soch Chosom, Siman 22. And therefore all four species grow over all types of water (al kol mayim) — for they are in the dimension of complete prayer, the dimension of "pour out your heart like water," as above. And therefore these four species are propitious (s'gula) for the descent of rains, as the Sages, z"l, taught — for complete prayer, which is the dimension of faith, is the dimension of miracles — the dimension of rain, as is explained in the main text.

Sh'mini Atzeres

Afterwards one merits the holiness of Sh'mini Atzeres — and then the union of the Matron in completeness — and [the feminine principle] retains the drop so that it does not miscarry — for then the Blessed Holy One unites with Israel with great closeness, as is explained in the holy Zohar, and His light illuminates for them — which is the dimension of the light of truth (the dimension of "send out Your light and Your truth" [Ps. 43:3] — said of the light of the Messiah that glimmers at Sh'mini Atzeres, which corresponds to the dimension of Malchus — the dimension of "this one will hold back within my people," as is brought). For the Blessed Holy One is the very essence of truth — and the flash of the light of truth is seeded and absorbed into the hearts of Israel at that time, connecting them to Him in an enduring bond — such that the trace of this illumination will never be nullified forever — the dimension of "and G-d's truth is forever" [Ps. 117:2]. And therefore all Israel ascend to the Torah at that time — for Torah is called truth, the dimension of "acquire truth" [Prov. 23:23], etc. — as the Sages, z"l, taught: to show that within every one of Israel there is a point of truth, for they are in the dimension of "entirely a seed of truth" [Jer. 2:21] — and through this all can draw near to Him.

And this is "G-d said: Let there be light", etc., and "G-d separated between the light" — this is Yaakov — "and between the darkness" — this is Esov — etc., as the Sages, z"l, expounded — for through the light of truth, which is from the dimension of Yaakov, the darkness from the dimension of Esov is repelled and nullified, as above. "One day" — the dimension of "and it shall be one day — it is known to G-d — neither day nor night" [Zech. 14:7], as the Sages, z"l, expounded — for through the light of truth one merits to emerge from the darkness and enter into holiness in its completeness and be absorbed in His unity — especially during prayer, where there is no connection to any darkness whatsoever — for "who is he that would pledge his heart to draw near to Me?" [Jer. 30:21], and "darkness does not darken before You, and night illuminates like day" [Ps. 139:12]. And there it is the dimension of "neither day nor night." Translator's Summary — Siman 9
The central teaching of Siman 9: prayer is the total reckoning of a human being — the primary divine judgment on Rosh HaShanah is for neglect of prayer. Two dimensions of truth map to Sh'vorim and Teruah: the window-truth (a nascent flicker, a sick man's groan) and the gem-truth (self-luminous, a full-throated cry). Yona from the fish's belly is the archetype of prayer within total darkness. The Ark of Noach = entering the teivos (words) of prayer when alien thoughts flood in. The Sukka's gematria = malach — perfect prayer vitalizes even the angels. On Sh'mini Atzeres, the light of truth is permanently planted in the heart of Israel: "G-d's truth is forever."

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Book Yerech HaAisonim — in it are explained many wondrous matters from the topic of
the holiness of Rosh HaShanah and the sounding of the Shofar and the prayers of Rosh HaShanah,
and the great merit of one who is privileged to be near a true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah,
and the topic of the custom that was practiced to go on Erev Rosh HaShanah to pray at the graves of the Tzadikim;
and likewise explained within it are the topics of the holiness of the Ten Days of Repentance,
Yom Kippur, Sukkos, Sh'mini Atzeres, and Simchas Torah, and the holiness of all the mitzvos
