units.he: בר"ה אנו עוסקין בבנין המלכו תשהוא בחי' התפלה ולהעלותה מהר ושדה לבחי' בית שזה סוד הנסירה לנסר אותה מבחי' אחור באחור שאז היא בסוד שדה ולהעלותה ולזווגה פנים בפנים שאז היא בסוד בית כמבואר בפירוש האריז"ל לסבא משפטים ובאשר מקומות, וזה בחי' יעקב כי יעקב קראו בית ועי"ז יש גם לעכו"ם השגה באלהותו ית' וכמבפ"נ, וזהו שאנו מתפללין אז הרבה על התגלות מלכותו ית' על כל העולם ויעשו כולם אגודה אחת לעשות רצונך בלבב שלם וכו' וידע כל פעול כי אתה פעלתו וכו', וכן מתפללין על ביטול המלכות דסט"א ממשלת זדון שיניקתה מבחי' הבעלי גאוה שמונעין עליות התפלה מהר ושדה לבחי' בית כמבפ"נ, ומחמת שאנו עוסקין אז בענין זה ע"כ מתגבר אז הקיטרוג ביותר ממה שפוגמין במלכות דק' ע"י עון הגאוה שהיא עבודה זרה שעי"ז נותנין כח להמלכות דסט"א וגורמין חרון אף בעולם ח"ו ואז המלכות בבחי' רגליה יורדות מות ח"ו, כי כל המתגאה חכמתו מסתלקת ממנו והחכמה עיקר החיים וע"י הגאוה נותנין כח לסטרא דמותא ח"ו, וזה בחי' הג' ספרים שנפתחין אז צדיקים גמורים היינ ואותם שביטלו הגאוה לגמרי ועוסקין בעליית המלכות כראוי ע"כ נכתבים לאלתר לחיים בספר החיים שהוא בחי' המלכות כידוע וזוכין לחכמה ודעת שהוא עיקר החיים, רשעים גמורים שהם מסטרא דמותא ממש ע"כ נתכבים לאלתר למיתה, בינונים תלויים ועומדים עד יו"כ ואז אימא וברתא סלקין כחדא ונמשך הארה גדולה מבחי' בינה לבא שהוא בחי' שורש הרוח הקודש שבלב דנשיב בשית פירקין דרגלין ובשית פירקין דדרועין אל המלכות ואז נשלמת התפלה בשלימות גדול שזה בחי' החמשה תפלות של יו"כ ואז נמתקין כל הדינים וזוכין לסליחת עוונות, וע"כ גם הבינונים אם זכו לעשות תשובה בעשי"ת ועיקר התשובה הוא הכנעתה ולב נשבר באמת היפוך הגאוה וע"כ נכתבין גם הם לחיים, וזה בחי' יום תרועה יהיה לכם ומבואר בזוה"ק כי תרועה היא בחי' יעקב כי בזה מעוררין מדתו של יעקב להעלות המלכות לבחי' בית, גם ע"י התרועה נתבטל הגאוה והע"ז בבחי' בתרועה דאיהי רוחא איתעביר אל אחר ועי"ז נמתקין כל הקיטרוגים והדינים, ומחמת שעיקר בחי' התרועה דאיהי רוחא הוא אצל הצדיק הגדול במעלה שהוא בח' איש אשר רוחו בו וכמבפ"נ ע"כ החיוב אז ביותר לבוא על ר"ה אל הצדיק ולהתקרב אליו ולהתקשר בו בכדי להמשיך ממנו הארת הרוח הקודש שמבו עד שיזכה לבטל הגאוה בשלימות ולהמשיך בחי' הארת ידין ורגלין שיהיו כולם בבחי' חסדים ולבטל כל הקטרוגים ולהמתיק כל הדינים:
units.en:
On Rosh HaShanah we engage in building Malchus — which is the dimension of prayer — and to elevate her from the dimension of mountain and field to the dimension of house. This is the secret of the Separation (Nesira): to separate her from the dimension of back-to-back — for in that state she is in the secret of field — and to elevate and unite her face-to-face — for then she is in the secret of house — as is explained in the commentary of the Ar"i z"l to the Sava d'Mishpatim and in many other places. And this is the dimension of Yaakov — for Yaakov called [G-d's place] a house — and through this even the nations of the world have some grasp of His G-dliness, as is explained in the main text. And this is why we pray extensively at that time for the revelation of His sovereignty over all the world: "and all will unite as one fellowship to do Your will with a whole heart," and "and all that was formed shall know that You formed it," etc.

And likewise one prays for the nullification of the Malchus d'Stra Achra — the dominion of wickedness — whose sustenance comes from the dimension of the arrogant (baalei gaavah), who prevent the ascent of prayer from mountain and field to house, as is explained in the main text. Because at that time the accusations intensify most strongly from the blemishing of the holy Malchus through the sin of pride (gaavah), which is idol-worship — through which one gives strength to the Malchus d'Stra Achra and causes divine wrath in the world, heaven forbid. And then Malchus is in the dimension of "her feet descend to death" [Prov. 5:5], heaven forbid — for whoever is arrogant: his wisdom departs from him, and Wisdom is the primary life; and through pride one gives strength to the side of death (stra d'mosa), heaven forbid.

And this is the dimension of the Three Books opened at that time: the completely righteous — those who nullified pride completely and engage in elevating Malchus as is fitting — are therefore immediately inscribed for life in the Book of Life, which is the dimension of Malchus, as is known, and they merit Wisdom and Knowledge, which is the primary life. The completely wicked — who are entirely of the side of death — are therefore immediately inscribed for death. The intermediate ones are suspended until Yom Kippur — when Ima u'Vra salikun k'chada ["Mother and Daughter ascend together"] — and a great illumination flows from the dimension of Bina, the heart, which is the dimension of the root of the Holy Spirit in the heart that blows through the six joints of the legs and the six joints of the arms to Malchus. Then prayer is completed with great completeness — the dimension of the Five Prayers of Yom Kippur — and all judgments are sweetened and one merits forgiveness of sins. And therefore the intermediate ones too — if they did repentance during the Ten Days of Repentance — and the essential repentance is the true humbling of the heart and a broken heart, the opposite of pride — they too are inscribed for life.

And this is the dimension of "a day of Teruah shall it be for you" — as is explained in the Zohar: Teruah is the dimension of Yaakov, for through this one arouses Yaakov's quality to elevate Malchus to the dimension of house. Also: through Teruah — which is a spirit (ruach) — the Other God (el acher) is removed, in the dimension of "through the Teruah, which is a spirit, the Other was removed" — and through this all accusations and judgments are sweetened. And because the essential dimension of Teruah that is spirit resides with the Tzadik of the highest stature — who is the dimension of "a man in whom the spirit is" [Num. 27:18], as is explained in the main text — therefore the obligation is greatest at that time to come to the Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah, to connect to him, to draw from him the illumination of the Holy Spirit — until one merits to completely nullify pride and to draw the illumination of arms and legs into the dimension of loving-kindnesses — and to nullify all accusations and sweeten all judgments.

units.he: וזה בחי' מצוות תקיעת שופר שבטבעו להחריד לב האדם ולהכניע ולהשפיל גאונו וזדון לבו של האדם כמובן בפסוקים הרבה, וע"כ השופר מצותו שיהיו של איל וכפוף ודרז"ל ע"ז כמה דכייף אינש דעתיה טפי מעלי כי העיקר הוא הכנעת הלב באמת, וע"כ מצותו בשל איל לזכור עקדתו של יצחק שפשט צווארו על גבי המזבח לישחט בשביל לקיים מצוות בוראו כי זה עיקר שלימות ההכנעה וביטול הגאוה עד שיהיה כאין ואפס ממש נגד רצון בוראו וימסור נפשו בכל עת על קדושת שמו ית', ומחמת שע"י התרועה נתבטל הע"ז שעיקר אחיזתה בבחי' רגלין בחי' רגליה יורדת מות אך אעפי"כ ממילא נעשה איזה פגם ח"ו גם בבחי' ידין וע"כ ע"י התרועה דאיהי רוחא בחי' הרוח שבלב העליון כביכול עי"ז נתעלין הרגלין בבחי' לבו נשא את רגליו וגם נתגלה הארת הידים, וממילא מובן כי בתחלה נתגלה הארת הידים שזה בחי' מחאת כפים מאחר שאין שם אחיזה להסט"א כ"כ, וגם כי הם סמוכין ביותר להרוח שבלב וכנראה בחוש שבשעת שמחה שנתעורר הרוח החיוני שבלב אזי בנקל וקרוב יותר שימחא האדם בכפים מחמת שמחה ממה שיתעורר גם לריקודין ברגין ממש, וזה בחי' שברים ותרועה שברים הוא גנוחי גנח שזה בחי' מה שמתאנח על פגם בחי' הידין שאין שם אחיזת הסט"א כ"כ רק אעפי"כ מתאנח וגונח על פגם ומיעוט הארתם ותרועה הוא יילולי ייליל בקולות קצרות ותכופות מחמת גודל הצער והכאב שזה כנגד בחי' פגם הרגלין שיש בהם אחיזה ביותר לסטרא דמותא ח"ו, ושניהם הם בחי' לב נשבר ונדכה בחי' רוח נשברה, ועי"ז בא אח"כ שמחה כמובא במ"א שאר לב נשבר בא שמחה שזה בחי' אשרי העם יודעי תרועה וסמוך לי' בשמך יגילון כל היום וע"י השמחה הבאה מהרוח שבלב עי"ז נתגלה הארת הידים ונתעלין הרגלין וע"כ שברים קודם לתרועה, וזהו שארז"ל כי תרועה מרמז על התורה כי התורה ג"כ כלולה מכל הבחינות הנ"ל כמבואר בפנים, ומחמת שעיקר המשכת תיקונים אלו הוא ע"י התקרבות אל הצדיק כנ"ל וההתקרבות אל הצדיק הוא בבחי' תקיעה פשוטה כמבואר בפרשת חצוצרות וכמובא לעיל וע"כ כל תרועה פשוטה לפניה ופשוטה לאחריה:
units.en:
This is the dimension of the mitzvah of Shofar-sounding — which by its nature startles a person's heart and humbles and abases the pride and insolence of the heart, as is understood from many verses. And therefore the Shofar is commanded to be of a ram's horn and bent — and the Sages, z"l, expounded: "the more a person bends himself, the more praiseworthy" [Rosh HaShanah 26b] — for the essential thing is the true humbling of the heart. And therefore the mitzvah is specifically of a ram's horn — to recall the Akaidah of Yitzchok, who stretched his neck over the altar to be slaughtered in order to fulfill the will of his Creator — for this is the essential completeness of humbling and nullifying pride: to be as absolute nothing and void against the will of one's Creator, giving one's life at all times for the sanctification of His Name.

And because through Teruah the idol-worship is nullified — whose primary foothold is in the dimension of the legs (riglin), the dimension of "her feet descend to death" — even so, some blemish occurs, heaven forbid, also in the dimension of the arms (idin). And therefore through the Teruah that is spirit — the dimension of the Holy Spirit in the supernal heart, as it were — the legs are elevated, the dimension of "and his heart lifted his legs" [Gen. 29:1], and also the illumination of the arms is revealed. And it is thereby understood that the illumination of the arms is revealed first — this being the dimension of the clapping of hands (mecha'as kapayim) — since the Stra Achra has less of a foothold there. And also because the arms are much closer to the spirit in the heart — as is discernible concretely: in a moment of joy, when the life-spirit in the heart is aroused, it is easier and more natural for a person to clap his hands than to be aroused to actual dancing with the feet.

And this is the dimension of Sh'vorim and Teruah: Sh'vorim — gonochi gonach — the dimension of sighing over the blemish of the arms, where the Stra Achra has less of a foothold — but even so one sighs and groans over the blemish and diminishment of their illumination. Teruah — yelulai yelil — in short rapid sounds, because of the great sorrow and pain — corresponding to the blemish of the legs, where the side of death has the greater foothold, heaven forbid. And both are the dimension of a broken and contrite heart, the dimension of a broken spirit (ruach nishvara). And through this, joy then comes — as is brought elsewhere: from a broken heart comes joy — the dimension of: "fortunate is the people who know the Teruah" and adjacent to it: "in Your Name they shall rejoice all day" [Ps. 89:16–17]. And through the joy that comes from the spirit in the heart, the illumination of the arms is revealed and the legs are elevated. And therefore Sh'vorim precedes Teruah.

And this is why the Sages, z"l, taught that Teruah alludes to Torah — for the Torah also encompasses all these dimensions, as is explained in the main text. And because the essential drawing of these rectifications is through drawing near to the Tzadik — and the drawing near to the Tzadik is in the dimension of the simple Tekia, as is explained in the passage of the trumpets, and as is brought above — therefore every Teruah has a simple [Tekia] before it and after it.

הרגלין הם בבחי' רגלי חסידיו המבפ"נ, ופסוקי זכרונות הוא להעלות חג"ת וכו' שזה בחי' התגלות הארת הידים המבפ"נ, ופסוקי שופרות הוא להעלות וכו' בנה"י דאימא ששם בחי' השופר הגדול (עיין סידור קול יעקב)היינו ששם שורש הרוח שבלב הנ"ל בחי' ורוח להולכים בה המבואר במ"א, וזה ג"כ בחי' השפוטה לפניה שמורה על ההתקרבות להצדיק וע"י הרוח הקודש שלו נשבר הרוח גבוה אל אחר שזה בחי' תרועה, ואח"כ תוקעין עוד תקיעה פשוטה כי אחר הג' בחי' עליות הנ"ל, וזה זכרונות כדי שיבוא זכרוניכם לפני לטובה זה כנגד בחי' ההתקרבות להצדיק ועי"ז נשבר הרוח גבוה ונעשה שפל רוח ונמתקין כל הדינים ונזכרים לטובה שזה בחי' שבשפלינו זכר לנו. וע"כ מתפללין בהברכה זו לזכור לנו עקידת יצחק שעי"ז נמתק הדין בשרשו העליון ע"י חסד דאברהם שעי"ז עיקר תיקון המלכות כ"ש והוכן בחסד כסא, וע"כ אמר אז אברהם בהר ה' יראה כי אז התחיל המלכות לעלות לבחי' הר ה' ואח"כ ע"י יצחק עלתה לבחי' שדה עד שע"י יעקב עלתה לבחי' בית וזה שסיימו רז"ל ובמה בשופר כי ע"י שופר ממשיכין כל התיקונים הנ"ל, וע"כ בשבת שאז עולה המלכות ממילא בעליות גדולות ע"י סוד קדושת שבת בסוד אם תשוב משבת רגליך וכמבואר במ"א ע"כאין תוקעין אז שמא יבוא עי"ז לחילול שבת ואתי לאתויי ד' אמות ברה"ר ועי"ז יפגום ביותר בכל העליות הנ"ל, וע"כ בברכתשופרות מזכירין פסוקי שופרות של מתן תורה כי התורה כלולה מכל הנ"ל, ומתפללין שם על קיבוץ גליות והביאנו לציון עירך ברנה ולירושלים בית מקדשך בשמחת עולם כ יאז תעלה המלכות בשלימות עלייתה לבחי' בית שזה בחי' יעקב קראו בית שמרמז על בנין הבית שלעתיד, וזה בחי' זכרון תרועה הנאמר בר"ה ודרז"ל שזה כשחל ר"ה בשבת שאז מזכירין אבל לא תוקעין כי זכרון מרמז על הצדיק בחי' זכר צדיק לברכה שעל ידו זוכין לתרועה דאיהי רוחא כנ"ל וע"כ כשחל בשבת שהוא כנגד בחי' יוסף הצדיק כמבואר בזוה"קאנו חוששין שמא יבוא לחלל שבת ויפגום בכל התיקונים הנ"ל וע"כ מזיכירן אבל לא תוקעין:
units.en:
And this is the dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros. And it is explained in the Kavanos that the verses of Malchuyos serve to elevate the Netzach-Hod-Yesod of the feminine principle into the Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes of Zeir Anpin — the dimension of the legs ascending, as in "his heart lifted his legs," and becoming loving-kindnesses — and then the legs are in the dimension of "the legs of His pious ones," as is explained in the main text. The verses of Zichronos serve to elevate Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes, etc. — the dimension of the revelation of the illumination of the arms, as is explained in the main text. The verses of Shofaros serve to elevate, etc., into the Netzach-Hod-Yesod of Ima — wherein is the Great Shofar (see Siddur Kol Yaakov) — meaning: there is the root of the Holy Spirit in the heart above, the dimension of "and a spirit to those who walk in it," as is explained elsewhere.

And this is also the dimension of the simple Tekia before — indicating the drawing near to the Tzadik. And through his holy spirit the high spirit of pride of the Other is broken — the dimension of Teruah. And afterward one sounds a second simple Tekia — for after the high spirit is broken, one merits to connect more deeply to the light of the Holy Spirit in the heart of the Tzadik.

And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught: "Say Malchuyos before Me so that you crown Me over you" — for all of this we are engaged in building the holy Malchus and elevating her from mountain and field to the dimension of house. And perhaps this itself corresponds to the three dimensions of ascent mentioned above. And "Zichronos — so that your remembrance ascends before Me for good" — this corresponds to the dimension of drawing near to the Tzadik, through which the high spirit is broken and one becomes lowly of spirit, and all judgments are sweetened and one is remembered for good — the dimension of "for in our lowliness He remembered us" [Ps. 136:23]. And therefore one prays in this blessing to recall for us the Akaidah of Yitzchok — through which the judgment is sweetened at its supernal root through the loving-kindness of Avraham, through which comes the principal rectification of Malchus, as it is written: "and through kindness a throne is established." And Avraham said at that time: "on the mountain of G-d it shall be seen" [Gen. 22:14] — for then Malchus began to ascend to the dimension of mountain of G-d. Then through Yitzchok she ascended to the dimension of field. Until through Yaakov she ascended to the dimension of house. And this is what the Sages, z"l, concluded: "and through what? Through the Shofar" — for through the Shofar all these rectifications are drawn.

And on Shabbos — when Malchus ascends of itself with great ascents through the secret of the holiness of Shabbos, in the secret of "if you turn your foot on account of the Shabbos" [Is. 58:13], as is explained elsewhere — therefore one does not sound the Shofar on Shabbos, lest this cause a desecration of Shabbos — "lest he carry the Shofar four cubits in a public domain" [Rosh HaShanah 29b] — and through this one would blemish greatly in all the ascents above. And therefore in the blessing of Shofaros one mentions the Shofar-verses of the Giving of the Torah — for Torah encompasses all the above. And one prays there for the ingathering of exiles: "bring us to Tzion Your city in song, and to Yerushalayim Your holy Temple with eternal joy" — for then Malchus will ascend completely to the dimension of house — the dimension of Yaakov called it house — alluding to the building of the future Temple.

And this is the dimension of Zichron Teruah ["Remembrance of the Teruah"] said on Rosh HaShanah — the Sages, z"l, taught: this refers to when Rosh HaShanah falls on Shabbos — when one mentions [the soundings] but does not actually sound them. For Zichron [remembrance] alludes to the Tzadik — the dimension of "the memory of the Tzadik is a blessing" [Prov. 10:7] — through whom one merits to Teruah that is spirit, as above. And therefore when [Rosh HaShanah] falls on Shabbos — which corresponds to the dimension of Yosef the Tzadik, as is explained in the Zohar — we fear lest one come to desecrate Shabbos and blemish all the rectifications above — and therefore one mentions but does not sound.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is the dimension of "a day of Teruah shall it be for you" — as is explained in the Zohar: Teruah is the dimension of Yaakov, for through this one arouses Yaakov's quality to elevate Malchus to the dimension of house. Also: through Teruah — which is a spirit (ruach) — the Other God (el acher) is removed, in the dimension of "through the Teruah, which is a spirit, the Other was removed" — and through this all accusations and judgments are sweetened. And because the essential dimension of Teruah that is spirit resides with the Tzadik of the highest stature — who is the dimension of "a man in whom the spirit is" [Num. 27:18], as is explained in the main text — therefore the obligation is greatest at that time to come to the Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah, to connect to him, to draw from him the illumination of the Holy Spirit — until one merits to completely nullify pride and to draw the illumination of arms and legs into the dimension of loving-kindnesses — and to nullify all accusations and sweeten all judgments.

The Mitzvah of Shofar — The Ram's Horn, Bent

units.he: ד"ה ועל כן
units.en: Passage beginning “And therefore”

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ועל כן is an actual partial discourse incipit. It does not supply the words that follow.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ועל כן נוהגין לילך בערב ר"ה להתפלל על קברי צדיקים כי כל צדיק אמיתי יש בו מבחי' משה רבינו ע"ה כמובן בדבריו ז"ל בכמה מקומות וע"כ כמו שקברו של משה מבטל כח הע"ז של פעור וממתיק החרון אף שנתעורר עי"ז כמו כן גם קברי שאר הצדיקי אמת הגדולין במעלה יש להם מבחי' זאת וע"כ הולכין בערב ר"ה על קברי צדיקים לעורר אותם שיתפללו ג"כ בעדינו לבטל הגאוה והע"ז ושיתביטל החרון אף ויומתקו כל הדינים מעלינו, וזה בחי' הקיצו ורננו שוכני עפר ודרז"ל אלו שנעשו שכנים לעפר בחייהם היינו שהיו ענווים ושפלים וזכו לשבר הגאוה בשלימות בחייהם בבחי' תרועה הנ"ל צדיקים אלו יש להם כח לבטל סטרא דמותא גם אחר הסתלקותם אדרבא גדולים צדיקים במיתתם יותר מבחייהם ולדמו רז"ל דבר זה ממה שנגעו עצמות אדם מת בעצמות אלישע וקם בתחיה והלך לו כי הצדיק הוא איש אשר רוח בו והוא קוצא דאות ד' שממנו נמשכין ד' רוחות כ"ש מארבע רוחות בואי הרוח ופסוק זה נאמר לענין המתים שהחיה יחזקאל, וזה שארז"ל למה נסמכה פרשת פרה לפרשת מיתת מרים לומר לך וכו' כך מיתתצדיקים מכפרת כי הצדיקים במיתתם דייקא ממתיקין הדינים בשרשם ומבטלין עי"ז סטרא דמותא שזה ג"כ בחי' טהרת הפרה אדומה כידוע, וע"כ נקבע ר"ה בר"ח שאז נמשך בחי' תיקון המלכות בחי' ושדר לי' סימנא דוד מלך ישראל חי וקים שארז"ל וכמובא, וגם ר"ה הוא יםו ראשון לעשי"ת וע"כ נקבע בר"ח שאז הוא שורש התשובה כמבפ"נ:
units.en:
And therefore the custom is to go on Erev Rosh HaShanah to pray at the graves of Tzadikim — for every true Tzadik possesses something of the dimension of Moshe our Teacher, a"h, as is understood from his words, z"l, in many places. And therefore just as the grave of Moshe nullifies the strength of the idol-worship of Peor and sweetens the divine wrath aroused through it — so too the graves of other great Tzadikim of the highest stature have this dimension. And therefore one goes on Erev Rosh HaShanah to the graves of Tzadikim — to arouse them that they should also pray on our behalf: to nullify pride and idol-worship, and that the divine wrath be nullified and all judgments sweetened upon us.

And this is the dimension of "awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust" [Is. 26:19] — and the Sages, z"l, expounded: these are those who made themselves neighbors to the dust during their lifetimes — meaning those who were humble and lowly and merited to completely break pride during their lifetimes, the dimension of Teruah above. These Tzadikim have the power to nullify the side of death even after their passing — on the contrary: "the Tzadikim are greater in their death than in their lives" [Chullin 7b]. And the Sages, z"l, compared this to the dead man's bones that touched the bones of Elisha and he came back to life and walked away — for the Tzadik is "the man in whom the spirit is" and he is the edge of the letter Dalet from which the four winds are drawn, as it is written: "from the four winds, come, O spirit" [Ezek. 37:9] — a verse said regarding the dead whom Yechezkel revived.

And this is what the Sages, z"l, said: why was the passage of the Red Heifer (Parah Aduma) placed adjacent to the passage of the death of Miriam? To tell you… just as the death of the Tzadikim atones — for the Tzadikim in their death specifically sweeten the judgments at their root and thereby nullify the side of death — and this is also the dimension of the purification of the Red Heifer, as is known. And therefore Rosh HaShanah is fixed on Rosh Chodesh — for then is drawn the dimension of the rectification of Malchus, the dimension of the sign that was sent, "David, King of Israel, is alive and enduring" — as the Sages, z"l, said, and as is brought. And also: Rosh HaShanah is the first day of the Ten Days of Repentance — and therefore it is fixed on Rosh Chodesh, for there is the root of repentance, as is explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
This is the dimension of the mitzvah of Shofar-sounding — which by its nature startles a person's heart and humbles and abases the pride and insolence of the heart, as is understood from many verses. And therefore the Shofar is commanded to be of a ram's horn and bent — and the Sages, z"l, expounded: "the more a person bends himself, the more praiseworthy" [Rosh HaShanah 26b] — for the essential thing is the true humbling of the heart. And therefore the mitzvah is specifically of a ram's horn — to recall the Akaidah of Yitzchok, who stretched his neck over the altar to be slaughtered in order to fulfill the will of his Creator — for this is the essential completeness of humbling and nullifying pride: to be as absolute nothing and void against the will of one's Creator, giving one's life at all times for the sanctification of His Name.

And because through Teruah the idol-worship is nullified — whose primary foothold is in the dimension of the legs (riglin), the dimension of "her feet descend to death" — even so, some blemish occurs, heaven forbid, also in the dimension of the arms (idin). And therefore through the Teruah that is spirit — the dimension of the Holy Spirit in the supernal heart, as it were — the legs are elevated, the dimension of "and his heart lifted his legs" [Gen. 29:1, as the Sages expound: Yaakov's heart lifted his legs when he went to meet Rachel], and also the illumination of the arms is revealed. And it is thereby understood that the illumination of the arms is revealed first — this being the dimension of the clapping of hands (mecha'as kapayim) — since the Stra Achra has less of a foothold there. And also because the arms are much closer to the spirit in the heart — as is discernible concretely: in a moment of joy, when the life-spirit in the heart is aroused, it is easier and more natural for a person to clap his hands than to be aroused to actual dancing with the feet.

qualifications.text: The supplied ושדר לי' סימנא דוד מלך ישראל חי וקים identifies “David, King of Israel, is alive and enduring” as the content of a sign or message sent. It does not identify David as the recipient. The English leaves the recipient unnamed.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

And once he said:
"With me, the main thing is Rosh HaShanah" — and also:
"My Rosh HaShanah is a great novelty (chidush) …
not only are you all certainly bound to my Rosh HaShanah,
but even all the world — the entire world — depends upon my Rosh HaShanah."

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ואח"כ עוסקין contains only the actual opening words of a discourse. No continuation is supplied.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בתשובה בכל עשי"ת וע"י כל זה מתקנין כל הפגמים שפגמו בבחי' המלכות דק' ומעלין אותה מבחי' רגליה יורדת מולת, כי ע"י תשובה זוכין לחיים כ"ש שובו וחיו וכתיב כי לא אחפוץ במות המת כ"א בשוב רשע מדרכו וחיה, עד שביו"כ נמתקין כל הדינים בשרשם ע"י הארת אימא עילאה ששם שורש הרוח דקדושה הנ"ל, וע"כ נקרא יו"כ יום חתונתו זו מתן תורה היינו הלוחות שניות שניתנו בו שהם כלל התורה שהוא בחי' הארת הרוח הנ"ל בבחי' ידין ורגין שהם בחי' מרדכי ואסתר שעי"ז נעשה יחוד קוב"ה וכשכינתיה בחי' השוו אשה לאיש המבפ"נ וזה בחי' חתונה, וביום שמחת לבו זה בנין ביהמק"ד בחי' חנוכת הבית שהיה ביו"כ כיאז עולה המלכות בשלימות מבחי' הר ושדה לבחי' בית, וזהו שדרז"ל יום כפורים שנמשך ביו"כ בחי' הארת פורים כי כל התיקונים הנ"ל נמשכין בפורים כמבפ"נ נמשכין ג"כ ביו"כ, וע"כ קורין בו ג"כ מענין מיתת בני אהרן ולמדו רז"ל מזה ג"כ שמיתת הצדיקים מכפרת היינו כנ"ל:
units.en: Afterwards one engages in repentance throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance — and through all this one rectifies all the blemishes inflicted upon holy Malchus and elevates her from the dimension of "her feet descend to death" — for through repentance one merits life, as it is written: "repent and live" [Ezek. 18:32], and it is written: "for I have no desire in the death of the one who dies, but rather in the wicked one's returning from his way and living." Until on Yom Kippur all judgments are sweetened at their root through the illumination of Supernal Ima — wherein is the root of the holy spirit above. And therefore Yom Kippur is called "the day of his wedding — this is the Giving of the Torah" — i.e., the Second Tablets given on that day — which are the entirety of the Torah containing the illumination of the spirit in the dimension of arms and legs — which are the dimension of Mordechai and Esther — through which the unity of the Blessed Holy One and His Divine Presence is accomplished — the dimension of "a woman equated with a man," as is explained in the main text — and this is the dimension of a wedding. And "the day of the joy of his heart — this is the building of the Temple" — the dimension of the dedication of the Temple, which took place on Yom Kippur — for then Malchus ascends completely from mountain and field to the dimension of house. And the Sages, z"l, taught that Yom Kippur carries the illumination of Purim — for all the rectifications drawn on Purim are also drawn on Yom Kippur. And therefore on it one also reads the matter of the death of the sons of Aharon — and the Sages, z"l, inferred from this too that the death of the Tzadikim atones, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is the dimension of Sh'vorim and Teruah: Sh'vorim — gonochi gonach — the dimension of sighing over the blemish of the arms, where the Stra Achra has less of a foothold — but even so one sighs and groans over the blemish and diminishment of their illumination. Teruah — yelulai yelil — in short rapid sounds, because of the great sorrow and pain — corresponding to the blemish of the legs, where the side of death has the greater foothold, heaven forbid. And both are the dimension of a broken and contrite heart, the dimension of a broken spirit (ruach nishvara). And through this, joy then comes — as is brought elsewhere: from a broken heart comes joy — the dimension of: "fortunate is the people who know the Teruah" and adjacent to it: "in Your Name they shall rejoice all day" [Ps. 89:16–17]. And through the joy that comes from the spirit in the heart, the illumination of the arms is revealed and the legs are elevated. And therefore Sh'vorim precedes Teruah.

And this is why the Sages, z"l, taught that Teruah alludes to Torah — for the Torah also encompasses all these dimensions, as is explained in the main text. And because the essential drawing of these rectifications is through drawing near to the Tzadik — and the drawing near to the Tzadik is in the dimension of the simple Tekia, as is explained in the passage of the trumpets, and as is brought above — therefore every Teruah has a simple [Tekia] before it and after it.

qualifications.text: The supplied בחי' חנוכת הבית שהיה ביו"כ explicitly identifies the dedication of the Temple with Yom Kippur. This statement is retained between the Temple-building interpretation and the ascent of Malchus to the dimension of house.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

And once he said that on Rosh HaShanah he performs matters and rectifications

units.he: ואחר יו"כ מתחילין החסדים ליכנס כי כשנתבטל הע"ז ונמתק החרון אף ונתרבה האמונה בעולם עי"ז נמשכין חסדים בעולם בבחי' להגיד בבוקר ואמונתך בלילות וכתיב זכר חסדו ואמונתו וכו', עד שביום ראשון של סוכות נכנס החסד הגדול הפנימי וכן של המקיפים ואז נכנסין לסוכה שמרמזת לבינה עילאה ששם שורש הרוח הנ"ל וכן למלכות סוכת דוד שהיא בחי' התפלה וכן הבית המקדש נקרא סוכה כ"ש ויהי בשלם סוכו וכו', ואז השמחה גדולה מאד ובשמחת בית השואבה היו מרקדין ושואביןממנה רוח הקודש כי כל השמחה והריקודין נמשכין מבחי' רוח-הקודש הנ"ל, ובחי' סוכה הוא אותיות כ"ו ה"ס בחי' יחוד קוב"ה ושכינתיה בחי' השוו אשה לאיש הנ"ל, וע"כ מקריבין אז שבעים פרים כנגד האומות כי ע"י כל הנ"ל גם העכו"ם מכירים ויודעים גדולתו ית' כמבפ"נ שזה ע"י בחי' יעקב שנאמר אצלו ויעקב נסע סוכותה בחי' סוכות הנ"ל ויבן לו בית כי העלה המלכות לבחי' בית כנ"ל:
units.en: After Yom Kippur the loving-kindnesses begin to enter — for when idol-worship is nullified, the divine wrath sweetened, and faith increased in the world — through this, loving-kindnesses are drawn in the world, in the dimension of "to declare in the morning, and Your faithfulness in the nights," and it is written: "He remembered His loving-kindness and His faithfulness," etc. Until on the first day of Sukkos the great innermost loving-kindness enters, and also the encompassing loving-kindness. And one enters the Sukka — which alludes to Supernal Bina, wherein is the root of the spirit above; and likewise to Malchus d'Sukkas Dovid, which is the dimension of prayer; and likewise the Temple is called Sukka, as it is written: "and in Salem was His Sukka" [Ps. 76:3], etc. And then the joy is exceedingly great — and at Simchas Beis HaShoaiva they would dance and draw from it the Holy Spirit — for all the joy and dancing flows from the dimension of the holy spirit above. And the dimension of Sukka — the letters Kaf-Vav / Hay-Samech — the unity of the Blessed Holy One and the Divine Presence — the dimension of "a woman equated with a man," as above. And therefore one brings seventy bulls corresponding to the [seventy] nations — for through all the above, even the nations recognize and know His greatness — as is explained in the main text. The dimension of what is written of Yaakov: "and Yaakov journeyed to Sukkos — and he built himself a house" [Gen. 33:17] — for he elevated Malchus to the dimension of house, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Malchuyos, Zichronos, Shofaros — The Three Kabbalistic Ascents

And this is the dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros. And it is explained in the Kavanos that the verses of Malchuyos serve to elevate the Netzach-Hod-Yesod of the feminine principle into the Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes of Zeir Anpin — the dimension of the legs ascending and becoming loving-kindnesses — and then the legs are in the dimension of "the legs of His pious ones," as is explained in the main text. The verses of Zichronos serve to elevate Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes, etc. — the dimension of the revelation of the illumination of the arms, as is explained in the main text. The verses of Shofaros serve to elevate Netzach-Hod-Yesod of Ima — wherein is the Great Shofar (see Siddur Kol Yaakov) — meaning: there is the root of the Holy Spirit in the heart above, mentioned above.

units.he: וזה בחי' הד' מינים שלוקחין אז ושמחין בהם כ"ש ושמחתם לפני ה' א', פרי עץ הדר זה בחי' מלכות בחי' הדר מלכות בחי' וכבוד הדר מלכותו, כפות תמרים זה בחי' הצדיק בחי' צדיק כתמר יפרח שעל ידו עיקר עליית המלכות שהיא בחי' התפלה, ענף עץ עבות כנגד חג"ת בחי' ידין, ערבי נחל כנגד נצח הוד בחי' רגלין, וכן מבואר שהם כנגד כל הבחינות הנ"ל זדעיר אין כאן מקום לבאר בזה, ורז"ל דרשו פרי עץ הדר זה אברהם וכו' שהוא היה הראשון שתיקן תפלת שחרית ועסק בתפלה להעלות אותה וקרא למקום התפלה הר, כפות תמרים זה יצחק וכו' שקראו שדה, ענף עץ עבות זה יעקב וכו' שקראו בית, וערבי נחל זה יוסף וכו' בחי' הצדיק איש אשר רוח בו שעל ידועיקר עליות התפלה והמשכת כל התיקונים הנ"ל, ועוד דרשו שפרי עץ הדר זו שרה שהיא בחי' מלכות כידוע ועליה נאמר השב אשת האיש המבפ"נ, כפות תמרים זו רבקה וכו' שהיא מבחי' בינה בסוד ויהי יצחק בן ארבעים שנה בקחתו את רבקה בחי' בן ארבעים לבינה (עיין ליקוטי תורה להאריז"ל) ובינה לבא ששם שורש הרוח הקודש הנ"ל וע"כ נולד ממנה יעקב שהוא בחי' תרועה דאיהו רוחא שמבטל כח הע"ז והגאוה של מלכות דסט"א בחי' עשו, וענף עץ עבות זו לאה שעומדת נגד חג"ת כידוע, וערבי נחל זו רחל שעומד כנגד נה"י, ועוד דרשו שמרמזין הד' מניים על הסנהדרין וכו' כי הם יושבין על המשפט וכמובא גם בפנים פסוק זה, ועוד דרשו שזה בחי' כל עצמותי תאמרנה וכו' שזה בחי' שלימות התפלה, וזה שאמרו אתרוג דומה ללב ששם משכן הרוח דנשיב בידין וברגלין, לולב דומה לשדרה שהוא בחי' הצדיק חי עלמין שהוא איש אשר רוח בו שעוסק להמשיך בחי' הרוח הזה, הדס דומה לעינים שהיא בחי' התורה שבנגלה שהיא בחי' עין בעין כמבפ"נ שהיא בחי' ידין, ערבה דומה לשפתים שהם בחי' נצח והוד העליונים בחי' רגלין בחי' נסתר כמבפ"נ, וע"כ מסיימן ההושענות שאומרין עם הד' מינים למען דעת כל עמי הארץ כי ה' הוא האלהים וכו' כי ע"י המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל אז ימכירין אפי' העכו"ם בגדולת הבורא ית':
units.en:
And this is the dimension of the four species that are taken at that time and with which one rejoices, as it is written: "And you shall rejoice before the L-rd your G-d." And the Sages, z"l, expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of honor (hadar malchus), the dimension of "and the glorious splendor of His kingdom." Kapos Smorim — the dimension of the Tzadik, the dimension of "the righteous one flourishes like a date-palm" [Ps. 92:13] — for through him is the essential ascent of Malchus-prayer. Anaf Eitz Avos — corresponding to Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes, the dimension of the arms. Arvay Nachal — corresponding to Netzach-Hod, the dimension of the legs. And it is also explained that they correspond to all the above-mentioned dimensions of Zeir; there is no room here to elaborate upon this. And more was expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Avraham — who was the first to establish the Morning Prayer and engaged in prayer to elevate it, and called the place of prayer: mountain. Kapos Smorim — this is Yitzchok — who called it field. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Yaakov — who called it house. Arvay Nachal — this is Yosef — the Tzadik, "a man in whom the spirit is" — through whom is the essential ascent of prayer and drawing of all these rectifications.

And more was expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Sarah — the dimension of Malchus, as is known, and concerning her it is said, "Restore the man's wife," as explained in the main text. Kapos Smorim — this is Rivka — who is from the dimension of Bina, in the secret of "and Yitzchok was forty years old when he took Rivka" — the dimension of "forty [years] for Bina" (see Likutay Torah of the Ar"i z"l). And Bina is the heart, where the root of the Holy Spirit mentioned above is found — and therefore Yaakov was born from her, who is the dimension of Teruah that is spirit that nullifies the strength of pride and idol-worship of Malchus d'Stra Achra — which is Esov. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Leah, corresponding to Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes. Arvay Nachal — this is Rachel, corresponding to Netzach-Hod. And more: the four species allude to the Sanhedrin, for they sit in judgment, as this verse is also brought in the main text. And more: the dimension of "all my bones shall say" — the dimension of complete prayer.

And this is: the esrog resembles the heart — wherein is the dwelling of the spirit that blows in the arms and legs. The lulav resembles the spine — the dimension of the Tzadik, Chai Olamim, "a man in whom the spirit is" — who engages in drawing this spirit. The hadas resembles the eyes — the dimension of Torah in its revealed aspect, the dimension of eye to eye, as is explained in the main text — which is the dimension of the arms. The arova resembles the lips — the dimension of Netzach-Hod, the hidden dimension, the dimension of the legs, as is explained in the main text. And therefore one concludes the Hoshanos with the verse: "so that all the peoples of the earth shall know that G-d — He is the G-d" [I Kings 8:60], for through drawing down the above-mentioned rectifications, even the nations of the world recognize the greatness of the Creator, Yisburach.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is also the dimension of the simple Tekia before — indicating the drawing near to the Tzadik. And through his holy spirit the high spirit of pride of the Other is broken — the dimension of Teruah. And afterward one sounds a second simple Tekia — for after the high spirit is broken, one merits to connect more deeply to the light of the Holy Spirit in the heart of the Tzadik.

And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught: "Say Malchuyos before Me so that you crown Me over you" — for all of this we are engaged in building the holy Malchus and elevating her from mountain and field to the dimension of house. And perhaps this itself corresponds to the three dimensions of ascent mentioned above. And "Zichronos — so that your remembrance ascends before Me for good" — this corresponds to the dimension of drawing near to the Tzadik, through which the high spirit is broken and one becomes lowly of spirit, and all judgments are sweetened and one is remembered for good — the dimension of "for in our lowliness He remembered us" [Ps. 136:23]. And therefore one prays in this blessing to recall for us the Akaidah of Yitzchok — through which the judgment is sweetened at its supernal root through the loving-kindness of Avraham. And Avraham said at that time: "on the mountain of G-d it shall be seen" [Gen. 22:14] — for then Malchus began to ascend to the dimension of mountain of G-d. Then through Yitzchok she ascended to the dimension of field. Until through Yaakov she ascended to the dimension of house. And this is what the Sages, z"l, concluded: "and through what? Through the Shofar" — for through the Shofar all these rectifications are drawn.

qualifications.text: The supplied phrase וכן מבואר שהם כנגד כל הבחינות הנ"ל זדעיר אין כאן מקום לבאר בזה relates the four species to all the foregoing dimensions and states that there is no room to elaborate. The irregular form זדעיר is read contextually as Zeir, without changing the supplied Hebrew or claiming an established original-print correction.

The supplied ובינה לבא ששם שורש הרוח הקודש identifies Bina with the heart, where the root of the Holy Spirit is found. The English preserves this apposition and the Holy Spirit's relationship to its root.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ זוכין לשמיני עצרת ואז זווגא דמטרוניתא פניפ בפנים שאז המלכות בבחי' בית כנ"ל בשם כתבי האריז"ל, ואז מסיימין התורה בלמ"ד ומתחילין בבי"ת שזה מרמז שהתורה היא בחי' לב ששם משכן הרוח דנשיב בידין ורגלין בחי' הרוח הזה, הדס דומה לעינים שהיא בחי' התורה שבנגלה שהיא בחי' עין בעין הרוח חיים שבתורה ע"י הצדיק שהוא איש אשר רוח בו, ועי"ז נעשה בחי' ריקודין והמחאת כף וע"כ כל ישראל שמחין אז הרבה בריקודין והמחאת כף הרבה מאד, וזה בחי' מה שמובא בכוונות כי אז הנוקבא עוצרת הטיפה שלא תפיל היינו כי אז משפיע הצדיק ומזריע ומאיר בלב ישראל הארת הרוח הקודש שבו באופן שתתבטל מהם הגאוה לגמרי ואז בטוחים שלא יפלו ממדריגתן לעולם, כי עיקר הנפילה של האדם הוא ע"י גדלות כמבואר במ"א, וזה בחי' בנין הבית שלעתיד שלא יפול ולא יחרב לעולם, וזה בראשית ברא אלהים את השמים שהן בחי' ידין בחי' כי אשא אל שמים ידי כמבואר במאמר ביכורים הסתרה סי' נ"ו וע"פ פשוטו ג"כ כי שמים הם בחי' אש ומים מעורבין שזה בחי' חג"ת בחי' ידין, ואת הארץ בחי' רגלין בחי' והארץ הדום רגלי, והארץ היתה תהו ובוהו וכו' בחי' הארבע מלכיות בחי' גאוה דסט"א שעיקר אחיזתן בבחי' רגלין בחי' ארץ, והתיקון הוא ע"י ורוח אלהים מרחפת על פני המים זה בחי' הרו חהקודש הנ"ל הגנוז בהתורה שנמשלה למים, רק עיקר הארת הרוח הנ"ל מקבלין ע"י הצדיק שהוא איש אשר רוח בו וזה שדרשו ורוח א' מרחפת דא רוחו של משיח שנאמר בו ונחה עליו רוח ה' וכו' זה בחי' הצדיק הדור הגדול במעלה שהוא בחי' משה משיח כנ"ל, ואז ויאמר א' יהי אור ויהי אור שני פעמים או"ר הוא בחי' בי"ת כמובא בכתבים כי עי"ז עולה המלכות לבחי' בית כנ"ל, וזהו שארז"ל בזכות ולקחתם וכו' אני נגלה לכם ראשון זה בחי' התגלות הבורא ית' לישראל בהתגלות גדול עד שעי"ז ידעו הכל את ה ', ופורע לכם מן הראשון זה עשו שממנו יצא עמלק והמן שהו אבחי' גאוה מלכות דסט"א, ובונה לכם ראשון זה בית המקדש היינו עליות התפלה לבחי' בית, ומביא לכם ראשון זה מלך המשיח שהוא יזכה לבחי' רוח הקודש הנ"ל, בשלימות שעי"ז נתתקן הכל כנ"ל:
units.en:
Afterwards one merits Sh'mini Atzeres — and then the union of the Matron face to face — and Malchus is in the dimension of house, according to the writings of the Ar"i z"l. And then one concludes the Torah with Lamed and begins with Beis — hinting that Torah is the dimension of the heart wherein is the dwelling of the spirit that blows in the arms and legs, the dimension of this spirit; the hadas resembles the eyes — the dimension of Torah in its revealed aspect, the dimension of eye to eye; the spirit of life in the Torah is received through the Tzadik, who is "a man in whom the spirit is." And thereby dances and clapping of hands are accomplished — and therefore all Israel rejoice greatly with much dancing and clapping.

And this is the dimension of what is explained in the Kavanos: at that time the [feminine principle] retains the drop so that it does not miscarry — for then the Tzadik bestows, sows and shines the illumination of the Holy Spirit within him into the hearts of Israel, such that pride is completely nullified from them — and then one is certain they will never fall from their level — for the primary falling of a person is through pride, as is explained elsewhere. And this is the dimension of the building of the future Temple that will never fall or be destroyed.

And this is: Bereishis bara Elokim es ha-Shamayim — the dimension of the arms, the dimension of "for I lift My hand toward heaven" [Deut. 32:40], as explained in the discourse ביכורים הסתרה, Siman 56. And also: Shamayim [heavens] = Eish u'Mayim [fire and water] combined — the dimension of Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes, the arms. And "the earth" — the dimension of the legs — "the earth is the footstool of My feet." "And the earth was void and formless" — the four kingdoms of the Stra Achra — the pride of the Stra Achra, whose primary foothold is in the dimension of the legs. And the rectification: "the spirit of G-d hovered over the face of the waters" — the Holy Spirit hidden in the Torah compared to water. But the essential illumination of the spirit above is received through the Tzadik who is "a man in whom the spirit is" — and this is what the Sages, z"l, expounded: "the spirit of G-d hovered" — this is the spirit of the Messiah — said of him: "and the spirit of G-d shall rest upon him" [Is. 11:2] — this is the Tzadik of the generation of the highest stature, the dimension of Moshe-Messiah, as above. And then "G-d said: Let there be light, and there was light" — two occurrences of Or (light), the dimension of Beis, as brought in the writings — for through this Malchus ascends to the dimension of house, as above. And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught: in the merit of "and you shall take," etc., "I will reveal Myself to you as the First" — the revelation of the Creator to Israel in great revelation, until through this everyone will know G-d. "He pays back to you from the First — this is Esov" — from whom Amaleik and Haman descended — the dimension of pride, the Malchus d'Stra Achra. "He builds for you the First — this is the Temple" — the ascent of prayer to the dimension of house. "He brings for you the First — this is King Messiah" — who will merit the Holy Spirit in completeness — through which everything will be rectified, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And on Shabbos — when Malchus ascends of itself with great ascents through the secret of the holiness of Shabbos, in the secret of "if you turn your foot on account of the Shabbos" [Is. 58:13], as is explained elsewhere — therefore one does not sound the Shofar on Shabbos, lest this cause a desecration of Shabbos — "lest he carry the Shofar four cubits in a public domain" [Rosh HaShanah 29b] — and through this one would blemish greatly in all the ascents above. And therefore in the blessing of Shofaros one mentions the Shofar-verses of the Giving of the Torah — for Torah encompasses all the above. And one prays there for the ingathering of exiles: "bring us to Tzion Your city in song, and to Yerushalayim Your holy Temple with eternal joy" — for then Malchus will ascend completely to the dimension of house — the dimension of Yaakov called it house — alluding to the building of the future Temple.

And this is the dimension of Zichron Teruah ["Remembrance of the Teruah"] said on Rosh HaShanah — the Sages, z"l, taught: this refers to when Rosh HaShanah falls on Shabbos — when one mentions [the soundings] but does not actually sound them. For Zichron [remembrance] alludes to the Tzadik — the dimension of "the memory of the Tzadik is a blessing" [Prov. 10:7] — through whom one merits to Teruah that is spirit, as above. And therefore when [Rosh HaShanah] falls on Shabbos — which corresponds to the dimension of Yosef the Tzadik, as is explained in the Zohar — we fear lest one come to desecrate Shabbos and blemish all the rectifications above — and therefore one mentions but does not sound.

And Therefore the Custom to Go to the Graves of Tzadikim on Erev Rosh HaShanah

And therefore the custom is to go on Erev Rosh HaShanah to pray at the graves of Tzadikim — for every true Tzadik possesses something of the dimension of Moshe our Teacher, a"h, as is understood from his words, z"l, in many places. And therefore just as the grave of Moshe nullifies the strength of the idol-worship of Peor and sweetens the divine wrath aroused through it — so too the graves of other great Tzadikim of the highest stature have this dimension. And therefore one goes on Erev Rosh HaShanah to the graves of Tzadikim — to arouse them that they should also pray on our behalf: to nullify pride and idol-worship, and that the divine wrath be nullified and all judgments sweetened upon us.

And this is the dimension of "awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust" [Is. 26:19] — and the Sages, z"l, expounded: these are those who made themselves neighbors to the dust during their lifetimes — meaning those who were humble and lowly and merited to completely break pride during their lifetimes, the dimension of Teruah above. These Tzadikim have the power to nullify the side of death even after their passing — on the contrary: "the Tzadikim are greater in their death than in their lives" [Chullin 7b]. And the Sages, z"l, compared this to the dead man's bones that touched the bones of Elisha and he came back to life and walked away — for the Tzadik is "the man in whom the spirit is" and he is the edge of the letter Dalet from which the four winds are drawn, as it is written: "from the four winds, come, O spirit" [Ezek. 37:9] — a verse said regarding the dead whom Yechezkel revived.

And this is what the Sages, z"l, said: why was the passage of the Red Heifer (Parah Aduma) placed adjacent to the passage of the death of Miriam? To tell you… just as the death of the Tzadikim atones — for the Tzadikim in their death specifically sweeten the judgments at their root and thereby nullify the side of death — and this is also the dimension of the purification of the Red Heifer, as is known. And therefore Rosh HaShanah is fixed on Rosh Chodesh — for then is drawn the dimension of the rectification of Malchus, the dimension of the sign sent to David — "David, King of Israel, is alive and enduring" — as the Sages, z"l, said, and as is brought. And also: Rosh HaShanah is the first day of the Ten Days of Repentance — and therefore it is fixed on Rosh Chodesh, for there is the root of repentance, as is explained in the main text.

Afterwards — Ten Days of Repentance through Sh'mini Atzeres

Afterwards one engages in repentance throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance — and through all this one rectifies all the blemishes inflicted upon holy Malchus and elevates her from the dimension of "her feet descend to death" — for through repentance one merits life, as it is written: "repent and live" [Ezek. 18:32], and it is written: "for I have no desire in the death of the one who dies, but rather in the wicked one's returning from his way and living." Until on Yom Kippur all judgments are sweetened at their root through the illumination of Supernal Ima — wherein is the root of the holy spirit above. And therefore Yom Kippur is called "the day of his wedding — this is the Giving of the Torah" — i.e., the Second Tablets given on that day — which are the entirety of the Torah containing the illumination of the spirit in the dimension of arms and legs — which are the dimension of Mordechai and Esther — through which the unity of the Blessed Holy One and His Divine Presence is accomplished — the dimension of "a woman equated with a man," as is explained in the main text — and this is the dimension of a wedding. And "the day of the joy of his heart — this is the building of the Temple" — for then Malchus ascends completely from mountain and field to the dimension of house. And the Sages, z"l, taught that Yom Kippur carries the illumination of Purim — for all the rectifications drawn on Purim are also drawn on Yom Kippur. And therefore on it one also reads the matter of the death of the sons of Aharon — and the Sages, z"l, inferred from this too that the death of the Tzadikim atones, as above.

After Yom Kippur the loving-kindnesses begin to enter — for when idol-worship is nullified, the divine wrath sweetened, and faith increased in the world — through this, loving-kindnesses are drawn in the world. Until on the first day of Sukkos the great innermost loving-kindness enters, and also the encompassing loving-kindness. And one enters the Sukka — which alludes to Supernal Bina, wherein is the root of the spirit above; and likewise to Malchus d'Sukkas Dovid, which is the dimension of prayer; and likewise the Temple is called Sukka, as it is written: "and in Salem was His Sukka" [Ps. 76:3], etc. And then the joy is exceedingly great — and at Simchas Beis HaShoaiva they would dance and draw from it the Holy Spirit — for all the joy and dancing flows from the dimension of the holy spirit above. And the dimension of Sukka — the letters Kuf-Vav / Hay-Samech — the unity of the Blessed Holy One and the Divine Presence — the dimension of "a woman equated with a man," as above. And therefore one brings seventy bulls corresponding to the [seventy] nations — for through all the above, even the nations recognize and know His greatness — as is explained in the main text. The dimension of what is written of Yaakov: "and Yaakov journeyed to Sukkos — and he built himself a house" [Gen. 33:17] — for he elevated Malchus to the dimension of house, as above.

The Four Species

And this is the dimension of the four species. And the Sages, z"l, expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of honor (hadar malchus). Kapos Smorim — the dimension of the Tzadik, the dimension of "the righteous one flourishes like a date-palm" [Ps. 92:13] — for through him is the essential ascent of Malchus-prayer. Anaf Eitz Avos — corresponding to Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes, the dimension of the arms. Arvay Nachal — corresponding to Netzach-Hod, the dimension of the legs. And more was expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Avraham — who was the first to establish the Morning Prayer and engaged in prayer to elevate it, and called the place of prayer: mountain. Kapos Smorim — this is Yitzchok — who called it field. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Yaakov — who called it house. Arvay Nachal — this is Yosef — the Tzadik, "a man in whom the spirit is" — through whom is the essential ascent of prayer and drawing of all these rectifications.

And more was expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Sarah — the dimension of Malchus, as is known. Kapos Smorim — this is Rivka — who is from the dimension of Bina, in the secret of "and Yitzchok was forty years old when he took Rivka" — the dimension of "forty [years] for Bina" (see Likutay Torah of the Ar"i z"l). And in Bina the heart is rooted — and therefore Yaakov was born from her, who is the dimension of Teruah that is spirit that nullifies the strength of pride and idol-worship of Malchus d'Stra Achra — which is Esov. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Leah, corresponding to Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes. Arvay Nachal — this is Rachel, corresponding to Netzach-Hod. And more: the four species allude to the Sanhedrin. And more: the dimension of "all my bones shall say" — the dimension of complete prayer.

And this is: the esrog resembles the heart — wherein is the dwelling of the spirit that blows in the arms and legs. The lulav resembles the spine — the dimension of the Tzadik, Chai Olamim, "a man in whom the spirit is" — who engages in drawing this spirit. The hadas resembles the eyes — the dimension of Torah in its revealed aspect, the dimension of eye to eye, as is explained in the main text — which is the dimension of the arms. The arova resembles the lips — the dimension of Netzach-Hod, the hidden dimension, the dimension of the legs, as is explained in the main text. And therefore one concludes the Hoshanos with the verse: "so that all the peoples of the earth shall know that G-d — He is the G-d" [I Kings 8:60].

Sh'mini Atzeres — Malchus Ascends to House

Afterwards one merits Sh'mini Atzeres — and then the union of the Matron face to face — and Malchus is in the dimension of house, according to the writings of the Ar"i z"l. And then one concludes the Torah with Lamed and begins with Beis — hinting that Torah is the dimension of the heart wherein is the dwelling of the spirit that blows in the arms and legs. And thereby dances and clapping of hands are accomplished — and therefore all Israel rejoice greatly with much dancing and clapping.

And this is the dimension of what is explained in the Kavanos: at that time the [feminine principle] retains the drop so that it does not miscarry — for then the Tzadik shines and radiates the illumination of the Holy Spirit within him into the hearts of Israel, such that pride is completely nullified from them — and then one is certain they will never fall from their level — for the primary falling of a person is through pride, as is explained elsewhere. And this is the dimension of the building of the future Temple that will never fall or be destroyed.

And this is: Bereishis bara Elokim es ha-Shamayim — the dimension of the arms, the dimension of "for I lift My hand toward heaven" [Deut. 32:40]. And also: Shamayim [heavens] = Eish u'Mayim [fire and water] combined — the dimension of Chesed-Gevura-Tiferes, the arms. And "the earth" — the dimension of the legs — "the earth is the footstool of My feet." "And the earth was void and formless" — the four kingdoms of the Stra Achra — the pride of the Stra Achra, whose primary foothold is in the dimension of the legs. And the rectification: "the spirit of G-d hovered over the face of the waters" — the Holy Spirit rooted in the Torah compared to water. But the essential illumination of the spirit above is received through the Tzadik who is "a man in whom the spirit is" — and this is what the Sages, z"l, expounded: "the spirit of G-d hovered" — this is the spirit of the Messiah — said of him: "and the spirit of G-d shall rest upon him" [Is. 11:2] — this is the Tzadik of the generation of the highest stature, the dimension of Moshe-Messiah, as above. And then "G-d said: Let there be light" — the dimension of Beis — for through this Malchus ascends to the dimension of house, as above. And: "I will reveal Myself to you as the First" — the revelation of the Creator in great revelation. "He pays back to you from the First — this is Esov" — from whom Amaleik and Haman descended — the dimension of pride, the Malchus d'Stra Achra. "He builds for you the First — this is the Temple" — the ascent of prayer to the dimension of house. "He brings for you the First — this is King Messiah" — who will merit the Holy Spirit in completeness — through which everything will be rectified, as above. [Note: In this discourse there are some matters that are somewhat concealed — this is because it is impossible to elaborate so much on the explanation of the two unifications mentioned here — and it is easily understood.]

Translator's Summary — Siman 10
Siman 10 traces prayer's three-stage elevation: Avraham = Mountain (first attachment); Yitzchok = Field (meditative dimension); Yaakov = House (perfect face-to-face union). Pride — idol-worship in disguise — drags prayer's feet toward death. The bent ram's-horn Shofar is the instrument of humbling. Sh'vorim = the sigh over the blemish of the arms; Teruah = the rapid cry over the blemish of the legs. Joy follows the broken heart. The Tzadik's grave on Erev Rosh HaShanah — like Moshe's grave opposite Beit Peor — is the specific antidote to the idol-worship of pride.

units.he: בר"ה עוסקין כל ישראל שיהיו נעשה בחי' יחודא עילאה ויחודא תתאה כמובן בכתבי האריז"ל וביותר מבואר בזה בספר ברית כהונת עולם, ושני יחודים אלו הם סוד שמע ישראל וברוך שם וכו' והם עיקר פסוקי קבלת מלכות שמים שבזה עוסקין ביותר בר"ה, וכמו שאר" אמרו לפני מלכיות כדי שתמליכוני עליכם וזה ג"כ בחי' תקיעת שופר של ר"ה כמבואר בספר ברית כהונת עולם הנ"ל, והנה מבואר בפנים שע"י שישראל גורמןי שני יחודים הנ"ל ע"י שנזהרין כולם בשמירת הברית הן בזיווג של חול הן אותן שזיווגם משבת לשבת עי"ז נשלם כבוד ה' ית' בשלימות, גם צריכין ליזהר מאד מגיאו תרק שיהיה'כבודו כאין נגד כבוד השי"ת ועי"ז נשלם הדיבור שהוא בחי' מלכות פה וזוכים עי"ז לדיבורים המאירים לו לתשובה ועי"ז זוכה לתבונת התורה לעומקא, והנה ר"ה הוא יום ראשון לעי"ת ואז אנו עוסקין בבנין המלכות שהוא בחי' הדיבור המאיר ומתפללין הרבה על התגלות מלכותו וכבודו ית', וזה בחי' המלך הקדוש שאומרין אז המלך הוא בחי' הכבוד בחי' מי זה מלך הכבוד והקדוש הוא בחי' הוא"ו של כבו"ד שהוא בחי' קדושת הברית שהוא עיקר הקדושה כמבפ"נ, וקדוש זאת ממשיכין ישראל על עצמן ממה שדביקין בקדושתו ית' בבחי' קדושים תהיו כיקדוש אני כמבוא, וגם כי סילוקא דיסודא הוא עד המוחין שהם בחי' קודש וכמבואר במ"א, וזה שאומרין בברכת אתה קדוש וקדושים בכל יום יהללוך סלה וכו', וזה שמתפללין ובכן יתקדש שמך וכו' נגד בחי' קדושה הנ"ל ובכן תן פחדך נגד בחי' כבוד הנ"ל בחי' ליראה את השם הנכבד, ואח"כ מתפללין ובכן תן כבוד ה' לעמך שגם ישראל יכו לבחי' כבוד הנ"ל וזה תהלה ליראיך תהלה היא בחי' הדיבור כמבפ"נ ותקוה טובה וכו' זה כנגד בחי' יצירה ועשיה שהם בחי' תיק לאותיות ו"ה כמבואר בכוונות זה בחי' יחודא תתאה בחי' מט"ט המקנן ביצירה וכו', ועל יחוד זה צריכין להתפלל ביותר כי לא אבו בעיר עד דבקרבך קדוש כשארז"ל וכמובן גם בפנים כשנשאו דשאים וכו' אז דיקא אמר שר העולם יהיה כבוד ה' לעולם, וזהו ופתחון פה למיחלים לך כי אז דייקא נפתח הפה והדיבור כמובן בפנים, וזה שמחה לארצך וכו' וצמיחת קרן לדוד עבדך וכו' כי בזה תלוי הגאולה כמובן בפנים, וזה ובכן צדיקם יראו וישמחו צדיק הוא מאן דנטיר ברית כידוע, ותמלוך בחי' התגלות מלכותו וכבודו ית', וזה קדוש אתה בחי' קדושה הנ"ל, ונורא שמך בחי' הכבוד הנ"ל בחי' ליראה את השם הנכבד והנורא בחי' מוראה של מלכות, ואין אלהים מבלעדיך כי זה בחי' שיש די באלהותו לכל בריה כמבפ"נ, (וזה בחי' לתקן עולם במלכות שדי), ומסיימין בברכת הלך הקדות כנ"ל, ומחמת שעוסקין אז בבנין המלכות והתגלות הכבוד דקודשה ע"כ נתעורר אז ביותר לעומת זה הדינין והקטרוגים ממה שפגמו במלכות דקדושה, והעיקר ע"י הגיאות והרדיפה אחר הכבוד כמבפ"נ. ע"כ ציוה עלינו השי"ת לתקוע בשופר שבטבעו להחריד לב האדם ולהכניע גאותו, וזה יום תרועה יהיה לכם כי תרועה היא בחי' ביטול ושבירת הגאוה כמבואר במאמר משפטים סי' יו"ד, וע"כ תרועה היא בחי' יעקב שהוא בחי' עקב ענוה יראת ה', והוא זכה לתקן בחי' השני יחודים הנ"ל כמו שארז"ל שהשבטים אמרו שמע ישראל וכו' והואאמר בשכמל"ו, ומחמת ששם צריכין שמירה ביותר כנ"ל ע"כ אומרין אותו בחשאי משום שאמרו יעקב כשארז"ל, וזהו שארז"ל שתרועה אותיות תור"ה עיי"ן בחי' הע' פנים לתורה כי ע"י כ"ז זוכין לבוא לתבונת התורה לעומקה, וע"כ תוקעין בשופר שמרמז על בינה היינו כנ"ל, ומחמת שצריכין לזה לבטל הגאוה ולתקן פגם הברית ע"כ תקנו רז"ל לתקוע שברים ותרועה, שברים הוא כנגד ביטול הגאוה בבחי' לפני שבר יגבה לב איש וכן לפני שבר גאון, ותרועה הוא יילולי ייליל זה כנגד פגם הברית שבא מהקליפה שנקראת לילית מפני שמייללת כמובא, ותחלה תוקעין שברים כי זה תלוי בזה בבחי' ואשת איש נפש יקרה תצוד כמובא בפנים גם מובא ששבריםתרועה הם כנגד יצירה ועשיה בחי' יחודא תתאה הנ"ל, וע"כ תוקעין פשוטה לפניה ופשוטה לאחריה, תקיעה פשוטה אותיות תקיע"ה בחי' יחודא עילאה כמובן ואח"כ תרועה היא בחי' יחודא תתאה הנ"ל, ואח"כ תוקעין פשוטה לאחריה כילעתיד גם יחודא תתאה יהיה בבחי' אותיות י"ה כמובא בכתבים שזה בחי' ביום ההוא יהי"הה' אחד וכו' וע"כ אין תוקעין בשבת כי אז נמשכין כל הבחינות הנ"ל ע"י קדושת שבת בעצמו כמובא במ"א:
units.en:
On Rosh HaShanah all Israel are engaged so that the dimension of the Supernal Unification (Yichuda Ilaa) and the Lower Unification (Yichuda Tataah) should be accomplished — as is understood in the writings of the Ar"i z"l, and elaborated upon most extensively in the book Bris Kehunas Olam. And these two unifications are the secret of Shema Yisroel and Boruch Shem Kevod Malchuso L'Olam Va'ed — which are the primary verses of the acceptance of the yoke of Heaven, which one engages in most intensively on Rosh HaShanah. And as the Sages taught: "Say Malchuyos before Me so that you crown Me over you" — and this is also the dimension of the Shofar-sounding on Rosh HaShanah, as is explained in Bris Kehunas Olam above.

And behold: it is explained in the main text that through Israel causing these two unifications — through being careful in guarding the Bris (holiness of the covenant), whether in weekday unions or in those unions from Shabbos to Shabbos — through this G-d's honor is completed in its fullness. Also: one must be very careful against pride, so that one's honor shall be as nothing against the honor of G-d. And through this the speech — which is the dimension of Malchus-mouth — is perfected. And one merits illuminating speech (diburim hame'irim) that leads to repentance — and through this one merits the understanding of Torah in its depth (tvunas ha-Torah l'umka).

And behold: Rosh HaShanah is the first day of the Ten Days of Repentance. And then we are engaged in building Malchus — which is the dimension of the illuminating speech — and one prays greatly for the revelation of His sovereignty and His honor. And this is the dimension of HaMelech HaKadosh: HaMelech is the dimension of honor — the dimension of "who is this King of Honor?" [Ps. 24:10]. And HaKadosh is the dimension of the Vav of Kovod (Honor) — which is the dimension of the holiness of the Bris, which is the very essence of holiness, as is explained in the main text.

And the holiness [of the Bris] is what Israel draw upon themselves from their cleaving to His holiness — the dimension of "be holy, for I am holy" [Lev. 11:44], as is brought. And also: the elevation of the Yesod (Foundation) is to the level of the mental faculties (mochin), which are the dimension of Kodesh (holiness), as is explained elsewhere.

And this is what one prays: "and the holy ones praise You every day, Selah", etc. And this is what one prays: "and so may Your Name be sanctified" etc. — corresponding to the dimension of holiness above. And "and so grant Your fear" — corresponding to the dimension of honor above, the dimension of "to fear the honored Name." And afterward one prays "and so grant honor, G-d, to Your people" — that Israel too merit the honor above. And this is: "praise to those who fear You" — praise is the dimension of speech, as is explained in the main text. And "good hope," etc. — this corresponds to the dimension of Yetzira and Asiya, which are the dimension of the vessel for the letters Vav-Hay, as is explained in the Kavanos. This is the dimension of the Lower Unification — the dimension of Metatron which nests in Yetzira, etc.

And one must pray most for this unification — for "I shall not come into the city until there is a Holy One in your midst" — as the Sages, z"l, taught. And as is understood also in the main text: when the herbs sprouted, etc. — specifically then the Minister of the World said: "May the honor of G-d be forever." And this is "and the opening of speech for those who hope in You" — for specifically then the mouth and speech opens, as is understood in the main text. And this is "and joy for Your land", etc., and "the sprouting of a horn for David Your servant," etc. — for in this depends the redemption, as is understood in the main text.

And this is "and so the Tzadikim shall see and rejoice" — a Tzadik is one who guards the Bris, as is known. And "You shall reign" — the dimension of the revelation of His sovereignty and honor. And "Holy are You" — the dimension of holiness above. And "awesome is Your Name" — the dimension of honor above, the dimension of "to fear the honored and awesome Name," the dimension of the awe of sovereignty (mora d'malchus). And "there is no G-d besides You" — for this is the dimension of it being sufficient in His G-dliness for every creature, as is explained in the main text (and this is the dimension of "to rectify the world under the sovereignty of the Almighty"). And one concludes with the blessing of HaMelech HaKadosh, as above.

And because at that time one is engaged in building Malchus and revealing the holy honor — the accusations and judgments intensify most strongly through what was blemished in holy Malchus — primarily through pride and the pursuit of honor, as is explained in the main text. Therefore G-d commanded us to sound the Shofar — which by its nature startles the heart and humbles pride. And this is: "a day of Teruah shall it be for you" — for Teruah is the dimension of the nullification and breaking of pride, as is explained in the discourse Mishpatim, Siman 10.

And therefore Teruah is the dimension of Yaakov, who is the dimension of "the heel (akev) — humility (anava) — the fear of G-d" [Prov. 22:4]. And he merited to perfect the dimension of the two unifications, as the Sages, z"l, taught: the Tribes said Shema Yisroel, and he responded Boruch Shem. And because this requires extra vigilance, as above — one says it in a whisper because Yaakov said it, as the Sages taught.

And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught: Teruah is the letters of TORAH-AYIN — the dimension of the seventy faces of Torah — for through all of this one merits to come to the understanding of Torah in its depth. And therefore one sounds the Shofar, which alludes to Bina, as above. And because for this one needs to nullify pride and rectify the blemish of the Bris — therefore the Sages, z"l, established to sound Sh'vorim and Teruah: Sh'vorim corresponds to the nullification of pride, the dimension of "before breaking a man's heart becomes haughty" [Prov. 18:12], and likewise "before breaking comes pride" [Prov. 16:18]. And Teruah — yelulai yelil — this corresponds to the blemish of the Bris, which comes from the husk called Lilit — for she wails (milaleis), as is brought. And Sh'vorim first — for this depends on that: the dimension of "and a married woman traps his precious soul" [Prov. 6:26], as is explained in the main text. And it is also brought that Sh'vorim-Teruah corresponds to Yetzira and Asiya — the dimension of the Lower Unification above.

And therefore one sounds a simple [Tekia] before it and after it. The simple Tekia [תקיעה] — its letters hint at the Supernal Unification, as is understood. And afterward Teruah — the dimension of the Lower Unification above. And afterward one sounds a simple Tekia after it — for in the future even the Lower Unification will be in the dimension of the letters Yud-Hay, as is brought in the holy writings — the dimension of "on that day G-d will be One and His Name One" [Zech. 14:9]. And therefore one does not sound [the Shofar] on Shabbos — for then all these dimensions flow of themselves through the holiness of Shabbos itself, as is explained elsewhere.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
On Rosh HaShanah All Israel Engage in the Supernal and Lower Unifications

On Rosh HaShanah all Israel are engaged so that the dimension of the Supernal Unification (Yichuda Ilaa) and the Lower Unification (Yichuda Tataah) should be accomplished — as is understood in the writings of the Ar"i z"l, and elaborated upon most extensively in the book Bris Kehunah Olam. And these two unifications are the secret of Shema Yisroel and Boruch Shem Kevod Malchuso L'Olam Va'ed — which are the primary verses of the acceptance of the yoke of Heaven, which one engages in most intensively on Rosh HaShanah. And as the Sages taught: "Say Malchuyos before Me so that you crown Me over you" — and this is also the dimension of the Shofar-sounding on Rosh HaShanah, as is explained in Bris Kehunah Olam above.

qualifications.text: The cited book is supplied as ספר ברית כהונת עולם. Its construct form כהונת is represented by Bris Kehunas Olam, retaining the final ת rather than the historical Kehunah form.

The supplied וקדושים בכל יום יהללוך סלה has the holy ones as the subject praising You each day. The supplied ובכן יתקדש שמך is a petition that Your Name be sanctified, not a command for G-d to sanctify His own Name.

The supplied compressed expression כי לא אבו בעיר עד דבקרבך קדוש is read contextually with the first-person “I shall not come into the city” and the condition concerning the Holy One in your midst. The supplied אבו is irregular and remains unchanged. The related teaching in Taanit 5a concerns the Jerusalem above and the Jerusalem below, but its fuller wording is not substituted for this source's expression.

The supplied וצמיחת קרן לדוד עבדך concerns the sprouting of a horn for David Your servant. The English preserves both the horn metaphor and its recipient without substituting the historical “growth of the glory of David.”
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וזה בחי' מלכיות כנגד בחי' הכבוד בחי' מלכות הנ"ל, זכרונות כנגד בח'י קדושת הברית הנ"ל, וע"כ מתחילין בפסוקי נח וגם את נח באהבה זכרת וכו' בהביאך את מי המבול וכו' מפני רוע מעלליהם שהיה העיקר בעוון פגם הברית ונח היה צדיק תמים שומר הברית, וכןברוב פסוקי זכרונות נזכר תיבת ברית (וזה בחי' זכר לעולם בריתו), שופרות הם כנגד בינה בחי' תבונת התורה לעומקא הנ"ל, וע"כ מדברשם הרבה מקול שופר של מתן תורה וגם משופר של קיבוץ גליות שיהיה ג"כ ע"י תיקונים הנ"ל כנ"ל, ואז יזכו ישראל לתבונת התורה לעומקא הנ"ל, וע"כ מדבר שם הרבה מקול שופר של מתן תורה וגם משופר של קיבוץ גליות שיהיה ג"כ ע"י תיקונים הנ"ל כנ"ל, ואז יזכו ישראל לתבונת התורה לעומקא כמו שפירש"י על פסוק ישקני מנשיקות פיהו וכמבוא בזוה"ק ובדבריו ז"ל במאמר להמשיך השגחה סי' י"ג וכן בסי' ל"ג מענין התורה שתתגלה לעתיד:
units.en: And this is the dimension of Malchuyos — corresponding to the dimension of honor, the dimension of Malchus above. Zichronos — corresponding to the dimension of the holiness of the Bris above — and therefore one begins with the verses of Noach: "and even Noach You remembered with love", etc., "when You brought the floodwaters", etc. — because of their evil deeds, which were primarily through the sin of the blemish of the Bris. And Noach was "a righteous, wholesome man, guarding the Bris". And likewise in most of the verses of Zichronos the word Bris (covenant) is mentioned (and this is the dimension of "He remembered His covenant forever" [Ps. 105:8]). Shofaros — corresponding to Bina, the dimension of the understanding of Torah in its depth above. And therefore one speaks there greatly of the Shofar-sound of the Giving of the Torah — and also the Shofar of the ingathering of exiles, which will also occur through these rectifications above. And then Israel will merit the understanding of Torah in its depth, as above. And therefore one speaks there greatly of the Shofar-sound of the Giving of the Torah — and also the Shofar of the ingathering of exiles, which will also occur through these rectifications above. And then Israel will merit the understanding of Torah in its depth, as Rashi explained on the verse "let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth" [Song 1:2], and as is brought in the Zohar and in his words, z"l, in the discourse L'Hamshich Hashgacha, Siman 13, and likewise in Siman 33, regarding the Torah that will be revealed in the future.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And behold: it is explained in the main text that through Israel causing these two unifications — through being careful in guarding the Bris (holiness of the covenant), whether in weekday unions or in those unions from Shabbos to Shabbos — through this G-d's honor is completed in its fullness. Also: one must be very careful against pride, so that one's honor shall be as nothing against the honor of G-d. And through this the speech — which is the dimension of Malchus-mouth — is perfected. And one merits illuminating speech (diburim hame'irim) that leads to repentance — and through this one merits the understanding of Torah in its depth (tvunas ha-Torah l'umka).

And behold: Rosh HaShanah is the first day of the Ten Days of Repentance. And then we are engaged in building Malchus — which is the dimension of the illuminating speech — and one prays greatly for the revelation of His sovereignty and His honor. And this is the dimension of HaMelech HaKadosh: HaMelech is the dimension of honor — the dimension of "who is this King of Honor?" [Ps. 24:10]. And HaKadosh is the dimension of the Vav of Kovod (Honor) — which is the dimension of the holiness of the Bris, which is the very essence of holiness, as is explained in the main text.

And the holiness [of the Bris] is what Israel draw upon themselves from their cleaving to His holiness — the dimension of "be holy, for I am holy" [Lev. 11:44], as is brought. And also: the elevation of the Yesod (Foundation) is to the level of the mental faculties (mochin), which are the dimension of Kodesh (holiness), as is explained elsewhere.

qualifications.text: The supplied וגם את נח באהבה זכרת addresses G-d in the second person, “You remembered.” The historical third-person rendering is corrected without changing the following floodwater quotation.

The supplied מפני רוע מעלליהם שהיה העיקר בעוון פגם הברית explicitly connects the floodwaters to their evil deeds, principally the blemish of the Bris. Both parts of that causal statement are represented.

The supplied prose repeats the Shofaros explanation concerning the Giving of the Torah, ingathering of exiles and understanding of Torah in its depth. Both occurrences are retained in their source order, with the first ending as above and the second continuing to the Rashi, Zohar and discourse references.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.
