units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בתשובה בכל ימי העשרת ימי תשובה, ותשובה כוללת ג"כ בחי' שני היחודים הנ"ל שזה בחי' אותיות תשוב"ה תשו"ב ה"א כמובא, וזה בחי' שובו אלי בחי' יחודא תתאה ואשובה אליכם בחי' יחודא עילאה בחי' לא אבוא בירושלים שלמעלה וכו' כנ"ל, וע"י התשובה עי"ז הולכין ממדריגה למדריגה עד שבא לתבונת התורה לעומקא שזה בחי' יו"כ שניתנה בו התורה לוחות שניות והוא כנגד בחי' בינה כידוע ואז מאירין שני היחודיםהנ"ל באור גדול וע"כ ואמרין אז גם בשכמל"ו בקול, וזה שדרז"ל (שבת קי"ט) לקדוש ה' מכובד זה יו"כ וכו' אמרה תורה כבדהו בכסות נקיה כי אז נשלם אור הכבוד וגם הוא"ו של כבוד שהיא בחי' קדושה והכבוד והגאוה הוא בחי' לבושו של השי"ת בחי' ה' מלך גאות לבש כמבפ"נ ע"כ אמרה תורה כבדהו בכסות נקיה, וזה בחי' הנרות שמדליקין ביו"כ בחי' ע"כ באורים כבדו את ה' כמובא בשו"ע כי אז מאיר אור הכבוד בבחי' והארץ האירה מכבודו, וזוכים אז לדברדיבורים המאירים שזה בחי' התפלות והדיבורים קדושים שעוסקין בזה אז כל היום, וגם הוא"ו של כבוד שהיא בחי' הקדושה הנ"ל הוא בחי' ט"ל אורות שכנגד זה הם ל"ט מלאכות שבמשכן כמבפ"נ כי שם עיקר הקדושה והכבוד בחי' ונקדש בכבודי, וע"כ תיכף אחר יו"כ ציוה משה על מלאכת המשכן:
units.en:
Afterwards one engages in repentance throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance — and repentance encompasses also the dimension of the two unifications above, the dimension of the letters of תשובה — tashuv-Hay, as is brought. And this is the dimension of "return to Me" — the dimension of the Lower Unification — "and I will return to you" — the dimension of the Supernal Unification — the dimension of "I will not enter the Jerusalem above", etc., as above. And through repentance one proceeds from level to level until one comes to the understanding of Torah in its depth — which is the dimension of Yom Kippur, on which the Torah — the Second Tablets — was given, and which corresponds to the dimension of Bina, as is known. Then the two unifications shine in great light — and therefore one also says Boruch Shem aloud [on Yom Kippur].

And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught (Shabbos 119a): "to the Holy One of G-d — honored" — this is Yom Kippur, etc. The Torah said: honor it with clean garments — for then the light of honor is completed, and also the Vav of Kovod which is the dimension of holiness. And honor and pride are the dimension of G-d's garment — the dimension of "G-d reigns, He is clothed in pride" [Ps. 93:1], as is explained in the main text. Therefore the Torah said: honor it with clean garments. And this is the dimension of the candles lit on Yom Kippur — the dimension of "therefore in the places of light honor G-d" [Is. 24:15], as is brought in the Shulchan Aruch — for then the light of honor shines — the dimension of "and the earth illuminated from His honor" [Ezek. 43:2]. And one merits then to illuminating speech — the dimension of the holy prayers and speeches one is engaged in all that day. And also the Vav of Kovod — which is the dimension of holiness above — is the dimension of thirty-nine Tal-lights, corresponding to which are the thirty-nine labors of the Sanctuary, as is explained in the main text — for there is the essential holiness and honor — the dimension of "and it shall be sanctified by My glory" [Ex. 29:43]. And therefore immediately after Yom Kippur Moshe commanded regarding the work of the Sanctuary.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is what one prays: "and in Your holiness Your praisers give praise each day, Selah", etc. And this is what one prays: "and so sanctify Your Name" etc. — corresponding to the dimension of holiness above. And "and so grant Your fear" — corresponding to the dimension of honor above, the dimension of "to fear the honored Name." And afterward one prays "and so grant honor, G-d, to Your people" — that Israel too merit the honor above. And this is: "praise to those who fear You" — praise is the dimension of speech, as is explained in the main text. And "good hope," etc. — this corresponds to the dimension of Yetzira and Asiya, which are the dimension of the vessel for the letters Vav-Hay, as is explained in the Kavanos. This is the dimension of the Lower Unification — the dimension of Metatron which nests in Yetzira, etc.

And one must pray most for this unification — for "He will not enter the Jerusalem above until the Jerusalem below is established" — as the Sages, z"l, taught. And as is understood also in the main text: when the herbs sprouted, etc. — specifically then the Minister of the World said: "May the honor of G-d be forever." And this is "and the opening of speech for those who hope in You" — for specifically then the mouth and speech opens, as is understood in the main text. And this is "and joy for Your land", etc., and "the growth of the glory of David Your servant," etc. — for in this depends the redemption, as is understood in the main text.

qualifications.text: The supplied rabbinic citation is שבת קי"ט, without an amud. The quoted interpretation of “honored” as Yom Kippur and the instruction to honor it with clean garments occur in Shabbos 119a; the English corrects the historical 119b locator without changing the Hebrew.

The supplied ונקדש בכבודי refers to the Sanctuary being sanctified by “My glory,” corresponding to Exodus 29:43. It does not say “through My honored ones I will be sanctified.” The English preserves the passive construction and the divine glory as the means of sanctification.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואחר יו"כ מתחילין לכנוס החסדים כי עיקר תיקון המלכות שהוא בחי' כבוד הוא ע"H החסדים כ"ש והוכן בחסד כסא וכמובא לעיל, וזה בחלי' כי לשמך תן כבוד על חסדך וכו' וזה בחי' יעלזו חסדים בכבוד, וכן שמירת הברית הוא בחי' חסדים בחי' שומר הברית והחסד וכתיבושמר ה' א' לך את הברית ואת החסד, וכן האור של הדיבור הוא בחי' חסד שהוא בחי' אור יום בחי' יומם יצוה ה' חסדו וכמובא בסי' י"ג, וזה בחי' להגיד בבוקר חסדך, וכן תבונת התורה שהוא בחי' שמים כמבפ"נ זה בחי' חסדים בחי' ה' בהשמים חסדך, וזה בחי' לעושה השמים בתבונה כי לעולם חסדו, עד שביום ראשון של סוכות נמשכין חסדים גדולים מאד ואז נכנסין לסוכה שהיא בחי' סוכה עליונה בחי' בינה בחי' תבונת התורה הנ"ל, וסוכהתתאה היא בחי' סגוכת דוד בחי' מלכות בחי' כבוד הנ"ל, והם בעצמם הם בחי' שני היחודים הנ"ל רק מחמת שעיקר עבודתינו הוא בבחי' היחודא תתאה הנ"ל,וה בחי' סוכה שהן אותיותך כ"ו ה"ס כמובא בזוה"ק, וע"כ ארז"ל תשבו כעין תדורו איש ואשתו וכו' שזה בחי' היחודא תתאה הנ"ל, וע"כ צריכין ליזהר בכבוד הסוכה ואסור לעשות בה תשמיש בזוי כמבואר בשו"ע, כי הוא בחי' כבוד הנ"ל, וגם אסור ליהנות מעצי הסוכה כל שבעה דחיילא קדושה עלייהו וכמו שארז"ל כי היא בבחי' קדושה הנ"ל שהוא בחי' הוא"ו של כבוד, וע"כ צריכין לדבר בה רק דברי קדושה בחי' דיבורים המאירים הנ"ל, זוה בחי' השמחה של סוכות בחי' יעלזו חסידים בכבוד וכתיב לכן שמח לבי ויגל כבודי, וגם הדיבור המאיר הוא בחי' שמחה בחי'שמחה לאיש במענה פיו וכן תבונת התורה לעומקה היא בחי' שמחה וזה בחי' (משלי כ"ג) בני אם חכם לבך (בחי' בינהלבא) ישמח לבי גם אני ותעלוזנה כליותי בדבר שפתיך מישרים בחי' הדיבור הנ"ל:
units.en:
After Yom Kippur the loving-kindnesses begin to enter — for the essential rectification of Malchus — which is the dimension of honor — is through loving-kindnesses, as it is written: "and through kindness a throne is established", as is brought above. And this is the dimension of "for Your Name give honor upon Your loving-kindness", etc. And this is the dimension of "the loving-kindnesses exult in honor" [Ps. 149:5]. And likewise: guarding the Bris is in the dimension of loving-kindnesses — the dimension of "guarding the covenant and the loving-kindness", and it is written: "and G-d your G-d will guard for you the covenant and the loving-kindness" [Deut. 7:12]. And likewise: the illuminating light of speech is the dimension of Chesed (loving-kindness) — which is the dimension of the light of day — the dimension of "by day G-d commands His loving-kindness" [Ps. 42:9], as is brought in Siman 13. And this is the dimension of "to declare in the morning Your loving-kindness." And likewise: the understanding of Torah — which is the dimension of Shamayim (heavens) as is explained in the main text — is the dimension of loving-kindnesses — the dimension of "G-d, in the heavens is Your loving-kindness" [Ps. 36:6]. And this is the dimension of "to the One Who makes the heavens with understanding — for His loving-kindness is eternal" [Ps. 136:5].

Until on the first day of Sukkos, great loving-kindnesses flow and one enters the Sukka — which is the dimension of the Supernal Sukka — the dimension of Bina — the dimension of the understanding of Torah above. And the Lower Sukka is the dimension of the Sukkas Dovid — the dimension of Malchus — the dimension of honor above. And they themselves are the dimension of the two unifications above — but because the essential work is in the dimension of the Lower Unification — this is the dimension of Sukka, the letters Kaf-Vav and Hay-Samech, as is brought in the Zohar. And therefore the Sages, z"l, taught: "you shall dwell as you normally dwell — a man and his wife", etc. — the dimension of the Lower Unification above. And therefore one must be careful of the honor of the Sukka and it is forbidden to perform a degrading use of it, as is explained in the Shulchan Aruch — for it is the dimension of honor above. And also it is forbidden to benefit from the wood of the Sukka all seven days — for "holiness rests upon them," as the Sages, z"l, said — for it is in the dimension of holiness above, the dimension of the Vav of honor. And therefore one must speak in it only words of holiness — the dimension of the illuminating speech above. And this is the dimension of the joy of Sukkos — the dimension of "the pious ones exult in honor", and it is written "therefore my heart rejoices and my honor is glad" [Ps. 16:9]. And also: illuminating speech is the dimension of joy — the dimension of "joy to a man is the answer of his mouth" [Prov. 15:23]. And likewise: the understanding of Torah in its depth is the dimension of joy. And this is the dimension of (Proverbs 23): "my son, if your heart is wise (the dimension of Bina in the heart) — my heart too rejoices; and my kidneys sing when your lips speak uprightly" — the dimension of illuminating speech above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is "and so the Tzadikim shall see and rejoice" — a Tzadik is one who guards the Bris, as is known. And "You shall reign" — the dimension of the revelation of His sovereignty and honor. And "Holy are You" — the dimension of holiness above. And "awesome is Your Name" — the dimension of honor above, the dimension of "to fear the honored and awesome Name," the dimension of the awe of sovereignty (mora d'malchus). And "there is no G-d besides You" — for this is the dimension of it being sufficient in His G-dliness for every creature, as is explained in the main text (and this is the dimension of "to rectify the world under the sovereignty of the Almighty"). And one concludes with the blessing of HaMelech HaKadosh, as above.

And because at that time one is engaged in building Malchus and revealing the holy honor — the accusations and judgments intensify most strongly through what was blemished in holy Malchus — primarily through pride and the pursuit of honor, as is explained in the main text. Therefore G-d commanded us to sound the Shofar — which by its nature startles the heart and humbles pride. And this is: "a day of Teruah shall it be for you" — for Teruah is the dimension of the nullification and breaking of pride, as is explained in the discourse Mishpatim, Siman 10.

qualifications.text: The first supplied expression is יעלזו חסדים בכבוד, using חסדים, “loving-kindnesses,” whereas the later expression is יעלזו חסידים בכבוד, using חסידים, “pious ones.” The English preserves the distinction. Psalm 149:5 has חסידים; that parallel does not change the first expression in the supplied Hebrew.

The supplied כי לשמך תן כבוד על חסדך directs the honor to “Your Name” and connects it with “Your loving-kindness.” The English retains those relationships without adding the unsupplied continuation of the verse.

The supplied ושמר ה' א' לך את הברית ואת החסד corresponds to Deuteronomy 7:12, which includes the covenant and loving-kindness being kept “for you.” The English locator is corrected from the historical Deuteronomy 7:9 without changing the quotation.

The supplied סוכה שהן אותיותך כ"ו ה"ס associates the Sukka with the letter groups כ"ו (Kaf-Vav, 26) and ה"ס (Hay-Samech, 65). Their combined numerical value is 91, as is the value of סוכה. The irregular אותיותך remains unchanged in the Hebrew; the English gives the contextual letter-group relationship without claiming that the groups literally spell complete Divine Names or asserting an original-print correction.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וזה בחי' הד' מינים שבלולב שמרמזין על ארבע אותיות השם הק' שהם בחי' יחודא עילאה ויחודא תתאה שעי"ז זוכין לדיבורים המאירים, וע"כ אומרים בהם את החלל וע"כ מברכין על נטילת לולב שהוא כנגד הוא"ו בחי' שמירת הברית שכולל שני היחודים הנ"ל כמבפ"נ, גם כי פרי עץ הדר מרמז על בחי' מלכות בחי' כבוד בחי' כבוד הדר מלכותו, וזה בחי' הוד והדר לבשת בחי' ה' מלך גאות לבש הנ"ל, כפות תמרים בחי' צדיק כתמר יפרח בחי' שמירת הברית, ענף עץ עבות ואר"ל הדס דומה לעינים זה בחי' תב ונת התורה שכולל כל העיי"ן פנים לתורה, וזה בחי' גל עיני ואביטה נפלאות מתורתיך, ערבה דומה לשפתים זה בחי' הדיבורים המאירים הנ"ל, ורז"ל דרשו פרי עץ הדר זה אברהם שהדרו הקב"ה בשיבה טובה זה בחי' כבוד בחי' ונגד זקיניו כבוד, וע"כ הוא הראשון שנאמר בו איך שהיה כבודו לאין נגד השי"ת כ"ש ואנכי עפר ואפר וכמו שארז"ל, כפות תמרים זה יצחק וכו' יצחק ורבקה הם מבחי' בינה כמבואר בליקוטי תורה להאריז"ל, פ' תולדות זה בחי' תבונות התורה, ענף עץ עבות זה יעקב שזכה לבחי' דיבור המאיר בחי' וזאת אשר דיבר להם אביהם וכמובן במאמר רומה על השמים סי' ע"ד ונתקיים בו לא ימיש ספר התורה הזה מפיך וכו' ומפי זרע זרעך אמר ה' מעתה ועד עולם כי השארת דיבוריו הק' נשאר אצל כל זרעו אחריו לדורותעולםך, והוא בעצמו היה זרע זרעו של אברהם שממנו התחילה התורה להאיר בעולם בבחי' שני אלפים תורה שארז"ל ועיין פנים מובא פסוק זה לא ימיש וכו' ותבין ביותר, וערבי נחל זה יוסף בחי' שמירת הברית הנ"ל, ועוד יש לפרש גם באופן אחר ומכוון ג"כ לענינינו, ועוד דרשו פרי עץ הדר זו שרה בחי' מלכות בחי' כבוד, כפות תמרים זו רבקה בחי' תבונת התורה כנ"ל, ענף עץ עבות זו לאה בחי' עלמא דאתכסיא בחי' קבלה בחי' יחודא עילאה, וע"כ באמת היה יוסף עתיד לצאת ממנה אלא שהתפללה לאה כשארז"ל ויצא מרחל בחי' עלמא דאתגליא בחי' הלכה בחי' יחודא תתאה ששם צריכין שמירה ביותר, וע"כ מסר יעקב כל חכמתו ליוסף כי היה כלול משני בחי' היהודים הנ"ל שהם בחי' הלכה וקבלה רזין ורזין דרזין, ויעקב בעצמו שזכה לייחד שני היחודים הנ"ל ע"כ נשא את לאה ואת רחל, ועוד דרשו שמרמזין על הסנהדרין שהם עוסקין לגלות תבונת התורה בהלכה ובקבלה, ועוד דרשו שמרמז על בחי' כל עצמותי תאמרנה וכו' כי אתרוג דומה ללב ששם עיקר שלימות הכבוד לכבד את ה' בכל לבו שלא ייה בבחי' בשפתיו כבדוני וכו' כמבואר במאמר להמשיך שלום סי' י"ד וכבוד גימט' לב כידוע, לולב דומה לשדרה שדרך שם נמשכת טיפת ההולדה בחי' שמירת הברית וע"כ יש בה ח"י חוליות נגד בחי' צדיק ח"י עלמין כידוע, הדס דומה לעינים וערבה לשפתים מבואר כבר לעיל, וזה שמובא בכוונת הנענועים לכוין ששה צירופי השם יה"ו שהם במילואם גימט' ט"ל בחי' הטל אורות הנ"ל הכלולים בהוא"ו של כבוד שזה בחי' הלולב כנ"ל:
units.en:
And this is the dimension of the four species of the lulav — which allude to the four letters of the holy Name — which are the dimension of the Supernal and Lower Unifications — through which one merits illuminating speech. And therefore one says the Hallel with them. And therefore one blesses specifically on taking the lulav, which corresponds to the Vav — the dimension of guarding the Bris, which encompasses both unifications, as is explained in the main text. Also: Peri Eitz Hadar alludes to the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of honor — the dimension of "the honor and majesty of His sovereignty." And this is the dimension of "splendor and glory You wear" — the dimension of "G-d reigns, He is clothed in pride," as above. Kapos Smorim — the dimension of the Tzadik, the dimension of "the righteous one flourishes like a date-palm" — the dimension of guarding the Bris. Anaf Eitz Avos — and the Sages, z"l, taught: the hadas resembles eyes — the dimension of the understanding of Torah that encompasses all seventy faces of Torah — and this is the dimension of "uncover my eyes and I will behold wonders of Your Torah" [Ps. 119:18]. Arova — resembles lips — the dimension of the illuminating speech above. And the Sages, z"l, expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Avraham — the dimension for which G-d beautified him with good old age — the dimension of honor — the dimension of "and before the elders is honor" [Is. 24:23]. And therefore he was the first of whom it is written how his honor was as nothing compared to G-d's — the dimension of "and I am dust and ashes" [Gen. 18:27], as the Sages, z"l, taught.

Kapos Smorim — this is Yitzchok — etc. Yitzchok and Rivka are from the dimension of Bina, as is explained in Likutay Torah of the Ar"i z"l, Parshas Toldos — the dimension of the understanding of Torah. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Yaakov — who merited the illuminating speech — the dimension of "and this is what their father spoke to them" [Gen. 49:28], as is understood in the discourse Roma al HaShamayim, Siman 74. And it was fulfilled in him: "the book of this Torah shall not depart from your mouth" [Josh. 1:8] — and "from the mouth of your seed's seed, says G-d, from now and forever" [Is. 59:21] — for the enduring speech of his holiness remained with all his progeny after him for eternal generations. And he himself was the seed of the seed of Avraham, from whom Torah began to shine in the world in the dimension of the two millennia of Torah, as the Sages, z"l, taught. See the main text where that verse is brought — and you will understand more. And Arvay Nachal — this is Yosef — the dimension of guarding the Bris above.

And more: one can also explain in another manner — aligned also with our topic. And more was expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Sarah — the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of honor. Kapos Smorim — this is Rivka — the dimension of the understanding of Torah, as above. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Leah — the dimension of the hidden world, the dimension of Kabbalah, the dimension of the Supernal Unification. And in truth Yosef was destined to come from her — but Leah prayed, as the Sages, z"l, taught — and [Yosef] came from Rachel — the dimension of the revealed world, the dimension of Halacha, the dimension of the Lower Unification — where vigilance is most needed. And therefore Yaakov transmitted all his wisdom to Yosef — for he was comprised of both dimensions of the two unifications — which are the dimensions of Halacha and Kabbalah, mysteries and mysteries of mysteries. And Yaakov himself — who merited to unify both unifications — therefore married both Leah and Rachel. And more was expounded: they allude to the Sanhedrin — who engage in revealing the understanding of Torah in Halacha and Kabbalah. And more was expounded: the dimension of "all my bones shall say," etc. — for the esrog resembles the heart, wherein is the essential completeness of honor — to honor G-d with all one's heart — so that it not be in the dimension of "with their lips they honor Me" [Is. 29:13], etc. — as is explained in the discourse L'Hamshich Sholom, Siman 14. And Kovod (honor) has the numerical value of Lev (heart), as is known. The lulav resembles the spine — through which the drop of procreation is drawn — the dimension of guarding the Bris. And therefore it has eighteen vertebrae corresponding to the dimension of Tzadik Chai Olamim (the Tzadik who is Life of the Worlds), as is known. The hadas resembles the eyes, and the arova resembles the lips — already explained above. And this is what is brought in the Kavanos of the wavings (neanu'im) — to intend the six permutations of the Name Yud-Hay-Vav which in their full spelling have the numerical value of Tal [dew = 39] — the dimension of the dew-lights above, included in the Vav of honor, which is the dimension of the lulav, as above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And therefore Teruah is the dimension of Yaakov, who is the dimension of "the heel (akev) — humility (anava) — the fear of G-d" [Prov. 22:4]. And he merited to perfect the dimension of the two unifications, as the Sages, z"l, taught: the Tribes said Shema Yisroel, and he responded Boruch Shem. And because this requires extra vigilance, as above — one says it in a whisper, as the Sages taught.

And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught: Teruah is the letters of TORAH-AYIN — the dimension of the seventy faces of Torah — for through all of this one merits to come to the understanding of Torah in its depth. And therefore one sounds the Shofar, which alludes to Bina, as above. And because for this one needs to nullify pride and rectify the blemish of the Bris — therefore the Sages, z"l, established to sound Sh'vorim and Teruah: Sh'vorim corresponds to the nullification of pride, the dimension of "before breaking comes pride" [Prov. 16:18], and likewise "before breaking comes pride." And Teruah — yelulai yelil — this corresponds to the blemish of the Bris, which comes from the husk called Lilit — for she wails (milaleis), as is brought. And Sh'vorim first — for this depends on that: the dimension of "and a strange woman traps his precious soul" [Prov. 6:26], as is explained in the main text. And it is also brought that Sh'vorim-Teruah corresponds to Yetzira and Asiya — the dimension of the Lower Unification above.

qualifications.text: The supplied אומרים בהם את החלל is read contextually as saying Hallel with the four species. Its unusual spelling החלל remains unchanged in the Hebrew; this does not establish a correction against an original printed edition.

The two supplied quotations are לא ימיש ספר התורה הזה מפיך and ומפי זרע זרעך אמר ה' מעתה ועד עולם. The first retains its second-person address and corresponds to Joshua 1:8; the second also addresses “your seed's seed” and preserves “says G-d, from now and forever,” corresponding to Isaiah 59:21. The omitted intervening words are not supplied.

The supplied שני בחי' היהודים הנ"ל occurs amid repeated references to the two unifications, Halacha and Kabbalah. The English reads it contextually as the two unifications. The literal word היהודים remains in the Hebrew without a claimed original-print correction. The following רזין ורזין דרזין denotes mysteries and mysteries of mysteries.

The supplied phrase ששה צירופי השם יה"ו שהם במילואם גימט' ט"ל associates six permutations of the Name יה"ו in their full spelling with ט"ל, whose numerical value is 39. The source does not specify the expanded spellings or say how the six permutations are to be counted. The English preserves the stated association without independently asserting that a sum of all six expanded permutations equals 39.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואח"כ בשמיני

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And once he said that on Rosh HaShanah he performs matters and rectifications
— even for the souls of those close to him who come to him on Rosh HaShanah —
that throughout the entire year, even he himself cannot perform them.

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ואח"כ בשמיני is an incomplete temporal discourse heading. The words following “on the Eighth” are not present in this heading and are not supplied from the next owner.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ בשמיני עצרת אז נשלמים היחודים הק' בשלימות ואז זיווגא דמטרוניתא פנים בפנים ועי"ז באים לתבונת התורה לעומקא, וע"כ כל ישראל עולין אז לתורה ונותנין כבוד לתורה כי נשלם אז הכבוד דקדושה בשלימות, ואז השמחה גדולה מאד כי ע"י כל התיקונים הנ"ל נעשה שמחה כנ"ל, וזה בחי' ישמחו השמים ותגל הארץ שמרומז בר"ת השם הק' הכולל שני היחודים הנ"ל כי אז השמחה בשלימות, וע"כ מסיימין אז התורה בענין שבירת הלוחות כי הלוחות הם סוד אותיות ו"ה כמו שארז"ל על פסוק והלוחות מעשה אלהים המה וכשראה משה מעשה העגל וארז"ל שלא עשו זו המעשה אלא כדי להתיר להם עריות ובזה פגמו העיקר בבחי' יחודא תתאה אותיות ו"ה וע"כ שיבר משה את הלוחות, וגם כי עי"ז נתרחקו מבחי' תבונת התורה ביותר שזה בעצמו בחי' הלוחות שהיו מבחי' בינה כידוע ועיין ליקוטי תורה להאריז"ל פ' כי תשא ועיין שם גם בסוד המסווה של משה ועיין מגלה עמוקות אופן קכ"ה מבואר שם ג"כ מענין הלוחות ומכוון ג"כ לענינינו, ואח"כ התפלל משה הרבה עד שזכה לתקן היחודים הנ"ל ולזכות את ישראל בתבונות התורה ואז קיבל הלוחות שניות וזה שמתחילין תיכף אח"כ בראשית ברא אלהים את השמים ואת הארץ מרמז על שני היחודים הנ"ל עיין מגלה עמוקות אופן רכ"ז וגם באופן קכ"ה הנ"ל, וזה והארץ היתה תוהו ובוהו וכו' מרמז על הד' מלכיות דסט"א הרוצים להפריד ח"ו בחי' היחודים הנ"ל, ורוח א' מרחפת על פני המיים זה רוחו של משיח שהוא יתקן היחודים הנ"ל בשלימות ויזכה את ישראל לתבונות התורה לעומקא שזה בחי' התגלות התורה שיהיה אז כי הוא יזכה בשלימות לרוח חכמה ובינה כ"ש ונחה עליו רוח ה' וכו' וזה ויאמר אלהים יהי אור דא רז בחי' רזין ורזין דרזין הנ"ל ויהי ערב ויהי בוקר יום אחד בחי' שלימות היחודים הנ"ל שזה בחי' כל מעשה בראשית עד הפרשה של קדושת שבת כמבפ"נ, וזהו שארז"ל בזכות ולקחתם לכם ביום הראשון אני נגלה לכם ראשון כי כשפוגמין ח"ו בבחי' היחודים הנ"ל והעיקר בבחי' יחודא תתאה בחי' הלבשת הנהגתו ית' בבחי' מט"ט שהוא בחי' כנף כמבפ"נ אזי נשתלשל מזה בחי' הסתרת פנים ח"ו כי הוא בעצמו בבחי' הלבשה והסתרה כמובן במאמר זה על מאמר רז"ל עוף אחד יש בשעה שמפריש את כנפיו הוא מחשיך את השמש, ועיין עוד במאמר אית לן בירא בדברא סי' ל"א, וע"כ באמת טעה אחר על ידו וקיצץ בנטיעות ר"ל אבל בזכות הד' מינים שמרמזין על שלימות התיקונים הנ"ל ע"כ זוכין עי"ז להתגלות אלהותו ית' בבחי' ולא יכנף עוד את מורך שיהיו לעתיד לבוא, ואז יזכו לתבונת התורה לעומקא שזה ג"כ בחי' התגלות אלהותו שבפנימיות התורה כמבואר במ"א, וזה בחי' והיו עיניך רואות את מורך שעי"ז זוכין לתבונת התורה לעומקא כשארז"ל וכמו שאמר רבי האי דמחדדנא טפי וכו', וזה ופורע לכם מן הראשון זה עשו בחי' מלכות דסט"א שהוא היפוך מכל הנ"ל שזה בחי' כי יד על כס י"ה אין השם שלם וכו', וכמו שארז"ל כל זמין שזרעו של עמלק קיים כאילו כנף מכסה את הפנים, וה ובונה לכם ראשון זה בית המקדש זה בחי' הט"ל אורות שהם בחי' הלט מלאכות שבמשכן שנקרא מקדש כמו שארז"ל, וגם כי שם עיקר המשכת כל התיקונים הנ"ל כי שם עיקר התגלות כבודו ית' ושם עיקר המשכת היחודים הנ"ל בחי' חדר המטות שנקרא הביהמק"ד כשארז"ל והכהנים העוסקין בעבודה מוזהרין ביותר על קדושת הברית, ושם עיקר המשכת תבונת התורה בחי' כי מציון תצא תורה ע"י הסנהדרין היושבין בלשכת הגזית, וזה ומביא לכם ראשון זה מלך המשיח כי הוא ימשיך כל התיקונים הנ"ל בתכלית השלימות: (בדרוש הזה יש דברים סתומים במקצת וזה מחמת שבפירוש שני היחודים הנ"ל אי אפשר לבאר כל כך וק"ל):
units.en:
Afterwards on Sh'mini Atzeres the sacred unifications are completed in their fullness — and then the union of the Matron face to face — and through this one comes to the understanding of Torah in its depth. And therefore all Israel ascend to the Torah and give honor to the Torah — for the honor of holiness is then completed in its fullness. And then the joy is exceedingly great — for through all these rectifications joy comes, as above. And this is the dimension of "the heavens shall rejoice and the earth shall be glad" — hinted in the abbreviation of the holy Name which encompasses both unifications — for then joy is complete. And therefore one concludes the Torah with the matter of the breaking of the Tablets — for the Tablets are the secret of the letters Vav-Hay, as the Sages, z"l, taught on the verse "and the Tablets were the work of G-d". And when Moshe saw the deed of the Golden Calf — the Sages, z"l, taught that they did this only to permit licentiousness — and through this they blemished primarily in the dimension of the Lower Unification, the letters Vav-Hay. And therefore Moshe broke the Tablets. And through this they distanced themselves most greatly from the understanding of Torah — which itself is the dimension of the Tablets that were from the dimension of Bina, as is known. See Likutay Torah of the Ar"i z"l, Parshas Ki Sisa — and see there also the secret of the veil (masveh) of Moshe — and see Megila Amukkos, Ofen 125, where the matter of the Tablets is explained and is also aligned with our topic. And afterward Moshe prayed greatly until he merited to rectify the unifications above and to cause Israel to merit the understanding of Torah — and then he received the Second Tablets. And this is why one immediately begins Bereishis bara Elokim es ha-Shamayim v'es ha-Aretz — hinting at the two unifications, see Megila Amukkos, Ofen 227 and also in Ofen 125 above. And "and the earth was void and formless," etc. — hinting at the four kingdoms of the Stra Achra that wish to sever the two unifications. And "the spirit of G-d hovered over the face of the waters" — the spirit of the Messiah — who will perfectly rectify the two unifications and will cause Israel to merit the understanding of Torah in its depth — which is the revelation of Torah that will take place then — for he will merit in fullness the spirit of wisdom and understanding, as it is written: "and the spirit of G-d shall rest upon him," etc. [Is. 11:2]. And this is "And G-d said: Let there be light" — this is a mystery — the dimension of mysteries and mysteries of mysteries. And "and there was evening and there was morning — one day" — the dimension of the completeness of the two unifications — the dimension of all the work of creation until the sanctity of Shabbos, as is explained in the main text. And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught: "In merit of 'take for yourselves on the first day' — I will reveal Myself to you as the First" — for when one blemishes in the two unifications and primarily in the Lower Unification — in the dimension of the investment of His governance in the dimension of Metatron who is the dimension of a wing (konaf), as is explained in the main text — thereby the concealment of the divine face is derived, heaven forbid. For he himself is in the dimension of investment and concealment, as is understood in this discourse from the Sages' saying: "there is a certain bird — when it spreads its wings it darkens the sun." See also the discourse Ais Lanu Bira B'Dara, Siman 31. And therefore in truth the Other erred through it and cut the plantings (kitzetz b'neti'os), heaven forbid. But in merit of the four species which allude to the completeness of the rectifications above — one merits the revelation of His G-dliness — the dimension of "and He will no longer cover your Teacher" [Is. 30:20] that will be in the future. And then one will merit the understanding of Torah in its depth — which is also the dimension of the revelation of His G-dliness in the inner dimension of Torah, as is explained elsewhere. And this is the dimension of "and your eyes shall behold your Teacher" — through which one merits the understanding of Torah in its depth, as the Sages, z"l, taught, and as Rabbi said: "the reason I am sharper," etc. And "He pays back to you from the First — this is Esov" — the Malchus d'Stra Achra, the opposite of all the above — the dimension of "for a hand is upon the throne of Yah" — the Name is not complete, etc. And as the Sages, z"l, taught: as long as the seed of Amaleik exists, it is as if a wing covers the divine face. And "He builds for you the First — this is the Temple" — the dimension of the thirty-nine lights, which are the dimension of the thirty-nine labors of the Sanctuary called Mikdash, as the Sages, z"l, taught. And also: there is the essential drawing of all these rectifications — for there is the essential revelation of His honor and there is the essential drawing of the two unifications — the dimension of the bridal chamber (cheder hamitos) called the Temple, as the Sages, z"l, taught. And the priests engaged in the service are most strictly admonished regarding the holiness of the Bris. And there is the essential drawing of the understanding of Torah — the dimension of "for from Tzion shall go forth Torah" — through the Sanhedrin sitting in the Chamber of Hewn Stone. And "He brings for you the First — this is King Messiah" — for he will draw all these rectifications to ultimate completeness.

[Note: In this discourse there are some matters that are somewhat concealed — this is because it is impossible to elaborate so much on the explanation of the two unifications mentioned here — and it is easily understood.]

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And therefore one sounds a simple [Tekia] before it and after it. The simple Tekia [תקיעה] — its letters hint at the Supernal Unification, as is understood. And afterward Teruah — the dimension of the Lower Unification above. And afterward one sounds a simple Tekia after it — for in the future even the Lower Unification will be in the dimension of the letters Yud-Hay, as is brought in the holy writings — the dimension of "on that day G-d will be One and His Name One" [Zech. 14:9]. And therefore one does not sound [the Shofar] on Shabbos — for then all these dimensions flow of themselves through the holiness of Shabbos itself, as is explained elsewhere.

The Three Blessings

And this is the dimension of Malchuyos — corresponding to the dimension of honor, the dimension of Malchus above. Zichronos — corresponding to the dimension of the holiness of the Bris above — and therefore one begins with the verses of Noach: "and even Noach he remembered with love", etc., "when You brought the floodwaters", etc. — which was primarily through the sin of the blemish of the Bris. And Noach was "a righteous, wholesome man, guarding the Bris". And likewise in most of the verses of Zichronos the word Bris (covenant) is mentioned (and this is the dimension of "He remembered His covenant forever" [Ps. 111:5]). Shofaros — corresponding to Bina, the dimension of the understanding of Torah in its depth above. And therefore one speaks there greatly of the Shofar-sound of the Giving of the Torah — and also the Shofar of the ingathering of exiles, which will also occur through these rectifications above. And then Israel will merit the understanding of Torah in its depth, as Rashi explained on the verse "let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth" [Song 1:2], and as is brought in the Zohar and in his words, z"l, in the discourse L'Hamshich Hashgacha, Siman 13, and likewise in Siman 33, regarding the Torah that will be revealed in the future.

The Ten Days of Repentance and Yom Kippur

Afterwards one engages in repentance throughout all the Ten Days of Repentance — and repentance encompasses also the dimension of the two unifications above, the dimension of the letters of תשובה — tashuv-Hay, as is brought. And this is the dimension of "return to Me" — the dimension of the Lower Unification — "and I will return to you" — the dimension of the Supernal Unification — the dimension of "I will not enter the Jerusalem above", etc., as above. And through repentance one proceeds from level to level until one comes to the understanding of Torah in its depth — which is the dimension of Yom Kippur, on which the Torah — the Second Tablets — was given, and which corresponds to the dimension of Bina, as is known. Then the two unifications shine in great light — and therefore one also says Boruch Shem aloud [on Yom Kippur].

And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught (Shabbos 119b): "to the Holy One of G-d — honored" — this is Yom Kippur, etc. The Torah said: honor it with clean garments — for then the light of honor is completed, and also the Vav of Kovod which is the dimension of holiness. And honor and pride are the dimension of G-d's garment — the dimension of "G-d reigns, He is clothed in pride" [Ps. 93:1], as is explained in the main text. Therefore the Torah said: honor it with clean garments. And this is the dimension of the candles lit on Yom Kippur — the dimension of "therefore in the places of light honor G-d" [Is. 24:15], as is brought in the Shulchan Aruch — for then the light of honor shines — the dimension of "and the earth illuminated from His honor" [Ezek. 43:2]. And one merits then to illuminating speech — the dimension of the holy prayers and speeches one is engaged in all that day. And also the Vav of Kovod — which is the dimension of holiness above — is the dimension of thirty-nine Tal-lights, corresponding to which are the thirty-nine labors of the Sanctuary, as is explained in the main text — for there is the essential holiness and honor — the dimension of "and through My honored ones I will be sanctified" [Lev. 10:3]. And therefore immediately after Yom Kippur Moshe commanded regarding the work of the Sanctuary.

After Yom Kippur — Sukkos through Sh'mini Atzeres

After Yom Kippur the loving-kindnesses begin to enter — for the essential rectification of Malchus — which is the dimension of honor — is through loving-kindnesses, as it is written: "and through kindness a throne is established", as is brought above. And this is the dimension of "for Your sake give honor upon Your loving-kindness", etc. And this is the dimension of "the pious ones exult in honor" [Ps. 149:5]. And likewise: guarding the Bris is in the dimension of loving-kindnesses — the dimension of "guarding the covenant and the loving-kindness", and it is written: "and G-d your G-d will guard for you the covenant and the loving-kindness" [Deut. 7:9]. And likewise: the illuminating light of speech is the dimension of Chesed (loving-kindness) — which is the dimension of the light of day — the dimension of "by day G-d commands His loving-kindness" [Ps. 42:9], as is brought in Siman 13. And this is the dimension of "to declare in the morning Your loving-kindness." And likewise: the understanding of Torah — which is the dimension of Shamayim (heavens) as is explained in the main text — is the dimension of loving-kindnesses — the dimension of "G-d, in the heavens is Your loving-kindness" [Ps. 36:6]. And this is the dimension of "to the One Who makes the heavens with understanding — for His loving-kindness is eternal" [Ps. 136:5].

Until on the first day of Sukkos, great loving-kindnesses flow and one enters the Sukka — which is the dimension of the Supernal Sukka — the dimension of Bina — the dimension of the understanding of Torah above. And the Lower Sukka is the dimension of the Sukkas Dovid — the dimension of Malchus — the dimension of honor above. And they themselves are the dimension of the two unifications above — but because the essential work is in the dimension of the Lower Unification — this is the dimension of Sukka, the letters of which, as is brought in the Zohar, [spell out the two Names]. And therefore the Sages, z"l, taught: "you shall dwell as you normally dwell — a man and his wife", etc. — the dimension of the Lower Unification above. And therefore one must be careful of the honor of the Sukka and it is forbidden to perform a degrading use of it, as is explained in the Shulchan Aruch — for it is the dimension of honor above. And also it is forbidden to benefit from the wood of the Sukka all seven days — for "holiness rests upon them," as the Sages, z"l, said — for it is in the dimension of holiness above, the dimension of the Vav of honor. And therefore one must speak in it only words of holiness — the dimension of the illuminating speech above. And this is the dimension of the joy of Sukkos — the dimension of "the pious ones exult in honor", and it is written "therefore my heart rejoices and my honor is glad" [Ps. 16:9]. And also: illuminating speech is the dimension of joy — the dimension of "joy to a man is the answer of his mouth" [Prov. 15:23]. And likewise: the understanding of Torah in its depth is the dimension of joy. And this is the dimension of (Proverbs 23): "my son, if your heart is wise (the dimension of Bina in the heart) — my heart too rejoices; and my kidneys sing when your lips speak uprightly" — the dimension of illuminating speech above.

The Four Species — The Two Unifications

And this is the dimension of the four species of the lulav — which allude to the four letters of the holy Name — which are the dimension of the Supernal and Lower Unifications — through which one merits illuminating speech. And therefore one says the Hallel with them. And therefore one blesses specifically on taking the lulav, which corresponds to the Vav — the dimension of guarding the Bris, which encompasses both unifications, as is explained in the main text. Also: Peri Eitz Hadar alludes to the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of honor — the dimension of "the honor and majesty of His sovereignty." And this is the dimension of "splendor and glory You wear" — the dimension of "G-d reigns, He is clothed in pride," as above. Kapos Smorim — the dimension of the Tzadik, the dimension of guarding the Bris. Anaf Eitz Avos — and the Sages, z"l, taught: the hadas resembles eyes — the dimension of the understanding of Torah that encompasses all seventy faces of Torah — and this is the dimension of "uncover my eyes and I will behold wonders of Your Torah" [Ps. 119:18]. Arova — resembles lips — the dimension of the illuminating speech above. And the Sages, z"l, expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Avraham — the dimension for which G-d beautified him with good old age — the dimension of honor — the dimension of "and before the elders is honor" [Is. 24:23]. And therefore he was the first of whom it is written how his honor was as nothing compared to G-d's — the dimension of "and I am dust and ashes" [Gen. 18:27], as the Sages, z"l, taught.

Kapos Smorim — this is Yitzchok — etc. Yitzchok and Rivka are from the dimension of Bina, as is explained in Likutay Torah of the Ar"i z"l, Parshas Toldos — the dimension of the understanding of Torah. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Yaakov — who merited the illuminating speech — the dimension of "and this is what their father spoke to them" [Gen. 49:28], as is understood in the discourse Roma al HaShamayim, Siman 74. And it was fulfilled in him: "the book of this Torah shall not depart from your mouth" — and from the mouth of his seed's seed, etc. [Josh. 1:8] — for the enduring speech of his holiness remained with all his progeny after him for eternal generations. And he himself was from the seed of Avraham from whom Torah began to shine in the world in the dimension of the two millennia of Torah, as the Sages, z"l, taught. See the main text where that verse is brought — and you will understand more. And Arvay Nachal — this is Yosef — the dimension of guarding the Bris above.

And more: one can also explain in another manner — aligned also with our topic. And more was expounded: Peri Eitz Hadar — this is Sarah — the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of honor. Kapos Smorim — this is Rivka — the dimension of the understanding of Torah, as above. Anaf Eitz Avos — this is Leah — the dimension of the hidden world, the dimension of Kabbalah, the dimension of the Supernal Unification. And in truth Yosef was destined to come from her — but Leah prayed, as the Sages, z"l, taught — and [Yosef] came from Rachel — the dimension of the revealed world, the dimension of Halacha, the dimension of the Lower Unification — where vigilance is most needed. And therefore Yaakov transmitted all his wisdom to Yosef — for he was comprised of both dimensions of the two unifications — which are the dimensions of Halacha and Kabbalah, the manifest and the hidden hidden. And Yaakov himself — who merited to unify both unifications — therefore married both Leah and Rachel. And more was expounded: they allude to the Sanhedrin — who engage in revealing the understanding of Torah in Halacha and Kabbalah. And more was expounded: the dimension of "all my bones shall say," etc. — for the esrog resembles the heart, wherein is the essential completeness of honor — to honor G-d with all one's heart — so that it not be in the dimension of "with their lips they honor Me" [Is. 29:13], etc. — as is explained in the discourse L'Hamshich Sholom, Siman 14. And Kovod (honor) has the numerical value of Lev (heart), as is known. The lulav resembles the spine — through which the drop of procreation is drawn — the dimension of guarding the Bris. And therefore it has eighteen vertebrae corresponding to the dimension of Tzadik Chai Olamim (the Tzadik who is Life of the Worlds), as is known. The hadas resembles the eyes, and the arova resembles the lips — already explained above. And this is what is brought in the Kavanos of the wavings (neanu'im) — to intend the six permutations of the Name Yud-Hay-Vav which in their full spelling have the numerical value of Tal [dew = 39] — the dimension of the dew-lights above, included in the Vav of honor, which is the dimension of the lulav, as above.

Sh'mini Atzeres — The Sacred Unifications Are Completed

Afterwards on Sh'mini Atzeres the sacred unifications are completed in their fullness — and then the union of the Matron face to face — and through this one comes to the understanding of Torah in its depth. And therefore all Israel ascend to the Torah and give honor to the Torah — for the honor of holiness is then completed in its fullness. And then the joy is exceedingly great — for through all these rectifications joy comes, as above. And this is the dimension of "the heavens shall rejoice and the earth shall be glad" — hinted in the abbreviation of the holy Name which encompasses both unifications — for then joy is complete. And therefore one concludes the Torah with the matter of the breaking of the Tablets — for the Tablets are the secret of the letters Vav-Hay, as the Sages, z"l, taught on the verse "and the Tablets were the work of G-d". And when Moshe saw the deed of the Golden Calf — the Sages, z"l, taught that they did this only to permit licentiousness — and through this they blemished primarily in the dimension of the Lower Unification, the letters Vav-Hay. And through this they distanced themselves most greatly from the understanding of Torah — which itself is the dimension of the Tablets that were from the dimension of Bina, as is known. See Likutay Torah of the Ar"i z"l, Parshas Ki Sisa — and see there also the secret of the veil (masveh) of Moshe — and see Megila Amukkos, Ofen 125, where the matter of the Tablets is explained and is also aligned with our topic. And afterward Moshe prayed greatly until he merited to rectify the unifications above and to cause Israel to merit the understanding of Torah — and then he received the Second Tablets. And this is why one immediately begins Bereishis bara Elokim es ha-Shamayim v'es ha-Aretz — hinting at the two unifications, see Megila Amukkos, Ofen 227 and also in Ofen 125 above. And "and the earth was void and formless," etc. — hinting at the four kingdoms of the Stra Achra that wish to sever the two unifications. And "the spirit of G-d hovered over the face of the waters" — the spirit of the Messiah — who will perfectly rectify the two unifications and will cause Israel to merit the understanding of Torah in its depth — for he will merit in fullness the spirit of wisdom and understanding, as it is written: "and the spirit of G-d shall rest upon him," etc. [Is. 11:2]. And this is "And G-d said: Let there be light" — this is the hidden dimension — the dimension of the hidden hidden. And "and there was evening and there was morning — one day" — the dimension of the completeness of the two unifications — the dimension of all the work of creation until the sanctity of Shabbos, as is explained in the main text. And this is what the Sages, z"l, taught: "In merit of 'take for yourselves on the first day' — I will reveal Myself to you as the First" — for when one blemishes in the two unifications and primarily in the Lower Unification — in the dimension of the investment of His governance in the dimension of Metatron who is the dimension of a wing (konaf), as is explained in the main text — thereby the concealment of the divine face is derived, heaven forbid. For he himself is in the dimension of investment and concealment, as is understood in this discourse from the Sages' saying: "there is a certain bird — when it spreads its wings it darkens the sun." See also the discourse Ais Lanu Bira B'Dara, Siman 31. And therefore in truth the Other erred through it and cut the plantings (kitzetz b'neti'os), heaven forbid. But in merit of the four species which allude to the completeness of the rectifications above — one merits the revelation of His G-dliness — the dimension of "and He will no longer cover your Teacher" [Is. 30:20] that will be in the future. And then one will merit the understanding of Torah in its depth — which is also the dimension of the revelation of His G-dliness in the inner dimension of Torah, as is explained elsewhere. And this is the dimension of "and your eyes shall behold your Teacher" — through which one merits the understanding of Torah in its depth, as the Sages, z"l, taught, and as one of the Rabbis said: "the reason I am sharper," etc. And "He pays back to you from the First — this is Esov" — the Malchus d'Stra Achra, the opposite of all the above — the dimension of "for a hand is upon the throne of Yah" — the Name is not complete, etc. And as the Sages, z"l, taught: as long as the seed of Amaleik exists, it is as if a wing covers the divine face. And "He builds for you the First — this is the Temple" — the dimension of the thirty-nine lights, which are the dimension of the thirty-nine labors of the Sanctuary called Mikdash, as the Sages, z"l, taught. And also: there is the essential drawing of all these rectifications — for there is the essential revelation of His honor and there is the essential drawing of the two unifications — the dimension of the bridal chamber (cheder hamitos) called the Temple, as the Sages, z"l, taught. And the priests engaged in the service are most strictly admonished regarding the holiness of the Bris. And there is the essential drawing of the understanding of Torah — the dimension of "for from Tzion shall go forth Torah" — through the Sanhedrin sitting in the Chamber of Hewn Stone. And "He brings for you the First — this is King Messiah" — for he will draw all these rectifications to ultimate completeness.

Translator's Summary — Siman 11
Siman 11 is built on the two sacred unifications: Shema Yisroel (Supernal Unification / Yichuda Ilaa) and Boruch Shem (Lower Unification / Yichuda Tataah). These require guarding the Bris and nullifying pride. Their perfection yields illuminating speech → deep Torah understanding. The Shofar's Sh'vorim/Teruah addresses both impediments: Sh'vorim = pride; Teruah = the blemish of the Bris. The Boruch Shem is said in a whisper because — like Yaakov's secret — it acknowledges the necessity of the Lower Unification's concealment. On Yom Kippur alone it is said aloud because Israel is then like angels, entirely beyond that concealment. Sh'mini Atzeres = both unifications in their eternal completeness.

qualifications.text: The supplied וע"כ שיבר משה את הלוחות expressly states that Moshe therefore broke the Tablets after the Golden Calf and the blemish of the Lower Unification. The causal statement is retained at that point.

The supplied שזה בחי' התגלות התורה שיהיה אז places the future revelation of Torah between Mashiach's bringing Israel to deep Torah understanding and his reception of the spirit of wisdom and understanding. The English preserves that sequence.

The source's דא רז בחי' רזין ורזין דרזין includes a mystery, mysteries and mysteries of mysteries. These are represented as distinct expressions without reducing both levels to a generic hiddenness description.

The supplied וכמו שאמר רבי האי דמחדדנא טפי attributes the quotation to רבי, Rabbi, without a personal name following that title. The English preserves the attribution and leaves the rest of the quotation abbreviated.

The supplied ולא יכנף עוד את מורך has את marking “your Teacher” as the object of covering. The English preserves this object relationship without naming an additional covering agent or substituting a different verse wording.

The closing parenthesis beginning בדרוש הזה יש דברים סתומים במקצת is part of this source's Hebrew. Its corresponding original English note is retained at the end of the prose, separately from the unowned translator summary.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Book Yerech HaAisonim — in it are explained many wondrous matters from the topic of
the holiness of Rosh HaShanah and the sounding of the Shofar and the prayers of Rosh HaShanah,
and the great merit of one who is privileged to be near a true Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah,
and the topic of the custom that was practiced to go on Erev Rosh HaShanah to pray at the graves of the Tzadikim;
and likewise explained within it are the topics of the holiness of the Ten Days of Repentance,
Yom Kippur, Sukkos, Sh'mini Atzeres, and Simchas Torah, and the holiness of all the mitzvos
of G-d which are observed during them.

units.he: בר"ה עוסקין כל ישראל בבנין המלכות דקדושה ע"י אור הבינה אימא עילאה שזה סוד השופר כמבואר בכוונות. ואח"כ מעלין אותה ממעלה למעלה לבחי' חיבוק ונישוק וזיווג עד שבשמיני עצרת אז הוא זזווגא דמטרוניתא פב"פ כמובא לעיל כ"פ, וזה בחי' כל הענין המבואר בפנים במאמר הנ"ל, ומחמת שעיקר התיקון להביא אותה לבחי' שכינתא בין תריא צדיקיא יתבא שהיא בחי' צדיק העליון וצדיק התחתון המעלה להשכינה מ"נ כדי שתתדבק, ע"כ צריכין לנסוע ולבוא אל הצדיק הדור על ר"ה ואשרי למי שזוכה לשמוע בר"ה חידושי תורה מהצדיק, ועכ"פ נוהגין כל ישראל להתפלל על קברי צדיקים בערב ר"ה כי מקום גניזתם הוא בחי' צדיקים ירשו ארץ שזה בחי' עליית השכינה הנ"ל כמבפ"נ ועיין ליקות"נ סי' ק"ט, וגם כי ע"י הפגם של הלימוד שלא לשמה עי"ז נעשה פירוד ח"ו בין התורה שבע"פ להצדיק שחידש זאת התורה ואינה נכנסת עמו לקבורה כמבפ"נ, וע"כ קודם ר"ה שעוסקין לתקן זאת כנ"ל הולכין להתפלל וללמוד על קברי הצדיקים, וזה בחי' יום תרועה יהיה לכם ומובא בזוה"ק שמרמז על מדתו של יעקב וכן קול השופר מרמז על זה כי יעקב הוא בחי' הצדיק המחדש חידושין דאורייתא בחי' תורה שבע"פ בחי' מלכות ולומד תורתו לשמה כמבפ"נ, וזה בחי' אברהם יצחק יעקב דוד שמרמזין בהתקיעות כמובא, דוד הוא בחי' מלכות בחי' התורה שבע"פ ותיקונה ועלייתה ע"י אברהם שהוא בחי' חסד ואהבה כמבפ"נ. ויצחק הוא בחי' השמחה בחי' וקראת את שמו יצחק על שם הצחוק והשמחה שזה בחי' שמחין ביסורין המבפ"נ כי יצחק הוא הראשון שביקש להתפלל על היסורין כשארז"ל, גם יצחק הוא מבחי' בינה כמובא לעיל בשם הליקויטי תורה להאריז"ל, וזה בחי' נתת שמחה בלבי המ בפ"נ, יעקב הוא בחי' החכמה כ"ש ויעקבני ותרגומו וחכמני וכמבואר בדבריו ז"ל בסי' א' ובסי' ע"ד שעי"ז עיקר בנינה עד שראויה לזיווג כביכול כמבפ"נ, ומחמת שהנשיקין הם ע"י חכמה ע,כ נאמר אצל יעקב בפירוש וישק יעקב לרחל, ועי"ז ממילא נתעורר זיווגא דגופא בגופא בחי' שכינתא בין תרין צדיקיא יתבא, וזה ג"כ סוד יעקב ששרשו בהדעת שמשם הזיווג, וע"כ זכה שיצאו ממנו יוסף ובנימין שהם סוד שני הצדיקים הנ"ל כידוע, וזה בחי' המלך הקדוש שממשיכין על המלכות אור החכמה שהיא בחי' קודש כידוע, וזה בחי' ובכן יתקדש שמך שהוא כנגד בחי' אברהם בחי' חסד ששרשו בחכמה שהיא בחי' שמחה בחי' וגילו ברעדה, ובכן תן כבוד כנגד יעקב בחי' כבוד חכמים ינחלו, ובכן צדיקים כנגד דוד, וזה בחי' צדי"ק וצד"ק המובא בכוונות היינו שמעלין המלכות בחי' צדק אל בחי' צדיק וזה צדיקים תרי משמע כי שכינתא בין תרין צדיקיא יתבא כנ"ל, וזה ועולתה תקפץ פיה כי עכשיו ע"י שיונקין כביכול מבחי' המלכות תורה שבע"פ עי"ז יש להם פה לדבר על הצדיק עתק וכו' אבל כשמעלין אותה מביניהם אז ועולתה תקפץ פיה וכו' כי תעביר ממשלת זדון בחי' ביטול המלכות דסט"א שמתגרה בהאדם בגאוה וגדלות ומסיתו ללמוד שלא לשמהולדבר על הצדיק וכו' וזה ותמלוך וכו' בחי' עלךיית המלכות דקדושה לשלימותה, וזה בחי' תקיעת שופר כי ארז"ל תקיעת שופר חכמה ואינה מלאכה גם תקיעה היא מלשון זיווג כמבואר בכוונות כי ע"י החכמה מזדווגת בין תרין צדיקיא כנ"ל, וזה בחי' תקיעה תרועה תקיעה זה בחי' שכינתא בין תרין צדיקיא יתבא, כי תרועה הוא בחי' השכינה בחי' מלכות בחי' תורה שבע"פ כ"ש ותרועת מלך בו ותרגומו ושכינת מלכיהון בהון, וזהו שארז"ל שתרועה היא אותיות תור"ה עי"ן בחי' עיי"ן פנים לתורה שזה בחי' כלל תורה שבע"פ והיא יושבת בין צדיק עליון שחידש זאת התורה ועכשיו משפיע בה ובין הצדיק התחתון הלומד להתורה וכו' כמבפ"נ, וזה בחי' התקיעה שלפניה ושלאחריה, כי תקיעה היא בחי' ההתקשרות להצדיק כמובא לעיל כ"פ, וע"כ צריכין לתקוע שברים ותרועה כי מחמת שעוסקין בזה להעלות השכינה בחי' תורה שבע"פ מהגלות שהיה לה בפה הלומד שלא לשמה שעי"ז לא די' שגרם צער להשכינה כביכול אלא שמקבל כח עי"ז ויש לו פה לדבר על הצדיק עתק ורודף את הצדיק התחתון וחולק עליו, ולא עוד אלא שרודף גם הצדיק העליון שחידש זאת התורה. אלא שזאת הרדיפה נעשה ממילא לפי תומו מחמת שאין התנא שהוא הצדיק העליון יכול לסבול הנשיקין שלו ואינו יכול להתדבק עמו רוחא ברוחא, וכנגד זה תוקעין שברים ורתועה, שברים הוא גנוחי גנח בחי' האנחה שמתאנח הצדיק העליון על הלמדן שלומד תורתו שלא לשמה ועי"ז אינו יכול להתדבק עמו רוחא ברוחא וע,כ מתאנח ע"ז, כי האנחה הוא מוציא רוח ומכניס רוח היינו שמוציא התנא הצדיק העליון ומרחיק ממנו הרוח של הלומד שלא לשמה ומכניס בעצמו רוח דקדושה, גם כי ע"י האנחה שהיא בבחי' תוסף רוחם יגועון עי"ז נגווע ונאסף התנא מהרוח של הלומד שלא לשמה ומדבק עצמו בהרוח דקדושה עיין כ"ז לקמן בפנים סי' ק"ח ק"ט, אך עכ"ז מאחר שאין הלומד מכוון לרדוף אותו רק שנעשה זאת ממילא כנ"ל ע"כ הוא רק בבחי' גנוחי גנח בחי' אנחה, אבל כנגד בחי' הצדיק התחתון שרודף אותו ממש בכח התורה שבע"פ שלומד כנגד זה תוקעין תרועה שהוא יילולי ייליל, כי הצדיק התחתון מילל וצועק על גודל הצער שיש לו מהלמדן שאינו כראוי בפועל ממש, ומחמת שהרדיפה להצדיק העליון הוא תיכף בשעת הלימוד והרדיפה להצדיק התחתון הוא אחר ה ע"כ שברים קודם לתרועה, ובאמת גם בהלימוד של הצדיק שלומד לשמה שזה בחי' יעקב בחי' תרועה כנ"ל יש בזה ג"כ בחי' שברים ותרועה, כי מחמת שצריך להמשיך בלימוד תורתו חיות רוחני בחי' אורך ימים בימינה וחיות גשמי בחי' בשמאלה עושר וכבוד וע"כ כשהוא דבוק בחיות רוחני הוא בבחי' גנוחי גנח, כי מכריחין אותו מלמעלה להתאנח על חסרון פרנסה של ישראל שזה בחי' שמפילין אותו לבחי' שמאלה של תורה בשביל טובת העולם ואז ברגע זו שנופל לבחי' שמאלה אז מחמת גודל קדושתו אינו יכול לעמוד ולשבות כלל במדריגה זו ותיכף מיילל וצועק על שבא לידי מדה זו וחוזר לבחי' ימינה של תורה כמובן כ"ז בפנים וזה בחי' תרועה. וע"כ בר"ה שאז צריכין להמשיך שני השפעות הנ"ל, וע"כ מתפללין אז הרבה על החיים בחי' אורך ימים בימינה, וכן מזונותיו של אדם קצובות לו מר"ה כמו שארז"ל שזה בחי' בשמאלה עושר וכבוד, ע"כ אז עוסקין הצדיקים בענין זה ביותר וע"כ נקרא זה החודש תשרי שהוא בחי' תשר"ק כשארז,ל כי אז עוסקין בעליית המלכות בחי' תורה שבע"פ שהיא בחי' תשר"ק כמובן במסכת שבת דף ל"א במעשה דהלל עם הגר ע"ש ובפירש"י, וזה בחי' הענין שיש אז בין יעקב לעשו כמובא בזוה"ק כי מחמת שגם הצדיק צריך ליפול ברגע קלה לבחי' שמאלה בשביל להמשיך ממון ופרנסה לישראל ע"כ יש לתורת התנא והצדיק שני משמעות בחי' צדיקים ילכו בם ופושעים יכשלו בם, ומחמת שמבחי' שמאל משם אחיזת עשו הרשע ע"כ הוא מתגרה בישראל ללמוד תורה שלא לשמה לגמרי ח"ו ואז הוא לוקח כל השפע לעצמו ר"ל כידוע, ולא עוד אלא שרודף את הצדיק בחי' יעקב עד שמוכרח לנוס ולברוח ממנו, וע"כ בר"ה שהיא בחי' שמאל כידוע אז עשו רוצה להתגבר ביותר והמקטריגין העומדים לשמאל מקטרגים מאד מחמת הלימוד של הלומדים שאינם הגונים, אך ע"י תקיעת שופר שעי"ז נמשך יראה והתעוררות התשבוה לכל ישראל שזה עיקר תיקון הלימוד שתיהיה יראת חטאו קודמת לחכמתו ותכלית תורה תשובה ומעש"ט, והעיקר בכח הצדיקים העוסקםי בזה בר"ה ביותר עי"ז נמתקים כל הקיטרוגים ונכנע קליפת עשו ואז זוכין ישראל לשפע רוחניות ולשפע גשמיות כנ"ל, וזה תקעו בחודש שופר וכו' כי חק לישראל הוא וכו' ודרז"ל מזה שמזונותיו של אדם קצובין לו מר"ה, ומחמת שהמזונות נמשכין מבחי' שמאלה של תורה שזה בעצמו בחי' ר"ה כנ"ל, ע"כ נתעוררין אז ביותר אותם העומדים לשמאל והתיקון הוא ע"י תקיעת שופר כנ"ל, וזה בחי' אמרו לפני מלכיות כדי שתמליכוני עליכם זה בחי' בנין המלכות מהצירופים של תורה שבע"פ שבפה הלמדן, וזה זכרונות כדי שיבוא זכרוניכם לפני לטובה זה בחי' עליית המלכות להזדווג בין תרין צדיקיא שהן מסטרא דדכורא כידוע, וזה בחי' זכר צדיק לברכה וזה נעשה ע"י בחי' חכמה כנ"ל שזה בחי' זכרון בחי'כי אין זכרון לחכם עם הכסיל, וזה ובמה בשופר שמרומז על עולם הבינה שמשם מתחיל התיקון של כל הנ"ל כמבפ"נ:
units.en:
On Rosh HaShanah all Israel engage in building the holy Malchus through the light of the Supernal Bina (Understanding) — this being the secret of the Shofar, as explained in the Kavanos. Afterwards one elevates it from level to level to the dimension of embrace, kiss, and union — until on Sh'mini Atzeres the union of the Matron face to face is accomplished, as brought many times above.

This is the dimension of the entire matter explained in the main text of the above-mentioned discourse. Because the essential rectification is to bring Malchus to the dimension of "the Divine Presence dwells between two Tzadikim" — namely, the upper Tzadik and the lower Tzadik, who raises feminine waters to the Divine Presence so that she may cleave — therefore one must travel and come to the Tzadik of the generation on Rosh HaShanah. Fortunate is one who merits to hear novel Torah insights from the Tzadik on Rosh HaShanah. And in any case, all Israel customarily pray at the graves of Tzadikim on Erev Rosh HaShanah, for the place of their burial is the dimension of "the Tzadikim shall inherit the land" — the dimension of the elevation of the Divine Presence above, as is explained in the main text. See also Likutay Moharan, Part II, Siman 109.

Also: through the blemish of studying Torah not for its own sake (shelo lishmah), a separation occurs between the Oral Torah and the Tzadik who originated that Torah teaching — and that Torah does not accompany him to the grave, as is explained in the main text. Therefore, before Rosh HaShanah when one engages in rectifying this, one goes to pray and study at the graves of Tzadikim.

This is the dimension of "It shall be a day of Teruah for you." It is brought in the holy Zohar that this alludes to the quality of Yaakov. Likewise the sound of the Shofar alludes to this, for Yaakov is the dimension of the Tzadik who originates novel interpretations of Torah, the dimension of the Oral Torah, the dimension of Malchus, and who studies his Torah for its own sake, as explained in the main text.

This is also the dimension of Avraham, Yitzchok, Yaakov and David, to whom the Shofar soundings allude, as is brought. David is the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of the Oral Torah, whose rectification and ascent take place through Avraham, who is the dimension of kindness and love, as explained in the main text. Yitzchok is the dimension of joy, as in "And you shall call his name Yitzchok," named for laughter and joy. This is the dimension of rejoicing in sufferings, explained in the main text, for Yitzchok was the first who sought to pray concerning sufferings, as our Sages, z"l, said. Yitzchok is also of the dimension of Bina, as brought above in the name of Likutay Torah of the Ar"i z"l. This is the dimension of "You have placed joy in my heart," as explained in the main text.

Yaakov is the dimension of wisdom, as it is written, "And he supplanted me," which the Targum renders with the expression of making wise, as explained in his holy words, z"l, in Siman 1 and Siman 74. Through wisdom the principal building of Malchus takes place, until she is fit for union, as it were, as explained in the main text. Because kisses are through wisdom, it is explicitly written concerning Yaakov, "And Yaakov kissed Rachel." Through this the bodily union is consequently awakened, in the dimension of "the Divine Presence dwells between two Tzadikim." This is also the secret of Yaakov, whose root is in Daas, from which union comes. Therefore he merited that Yosef and Binyamin should descend from him, for they are the secret of the two above-mentioned Tzadikim, as is known.

This is the dimension of HaMelech HaKadosh, for one draws upon Malchus the light of wisdom, which is the dimension of holiness, as is known. This is the dimension of "And so may Your Name be sanctified," corresponding to Avraham, the dimension of kindness rooted in wisdom, which is the dimension of joy, as in "Rejoice with trembling." "And so grant honor" corresponds to Yaakov, the dimension of "The wise shall inherit honor." "And so the righteous" corresponds to David.

This is the dimension of Tzadik and Tzedek, brought in the Kavanos: one elevates Malchus, the dimension of Tzedek, to the dimension of Tzadik. And "the righteous" is plural, indicating two, for the Divine Presence dwells between two Tzadikim, as above.

This is "And iniquity shall shut its mouth." At present, because they draw nourishment, as it were, from Malchus, the Oral Torah, they thereby have a mouth with which to speak arrogantly against the Tzadik, etc. But when Malchus is raised from between them, "And iniquity shall shut its mouth," etc. "For You shall remove the dominion of wickedness" is the dimension of nullifying the kingship of the Other Side, which incites a person to pride and arrogance, entices him to study Torah not for its own sake, and leads him to speak against the Tzadik, etc. "And You shall reign," etc., is the ascent of holy Malchus to its completeness.

This is the dimension of Shofar-sounding, for our Sages, z"l, said, "Sounding the Shofar is wisdom and not labor." Also, tekiah is an expression of union, as explained in the Kavanos, for through wisdom she is united between the two Tzadikim, as above.

This is the dimension of tekiah, teruah, tekiah: "the Divine Presence dwells between two Tzadikim." For teruah is the dimension of the Divine Presence, the dimension of Malchus, the dimension of the Oral Torah, as it is written, "And the teruah of the King is within him," which the Targum renders, "And the Divine Presence of their King is among them." This is what our Sages, z"l, said: teruah contains the letters Torah and Ayin, the dimension of the seventy faces of Torah, which is the entirety of the Oral Torah. She dwells between the upper Tzadik, who originated that Torah and now bestows into her, and the lower Tzadik, who studies that Torah, etc., as explained in the main text. This is the dimension of the tekiah before and the tekiah after, for tekiah is the dimension of attachment to the Tzadik, as brought above many times.

Therefore one must sound Shevarim and Teruah. For one is engaged in raising the Divine Presence, the Oral Torah, out of the exile she suffered in the mouth of the person who studies not for its own sake. Through this he not only caused distress to the Divine Presence, as it were, but also received power thereby, gaining a mouth with which to speak arrogantly against the Tzadik, to persecute the lower Tzadik and oppose him. Moreover, he also persecutes the upper Tzadik who originated that Torah. However, this latter persecution comes about of itself, without his intention, because the Tanna, the upper Tzadik, cannot bear his kisses and cannot cleave to him spirit to spirit.

Corresponding to these two matters one sounds Shevarim and Teruah. Shevarim is gonochi gonach, the sigh of the upper Tzadik [who originated the Torah teaching] over the student who studies his Torah not for its own sake, for thereby the Tzadik cannot unite with him spirit to spirit — and therefore sighs over this. For the sigh expels one breath and draws in another — meaning the upper Tzadik expels and distances from himself the spirit of the one who studies not for its own sake, and draws within himself a holy spirit. Also, through the sigh, in the dimension of "You withdraw their spirit; they expire," the Tanna expires and is gathered away from the spirit of the student who studies not for its own sake, and cleaves to the holy spirit. See all this below in the main text, Siman 108 and 109.

Nevertheless, since the student does not intend to persecute the upper Tzadik and this occurs of itself, as above, it is only in the dimension of gonochi gonach, a sigh. But corresponding to the lower Tzadik, whom he actually persecutes through the power of the Oral Torah he studies, one sounds Teruah, which is yelulai yelil. For the lower Tzadik wails and cries over the great suffering that he actually experiences from the student who is not as he should be. Since the persecution of the upper Tzadik takes place immediately during the study, while the persecution of the lower Tzadik comes afterward, Shevarim precedes Teruah.

In truth, even in the study of the Tzadik who learns for its own sake, which is the dimension of Yaakov and the dimension of Teruah, as above, there is also a dimension of Shevarim and Teruah. For he must draw through his Torah study both spiritual vitality, in the dimension of "Length of days is in her right hand," and material vitality, in the dimension of "In her left hand are wealth and honor." Therefore, while cleaving to spiritual vitality, he is in the dimension of gonochi gonach, for he is compelled from above to sigh over the lack of livelihood among Israel. This is the dimension of his being brought down to the left side of Torah for the benefit of the world.

At the very moment when he descends to the left side, however, because of his great holiness he cannot stand or remain in that level at all. He immediately wails and cries out because he has come to that state, and returns to the right side of Torah, as all this is understood in the main text. This is the dimension of Teruah.

Therefore, on Rosh HaShanah, when it is necessary to draw down both kinds of influence mentioned above, one prays extensively for life, the dimension of "Length of days is in her right hand." Likewise, "a person's sustenance is apportioned to him from Rosh HaShanah," as our Sages, z"l, said, which is the dimension of "In her left hand are wealth and honor." The Tzadikim therefore engage especially in this matter at that time.

And therefore this month is called Tishray — in the dimension of Tishrak [reversed alphabet] — as the Sages, z"l, taught — for during this month one engages in the elevation of Malchus, which is the dimension of the Oral Torah (Torah SheBeAl Peh), which is the dimension of Tishrak, as is understood from the story of Hillel with the convert in Tractate Shabbos 31a and Rashi's commentary there.

This is the dimension of the matter between Yaakov and Esau at that time, as brought in the holy Zohar. Because even the Tzadik must descend momentarily to the left side in order to draw money and livelihood to Israel, the Torah of the Tanna and Tzadik has two possible meanings, in the dimension of "The righteous shall walk in them, but sinners shall stumble in them." Because the wicked Esau has his hold on the left side, he incites Israel to study Torah entirely not for its own sake, Heaven forbid. Then he takes all the abundance for himself, may G-d protect us, as is known. Furthermore, he persecutes the Tzadik, the dimension of Yaakov, until the Tzadik is compelled to flee from him.

Because Rosh HaShanah is the dimension of the left, as is known, Esau then seeks to prevail especially strongly, and the accusers standing on the left accuse intensely because of the study of those who are unworthy. And the Shofar-sounding awakens awe and the awakening to repentance in all Israel — which is the essential rectification of study — that one's fear of sin precede one's wisdom and the goal of Torah be repentance and good deeds. Principally through the power of the Tzadikim, who engage in this especially on Rosh HaShanah, all accusations are sweetened and the husk of Esov is subdued. Then Israel merits both spiritual abundance and material abundance, as above.

This is the dimension of "Sound the Shofar at the new moon," etc., "For it is a statute for Israel," etc., from which our Sages, z"l, expounded that a person's sustenance is apportioned to him from Rosh HaShanah. Since sustenance is drawn from the left side of Torah, which itself corresponds to Rosh HaShanah, as above, those who stand on the left are especially aroused then. The rectification is through Shofar-sounding, as above.

And this is the dimension of Malchuyos: "Say Malchuyos so that you crown Me over you" — the dimension of building Malchus from the letters of Oral Torah in the mouth of the student. Zichronos — "so that your remembrance shall come before Me for good" — the dimension of the elevation of Malchus to unite between the two Tzadikim, both of whom are from the masculine side, as is known. This is the dimension of "the memory of the Tzadik is a blessing." This is accomplished through wisdom, as above, which is the dimension of remembrance, in the dimension of "For there is no remembrance of the wise man together with the fool." And "through what? Through the Shofar" — for the Shofar alludes to the world of Bina, from which all these rectifications begin, as explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
On Rosh HaShanah We Elevate the Holy Kingdom Through the Light of Supernal Understanding

On Rosh HaShanah all Israel engage in building the holy Malchus through the light of the Supernal Bina (Understanding) — this being the secret of the Shofar, as explained in the Kavanos. Afterwards one elevates it from level to level to the dimension of embrace, kiss, and union — until on Sh'mini Atzeres the union of the Matron face to face is accomplished, as brought many times above.

qualifications.text: The supplied שכינתא בין תריא צדיקיא יתבא concerns the Divine Presence between the upper and lower Tzadikim; the lower Tzadik raises מ"נ, feminine waters, to the Divine Presence so that she may cleave. The obligation is for people to travel to the Tzadik of the generation, not for the Tzadik to travel to them.

The graves reference ליקות"נ סי' ק"ט is read contextually as Likutay Moharan, Part II, Siman 109. The supplied Hebrew abbreviation remains unchanged; this identification does not claim verification of an original printed edition.

The supplied הראשון שביקש להתפלל על היסורין says that Yitzchok was the first to seek to pray concerning sufferings. The English retains the prayer action without replacing it with a claim that he requested sufferings.

The language נגווע ונאסף התנא מהרוח של הלומד שלא לשמה describes the Tanna's withdrawal from the spirit of the one studying not for its own sake, while cleaving to the holy spirit. The expiry-and-gathering imagery is preserved within this spiritual relationship; it does not assert a new physical death.

The text distinguishes the upper Tzadik's involuntary suffering from the student's study from the lower Tzadik's actual persecution. In the separate account of study for its own sake, the Tzadik's temporary descent to the material or left-hand dimension is for Israel's livelihood, followed immediately by his anguished return to the spiritual or right-hand dimension.

The source calls the month תשרי and associates it with תשר"ק. Tishray and Tishrak are retained as distinct expressions, not represented as identical words or as a literal full spelling of the reversed alphabet.

The supplied בין תרין צדיקיא שהן מסטרא דדכורא applies the masculine-side description to both Tzadikim. The associated quotation כי אין זכרון לחכם עם הכסיל retains its negative sense about remembrance of the wise man together with the fool.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.
