units.he: ידוע כי בר"ה עוסקין לנסר את המלכות מבחי' אחור באחור ולהחזירה לבחי' פנים בפנים וזה נעשה ע"י הדורמיטא בחי' שינה והתעוררות השינה שע"י תקיעת שופר כמבואר בכתבים אך שם מדבר בענינים נסתרים מאד גבוה מעל גבוה ואין לנו עסק בנסתרות, אך לענינינו הוא כי תחלת גמר הבריאה היה בר"ה כי בו נברא אדם הראשון והיה עדיין עם חוה בבחי' אחור באחור שזה בחי' אחור וקדם צרתני המובפ"נ שדרז"ל ע"ז אדם וחוה דו פרצופין נבראו ואח"כ ויפל ה' אלהים תרדימה וכו' ואז נבנית בנין שלם בחי' ויבן ה' א' את הצלע וכו' כמובא כ"ז בכתבים, והנה מבואר בפנים שיש שכל שהוא בחי' אחור ויש שכל שהוא בחי' קדם בחי' פנים ועיקר תכלית ביאת האדם לזה העולם הוא להמשיך השכל הפנים בעולם וזה סוד חופה וקידושין והולדות הבנים וכו' כמובן בפנים, וע"כ בכל ר"ה שחוזר הענין למציאותו הראשון ואז צריכין לעסוק ביותר בתיקונים אלו היינ ולהמשיך שכל הפנים בעולם שהכל הזה הוא בחי' מקיפין בחי' אור הפנים וזה בחי' תקיעת שופר והתאדמות פני התוקע שמרמז לבחי' אור הפנים כמבואר בכתבים, וזה בחי' אשרי העם יודעי תרועה ה' באור פניך יהלכון, כי מבואר בסוף המאמר שיש שכליות ומקיפין שאי אפשר להמשיכן בכל משך זמן העוה"ז ולא יתגלו אלא לעתיד והם בבחי' עתיקא טמיר וסתים אך גם בהשגות ושכליות שאפשר להמשיכן בזה העולם והם מבחי' זעיר אנפין גם בזה יש בחי' פנימי ומקיף כשמשיגין אותם הם בבחי' פנימי וקודם ההשגה הם בבחינת מקיף ופעמים הם בהעלם לגמרי בבחי' עיבור שזה בחי' מקיף למקיף שזה בחי' זעירא דאנפין איתגליא ולא איתגליא כמבפ"נ, והנההאדם צריך לעסוק בזה כל ימיו להוליד המוחין מבחי' עיבור והעלם גמור לבחי' לידה, וזה זוכין ע"י צעקות וקולות דקדושה, ואח"כ צריך להמשיך המוחין מבחי' מקיף לפנימי שזה בחי' שממשיכין שכל הפנים, וזה זוכין ע"י קדושת שבעת הנרות כמבפ"נ, והנה הגם כי אין לנו רשות לבאר בזה ענין כוונות של תקיעת שופר עכ"פ היוצא לנו מזה לענינינו שע"י השינה דאפיל על זעיר אנפין ושינה הוא בחי' הסתלקות המוחין ויש מוחין ושכליות שנסתלקין ועולין לבחי' עיבור והעלם לגמרי ויש שנסתלקין ונתעלמין מבחי' פנימי למקיף וע"י השינה דייקא נתחדשין המוחין וע"כ ע"י התשובה והקולות דקדושה שצועקין ישראל בתפלה ותחנונים וע"י תקיעת שופר עי"ז ממשיכין שפע והארה מבחי' עתיק כמבואר בכוונות ונמשךבחי' התעוררות השינה לזעיר אנפין ומקבל מוחין חדשים וגדולים מאד ואז מאיר למלכות שהיא בחי' כלל כנסת ישראל וזוכין להשיגעי"ז השגות נפלאות ולהמשיך המקיפין שהם בחי' אור הפנים שזה בחי' באור פניך יהלכון כנ"ל, וזה שמובא בזוהר בהעלתך דף קמ"ט כי תקיעת שופר היא בבחי' אחת עם הדלקת נרות המנורה היינ וכנ"ל כי התיקון שממשיכין ע"י הדלקת שבעת הנרות של המנורה שעי"ז ממשיכןי בחי' השכל של שפע אלהי שהוא בבחי' פנים כמבפ"נ כל זה ממשיכין ג"כ ע"י תקיעת שופר כנ"ל, וזה שמבואר בזוה"ק כי תרועה וקול שופר הן בחי' יעקב כי יעקב אבינו ע"ה עסק בזה ביתר כמובן בפנים כי שם יעקב מרמז על העת שהמוחין בהעלם בבחי' עיבור שאז צריכין לצעקות וקולות שזה בחי' הקל קול יעקב ואח"כ זכה שנקרא ישראל על שם המשכת המוחין מבחי' מקיפין לפנים, ומחמת שצריכין לעסוק בזה תמיד ולעלות מדרגא לדרגא ולהמשיך בכ"פ מקיפין חדשים ע"כ נקרא גם אח"כ בשם יעקב כמו שארז"ל. וזה תקעו בחודש שופר בכסא ליון חגינו הינו שהמוחין נתכסין ונתעלמין אז בבחי' שינה כמובא בכוונות על פסוק זה (עיין סידור קול יעקב), וזה כי חק לישרא להוא היינו מה שהוא בבחי' חק בחי' מקיפין או העלם גמור שאין השכל יכול להשיג משפט לאלהי יעקב משפט הוא בחי' מה שהכל ג"כ מסכים לזה ומשיג אותו, היינו שענין תקיעת שופר הוא להמשיך בחי' התעוררות השינה והתגלות המוחין מתעלומתן ולעשות ממקיפים פנימיים כנ"ל, ומה שאצל חק אמר לישראל הוא ואצל משפט אמר לאלהי יעקב אין כאן מקום לבאר, והנה להמשיך המקיפין לפנים הוא ע"י קודשת שבעת הנרות שהם העינים והאזנים והחוטם והפה וכו' כמבפ"נ וע"כ מצינו ג"כ בענין תקיעת שופר המשכת בחי' אלו כי ע"י ההבל של הפה של התוקע שנכנס לתוך השופר עי"ז ממשיכין בחי' קדושת הפה ועיקר קדושת הפה הוא רק לדבר דיבורי אמת וכו' כמבפ"נ, וזה שמבואר בכוונות בענין ההבלים של השופר שהם בחי' ז' פעמים ס"ג גימטריא אמת ונמשכין בשרשן מתיקון ואמת, ומשה רבינו ע"ה זכה ע"י קדושת הפה שלו לבחי' פה אל פה אדבר בו וזה מצינו ג,כ בענין תקיעת שופר כי ע"י ההבלים היוצאים מפה התוקע נמשכין ונתעוררין בשרשם ההבלים העליונים הק' של בחי' פה ה' כביכול כמבואר בזוה"ק ובכוונות, וזה שמבואר בזוהר כי על כל מוצא פי ה' יחיה האדם דאקול השופר, וע"י היראה שנתעורר ע"י השופר בבחי' היתקע שופר בעיר והעם לא יחרדו זה בחי' קדושת החוטם בחי' והריחו ביראת ה' כמבפ"נ, וע"י מה שכל אחד מטה אזנו לשמוע קול השופר כמו שמברכין לשמוע קול שופר וקול השופר הוא בחי' קול המוכיח של החכם האמת בבחי' כשופר הרם קולך וכו' וכמבואר במ"א וכששומעין קול השופר זה בחי' שמע דברי חכמים בחי' תקיעת שופר חכמה וכו' בחי' הוכח לחכם ויאהבך שזבה בחי' קדושת האזנים כמבפ"נ וע"י הבכיות הרבות והדמעות הרבים ששופכין ישראל בשעת תקיעת שופר עי"ז ממשיכן בחי' קדושת העינים, גם ע"י קול השופר נתעורר זכות קול השופר של מתן תורה כידוע ואז זכו ישראל לעינים קדושים כאלו עד שראו את הקול כ"ש וכל העם רואים את הקולות וכו' ואת קול השופ והכו' וע"י כ"ז וזכין לבחי' אור הפנים שזה בחי' פנים בפנים דיבר ה' עמכם הנאמר במתן תורה, וזה אותיות תרועה תורה עיין בחי' עין פנים לתורה כמובא שזה בחי' כלל השגת התורה כלל המשכת המקיפין שהם בחי' אור הפנים בחי' פנים לתורה:
units.en:
It is known that on Rosh HaShanah one performs the Separation (Nesira) — separating Malchus from the dimension of back-to-back and returning her to face-to-face. This is accomplished through the dormancy (dormita) — the dimension of sleep and the awakening from sleep through the Shofar-sounding, as explained in the holy writings. But those writings speak of very hidden matters — exceedingly high — and we have no business with hidden matters.

As it applies to us: the beginning of the completion of creation was on Rosh HaShanah, when Adam was created, and he and Chava were still back-to-back. This is the dimension of "Behind and before You formed me," concerning which our Sages, z"l, expounded that Adam and Chava were created with two faces. Then "G-d cast a deep sleep" [Gen. 2:21] — and then a complete building was built, the dimension of "G-d built the rib," etc., as all this is brought in the holy writings.

It is explained in the main text that there is intellect that is the dimension of back, and intellect that is the dimension of front (face), and the essential purpose of a person's coming to this world is to draw the frontal intellect (sechel d'panim) into the world. And this is the secret of the nuptial canopy, betrothal, and the birth of children, etc., as is understood in the main text.

Therefore on every Rosh HaShanah — when the matter returns to its primal state — one must engage most intensively in these rectifications: drawing the frontal intellect into the world. And all of this is the dimension of encompassing lights and the face of light. And this is the dimension of the Shofar-sounding and the reddening of the Shofar-blower's face — hinting at the dimension of the face of light, as explained in the holy writings.

This is the dimension of "Fortunate is the people who know the Teruah; G-d, in the light of Your face they shall walk."

For it is explained at the end of the discourse that there are intellects and encompassing lights which cannot be drawn down throughout the duration of this world and will be revealed only in the future. They are of the dimension of Atika, concealed and hidden.

But even among the attainments and intellects that can be drawn down in this world, which are of the dimension of זעיר אנפין, there are also the dimensions of internal and encompassing. When one attains them, they are in the dimension of internal; before their attainment, they are in the dimension of encompassing. Sometimes they are completely concealed, in the dimension of gestation, which is the dimension of an encompassing light surrounding an encompassing light. This is the dimension of זעירא דאנפין being revealed and not revealed, as explained in the main text.

A person must therefore engage in this throughout all the days of his life: to bring forth the mental faculties from the dimension of gestation and complete concealment into the dimension of birth. One merits this through holy cries and voices.

Afterward one must draw the mental faculties from the dimension of encompassing to internal, which is the dimension of drawing down the frontal intellect. One merits this through the holiness of the seven lamps, as explained in the main text.

Although we have no permission to explain here the intentions of Shofar-sounding, nevertheless what emerges from this for our purposes is that through the sleep that falls upon זעיר אנפין — sleep being the dimension of the withdrawal of the mental faculties — certain mental faculties and intellects withdraw and ascend into the dimension of gestation and complete concealment, while others withdraw and become concealed, passing from the dimension of internal to encompassing.

Specifically through sleep the mental faculties are renewed. Therefore through repentance, through the holy cries and voices with which Israel cry out in prayer and supplications, and through Shofar-sounding, an abundance and illumination are drawn from the dimension of Atik, as explained in the Kavanos. The dimension of awakening from sleep is drawn to זעיר אנפין, who receives exceedingly great and new mental faculties.

Then he illuminates Malchus, which is the dimension of the collective Assembly of Israel. Through this Israel merit wondrous attainments and the drawing down of the encompassing lights, which are the dimension of the face of light. This is the dimension of "In the light of Your face they shall walk," as explained above.

This is what is brought in the Zohar, Behaaloscha, page 149: that Shofar-sounding is of one dimension with the kindling of the lamps of the Menorah. That is, as explained above, the rectification drawn through kindling the seven lamps of the Menorah — thereby drawing the dimension of the intellect of Divine abundance, which is in the dimension of face, as explained in the main text — is likewise drawn through Shofar-sounding.

This is what is explained in the holy Zohar: Teruah and the sound of the Shofar are of the dimension of Yaakov. For Yaakov our father, peace be upon him, engaged especially in this, as may be understood from the main text.

The name Yaakov alludes to the time when the mental faculties are concealed in the dimension of gestation, when cries and voices are necessary. This is the dimension of "The voice is the voice of Yaakov." Afterward he merited to be called Yisrael, because of drawing the mental faculties from the dimension of encompassing inward.

Because one must engage in this constantly, ascending from level to level and drawing down new encompassing lights each time, he continued to be called Yaakov even afterward, as our Sages, z"l, taught.

And this is "Sound the Shofar at the new moon, at the covering for our festival day." That is, the mental faculties are then covered and concealed in the dimension of sleep, as brought in the Kavanos concerning this verse (see Siddur Kol Yaakov).

This is "For it is a statute for Yisrael" — meaning that which is in the dimension of a statute, the dimension of encompassing lights or complete concealment, which the intellect cannot grasp. "A judgment for the G-d of Yaakov" — judgment is the dimension of something to which the intellect also agrees and which it comprehends.

That is, the matter of Shofar-sounding is to draw the dimension of awakening from sleep and the revelation of the mental faculties from their concealment, and to make the encompassing lights internal, as explained above.

Why, concerning the statute, the verse says "for Yisrael," whereas concerning judgment it says "for the G-d of Yaakov," is not something to explain here.

Now the drawing of encompassing lights inward is through the holiness of the seven lamps, which are the eyes, ears, nose and mouth, etc., as explained in the main text. Therefore we also find in Shofar-sounding the drawing down of these dimensions.

Through the breath of the Shofar-blower's mouth that enters the Shofar, one draws down the dimension of the holiness of the mouth. The primary holiness of the mouth is only to speak words of truth, etc., as explained in the main text.

This is what is explained in the Kavanos concerning the breaths of the Shofar: they are in the dimension of seven times Samech-Gimmel, the numerical value of Emes, truth, and are drawn at their root from the rectification of "And Truth."

Moshe Rabbainu, peace be upon him, merited through the holiness of his mouth the dimension of "Mouth to mouth I shall speak with him." We likewise find this in Shofar-sounding, for through the breaths emerging from the Shofar-blower's mouth, the supernal holy breaths of the dimension of the mouth of G-d, as it were, are drawn and awakened at their root, as explained in the holy Zohar and the Kavanos.

This is what is explained in the Zohar concerning "For by every utterance of the mouth of G-d shall man live" — that this is the sound of the Shofar.

Through the awe awakened by the Shofar, in the dimension of "Will the Shofar be sounded in the city and the people not tremble?" one draws the dimension of the holiness of the nose, the dimension of "And he shall smell in the fear of G-d," as explained in the main text.

And through everyone inclining an ear to hear the sound of the Shofar, as one blesses "to hear the sound of the Shofar," one draws the holiness of the ears.

For the sound of the Shofar is the dimension of the voice of rebuke of the true Sage, in the dimension of "Raise your voice like a Shofar," etc., as explained elsewhere. Hearing the sound of the Shofar is thus the dimension of "Hear the words of the wise," the dimension of "Sounding the Shofar is wisdom," etc., and the dimension of "Reprove a wise person and he will love you." This is the dimension of the holiness of the ears, as explained in the main text.

Through the abundant weeping and many tears that Israel shed during Shofar-sounding, one draws the dimension of the holiness of the eyes.

Also, the sound of the Shofar awakens the merit of the Shofar-sound at the Giving of the Torah, as is known. At that time Israel merited such holy eyes that they saw the sound, as it is written, "And all the people saw the voices," etc., "and the sound of the Shofar," etc.

Through all this one merits the dimension of the face of light, the dimension of "Face to face G-d spoke with you," said concerning the Giving of the Torah.

And this is the letters of Teruah: Torah and Ayin, the dimension of the seventy faces of Torah, as is brought. This is the dimension of the comprehensive attainment of Torah, the comprehensive drawing down of encompassing lights, which are the dimension of the face of light, the dimension of the faces of Torah.

history.earlier_supplied_English: On Rosh HaShanah We Perform the Separation

qualifications.text: The opening relates the Rosh HaShanah Separation and dormancy to Malchus moving from back-to-back to face-to-face. The compiler explicitly refrains from expounding the hidden Kavanos themselves and instead develops their implications for intellect and the face of light. The actual quotation ויפל ה' אלהים תרדימה וכו' is abbreviated and does not print an 'upon the man' object; the English does not insert that object. The bracketed [Gen. 2:21] is inherited historical-English contextual reference apparatus, not a citation locator printed in this primary Hebrew.

The source distinguishes intellects of Atika that cannot be attained during earthly life from attainable intellects associated with זעיר אנפין. Within the latter, complete concealment or gestation, encompassing illumination, and internalized knowledge are distinct stages. The source also uses the variant זעירא דאנפין in its revealed-and-not-revealed formulation.

Holy cries bring concealed mental faculties from gestation to birth, while the holiness of the seven lamps draws encompassing faculties inward. The source associates both the Menorah and Shofar with this process and cites Zohar Behaaloscha, page קמ"ט, 149, without an additional printed column designation.

Yaakov represents concealed faculties requiring cries, and Yisrael represents further inward attainment. The continued use of the name Yaakov is explained by the need for repeated ascents and newly drawn encompassing lights.

The supplied Shofar verse contains the literal fragments בכסא ליון חגינו and לישרא להוא. The English interprets בכסא contextually as a covering associated with the festival, but the printed בכסא is not itself changed or silently replaced by another Hebrew reading. The source also says מה שהכל ג"כ מסכים לזה ומשיג אותו, literally that 'everything also agrees with it and grasps it'; the English reads this contextually as intellectual agreement and comprehension. These contextual interpretations do not emend the Hebrew or establish an original printed reading. The compiler expressly declines to explain the different use of Yisrael and Yaakov in the statute and judgment clauses.

The source connects the mouth with truth and Shofar breath, the nose with awe, the ears with hearing the true Sage's rebuke, and the eyes with tears and the Giving of the Torah. The supernal mouth is explicitly qualified by כביכול, 'as it were.'

The printed seven times ס"ג is seven times 63, which equals 441, the numerical value of אמת. This numerical relationship is preserved without changing the source's letters or implying that a different number was printed.

The source's final תרועה אותיות תורה עיין and עין פנים לתורה connect Teruah, Torah, the eye and the faces of Torah. The full word עיין is not itself the single letter ע required for the letter arrangement, and the spelling עין is not numerically seventy. The English conveys the contextual Torah-and-Ayin relationship without asserting a false whole-word permutation or gematria.

The supplied quotation ואת קול השופ is clipped. The English represents it contextually as the sound of the Shofar while preserving the abbreviated biblical quotation and without claiming that its full form was printed.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה וזה בחי'
units.en: Passage beginning “And this is the dimension”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Aleph-Hay [abbreviation: א״ה = "with G-d's help"]:
It is explained in the words of our holy Rebbe, the Light of Lights,
Mohara"n, z"l — in many places in his holy book
Likutay Mohara"n and in his holy conversations —
regarding the topic of the wondrous rectifications (tikkunim nifloim)
that are accomplished by those who come to the true Tzadik
on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה וזה בחי' is a partial discourse incipit. The historical introduction concerning Rabbainu and his teachings is not part of the heading.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וזה בחי' מלכיות זכרונות ושופרות וארז,ל אמרו לפני מלכיות כדי שתמליכוני עליכם היינו כי בשעה שהמוחין הם בהעלם בבחי' עיבור אז עיקר החיות דקדושהע"י אמונה שהיא בחי' מלכות ואז יפה צעקה לאדם שזה בחי' השםהיוצא מתפלת שועתינו קבל ושמע צעקתינו יודע תעלומות שהוא במלכות כידוע (ועיין בליטקות"נ במאמר תקעו אמונה סי' ה' שעיקר שלימות הקול דקדושה הוא ע"י אמונה) וע"י הצעקות והקולות נולדין המוין מבחי' עיבור ללידה שזה ג"כ בחי' המתקת הדינים בחי' דם נעכר ונעשה חלב המבפ"נ, ואח"כ צריכין להמשיך המוחין מבחי' מקיף לפנימי שזה עיקר שלימות הדעת ועי"זנמתקין הדינים בשלימות כי ע"י הדעת נתבטל כל מיני כעס ודינים ונמשך חסד ורחמים כמובן בפנים, וזה בחי' אמרו לפני זכרונות כדי שיעלה זכרוניכם לפני לטובה שזה בחי' המתקת הדינים בשלימות כמו שמתפללין אז וכיבשו רחמיך את כעסך וכו', וע"כ זכרונות הם בחב"ד בחי' המשכת המוחין בשלימות וזה ובמה בשופר כי ע"י השופר ממשיכין כל הנ"ל כי שופר מרמז על המשכת המוחין של בחי' זעירא דאנפין וגם על המקיפין העליונים של בחי' עתיק שלא ישיגו אותם אלא לעתיד בעוה"ב שהוא בחי' בינה בחי' שופר גדול כידוע, וע"כ מזכירין פסוקי שופרות של מתן תורה וגם פסוקי שופרות שלעתיד, ומחמת שגם המשכת המוחן של תפלה הוא עי"ז ע"כ אומרים ג"כ הללוהו בתקע שופר וכו' בצלצלי תרועה, וזה שמתפללין שם תקע בשופר גדול לחירותינו וכו' כי עיקר החירות והקיבוץ גליות יהיה ג"כ ע"י שלימות הדעת הנ"ל כמובן בפנים:
units.en:
This is the dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos and Shofaros.

Our Sages, z"l, said: "Say Malchuyos before Me so that you crown Me over you." For when the mental faculties are concealed in the dimension of gestation, the principal vitality of holiness comes through faith, which is the dimension of Malchus.

Then crying out is beneficial for a person. This is the dimension of the Name that emerges from the prayer "Accept our supplication and hear our cry, Knower of hidden things," which is associated with Malchus, as is known. See also Likutay Moharan, Part II, in the discourse תקעו אמונה, Siman 5, where it is explained that the principal completeness of the holy voice comes through faith.

Through the cries and voices, the mental faculties are born, passing from the dimension of gestation to birth. This is also the dimension of the sweetening of judgments, the dimension of "The blood becomes turbid and turns into milk," as explained in the main text.

Afterward one must draw the mental faculties from the dimension of encompassing into the internal. This is the principal completeness of Daas. Through this the judgments are sweetened in completeness, for through Daas all kinds of anger and judgments are nullified and kindness and compassion are drawn down, as may be understood from the main text.

This is the dimension of "Say Zichronos before Me so that your remembrance may ascend before Me for good." It is the dimension of sweetening judgments in completeness, as one prays then, "And may Your mercies subdue Your anger," etc.

Therefore Zichronos correspond to Chochmah, Bina and Daas, the dimension of drawing down the mental faculties in completeness.

And this is "Through what? Through the Shofar," for through the Shofar all the foregoing is drawn down. The Shofar alludes to drawing the mental faculties of the dimension of זעירא דאנפין, and also to the supernal encompassing lights of the dimension of Atik, which will not be attained until the future, in the World to Come, which is the dimension of Bina, the dimension of the Great Shofar, as is known.

Therefore one mentions verses of Shofaros concerning the Giving of the Torah and also verses of Shofaros concerning the future.

Because the drawing down of the mental faculties of prayer is also accomplished through this, one also says, "Praise Him with the sounding of the Shofar," etc., "with the clashing cymbals of Teruah."

This is why one prays there, "Sound the great Shofar for our freedom," etc., for the principal freedom and ingathering of exiles will likewise come through the completeness of Daas mentioned above, as may be understood from the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English: It is known that on Rosh HaShanah one performs the Separation (Nesira) — separating Malchus from the dimension of back-to-back and returning her to face-to-face. This is accomplished through the dormancy (dormita) — the dimension of sleep and the awakening from sleep through the Shofar-sounding, as explained in the holy writings. But those writings speak of very hidden matters — exceedingly high — and we have no business with hidden matters.

qualifications.text: Malchuyos is associated with faith sustaining holy vitality while the mental faculties are concealed in gestation. The holy cries bring those faculties to birth and initiate the sweetening of judgments, expressed through the blood-to-milk image.

The source identifies the prayer by the words שועתינו קבל ושמע צעקתינו יודע תעלומות and refers to Likutay Moharan, Part II, the discourse תקעו אמונה, Siman 5. The prayer wording is represented without an invented Latin transliteration or an added paragraph locator.

Drawing encompassing intellect inward is distinguished from bringing concealed intellect to birth. The resulting completeness of Daas removes anger and severe judgments and draws kindness and compassion, which is associated with Zichronos and Chochmah, Bina and Daas.

The Shofar is associated both with attainable mental faculties of זעירא דאנפין and with supernal encompassing illumination of Atik, which the source says will not be attained until the future World to Come. The passage separately invokes Shofar verses of the Giving of Torah and of the future.
The source also connects Shofar with the mental faculties of prayer, the verses of praise involving Shofar and cymbals, and the Great Shofar for freedom and ingathering through complete Daas.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואח"כ עוסקין
units.en: Passage beginning “And afterward they engage”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 1, in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola
["Blow the Shofar of Sovereignty"], it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension (bechia) of being the Place of the World
— and they are able to perform the [spiritual work of] Rosh HaShanah.
And in the discourse Tik'u Emuna, Siman 5,
much is explained regarding the wondrous rectifications
that are wrought through the gathering of the disciples near the true Rebbe —
and the primary time of gathering is on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ואח"כ עוסקין is a partial incipit. The historical discussion of separate Likutay Moharan discourses is not imported.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בתשובה בכל ימי התשובה ועי"ז ממשיכין מוחין חדשים בכ"פ עד שביו"כ זוכין לקבל מוחין גדולים מאד כי יו"כ היא בחי' עוה"ב שאין בו לא אכילה ולא שתיה רק צדיקים יושבים ועטרותיהם בראשיהם היינו שהמקיפים יכנסו בתוך ראשיהם היינ ובתוך פנימיות המוחין כמבפ"נ וע"כ ישראל דומין אז למלאכים היינו כי מכו לעתיד תוגדל הידיעה אצל ישראל עד שתתבטל הבחירה שלהם ויהיו בגדר מלאך כמבפ"נ זו הבחינה נמשך ג"כ ביו"כ וע"כ נעשין אז כבריה חדשה וזוכין לסליחת עוונות והכל ע"י הארת המוחין הגדולים שזוכין לקבל אז בבחי' ואשי חכם יכפרנה כי יו"כ הוא בחי' משה כמובא בזוהק ועל משה נאמר פסוק זה ואי'ש חכ'ם יכפרנ'ה כידוע, וע"כ ביו"כ פעל משה גם בתפלתו שהתפלל על סליחת עוונות של ישראל וקיבל הלוחות שניות שהם בחי' כלל המוחין של התורה הק' וזכה לקירון עור הפנים שהוא בחי' אור הפנים הנ"ל:
units.en:
Afterward one engages in repentance throughout all the Days of Repentance. Through this one draws down new mental faculties each time, until on Yom Kippur one merits receiving exceedingly great mental faculties.

For Yom Kippur is the dimension of the World to Come, in which there is neither eating nor drinking, but the righteous sit with their crowns upon their heads. That is, the encompassing lights enter into their heads, into the innermost mental faculties themselves, as explained in the main text.

Therefore Israel then resemble angels. For just as in the future knowledge among Israel will become so great that their free choice will be nullified and they will be in the category of angels, as explained in the main text, this dimension is likewise drawn down on Yom Kippur.

Therefore they then become like a new creation and merit forgiveness of sins. All this is through the illumination of the great mental faculties which they merit to receive at that time, in the dimension of "And a wise man shall atone for it."

For Yom Kippur is the dimension of Moshe, as brought in the holy Zohar. Concerning Moshe this verse is said, "And a wise man shall atone for it," as is known.

Therefore on Yom Kippur Moshe also accomplished through his prayer what he prayed concerning the forgiveness of Israel's sins, and received the Second Tablets, which are the dimension of the totality of the mental faculties of the holy Torah. He merited the radiance of the skin of his face, which is the dimension of the face of light mentioned above.

history.earlier_supplied_English: As it applies to us: the beginning of the completion of creation was on Rosh HaShanah, when Adam was created, and he and Chava were still back-to-back. Then "G-d cast a deep sleep upon the man" [Gen. 2:21] — and then a complete building was built, the dimension of "G-d built the rib," etc. It is explained in the main text that there is intellect that is the dimension of back, and intellect that is the dimension of front (face), and the essential purpose of a person's coming to this world is to draw the frontal intellect (sechel d'panim) into the world. And this is the secret of the nuptial canopy, betrothal, and the birth of children, etc., as is understood in the main text.

qualifications.text: The source describes repeated renewal of intellect through repentance during the Days of Repentance, culminating in Yom Kippur. The World-to-Come crowns are interpreted as encompassing lights entering the heads and becoming internal mental faculties.

The future condition in which Israel's expanded knowledge nullifies free choice is compared with the angel-like holiness drawn on Yom Kippur. It is not presented as a general denial of present human free choice.

The source prints ואשי חכם יכפרנה before later printing ואי'ש חכ'ם יכפרנ'ה. The English reads the first form contextually as the wise-person atonement expression without changing either supplied Hebrew form or claiming an original-print correction.

The marked final glyphs in ואי'ש חכ'ם יכפרנ'ה are ש, ם and ה, literally שםה. Mapping the final ם to its medial letter identity מ yields שמה, a permutation of משה, but not its ordered spelling. The passage associates the verse with Moshe without asserting that the printed marked glyphs spell משה in order.

The conclusion distinguishes Moshe's prayer for forgiveness, his receiving the Second Tablets and his meriting the radiance of his face. The Tablets are associated with the collective mental faculties of Torah.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואחר יו"כ
units.en: Passage beginning “And after Yom Kippur”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And more is explained in many discourses in his holy books
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, the soundings of the Shofar,
and the general holiness of the month of Tishray.
See also Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 94,
which likewise explains that one must travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ואחר יו"כ is a partial discourse incipit. The historical Rosh HaShanah and Shofar material does not belong to this heading.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואחר יו"כ זוכין לסוכות וסוכה היא בחי' שפע אלהי בחי' המשכת המקיפין אור הפנים וע"כ היו שואבין אז רוח הקודש כי שפע אלהי הנ"ל הוא בחי' רוח הקודש כמבואר הכל בפנים:
units.en: After Yom Kippur one merits Sukkos — and the Sukka is the dimension of the divine abundance, the drawing of encompassing lights, the face of light. And therefore they used to draw the Holy Spirit at that time, for the Divine abundance mentioned above is the dimension of the Holy Spirit, as is fully explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English: Therefore on every Rosh HaShanah — when the matter returns to its primal state — one must engage most intensively in these rectifications: drawing the frontal intellect into the world. And all of this is the dimension of encompassing lights and the face of light. And this is the dimension of the Shofar-sounding and the reddening of the Shofar-blower's face — hinting at the dimension of the face of light.

qualifications.text: The source associates Sukkos and the Sukka with Divine abundance, the drawing of encompassing lights and the face of light. It identifies that abundance with the Holy Spirit.
The supplied passage says that the Holy Spirit was drawn then, without naming Simchas Bais HaShoaiva in this owner. The latter designation from historical English is therefore not imported.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה וזה בחי'
units.en: Passage beginning “And this is the dimension”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And once he said:
"With me, the main thing is Rosh HaShanah" — and also:
"My Rosh HaShanah is a great novelty (chidush) …
not only are you all certainly bound to my Rosh HaShanah,
but even all the world — the entire world — depends upon my Rosh HaShanah."

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה וזה בחי' is a partial discourse incipit only. The historical declaration concerning Rabbainu's Rosh HaShanah is excluded.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וזה בחי' נטילת הד' מינים, אתרוג דומה ללב זה בחי' שלהבת הלב העולה תמיד מאליה ע"י מהירות תנועות השכל של שפע אלה"י בחי' פנים כמובפ"נ, לולב דומה לשדרה שדרך שם נמשכת טיפת המוח מהעלם אל הגילוי היינו מבחי' מקיף למקיף אל בחי' מקיף, הדס דומה לעינים זה בחי' שממשיכין המוחין מבחי' מקיפין לפנימיים שזה בחי' עינים בחי' גל עיני ואביטה נפלאות מתורתך, ערבה דומה לפה זה בחי' מפיו דעת ותבונה כי כשזוכין להשיג המקיפין אז צרים לגלות הארת דעתו גם לאחרים ולהודיע הסגולה לעם סגולה כמבפ"נ וזה א"א כי אם ע"י דברי פיו שעל ידם נתגלה דעתו גם לאחרים מישראל שזה עיקר השלימות כמבואר במ"א, ועי"ז בעצמו זוכה להמשיך מקיפים יותר גבוהים כמבואר בליקוטי תניינא במאמר כי מרחמם ינהגם סימן זיי"ן:
units.en:
This is the dimension of taking the Four Species.

The esrog resembles the heart — the flame of the heart always ascending of itself through the rapid movements of the G-dly intellect in the dimension of face, as explained in the main text.

The lulav resembles the spine — through which the drop of intellect flows from concealment to revelation, namely, from an encompassing light surrounding an encompassing light to an encompassing light.

The hadas resembles the eyes — drawing the mental faculties from encompassing to internalized — the dimension of "open my eyes and I will behold wonders of Your Torah."

The arova resembles the mouth — the dimension of "from His mouth come knowledge and understanding" — for when one merits attaining the encompassing lights, one must reveal the illumination of one's knowledge to others and make known the virtues to G-d's people, as explained in the main text.

This is possible only through words of one's mouth, through which one's knowledge becomes revealed to others among Israel. This is the principal completeness, as explained elsewhere.

Through this itself one merits drawing down still higher encompassing lights, as explained in Likutay Moharan, Part II, in the discourse כי מרחמם ינהגם, Siman 7.

qualifications.text: The Four Species represent the heart's self-ascending flame, the spine's movement of concealed intellect toward encompassing revelation, the eyes' inward attainment and the mouth's disclosure of attained knowledge to others.

The source's lulav sequence is specifically from מקיף למקיף to מקיף — from an encompassing light surrounding an encompassing light into an encompassing light. The inward or internalized stage belongs to the following hadas correspondence, not to the lulav.

The source states that teaching others among Israel through speech is itself a principal completeness and enables the drawing down of still higher encompassing lights, not merely the communication of already internalized intellect.

The closing reference is to Likutay Moharan, Part II, the discourse כי מרחמם ינהגם, Siman 7. The supplied Hebrew incipit is retained without introducing an unbound transliteration or an additional paragraph reference.

units.he: ואח"כ בשמניי עצרת אז הוא זיווגא דמטרוניתא פנים בפנים ואז נמשך על כל ישראל הארה מהשכל העליון שהוא בחי' אור הפנים ואז השמחה וההתלהבות הלב של ישראל גדול מאד בבחי' שלהבת הלב העולה מאליה כנ"ל ואז כל ישראל עולין לתורה כי כולם יש להם חלק בבחי' הפנים לתורה ומסיימין ולא קם נביא עוד בישראל כמשה אשר ידעו ה' פנים אל פינם (שזכה להשיג בשלימות בחי' אור הפנים) וכו' אשר עשה משה לעיני כל ישראל כי האיר הדעת לכל ישראל והודיע הסגולה לעם סגולה, ומתחילין בראשית ותרגומו בחוכמא היינו בזה השכל שהוא בחי' ראשית בחי' קדם ופנים, ורז"ל דרשו בשביל ישראל בשביל התורה ובשביל משה וכו' והכל אחד היינו בשביל המשכת המוחין והחכמה והתגלות הדעת והתורה לישראל בשביל זה היתה כל הבריאה רק שבשביל הבחירה ניתן כח להקליפות והחשך לכסות על המוח שזה בחי' והארץ היתה תהו ובהו וכו' ויאמר א' יהי אור (שיתגלה אור הדעת בעולם) וכו' ויהי ערב ויהי בקר יום אחד בחי' התגלות הדעת שלעתיד לבוא בחי' יום אחד יודע לה' שאז יהיו כולם טוב כולם אחד כמבואר בפנים:
units.en:
On Sh'mini Atzeres — the union of the Matron face to face — a great illumination of the supernal intellect is drawn upon all Israel — the face of light — and the joy and flaming of the heart is exceedingly great, in the dimension of the flame of the heart that ascends of itself, as mentioned above.

And all Israel ascend to the Torah, for they all have a share in the dimension of the faces of Torah.

One concludes, "And there arose no prophet again in Israel like Moshe, whom G-d knew face to face" — for he merited attaining the dimension of the face of light in completeness — etc., "which Moshe performed before the eyes of all Israel." For he illuminated Daas for all Israel and made known the virtues to G-d's chosen people.

And one begins Beraishis, which the Targum renders "With wisdom." That is, with this intellect, which is the dimension of beginning, the dimension of before and face.

Our Sages, z"l, expounded: For the sake of Israel, for the sake of Torah and for the sake of Moshe, etc. All are one: it was for the drawing down of mental faculties and wisdom, and the revelation of Daas and Torah to Israel, that the whole creation came into being.

Only for the sake of free choice was power given to the husks and the darkness to cover the intellect. This is the dimension of "And the earth was formless and void," etc.

"And G-d said: Let there be light" — that the light of Daas should be revealed throughout the world — etc.

"And there was evening and there was morning, one day" — the dimension of the future revelation of Daas, the dimension of "One day known to G-d," when all will be good and all will be one, as explained in the main text.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
The Sages, z"l, could not clarify the exact nature of Teruah — because the drawing of frontal intellect involves both arousing the mental faculties from the dimension of gestation (ibbur) to birth, and also drawing the mental faculties from encompassing (makif) to internalized (p'nimi). Through holy cries and voices one merits the first; through the holiness of the seven lamps one merits the second.

And through the Shofar: through the breath of the Shofar-blower's mouth entering the Shofar, the holiness of the mouth is drawn — for the primary holiness of the mouth is to speak words of truth. And this is what is explained in the Kavanos regarding the breaths of the Shofar — which are in the dimension of seven times Samech-Gimmel (= Emes, truth). And through the awakening of Awe through the Shofar — the dimension of "will the Shofar sound in the city and the people not tremble?" — this is the dimension of the holiness of the nose. And through inclining one's ear to hear the Shofar — this is the holiness of the ears. And through the many tears shed during the Shofar-sounding — the holiness of the eyes. And through all of this one merits the face of light.

Sukkos and Sh'mini Atzeres

After Yom Kippur one merits Sukkos — and the Sukka is the dimension of the divine abundance, the drawing of encompassing lights, the face of light. And therefore they used to draw the Holy Spirit at Simchas Beis HaShoaiva.

The four species: esrog — the heart — the flame of the heart always ascending of itself through the rapid movements of the G-dly intellect in the dimension of face. lulav — the spine — through which the drop of intellect flows from concealment to revelation, from encompassing to encompassing to internalized. hadas — the eyes — drawing the mental faculties from encompassing to internalized — the dimension of "open my eyes and I will behold wonders of Your Torah." arova — the mouth — the dimension of "from His mouth come knowledge and understanding" — for when one merits attaining the encompassing lights, one must reveal the illumination of one's knowledge to others and make known the virtues to G-d's people — which is only possible through words of one's mouth.

On Sh'mini Atzeres — the union of the Matron face to face — a great illumination of the supernal intellect is drawn upon all Israel — the face of light — and the joy and flaming of the heart is exceedingly great. And all Israel ascend to the Torah: "and there arose no prophet in Israel like Moshe, whom G-d knew face to face" — for he merited completely attaining the face of light. And one begins Bereishis — in the wisdom (b'chochma) — for the creation was for the sake of drawing this intellect, this wisdom, this face-to-face encounter into the world.

Translator's Summary — Siman 21
Siman 21 penetrates the deepest level of Rosh HaShanah: the Separation (Nesira) — the cosmic separation of back-to-back into face-to-face — the drawing of the divine frontal intellect into the world. The Shofar and all its associated elements (the breath, the tears, the listening, the reddened face) are a complete sensory meditation on the five gates of holiness — nose, ears, eyes, mouth, face — all activated in the service of drawing the divine face-light into creation. Sh'mini Atzeres = Moshe's face-to-face encounter = the model for all of Israel.

qualifications.text: Sh'mini Atzeres is associated with the face-to-face union, an illumination of supernal intellect for all Israel and the spontaneous flame of the heart. Israel's ascent to Torah is explained through their share in the faces of Torah.

The supplied quotation prints פנים אל פינם, an irregular form in its description of Moshe being known face to face. The English reads it contextually as face to face without changing the Hebrew or claiming a verified original printed form.

The Torah conclusion includes Moshe's own complete attainment of the face of light and his illumination of Daas for all Israel. The English retains the abbreviated transition between the face-to-face quotation and the final reference to what Moshe performed before all Israel.

The interpretation of Beraishis as wisdom and the three purposes of creation — Israel, Torah and Moshe — are united by the source in the drawing of intellect, wisdom, Daas and Torah to Israel. The existence of obscuring husks and darkness is attributed to the allowance for free choice.

The source's concluding one-day interpretation concerns the future revelation of knowledge when all will be good and one. Its biblical fragments remain abbreviated rather than being completed with surrounding canonical verses.

units.he: ידוע כי בר"ה עוסקין ישראל בבנין קומת השכינה כביכול ולהמתיק כל הדינין והגבורות שבה שזה בחי' שמעלין אותה מבחי' שנקאת צדק (שמשם התעוררות הדינים בבחי' והוא ישפוט תבל בצדק) לבחי' אמונה שאז נמתקין כל הדינים וכל טיבו ולכ נהירו שריא באה כמובא במאמר תתן אמת ליעקב סימן פ"ז, והנה אמוננ איתקריאת כד אתחבר בה אמת שהוא בחי' יעקב בחי' אור הפנים כמבפ"נ וזה בחי' יום תרועה יהיה לכם ומבואר בזוה"ק שתרועה היא בחי' יעקב, וזה בחי' יום תרועה יהיה לכם ומבואר בזוה"ק שתרועה היא בחי' יעקב, וזה בחי' אשרי העם יודעי תרועה ה' באור פניך יהלכון כי ממשיכין עי"ז בחי' אור הפנים, וזה בשמך יגילון כל היום וכו' כי אור הפנים הוא בחי' שמחה ועיכ"ז נמתקין כל הדינים ונכתבין לחיים בבחי' באור פני מלך חיים גם זוכין לפרנסה דקדושה שנמשכת מבחי' אמת בחי' אור הפנים כמבפ"נ, כי ר"ה הוא יומא דדינא של כל השנה והנה דרז"ל על פסוק והיה אמונת עתיך וכו' ששואלין את האדם בתחילת הדין נשאת ונתת באמונה וע,כ גם בר"ה צריכין להמשיך התיקון של בחי' משא ומתן באמונהשבמשא ומתן כזה ובפרנסה כזאת מאיר בה בחי' אור הפנים (ועיין גם במאמר אשרי העם זרקא סימן ל"ה) וזוה שארז"ל שתרועה אותיות תורה עיין בחי' עיין פנים לתורה שהם בחי' אנפין נהירין היפוך תאוות ממון שהיא כלולה מכל הע' אנפין חשוכין כמובן בפנים ועיין במאמר בקרוב סיןמ ל"ו וסימן, ק"א, ומחמת שעיקר תיקון זה זוכין ע"י תיקון הברית שזה בחי' מצות מילה ודם הברית כמבפ"נ ע"כ מבואר בשו"ע שכשיש מילה בר"ה מלין קודם תקיעת שופר ומובא שם בשם גדול אחד שלא היה רוחץ אז את פניו מדם המילהותקע כך בכדי לערב זכות דם המילה עם השופר היינו כנ"ל, ומחמת שעיקר שלימות תיקון הברית הוא רק אצל הצדיקי אמת ע"כ צריכין לבוא לצדיקי אמת על ר"ה או עכ"פ להתפלל על בקרי צדיקים בערב ר"ה שזה ג"כ בחי' תיקון הברית שעי"ז ממשיכין בחי' מלח להמתיק הדינין שבבחי' צדק עד שנשתלשל מזה גם למטה בעוה"ז המתקה לבחי' מרירותא דעלמא שממררין בני אדם את חייהם בדאגות על הפרנסה ובטירדות תאוות ממון, וע"כ נוהגין כל ישראל להרבו תאז בצדקה כיעי"ז משברין תאוות ממון שזה בחי' מלח ממון חסר ואיכא דאמרי חסד כמבואר במ"א וכמבואר במאמר אשרי השגחה סימן י"ג, וזה בחי' תשובה תפלה וצדקה מעבירין את רוע הגזירה ונתנו ע"ז הקדמונים סימן צום קול ממון כי עיקר צריכין בימים הללו להמשיך בחי' ביטול תאוות ממון ולהעביר את רוע הגזריה שנמשך ח"ו ע"י התגברות תאוות ממון שהיא בחי' עבודה זרה שכלולה מכל השבעים מיני עבודות זרות שבשביל זה השכינה כביכול צועקת ק"מ קלין על אלו הנופלין בתאוות ממון כמבפ"נ וכל זמן שיש ע"ז הזאת בעולם חרון אף בעולם ח"ו ובימים אלו אנו עסוקין לתקן זאת ע"י תשובה תפלה וצדקה שהם בחי' צום קול ממון כנ"ל. וזה בחי' שברים תרועה כי כמו שבהתגברות תאוות ממון ח"ו ובימים אלו אנו עוסקין לתקן זאת ע"י תשובה תפלה וצדקה שהם בחי' צום קול ממון כנ"ל. וזה בחי' שברים תרועה כי כמו שבהתגברות תאוות ממון ח"ו אזי קשה לו מאד קודם שמוליד השפע ואח"כ גם אחר שנולד השפע והפרנסה אזי מתגבר עליו הדאגה והעצבון ביותר בבחי' מרבה נכסים מרבה דאגה כמבפ"נ, ואפשר שמחמת זה צועקת השכינה שני מיני קולות היינו כנגד שני הבחינות הנ"ל, וע"כ גם בקול שופר שעי"ז מתקנין זאת צריכין ג"כ לשני מניי קולות, וזה תקעו בחודש שופר וכו' כי חק לישראל הוא ודרז"ל חק לישנא דמזונא כי כל מזונותיו של אדם קצובות לו מר"ה, היינו כי בתקיעת שופר ממשיכין תיקון המזונות והפרנסה לידע כי הכל קצוב לו מר"ה ברצונו ית' וזה משפט לאלהי יעקב כי אז נתחבר צדק ומשפט שעי"ז נמתק מרירותא דעלמא כמבואר בזוהר ויחי דף רמ"א ע"ב על פסוק כי כאשר משפטיך לארץ צדק למדו יושבי תבל וכתיב צדק ומשפט מכון כסאך עיי"ש, וזה בחי' יעקב שהוא בחי' עמודא דאמצעיתא בחי' משפט ובחי' אמת שעי"ז המלכות בחי' צדק נקראת אמונה כד איתחבר בה אמת כנ"ל, ועי"ז נתקנת הפרנסה שלא תהיה בבחי' תאוות ממון שזה בחי' עושה עושר ולא במשפט וכו':
units.en:
It is known that on Rosh HaShanah Israel are engaged in building the structure (koma) of the Divine Presence, as it were, and in sweetening all the judgments and severe attributes (gevuros) within her — elevating her from the dimension called Righteousness (Tzedek) — from which the judgments are aroused, in the dimension of "And He shall judge the world with righteousness" — to the dimension of Faith (Emuna) — where all judgments are sweetened and all goodness and light dwells there. As brought in the discourse תתן אמת ליעקב, Siman 87. And Faith is called this when Truth — the dimension of Yaakov — combines with it, the dimension of the face of light, as is explained in the main text.

This is the dimension of "A day of Teruah shall it be for you," and it is explained in the holy Zohar that Teruah is the dimension of Yaakov.

This is the dimension of "A day of Teruah shall it be for you," and it is explained in the holy Zohar that Teruah is the dimension of Yaakov.

And this is: "fortunate is the people who know the Teruah — G-d, in the light of Your face they shall walk" — for through this one draws the dimension of the face of light. And in Your Name they shall rejoice all day — for the face of light is the dimension of joy. And through this all judgments are sweetened and one is inscribed for life — the dimension of "in the light of the King's countenance is life." Also one merits holy sustenance flowing from the dimension of Truth — the face of light, as is explained in the main text. For Rosh HaShanah is the Day of Judgment for the entire year, and the Sages, z"l, expounded on the verse "and there shall be faithfulness of your times" [Is. 33:6]: the first question asked of a person in the initial judgment is: "Did you conduct your business in faith?" Therefore on Rosh HaShanah one must also draw the rectification of the dimension of conducting business in faith — for in such business dealings the face of light shines.

See also the discourse אשרי העם זרקא, Siman 35.

This is what our Sages, z"l, said: Teruah contains the letters of Torah and Ayin, the dimension of the seventy faces of Torah, which are the illuminated faces — the opposite of the lust for money, which includes all seventy darkened faces, as may be understood from the main text. See the discourse בקרוב, Siman 36, and Siman 101.

Because the essential rectification of this is accomplished through the guarding of the Bris — the dimension of the mitzvah of circumcision — and the blood of the covenant, as is explained in the main text — it is explained in the Shulchan Aruch that when there is a circumcision on Rosh HaShanah, one circumcises before the Shofar-sounding. And a great one taught that he would not wash the blood of circumcision from his face and would sound the Shofar in that state — in order to combine the merit of the blood of circumcision with the Shofar. And because the essential completeness of guarding the Bris is only with the true Tzadikim, one must come to the true Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah — or at least to pray at the graves of Tzadikim on Erev Rosh HaShanah.

This too is the dimension of rectifying the covenant, through which one draws the dimension of salt to sweeten the judgments of the dimension of Tzedek. From this there develops, even below in this world, a sweetening of the bitterness of the world, through which people embitter their lives with worries over their livelihood and the burdens of the lust for money.

And therefore all Israel customarily greatly increase charity at that time — for through charity one breaks the lust for money. This is the dimension of "The salt of money is diminution," and some say "kindness," as explained elsewhere and in the discourse אשרי השגחה, Siman 13.

And this is the dimension of "Repentance, prayer, and charity remove the evil decree." The early authorities gave the mnemonic: Tzom — Kol — Mamon [Fast — Voice — Money]. For the principal task during these days is to draw down the nullification of the lust for money and to remove the evil decree, which is drawn down, heaven forbid, through the intensification of the lust for money.

For the lust for money is a dimension of idolatry that includes all seventy kinds of idolatry. Because of this, the Divine Presence, as it were, cries out with one hundred and forty cries over those who fall into the lust for money, as explained in the main text. As long as this idolatry remains in the world, divine anger remains in the world, heaven forbid. During these days we engage in rectifying this through repentance, prayer and charity, which are the dimensions of Tzom, Kol and Mamon, as explained above.

This is the dimension of Sh'vorim and Teruah, for just as when the lust for money intensifies, heaven forbid, during these days we engage in rectifying this through repentance, prayer and charity, which are the dimensions of Tzom, Kol and Mamon, as explained above.

This is the dimension of Sh'vorim and Teruah, for just as when the lust for money intensifies, heaven forbid, it becomes exceedingly difficult for a person before the abundance is brought forth, and afterward, even when the abundance and livelihood have been brought forth, worry and sadness prevail over him all the more, in the dimension of "One who increases possessions increases worry," as explained in the main text.

It is possible that because of this the Divine Presence cries out with two kinds of voices, corresponding to the two dimensions mentioned above. Therefore the sound of the Shofar, through which this is rectified, likewise requires two kinds of sounds.

This is "Sound the Shofar at the new moon," etc., "For it is a statute for Israel." Our Sages, z"l, expounded that 'statute' is an expression denoting sustenance, for all of a person's provisions are allotted to him from Rosh HaShanah.

That is, through Shofar-sounding one draws down the rectification of food and livelihood, to know that everything is allotted to a person from Rosh HaShanah according to His will, Yisburach.

And this is "A judgment for the G-d of Yaakov," for then Tzedek and Mishpat are joined, through which the bitterness of the world is sweetened, as explained in the Zohar, Vayechi, page 241b, concerning the verse "For when Your judgments are upon the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness," and as it is written, "Righteousness and judgment are the foundation of Your throne." See there.

This is the dimension of Yaakov, who is the middle pillar, the dimension of Mishpat and the dimension of Truth. Through this Malchus, the dimension of Tzedek, is called Faith when Truth is joined with it, as explained above.

Through this livelihood is rectified so that it should not be in the dimension of the lust for money, which is the dimension of "He who makes wealth, but not through judgment," etc.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
On Rosh HaShanah We Engage in Building the Structure of the Divine Presence

It is known that on Rosh HaShanah Israel are engaged in building the structure (koma) of the Divine Presence, and in sweetening all the judgments and severe attributes (gevuros) within her — elevating her from the dimension called Righteousness (Tzedek) — from which the judgments are aroused — to the dimension of Faith (Emuna) — where all judgments are sweetened and all goodness and light dwells there. As brought in the discourse Titen Emes L'Yaakov, Siman 87. And Faith is called this when Truth — the dimension of Yaakov — combines with it, the dimension of the face of light, as is explained in the main text.

qualifications.text: The source associates the building of the Divine Presence, qualified by כביכול, with elevating Tzedek, the source of aroused judgments, to Emuna through the joining of Truth, identified with Yaakov and the face of light. It cites the discourse תתן אמת ליעקב, Siman 87.

The full statement וזה בחי' יום תרועה יהיה לכם ומבואר בזוה"ק שתרועה היא בחי' יעקב occurs twice consecutively in the supplied Hebrew. Both occurrences are retained in the English rather than deduplicated.

The passage connects illuminated faces with joy, inscription for life, holy livelihood and conducting business faithfully. It gives the discourse references אשרי העם זרקא, Siman 35; בקרוב, Siman 36; and Siman 101, without supplying additional subsection references.

The printed תרועה אותיות תורה עיין connects Teruah with Torah and the eye or seventy faces of Torah. The full spelling עיין is not numerically seventy and cannot be added as a complete word to תורה to form a literal letter permutation of תרועה. The contextual association with the single letter ע and seventy illuminated faces is retained without changing the Hebrew.

The circumcision instruction is conditional on a circumcision taking place on Rosh HaShanah. The account of an eminent person leaving circumcision blood upon his face while sounding the Shofar is reported as that person's practice, not as a universal requirement.

The supplied על בקרי צדיקים is irregular in the reference to Erev Rosh HaShanah prayer. The context supports a reading of prayer at the graves of Tzadikim; the Hebrew is not emended and no original-print correction is claimed.

The text connects covenantal rectification with salt and the sweetening of livelihood-related bitterness. It explicitly gives two formulations of the salt-of-money teaching, חסר and חסד, represented respectively as diminution and kindness, and cites אשרי השגחה, Siman 13.

The early mnemonic צום קול ממון corresponds to fasting, voice and money in the repentance-prayer-charity passage. The one hundred and forty cries of the Divine Presence are indicated by ק"מ and are described with the source's כביכול qualification.

The source repeats the repentance-prayer-charity and Tzom-Kol-Mamon language in its transition to Sh'vorim and Teruah. The first transition ends incompletely before the Sh'vorim-and-Teruah opening is repeated. Both printed transitions are retained; neither is treated as an additional completed argument.

The text distinguishes difficulty before livelihood emerges from increased anxiety after livelihood is obtained. The explanation of two kinds of cries is expressly introduced by ואפשר, 'It is possible,' and is not asserted as certain.

The closing connection between Tzedek and Mishpat is attributed to Zohar Vayechi, page רמ"א ע"ב, 241b. The supplied abbreviated Shofar and biblical quotations are not completed beyond their printed scope.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה וזה אמרו
units.en: Passage beginning “And this is what they said”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
Aleph-Hay [abbreviation: א״ה = "with G-d's help"]:
It is explained in the words of our holy Rebbe, the Light of Lights,
Mohara"n, z"l — in many places in his holy book
Likutay Mohara"n and in his holy conversations —
regarding the topic of the wondrous rectifications (tikkunim nifloim)
that are accomplished by those who come to the true Tzadik
on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה וזה אמרו is a partial discourse incipit only. The historical introductory account is excluded.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: וזה אמרו לפני מלכיות כדי שתמליכוני עליכם כי הפרנסה והעשירות הוא בחי' מלכות בחי' עשיר ברשים ימשול אבל צריכין לידע כי כל העושר והכבוד מלפניו ית' והוא מושל בכל כי עיקר הפרנסה דקדושה נמשכת מבחי' המלכות דקדושה כמבואר בזוהר תרומה דף קנ"ג וכמובא בדבריו ז"ל בליקות"נ סימן ז', וזה זכרונות כדי שיבוא זכרוניכם לפני לטובה היינו שימתקו כל הדינים המתעוררין ח"ו ע"י תאוות ממון ויתהפכו לרחמים, גם זכרונות מרמז על בחי' ברית בחי' יזכור לעולם בריתו ונאמר זכר צדיק לברכה שעי"ז נמתק מרירות דאגת הפרנסה כנ,ל וזה ובמה בשופר כי בר"ה ממשיכןי כ"ז ע"י השופר וע"כ מזכירין פסוקי שופר של מתן תורה וקיבוץ גליות כי ע"י שמבטלין תאוות ממון בלח' אנפין נהירין עי"ז זוכין לעין פנים לתורה שהם בחי' אמת כ"ש אמת קנה וארז,ל אין אמת אלא תורה, וזוכין לקיבוץ גליות היינו לצאת מהגלות של ע' עממין וכ"ז זוכין ע"י השופר שעי"זממשיכין אור האמת בחי' בחי' שופריה דיעקב כידוע ומעוררין בחי' השופר הגדול שהיא בחי' בינה לבא ששם שורש האמת בחי' ודובר אמת בלבבו ועי"ז נתבטלין האנפין חשוכין של תאוות ממון בבחי' לב מבין דתמן צדיק אישתזיב מינה כמבפ"נ היינו לב מבין דייקא בחי' בינה לבא כנ"ל:
units.en:
"Say Malchuyos so that you crown Me over you" — for livelihood and wealth are of the dimension of kingship, in the dimension of "The rich rules over the poor." But one must know that all wealth and honor come from Him, Yisburach, and that He rules over everything, for the principal holy livelihood is drawn from holy Malchus, as explained in Zohar Terumah, page 153, and as brought in his words, z"l, in Likutay Moharan, Part II, Siman 7.

"Zichronos — so that your remembrance ascends before Me for good" — that all the judgments which are aroused, heaven forbid, through the lust for money should be sweetened and transformed into compassion.

Zichronos also alludes to the dimension of the covenant, in the dimension of "He shall remember His covenant forever," and as it is said, "The remembrance of the righteous is for blessing." Through this the bitterness of worry over livelihood is sweetened, as explained above.

"Through what? Through the Shofar" — for on Rosh HaShanah all this is drawn down through the Shofar. Therefore one mentions verses of Shofar concerning the Giving of the Torah and the ingathering of exiles.

For through nullifying the lust for money in the dimension of illuminated faces, one merits the seventy faces of Torah, which are the dimension of Truth, as it is written, "Buy Truth," and as our Sages, z"l, taught, "There is no Truth except Torah."

One also merits the ingathering of exiles, meaning emergence from the exile of the seventy nations. All this is attained through the Shofar, through which one draws down the light of Truth, the dimension of the beauty of Yaakov, as is known.

Through this one awakens the dimension of the Great Shofar, which is the dimension of Bina, the heart, where Truth has its root, in the dimension of "And he speaks Truth in his heart."

Through this the darkened faces of the lust for money are nullified, in the dimension of "An understanding heart, from which the Tzadik is saved," as explained in the main text. That is, specifically an understanding heart, the dimension of Bina, the heart, as explained above.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And this is the dimension of "a day of Teruah shall it be for you" — as explained in the Zohar, Teruah is the dimension of Yaakov. And this is: "fortunate is the people who know the Teruah — G-d, in the light of Your face they shall walk" — for through this one draws the dimension of the face of light. And in Your Name they shall rejoice all day — for the face of light is the dimension of joy. And through this all judgments are sweetened and one is inscribed for life — the dimension of "in the light of the King's countenance is life." Also one merits holy sustenance flowing from the dimension of Truth — the face of light, as is explained in the main text. For Rosh HaShanah is the Day of Judgment for the entire year, and the Sages, z"l, expounded on the verse "and there shall be faithfulness of your times" [Is. 33:6]: the first question asked of a person in the initial judgment is: "Did you conduct your business in faith?" Therefore on Rosh HaShanah one must also draw the rectification of the dimension of conducting business in faith — for in such business dealings the face of light shines.

Charity and the Mitzvah of Circumcision — Before the Shofar

Because the essential rectification of this is accomplished through the guarding of the Bris — the dimension of the mitzvah of circumcision — and the blood of the covenant, as is explained in the main text — it is explained in the Shulchan Aruch that when there is a circumcision on Rosh HaShanah, one circumcises before the Shofar-sounding. And a great one taught that he would not wash the blood of circumcision from his face and would sound the Shofar in that state — in order to combine the merit of the blood of circumcision with the Shofar. And because the essential completeness of guarding the Bris is only with the true Tzadikim, one must come to the true Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah — or at least to pray at the graves of Tzadikim on Erev Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: Malchuyos is connected with livelihood and wealth as manifestations of kingship, while the source insists that wealth and honor come from G-d and that holy livelihood is drawn from holy Malchus, not merely from human economic power.
The passage cites Zohar Terumah, page קנ"ג, 153, and ליקות"נ סימן ז', contextually Likutay Moharan, Part II, Siman 7. No unprinted subsection or column designation is introduced.

Zichronos is associated both with transforming judgments arising through money-desire into mercy and with remembrance of the covenant and of the Tzadik, through which livelihood-related worry is sweetened. The supplied text does not introduce the Akaidah into this paragraph.

The supplied בלח' אנפין נהירין is irregular in the link between nullifying money-desire and attaining the seventy faces of Torah. The English follows the contextual reference to illuminated faces without assigning an unsupported numerical value to בלח' or changing the Hebrew.

The Shofar is associated with the Giving of Torah, the ingathering of exiles, the seventy faces of Torah and the Great Shofar of Bina. The source connects Yaakov's beauty, Truth in the heart and the understanding heart with the nullification of money-desire's darkened faces.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואח"כ עוסקין
units.en: Passage beginning “And afterward they engage”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 1, in the discourse Tik'u Mimshola
["Blow the Shofar of Sovereignty"], it is explained regarding the great Tzadikim,
who are in the dimension (bechia) of being the Place of the World
— and they are able to perform the [spiritual work of] Rosh HaShanah.
And in the discourse Tik'u Emuna, Siman 5,
much is explained regarding the wondrous rectifications
that are wrought through the gathering of the disciples near the true Rebbe —
and the primary time of gathering is on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ואח"כ עוסקין is a partial discourse incipit. The historical material about other Likutay Moharan teachings does not belong to this heading.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואח"כ עוסקין בתשובה בכל ימי התשובה ועיקר התשובה הוא לצאת מחושך לאור מאנפין חשוכין לבחינת אפנין ניהירן שהם עיקר החיים בחי' באור פני מלךם חיים כנ"ל וזה בחי' שובו וחיו וצועקין בקולות הרבה ומרבין בצדקה עד שזוכין לקדושת יו"כ ואז נמשכין האנפין נהירין בשלימות כמו שדרז"ל באור פניך יהלכון זה יו"כ וכו' ואז נתצרה השי"ת לישראל ומחל להם על עוון העגל שהוא בחי' הע"ז של ממון בחי' ויעשו להם אלהי זהב, ונתן להם הלוחות שניות שהם כלל התורה הק' הכלולה מע' אנפין נהירין:
units.en:
Afterward one engages in repentance throughout all the Days of Repentance. The principal repentance is to emerge from darkness into light, from darkened faces to illuminated faces, which are the principal life, in the dimension of "In the light of the King's countenance is life," as explained above.

This is the dimension of "Return and live." One cries out with many voices and greatly increases charity until one merits the holiness of Yom Kippur.

Then the illuminated faces are drawn down in completeness, as our Sages, z"l, expounded, "In the light of Your face they shall walk" — this is Yom Kippur, etc.

Then G-d, Yisburach, was reconciled with Israel and forgave them for the sin of the Golden Calf, which is the dimension of the idolatry of money, in the dimension of "And they made for themselves gods of gold."

And He gave them the Second Tablets, which comprise the entire holy Torah, encompassing the seventy illuminated faces.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And therefore all Israel customarily greatly increase charity at that time — for through charity one breaks the lust for money, which is the dimension of sweetening the judgments. And this is the dimension of repentance, prayer, and charity remove the evil decree — and the early authorities gave the mnemonic: Tzom — Kol — Mamon [Fast — Voice — Money] — for this is the essential work of these days.

The Three Blessings — Malchuyos, Zichronos, Shofaros

qualifications.text: Repentance during the Days of Repentance is portrayed as a movement from darkened faces to illuminated faces, the source's principal dimension of life. Crying out and increased charity lead toward the complete illumination of Yom Kippur.

The source links Yom Kippur with G-d's reconciliation with Israel, forgiveness of the Golden Calf and the Second Tablets. It interprets the calf as the dimension of the idolatry of money and the Tablets as encompassing the seventy illuminated faces of Torah.

The supplied באור פני מלךם חיים has an irregular מלךם. The English reads the surrounding life-and-illuminated-face expression contextually without altering the Hebrew or claiming an original printed correction.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ד"ה ואחר יו"כ
units.en: Passage beginning “And after Yom Kippur”

history.earlier_supplied_English:
And more is explained in many discourses in his holy books
regarding the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, the soundings of the Shofar,
and the general holiness of the month of Tishray.
See also Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 94,
which likewise explains that one must travel to Tzadikim on Rosh HaShanah.

qualifications.text: The supplied ד"ה ואחר יו"כ is a partial discourse incipit, not an authorization to import the historical Shofar blessings, Sukkos heading or subsequent Sh'mini Atzeres discussion.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.

units.he: ואחר יו"כ זוכין לסוכות זמן שמחתינו בחי' שובע שמחות את פניך הנאמר על סוכות כמו שדרז"ל ואז נכנסין לסוכה שהוא בחי' מקיפין בחי' אור הפנים כמובן במאמר עתיקא סי' כ"א וזה סוכה אותיות כ"ו ה"ס בחי' יחוד אמת ואמונה כידוע, ועל כן מקריבין אז ע' פרים כדי לבטל כל מניי אנפין חשוכין של כל הע' עממין כמו שארז"ל שמתמעטין והולכין כפרי החג, וע"כ לעתיד לבוא יהי מפלת או"ה ע"י הניסיון של מצוות סוכה כשארז"ל כי זה בחי' ויגרש מפניך אויב ויאמר השמד כי מצות סוכה היאבחי' אור הפנים דקדושה כנ"ל, וזה שארז"ל שיאמר להם הקב"ה מצוה קלה יש לי וסוכה שמה לכו ועשו אותה וכו' ולמה נקרא שמה מצוה קלה יש לי שאיןבה חסרון כיס היינו שיאמר להם נהי שאתם רחוקים מאור הפנים דקדושה ומשוקעים בתאוות ממון שהיא הע"ז כל הע' אומו עכ"פ אראה אם תקיימו מצות סוכה שהיא מצוה קלה שאין בה חסרון כיס, וגם מבואר בסוף המאמר שמצוה שהאדם עושה בלא ממון שאינו רוצה להפסיד ממון עליה המוה הזאת היא נקרא תצדק, וכשעושה מצוה ומפזר ממונו עליה זו המצוה נקראת אמונה כי אמונה כד אתחבר בה אמת וכו' וע"כ יאמר להם הקב"ה אם אתם רוצים באמת לקבל עליכם קדושת התורה והמצוות ולהיות בבחי' גרי (מכאן עד סוף הספר חסר, חבל על דאבדין, וברוך הוא וברוך שמו על פליטה הנשארת) ב"ה, דבר בעתו מה טוב, על כן אמרתי להסמיך לכאן ולצרף קונטרס זה פה, אשר בו מבואר היטב בעזה"י לדעת לאנ"ש כדת מה לעשות בצוק העתים האלו בענין הנסיעה לצדיקים אמתיים על ימי ראש השנה הקדושים, וכבר נדפסו דברים אל ובקונטרס בפני עצמו בשנת תש"ו לפ"ק פעיה"ק ירושלים תובב"א, ועכשיו נדפס עוד פעם בשתנת תבואי תשורי מראש אמנה לפ"ק.
units.en:
After Yom Kippur one merits Sukkos — the season of our joy — the dimension of "a fullness of joys is in Your presence" [Ps. 16:11] said of Sukkos, as the Sages, z"l, expounded. One enters the Sukka — the dimension of the encompassing lights, the face of light, as understood in Siman 21. And the Sukka is in the numerical dimension of the unification of the two holy Names Havaya and Adnay — the unification of Truth and Faith, as is known. And therefore seventy bulls are brought corresponding to the seventy nations — to nullify all types of darkened face of the seventy nations, as our Sages, z"l, said, for they diminish progressively like the bulls of the festival.

And for the future, the fall of the nations will be through the test of the mitzvah of Sukka, as our Sages, z"l, taught. This is the dimension of "And He shall drive the enemy from before you and say: Destroy," for the mitzvah of Sukka is the dimension of the holy face of light, as explained above.

This is what our Sages, z"l, said: The Blessed Holy One will tell them, "I have an easy mitzvah, and its name is Sukka; go and perform it," etc. Why is it called an easy mitzvah? Because it entails no financial loss.

That is, He will say to them: Although you are distant from the holy face of light and immersed in the lust for money, which is the idolatry of all seventy nations, nevertheless I shall see whether you will fulfill the mitzvah of Sukka, an easy mitzvah that involves no financial loss.

It is also explained at the end of the discourse that a mitzvah which a person performs without money, being unwilling to lose money over it, is called Tzedek. But when one performs a mitzvah and spends one's money upon it, that mitzvah is called Emuna, for Faith is so called when Truth joins with it, etc.

Therefore the Blessed Holy One will say to them: If you truly wish to accept upon yourselves the holiness of Torah and mitzvos and to be in the dimension of 'conver—'

(From here until the end of the book the text is missing. Woe for what has been lost, and blessed is He and blessed is His Name for the remnant that has survived.)

Blessed be G-d. "How good is a word spoken in its time." Therefore I said to place here and attach this pamphlet, in which, with G-d's help, it is thoroughly explained for Anash what is proper to do in these difficult times concerning traveling to the true Tzadikim for the holy days of Rosh HaShanah.

These matters were already printed in a separate pamphlet in the year 5706 according to the customary reckoning, here in the holy city of Yerushalayim, may it be rebuilt and established speedily in our days, Amen. And now it is printed once again in the year "תבואי תשורי מראש אמנה" according to the customary reckoning.

history.earlier_supplied_English:
"Say Malchuyos so that you crown Me over you" — the dimension of building Malchus from the holy Torah combinations, elevating her to the dimension of Faith — sweetening Righteousness with Truth. "Zichronos — so that your remembrance ascends before Me for good" — sweetening all the judgments that intensify through the lust for money — the dimension of "remember His loving-kindness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel." And the Zichronos blessing mentions the merit of the Akaidah of Yitzchok — which sweetens the judgments at their root. "Through what? Through the Shofar" — for through the Shofar all the above is drawn, and one recites in the Shofaros blessing verses from the Giving of the Torah and from the ingathering of exiles. For through nullifying the lust for money — from the illuminated face (anpin nehirin) — one merits the seventy faces of Torah and the ingathering of exiles.

Sukkos and Sh'mini Atzeres

After Yom Kippur one merits Sukkos — the season of our joy — the dimension of "a fullness of joys is in Your presence" [Ps. 16:11] said of Sukkos, as the Sages, z"l, expounded. One enters the Sukka — the dimension of the encompassing lights, the face of light, as understood in Siman 21. And the Sukka is in the numerical dimension of the unification of the two holy Names Havaya and Adnay — the unification of Truth and Faith, as is known. And therefore seventy bulls are brought corresponding to the seventy nations — to nullify all types of darkened face of the seventy nations. And for the future, the fall of the nations will be through the test of the mitzvah of Sukka.

On Sh'mini Atzeres — the union of the Matron — honor ascends to its root in completeness — and all Israel give honor to the Torah and ascend to the Torah. And one concludes with the breaking of the Tablets, for when the face of holiness was in exile among the nations — when Israel blemished through the Golden Calf — Moshe shattered the Tablets. Afterward, through great prayer, he sweetened the anger and received the Second Tablets on Yom Kippur. And immediately one begins Bereishis — the Messiah's spirit which will elevate the honor from the lowliness of exile and draw all the rectifications to completion.

The author notes: From here to the end of the book, text is missing — lost to us. He writes: "Blessed is He and Blessed is His Name for what has been preserved." He adds: "A word spoken in its time — how good it is" — and includes at the end an appended pamphlet explaining to the Breslov community the proper conduct during the difficult times regarding the journey to the true Tzadikim on the holy days of Rosh HaShanah — which was previously published separately in Jerusalem in 5706 and is now reprinted.

Translator's Summary — Siman 23 (and Conclusion)
The final complete Siman reveals that honest, faithful business dealings are themselves a portal to the divine face-light (anpin nehirin) — the opposite of money-lust's darkened face (anpin chashuchin). The Shofar, circumcision, charity, and honest trade all serve to extract the divine face from its exile within worldly commerce. The book concludes with an editorial note: the final portion of the text was lost ("chaveil al d'avdin" — "woe for what is lost!"). What remains is immeasurably precious. May the merit of Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman illuminate even what is hidden.

— End of Complete Translation: Yerech HaAisonim — All 23 Simanim —

Translated in the merit of Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman

"Blessed is He and Blessed is His Name for what has been preserved."

May all the words of the holy Torah bring us ever closer to the Master of the World.

May we merit to be by the Rebbe on every Rosh HaShanah — in Uman — forever. Amen.

qualifications.text: The Sukka is associated with encompassing lights and the face of light, with a reference to Siman 21. The supplied סוכה אותיות כ"ו ה"ס preserves the order of the letter groups כ"ו and ה"ס, whose numerical values are 26 and 65. Together they equal 91, the numerical value of סוכה. The source connects this with the unification of Truth and Faith; the historical holy-Names interpretation is contextual rather than a printed spelling of the Names in this passage.

The seventy bulls are connected with the progressive diminution of the darkened faces of the seventy nations. The future Sukka trial is presented as a teaching of the Sages, with the enemy-removal quotation retained in its abbreviated source form.

The trial is explicitly described as involving an easy mitzvah without financial loss, despite the nations' attachment to money-desire. The text subsequently distinguishes a mitzvah performed without willingness to lose money, called Tzedek, from a mitzvah on which one spends money, called Emuna. The supplied תצדק is read contextually as the Tzedek label; the source does not print צדק at that position, and the Hebrew is neither emended nor claimed to have an original-print correction. These characterizations are retained without adding an unprinted rule about the actual cost of constructing a Sukka.

The supplied argument stops at להיות בבחי' גרי immediately before the explicit notice of missing text. The English represents this as an unfinished expression and does not complete it to גירי צדק, a full conversion category or any reconstructed continuation.

The parenthetical מכאן עד סוף הספר חסר announces that the text from this point to the end of the book is missing. Its lament over what has been lost and blessing over the surviving remnant are retained as part of the supplied source, not replaced by a translator's summary.

After the lacuna notice, an editorial announcement beginning ב"ה, דבר בעתו מה טוב introduces an attached pamphlet for Anash about traveling to true Tzadikim for Rosh HaShanah during difficult times. It announces and describes the pamphlet but does not reproduce its contents.

The announcement says the pamphlet had previously been printed separately in Yerushalayim in תש"ו, corresponding to Hebrew year 5706. The later reprint date is presented through the printed phrase תבואי תשורי מראש אמנה. That phrase is retained exactly without assigning an unmarked numeric year or a Gregorian date.

The historical English contains a Sh'mini Atzeres and Tablets paragraph, translator summaries, closing blessings and an 'End of Complete Translation' statement without corresponding Hebrew in this owner. These are excluded. The explicit lacuna precludes claiming a complete surviving original book text.
The current English follows the Hebrew shown here. Earlier supplied English is kept separately for comparison.
